dus 'khor don du gnyer nas bal po mthil du byon/ paṇa chen sa man+ta shrī lo lnga zla brgyad zhag lnga bar ma chad par bsten/ dbang bshad man ngag bum pa gang byor gnang / bod du gdan drangs nas bsgyur bshad gtan la phab nas gser srang brgya phul/ skye ma skyid grong bar du byas pas paṇ+ḍi ta dges te/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i phrog zhu/ chags lham rdor dril dus 'khor lugs kyi phyag tshad ma dang bcas pa gnang ngo / /ra chos rab des nub mda' rdo can du bzhugs so/ /de'i sras ra ye shes seng ge de'i sras ra 'bum seng rnams kyang rim par bum pa gang byor mkhyen no/ /de la rong pa sga los zhus te/ 'di ni bod chos rgyal gyi dus su rgya nag nas hwa shang spyan drangs pa'i zla la mi nyag hwa shang gcig yong ba rgyal po'i mchod gnas su gyur pa nas bzung ste/ sngags 'chang bar ma chad pa'i brgyud pa la yar 'brog sgang du mi nyag gzhon nu snying po zhes bya ba byung / de'i sras gzhon nu seng ge de'i sras rig 'dzin snying po des rong gi rgya ma kha bzung / de'i sras rdo rje seng ge rong mkhar phug bzung / de'i sras rje btsun sga lo yin/ mtshan ltas la brten nas sngon gyi khams pa sga lo'i skye bar yab kyis dgongs nas mtshan du yang de ka grags/ dgung lo gsum tsam gyi dus su kha che paṇa chen ngur smrig tu byon pa'i drung du ma gcig skyid mos bsnams nas byin rlabs zhus pas/ dbu la phyag gis bzhams/ saṃ skri ta'i skad du dbugs dbyung zhing byin gyis brlabs pas/ skye bo kun gyi skyes bu dam par 'gyur bar thag bcad do/ /yab kyi drung du mngon pa dang / mdo sde dang / man ngag mang du gsan/ dpyal chos bzang gi drung du rgya klog dang / rgya yig dang / saṃ skṛ ta'i skad dang / khyad par dges phag gnyis la sbyangs/ dgung lo drug pa la ngur smrig tu bshad gsar mdzad nas dges phag gsungs/ gzhan yang nā ro 'grel chen dang bde mchog gzhung 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/

bde mchog gi dbang zhus dus su dkyil 'khor kyi dbus nas ngo mtshar ba'i sgra thos/ shangs khrag zags shing zag par rmis nas sdig sgrib dag lus bde/ shes rab gsal bar gyur/ khyad par gshed dmar gyi dbang zhus dus su bdud kyi bar chad las thar te/ 'di ltar dang por ngur smrig tu btsun pa lham mthil rdol gyi khres po khur ba gcig byung nas/ ngas 'di tsam zad zad du btsal ba de/ da rnyed pas a re dga' zhes zer zhing phan pa mang du sgrub par byed/ phyis 'dod chung du snyung ba'i dus su mgron btsun rgya dpe kong tshe gang khur ba gcig gis/ khyod mkhas na 'di rnams kyi don shod ces zer zhing / dpe ris shad shud byed/ yi ge ma ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes sogs zer ro/ /de rjes yab kyi drung du byon pas/ mdang 'byung po'i cho 'phrul mang ba la/ de ring dge bshes byon pas de'i phan pa la yid ma gtod par thugs dam la 'bungs shig gsungs pa bzhin du lha'i bsgom bzlas drag tu mdzad pa dang / 'thab pa dang 'grang ba sogs mdzad kyang / de yis mi zhum par/ res 'ga' ni bshes gnyen gyi tshul du 'chos/ yun ring na grogs su gyur pas skye ba 'di dang 'dir yang phan pa 'di dang 'di lta bu bya'o zhes skye rgyud sna tshogs gleng / res 'ga' ni gtsug lag khang gi bdag po ltar 'chos/ res 'ga' ni mkhas pa chen po ltar/ res 'ga' ni grub thob chen po ltar/ kho bo'i gtsug lag khang ni 'di lta bu'o/ /zhes sogs dang / kho bo'i rig sngags ni 'di lta bu'o zhes sogs ston no/ /res 'ga' ni bya se bo chen po mi skad 'don pa'i gzugs su byas te tho rangs gshog pa bsdebs shing / zla 'od gzhon nu/ seng ge rgyal mtshan 'od kyi snye ma zhes 'bod cing / yar longs shig gzhung bshor zhig lta rtog dang thugs dam mdzod cig ces chos la bskul ba ltar 'chos pa las/ thar par byon dbang zhu bar brtsams pa na/

da ni yul du 'gro bar rigs so/ /yab yum la sogs pa na'o/ /dbang bskur ni phyis zhu bar 'thad do zhes zer ro/ /phyis dka' bas da lan rang zhu'o zhes smras pa na/ ngas de tsam du khyod la bsam na khyod de ltar byed pa mi rigs pas da lta ldeng zhes smra zhing 'brang dang khres po rdeg par byed do/ /de ltar zer yang ma nyan pa na/ khres po skas 'og tu bskyur/ yun ring 'grogs pa'i grogs pos bslus so/ /khyod nyid ci bde bar gyis shig nga 'gro bas khyod kyis skyel thung gyis shig ces zer ba la/ thar pa'i mo yan sgang bar bskyal bas de na 'dug pa'i rta la bzhon/ nam mkha' la 'phags/ rta de seng ger bsgyur/ dpon gu rub ces bya ba'i rnam pas 'gram pa lag pas bskyor te glu len zhing la rgan la mgo ye re re brgal nas song ste/ de tshun chad bdud kyis ma tshugs so/ /gzhan yang chos rje sa paṇa/ lce stod mdo sde seng ge bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal la sogs pa bla ma mang po la zab rgyas kyi chos dpag med gsan/ rten dkar po yin yang sngags mtshan nyid du ma sbyangs te/ 'dis mdzad pa'i dbu tshad kyi bsdus chen sogs kyang yod do/ /khyad par du 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer la mdo sngags mang po dang / dus 'khor 'bro lugs kyi dbang bshad man ngag thams cad rdzogs par nos/ bla ma ra 'bum seng yun ring du bsten nas dus 'khor ra lugs kyi dbang bshad man ngag thams cad rdzogs par nos te/ ra 'bro gcig tu 'dril ba'i zhal pho yang yod do/ /gzhan yang nyid kyi sku'i sras rgya gar grags dang / slob ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gnyis byis pa chung ngur yod pa hor dmag gis khyer ba la/ sgrol ma btson 'don gyi cho ga mdzad pas/ sgrol ma'i sku nam mkha'i khyon tsam gyi lte khung na bu chung gnyis po mgo rug ge 'dug pa gzigs/ zhag gsum tsam na khong gnyis thar/ yang snar bu'i dgon pa mdzod sgang na bza' mi gnyis la bu lo drug lon kyang lkugs shing 'gro mi shes pa gcig yod pa la byin rlabs mdzad/

gos brjes/ ming btags pas de ma khad 'gro ba dang smra shes par mdzad cing / gzhan lkugs phye mang po la de ltar mdzad/ yang thar pa na ston pa gzhon brtson zhes bya ba rma 'gras kyi rnag zags pas glo snying phyi rol nas mthong ba gcig yod pa la/ ston pa ra rtser ming btags nas ston pa gzhon brtson ston pa ra rtse ste/ /ston pa ra rtses mi kha ra thod bsad ces pa sgo gong la bris pas de ma thag sos pa dang / de bzhin du so na ba la thab kyi ser kha bsub pas dang / klad gzer na ba la sgo'i gzer phyung bas dang / bud med bu ma thon pa la thad ka'i gyang la bug pa phug pas phan pa dang / smyo ba sangs pa la sogs pa snang ba la dbang bsgyur zhing rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pa'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa yod la/ rgod dkar la la byon pa'i tshe jag pa la lta stangs dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa tsam gyis bros pa la sogs pa grub pa'i mtshan ma yang bsam gyis mi khyab cing / khyad par dus 'khor gyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad nas slob ma mkhas par gyur nyid kyis sku'i sras rnams dang / sku nyid po ta lar gshegs pa'i man lung gu ru dang / lho pa grub seng / la stod chos ldan/ dbus pa tshul dar/ thang ston lo tsā ba la sogs pa dus 'khor la mkhas pa'i mchog tu grags pa mang po dang / 'phags pa dang / khro phu rin po che la sogs pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i slob ma mang po smin grol la bkod nas dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i chu pho rta'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i yar ngo'i tshes gsum gyi snga dro ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te gshegs so/ /de la sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba rgya gar grags rab tu byung ba'i mtshan nam mkha' dpal bas dus 'khor la sogs pa'i yab kyi chos ma lus par mkhyen/ dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung gtsug lag khang dang rten gsum mang du bzhengs/ chos kyi bya ba rgya cher mdzad nas 'das/ bla ma a ga ra sid+dhi'i sras bla ma shes rab seng ge gzhon nu nas dus 'khor sogs yab kyi chos rnams mkhyen/

dgung lo bcu drug pa la dus 'khor 'grel chen gsungs/ nyi shu pa la thar par byon/ dpyal pa'i chos rnams zhus/ nyer gnyis pa la g.yag sde seng rgyal la phar tshad mngon gsum gsan/ khyad par tshad ma la mkhas par grwa bskor mdzad/ sum cu pa la 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang / 'chim nam mkha' grags la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ chos mang du zhus/ lo tsā ba grags rgyal gdan drangs nas phreng ba skor gsum la sogs pa mang du gsan/ dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung nas dus 'khor gyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad/ gzhan yang thar pa/ khro phu/ bsam yas/ stag lung / gzhu kun dga' ra ba/ shangs rtse gdong / ston mo lung / g.yu'i dga' ldan la sogs pa rnams su dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgya cher mdzad/ dgung lo zhe gcig la dben dmar gyi gdan sa bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gtad nas dmu lha sham+bhar gyi dgon pa btab ste gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten mang du bzhengs/ dus 'khor gyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad pas ti shrī kun blo sku mched la sogs pa'i mi chen po'i slob ma du ma dang / lo tsā ba yar thang dbang gsum la sogs pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi slob ma dang / khyad par dus 'khor la mkhas pa mang du byung / dgung lo drug cu rtsa lnga pa yos bu'i lo la gshegs so/ /lugs 'di'i bshad bka' la sga lo yab sras 'di gnyis bka' drin che'o/ /sras gcig slob dpon rnal 'byor gyis lam 'khor bskyangs/ sras gcig bla ma ā ka ra sid+dhis dus 'khor ra 'bro sogs yab kyi chos phal che ba mkhyen/ de'i sras bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan chu mo lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas rgya bod kyi yig klog du ma mkhyen/ dus 'khor la sbyangs nas dgung lo bcu drug la rgyud 'grel gsungs/ sa skya'i shar pa 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal dang / slob dpon sher rgyal la mkhan slob zhus dge tshul mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug nas dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung /

dus 'khor gyi bshad grwa bskyangs/ ka bzhi pa gra pa gzhon nu dang / zhal snga mkhan po las bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad/ thar lo la sgra dang mngon pa gsang sngags mang du gsan/ khyad par du bla ma sher bzang la dus 'khor gyis gtso byas dbang bshad man ngag bum pa gang byo gsan/ dus 'khor la mi bde ba gang byung zhu yig tu bskur ba dang / dris lan gyi sgo nas kyang dus phyis kyi bar du gtan la phab nas shin tu mkhas par gyur to/ /gzhan yang bla ma mang du bsten/ mdo sngags du ma la mkhas/ bla ma shes rab seng ge gshegs nas sham+bhar dang gnyis ka bzung / dus 'khor gyi nyan bshad mang du mdzad/ de nas hor rgyal pos gdan drangs te rgya yul du byon/ 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ glang gi lo rgya yul du sku gshegs/ de la bu ston chos kyi rgyal pos gsan/ 'di ni gangs ri'i khrod du byung ba'i bstan 'dzin gcig la mkhyen brtse 'phrin las/ bstan pa la bya ba byas tshul che ba mchog tu gyur par kun la grags shing / 'di'i rnam thar 'og nas 'chad do/ /dus 'khor 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ kha che zla mgon gyis bod du byon/ skyi shod smad du kha rag gi gnyos lo tsā ba la babs te/ dri med bsgyur ba/ gser srang brgya 'bul bar chad pa la/ phyed tsam bsgyur pa dang / gser srang lnga bcu blangs gsungs pa la ma phul bas ma mnyes te/ 'gyur byed 'phro'i dpe bsnams nas 'phan yul grab tu byon/ mdze byung pa mang po gsos/ der 'bro lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab grags kyis gser srang brgya/ gos dar/ gla rtsi'i stang tshe mang du phul nas nan gyis zhus pas/ dbang bskur cing rgyud 'grel tshar gcig gsungs/ sor bsam gyi khrid gnang / de nas zhang sba chung bas gdan drangs/ gser srang brgyas mgo byas 'bul ba mang du byas nas rgyud 'grel bsgyur bar zhus pas/ 'bros lo tsā ba byas te/ mchog mi 'gyur ba'i le'u ma gtogs rgyud 'grel rdzogs par bsgyur/

zhang la dbang bskur/ rgyud 'grel tshar gcig dang sor bsam gyi khrid gnang / mchog mi 'gyur ni bsgyur du ma bzhed do/ /gnyos kyis zhang la nga'i bla ma phrogs pa yin pas/ lba seb tu yungs kar rtseng ba zhig bya yi zer ba la/ kho bo ni khro bo brgya yis bsdigs kyang mi 'jigs/ lha mo brgya yis 'dzum bstan kyang mi chags zhes springs te/ bla ma'i zhabs tog mdzad do/ /de nas yar rgyab bzang yul gyi lce dol sgang pa zla ba grags pa yab sras kyis gser srang gsum dang ber gcig gis sna drangs pa'i na bza' cha tshang phul nas mjal te/ bzang yul du gdan drangs lo gcig tu bsnyen bkur nas/ lo tsā gcig zha rgya gar brtsegs kyis byas te rgyud 'grel gcig zha 'gyur tshar gcig sor bsam gyi khrid dang bcas pa zhus/ yon du gser srang sum cu'i mgo byas srang drug bcu phul/ de nas g.yor po byang thang gi mgar ston gyis gdan drangs/ 'dis drin nas bla ma'i ched du dpe cha blangs pas kha bas sor mo brul/ de nas gnyos ston ye shes mchog gis gdan drangs gser srang bco brgyad phul/ de nas grwa pa mngon shes kyis gdan drangs lo gsum du chos ston gsol/ de'i bar du nyin re bzhin ja 'dren/ nam mjal res phyag rten 'bul ba mchad par byas/ de nas ston pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis skar chung du gdan drangs/ de rnams su rgyud 'grel tshar re gsungs/ gzhan yang stag tshal smon gro'i 'jam bsgom gyis 'bul ba cher byas pas sor bsam gyi khrid gnang / de nas rgya gar du thegs pa'i tshe jo btsun rin chen tshul khrims kyis gser srang drug phul/ bal yul bar du zhabs tog byas shing / gser mang ba'i grags pas jag pa mang po byung ba la srog dang brdos nas paṇa chen gyi sku srung byas pas shin tu mnyes te/ sor bsam gyi gdams pa gnang bas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /mang yul gyi mtshan ldan sri thar rgyan gyis rang lus phul te zhus pas sor bsam las ma gnang yang grub pa brnyes/

de nas paṇa chen gyis ma ga dhar byon te rdo rje gdan du bla ma'i mchod pa la gser mang po phul/ chos 'khor zla med pa btsugs/ mched po 'dul ba'i 'byung gnas blo gros dang / seng ge rgyal mtshan la yang rgyud kyi dka' gnas dang / gdam ngag la sgro 'dogs bcad nas slar yang bod du byon/ 'bro los sngar gyi 'gyur de dag par bcos/ sgom pa dkon mchog bsrungs kyis lus phul nas zhabs tog go re long mdzad pa la dbang gzhung gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang / de'i tshe sgom pas mchog mi 'gyur gyi le'u zhus pas/ 'di shin tu zab pas gzhan gyi blor mi shong gsungs nas ma gnang / nan gyis zhus pas 'o na 'di la lo tsā ba mi dgos gsungs nas rang 'gyur mdzad pas/ 'gyur shin tu bzang ba gcig byung ste dges bzhin du legs par gnang / sgro ston la yang sor bsam gyi khrid gnang / slob ma'i tshogs chen po la gsang 'dus sgron gsal dang / dbu ma rtsa shes gsungs/ lar 'bul nod stobs che ba byung yang sbyor drug la bka' dam pas kun la ma gnang ste/ chos tshong ba las nor tshong ba dga' zhes gsungs shing / sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis tshul gyi tshong 'dra mdzad cing / kong po'i bar zhabs kyis bcags/ yang rgya gar du byon nas phyi zhig na bod du phebs te skar chung sogs su bzhugs/ sgro ston la chos gnang ste sgro 'dogs bcad/ yu mos kyang chos 'brel thob/ bod du sbyor drug gi gdam ngag rdzogs par gnang ba gnyis kho na ste/ de yang gcig ni bla ma grab sgom yin la/ gcig ni mang yul gyi btsun pa gcig gis zhabs tog yun ring du byas pa la man ngag rdzogs par gnang / des kyang gzhan la ma bstan par yer par rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas yan lag mthar phyin te/ lus ma spangs par 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur nas ye shes kyi sku grub pa'o/ /paṇa chen bod skad la shin tu byang bas/ don dam bsnyen pa'i 'gyur mdzad pa'ang shin tu bzang la/

mnga' ris su phyis byon dus 'grel chen la yang rang 'gyur mdzad pas 'bro 'gyur las ches bzang zhes grag go /slar kha cher byon te gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku brnyes so/ /paṇa chen de'i gangs can gyi sras gcig pu lha rje sgom pa dkon mchog srung ni 'phan yul grab tu sku 'khrungs/ rten dge bsnyen sman dpyad la byang pas 'gro don che/ mngon pa/ sa sde/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor gshed skor/ bde dgyes sogs gsang sngags phal mo che mkhas par mkhyen/ bsnyen sgrub phul du phyin pas grab sgom du grags shing thun mong gi dngos grub la mnga' brnyes pa des/ paṇa chen zla mgon bod du 'byon thengs bar pa'i res la mjal bas shin tu dad de/ yo byad thams cad bsdus pas gser srang drug byung ba phul/ dar yug gcig ske la btags te lus phul nas zhabs tog mtho bar mdzad/ mkhyen pa che zhing ci gsungs bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas dgyes te/ dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag ma lus pa dang / gzhan phan gyi bka' gtad rjes gnang dang bcas pa stsal/ paṇa chen rgya gar la 'byon pa'i phyag phyir thogs na'ang ma khrid par 'phan yul grab nyid du rtse gcig tu sgom du bcug pas thugs dam gyi lha mang po zhal gzigs/ ye shes kyi nang rtags mthar phyin/ mngon shes lnga grub/ rlung gtsug tor du 'ching nus/ rgyud 'brel 'bro 'gyur gyi steng nas bshad pas 'bro yang bka' drin che zhes brgyud pa la 'dzud par mdzad la 'bro lugs zhes grags so/ /bla ma des gzhan la gzhung bshad cher ma mdzad/ chos rnams sgro ston la gnang nas/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te mya ngan las 'das so/ /phyi rten ring bsrel mang po 'byung ba zhig 'phan yul rag ma'i nang na deng sang yang yod ces grag go /de nyid kyi thugs sras sgro ston ni 'khrungs sa 'phan yul sgro ris/ gdung sgro/ mtshan gnam la brtsegs/ rten dge bsnyen na bza' dkar po can/

dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa la g.yu rnying phul gang rgyags su bsnams nas legs shākya brtson 'grus/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas te lo tsā ba gsum gyi slob ma dge bshes lo ro pa zhes pa'i drung du yol dbus sder byon te/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du phar tshad mngon gsum/ bya spyod rnal gsum/ bde dge gsang gsum/ sgyu thod gdan gsum sogs la slob gnyer mdzad do/ /lo ro ba'i zhal nas 'chims bya ba'i sngags pa chen po zhig yod pa la/ 'di na ning tsa na rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra/ nga ba lang dang 'dra/ da nga yang lo tsā gsum la thug pas rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra/ dus 'khor shes pa gcig ma byung na da dung ba lang dang 'dra bar 'dug gsungs pas/ bla ma gnam brtsegs dus 'khor shes pa gcig byung na snyam du sems shing / dge bshes de la thig le skor gsan pa'i skabs su/ rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā tha zhes pa dus 'khor mkhyen pa gcig byon 'dug ces gsan nas bla ma la zhus pas/ khyod mjal 'dod che bar 'dug pas chos grol ma thag sngon la song / nga phyi la yong gis gsungs pas byon te/ paṇa chen la gser srang bcu gnyis phul nas mjal/ slang mar zhing gsings ma can btsongs te rta nag bzang po gcig phul/ kong po tshun phyag phyir 'brangs zhabs tog yun ring du byas pas dbang dang sor bsam gnang ste nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs/ chos gzhan ma thob pa dang / paṇa chen dang bla ma sgom pa gnyis 'gol dus zhu gtugs mdzad cing gzhan byung ba dang 'phro gcod pa gzigs nas/ gdam ngag thams cad bla ma sgom pa la gnang yod dgongs te/ sgom pa la gser phul nas zhus pas/ bka' rgya yod gsungs nas ma gnang / de nas paṇa chen rgya gar la gshegs pa'i shul du/ 'phan yul yur ma'i mda'i rnor bzang du lo gsum/ yer par lo gsum/ bla ma sgom pa go bteg mdzad nas/ sems 'grel skor gsum man ngag phran dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang /

gsang 'dus 'phags skor sogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du zhus/ de rjes bla ma mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku mdad mdzad/ /rnor bzang nyid du thugs dam las mi g.yel bar bzhugs pa na/ phyis paṇa chen bod du phebs dus slob ma rnams kyis lha rje sgom pas gdam ngag thams cad sgrom ston la byin nas khong rang gshegs so zhes zhus pas/ sgro ston gyis paṇa chen la mjal du 'ongs pa'i dus su/ ngas chos gang 'dod sbyin no gsungs pa la/ gzhon dus su ni gnang du ma bzhed da rgas pas mi zhu byas pas/ khyod dkon mchog bsrung gi chos kyis ngoms 'dug ste/ de nga las ma byung na su las byung gsungs nas phyag dbyugs/ bla ma chen po'i bka' drin lags zhus pas/ gang gang byin gsungs/ 'di dang 'di rnams gnang lags zhus pas/ de las nga la yang med thams cad rdzogs par byin 'dug ste gzhan la ster mi mna' skyol gsungs nas mgul la phreng ba bcug der bla mas ni rdzogs par ma gnang / bla ma sgom pa la zhus pa lags mod zhus pas phreng ba phud de/ ngan pa 'di gsungs nas dbu la bye ma spar gang brgyab/ re zhig na da 'o na khyod kyis gzhan la ston la mgo lus tshang bar byin cig ces rjes su gnang ba yang thob/ sgro ston gyis rang gi yo byad yod do cog phul bas paṇa chen mnyes te/ dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur/ rgyud 'grel gyi dka' gnas rnams dri gtugs gsan cing gsan/ de ltar paṇa chen dang bla ma sgom pa las sems 'grel skor gsum gzhung gdams ngag cha lag dang bcas pa ma lus pa gsan nas/ chos phran bag re gsungs shing slob ma thams cad la sor bsam gnang nas sgom pa kho na la btsud de/ gzhung bshad mi mdzad pa las/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa na grub chen yu mo la chos skor rdzogs par gnang ste/ dgung lo brgyad cu pa la chos kyi dbyings su snyoms par bzhugs so/ /'di'i phyi rten sgro ris gnas sgang na bzhugs pa zhig pa'i sa 'bur tsam la ring bsrel du ma rnyed cing tsha tsha'i nang gzungs kyi sham bur bla ma gnam la brtsegs kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur cig ces pa yod la/

phyis kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang pos mjal bas ring bsrel brgya phrag mang po rnyed/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten gsos te bzhugs so/ /bla ma de'i thugs kyi sras gcig pu grub chen pu mo ni/ gangs te se'i rtsar yab rngam khro bo zhes pa la sras shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdor byang / tshul shes/ grub chen te bzhi 'khrungs so/ /'di nyid kyis rim gyis la stod lhor byon nas dgung lo bcu pa la lto phyer gyi gnas su mkhan po stag lo tsā ba gzhon brtson las rab tu byung ste/ mtshan 'dogs pa'i tshe gdung rus rngam du 'dug pa dad pa shin tu che ba gcig 'dug pas/ rngam btsun dad pa rgyal po zhes par 'dogs dgos so zhes mtshan de ltar btags/ mkhan po la chos gsan zhing lo gnyis bzhugs/ de nas don mo rir se ston sgra gcan 'dzin dang / dge gnas su ba reg thos pa dga'i drung du mngon pa dang phar phyin gsan/ mi rnams dbu ba yu mo'i mgo 'dra zhes gleng bas rang nyid kyis yu mo zhes mtshan bla dwags su btags so/ /rma dge mthong dang / snyegs la dbu tshad dang / sog 'dul ba 'dzin pa la 'dul ba dang spyod phyogs gsan/ mdo rtsa la zhal 'don mdzad/ kye rdor sogs sngags skor yang gsan/ der grogs gcig gis dgun ci byed 'dri ba la/ mtshams byas nas sngags kyi dpe 'dra 'bri gsungs pas/ 'o na byan lag tshangs na rdo rje snying 'grel 'dug zer ba 'bri'am zhes zer ma thag sngon gyi bag chags sad nas dad pas spu gzings su gyur te/ dpe de g.yar nas 'bri zhing gzigs pas shin tu dad de sus shes dris pas/ so ma nā thas shes zer ba la/ de sngon gyi mi zhig yin snyam nas dbus su khams pa lde'u pa la spyod phyogs gsan zhing bzhugs pa'i dus su/ paṇa chen zla mgon skar chung na bzhugs zer ba gsan te/ rdo rje snying 'grel shes sam byas pas/ de los mkhyen/ spyir gsang sngags tsam la mkhas/ khyad par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel pa chen po yang mkhyen zer/

zhus na gnang ngam dris pas/ spyir bka' dog ste/ da lta bal yul du gshegs pa'i zhabs tog pa med pas 'gro nus na 'ong zer/ sum pa rdo rje gzhon nus zhus sna byas nas paṇa chen dang / bla ma gnam brtsegs gnyis kyai rdor rtsa sngags dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa la zhu dag mdzad pa'i skabs su mjal te chos 'brel zhus pas/ sngags gnyis po la bshad pa mdzad nas gsungs/ chang dkar yol gang gnang / paṇa chen yis gser gyis thig pa dang / gla rtsi'i rkyal pa mang po bstan nas/ 'di rnams khyod kyis bal yul thub khur nus shing mgo thon na/ sang res bod du 'ongs dus chos sbyin no gsungs pas/ bsgom pa tshul grags la dpe cha bcol ba len du byon pas/ khyod gar 'gro zer ba la sngar gyi lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta la chos mi khugs/ sngar yang mang pos ma khugs pa yin/ de bas paṇ+ḍi ta'i chos ma lus pa mkhyen pa nged kyi bla ma rnor bzang na bzhugs byas pas/ blo 'gyur te ston pa rgyal ba 'od/ sgom pa dbang bsod/ sgom pa tshul khrims grags rnams kyis zhu sna byas/ sgro ston la zhu rten du gser zho 'ga' zhig dang / dung chen legs po gcig ka pā li gcig phul bas/ khyod kyi 'di tsho la nye bzang / sog 'dul ba 'dzin pa de btsun zas bza' mi shes/ gos gon mi shes pa thams cad zhal 'chos pha ltar byed pa yin zer/ de'i thugs zin khyod yin par 'dug pas/ yon tan gcig yod pa yin te 'ong gsungs nas chos gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes/ bla ma dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa la zhal mjal te lo bzhi'i bar 'bral med du bsten nas 'grel pa skor gsum gyi gzhung man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa dang / mtshan brjod man ngag gi bshad pa dang / gsang 'dus sgron gsal sogs gsan pa'i dus su bla ma bag tsam snyung ba na/ gtsang stod 'di la chos ma phogs kyi bar du nga ma gsod ces mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba btab nas gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang ngo /

/mthar yang dbang bzhi pa gnang / bdag po chen po'i dbang bskur mdzad nas 'dis rgyud kyi dka' gnad khrol ba yin/ skal ldan ma gtogs pa la ma bshad gsungs te/ rdo rje lag tu gtad/ rgyud 'di khrid dang bdag po'i dbang ma thob pa la mi 'chad pa yin/ dpe tsam gyis mi khrol bas lan gsum yan chad thos nas tshig zin cing don go bas bla ma la tshur bzlas shing gtan la dbab dgos pa yin gsungs/ dgung lo lnga bcu pa la 'u yug tu byon nas nub ma'i mda' rgyal khab ces par gzhi phab ste/ phur dben gnas kyang mdzad/ gag tshangs kyi phu'i brag tu'ang thugs dam yun ring du mdzad pas grub pa thob ste/ dbang rgyud man ngag mang du gsungs/ gsal sgron bzhi dang gces bsdus la sogs pa'i gdams pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad nas dgung lo brgyad cu'i bar du bzhugs te bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa yin no/ /slob ma yang sras mchog dharma shwa ra/ wa brag dkar ba/ gnyal sa gro gnyos kyi khung pa/ grub thob dharma bo dhi/ mkhas pa tre bo mgon po/ se chos kyi mnga' bdag la sogs pa mang du byon te/ wa brag dkar ba dang / gnyal sa gro chen po gnyis kyis bka' gdams la 'dag 'byar yun ring du byas pas rtogs pa'i khyad par ci yang ma byung ba las/ phyis bla ma yu mo'i drung du 'ongs nas gdams ngag bsgoms pas zhag dang po la rtags rnams rdzogs te/ lam gyi mchog tu nges pa rnyed/ bsgoms pas mngon par shes pa rgya chen po dang ldan no/ /bla ma yu mos skya ka'i gzugs su bsgyur te/ wa brag dkar wa brag tog gcig na nyin mo'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i sar byon nas/ khyi lud kyi phung po la mchu brdar te skad phyung pa dang / des ngo shes te bla ma rin po che bdag la de 'dra'i kyal kha mi mdzad par zhu zer nas phyag phul bas/ bla ma mnyes nas sgyu 'phrul sku'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa bstan to/ /khyad par du wa brag dkar pa ni rdzogs rim gyi lha grub pas sprul bsgyur nus pa ste/

dpal chen sga los gnam rtse ldang gi phu'i ngang tshang brag phug nas bya rog gi gzugs kyis phyin nas/ brag dkar ba'i nye logs na sha 'dug pa la 'then pa dang / des shes nas/ sga chung ba khyod de 'dras ci bya tshur shog la sha zo zer te/ dpal chen po dang phan tshun stag rnam par rtse ba'i sgyu ma'i bkod pa ci yang ston res byas so/ /gnyos kyi khung pa ni ra sgreng du lo bdun cu'i bar du bka' gdams la sbyangs pas yon tan ma skyes pa las/ 'u yug tu yu mo dang mjal/ man ngag bsgoms ma thag rlung dbu mar chud zhi ba can grub cing 'dzin pa'i yon tan thob bo/ /yu mo'i sras dharme shwa ra ni/ yab dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa'i tshe 'u yug rgyal khab tu 'khrungs/ skyes stobs kyi thugs rab shin tu che zhing mtshan chos kyi dbang phyug tu btags/ chos 'di la sngon gyi bag chags sad de/ yab la legs par gsan/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la dbang mdor bstan gsungs/ bcu drug pa la mi chen mang po la sems 'grel gsum ka gsungs/ bcu bdun pa nas lo re la rgyud 'grel dus chos su gnang / nyer lnga tshun la yab kyi yon tan bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mkhyen/ spyir yab kyi zhal slob dge bshes che dgu thams cad la gtugs nas/ spyod phyogs/ dbu tshad/ lam rim/ rgyud sde mang po dgung lo sum cu'i bar du gsan cing sbyangs/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ sa chen/ rgya gling pa sogs mkhas pa mang po rtsod pas zil gyis mnan te mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab/ gtsang g.yas ru shangs rtse gdong gi shar phyogs smon mkhar gyi grong chung dgon par phal cher bzhugs nas spyod phyogs dang / tshad ma dang / 'phags skor sogs kyang gsungs shing gtso bor chos 'di'i sgo nas bstan pa'i sgron me 'bar bar mdzad do/ /'di'i slob ma khang gsar nam mkha' 'od ni/ 'gos dbang btsan la rigs tshogs gsan pas sde snod mtha' dag la mkhas pa/ sras mchog dharmā+e shwa ra las sems 'grel skor gsum gyi gzhung gdam ngag ma lus par gsan te/

rgyud 'grel chen po'i bshad pa byang ba/ yan lag drug gi nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs pa zhig go /bla ma dharme shwa re la sras lcam sring gnyis kyi dang po ma gcig sprul sku jo 'bum ni/ byad gzugs mdzes pa ḍā ki'i mtshan dang ldan zhing gzhon dus spyod pa sna tshogs pa mdzad/ skyes stobs che bas yab la chos rnams gsan cing mkhyen/ yab grongs dus yum gyis bskul bas mthu bsgrubs te dgra mang po brlag par byas/ tshe bdag gi zhal gzigs/ nus mthu'i pha rol tu gson/ de dus byang chub kyi lam sna gcig mi zin na cis kyang mi phan zhes nges 'byung bcos min du 'khrungs te/ sngar yab la gsan pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas de ma thag rlung dbu mar chud de mngon shes lnga thob/ brag ri la yang thogs pa med par rgyu zhing / kham zas la mi ltos tshe 'di nyid la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang skal pa mnyam pa'i 'phags mar gyur to/ /kho mo u rgyan du 'gro zhes sgra 'od dang / sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas dang bcas te mkha' spyod du gshegs/ lcam lak+ṣ+miṃ ka ra'i sprul par grags so/ /gsum pa sras grub thob se mo che pa ni/ ljags mi bde yang chung ngu'i dus nas klog ma bslab par mkhyen/ yab la dbang rgyud bshad gdams ngag dang bcas pa thob cing / sprul sku jo 'bum las kyang 'grel chung pad+ma can dang / sgrub thabs man ngag phran mang po thob/ slar yang mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od las rgyud 'grel zab bshad dang / yu mo'i bstan bcos 'ga' zhig dang / yab kyis mdzad pa'i ro bcud stong thun la sogs pa dang / 'bro lugs kyi gsung bgros 'od zer phreng ba dang / co btsun khyung gis mdzad pa'i dri med rgyan rnams gsan cing / de dag kyang lan re la thugs su chud la mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes btags/ bla ma gye re ba dang rtse gdong pa sogs la chos drug

phyag chen/ bde mchog sogs gsan/ rdo rje rnal 'byor la thugs dam snying por mdzad pas gang snang stong gzugs kho nar shar la/ mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med du mnga'/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes 'dzem med du gsungs pas 'ga' zhig mos kyang / phal cher skrag cing bag tsha bar gyur pas/ bla ma rtse gdong pas bka' rgyas btab nas phyis snod ldan re re tsam las gnang du mi bzhed/ gtsang gi 'o lung se mo cher bzhugs pas grub thob se mo cher grags/ lcam jo 'bum mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i dus mchod kyi skabs su zla ba phyed kyi bar du mi g.yo bar ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po la mnyam par bzhag ste/ de las bzhengs nas 'di skad gsungs pa/ bdag gis phag gi lo gsar la/ /'od gsal chen por mnyam bzhag dus/ /sngon gyi skye ba dran zhing gsal/ /dper na gnyid sad rmi lam bzhin/ /sngon 'das dus na 'jig rten khams/ /'od zer kun nas 'phro zhes par/ /bskal pa chen po bzang ldan la/ /bcom ldan bde gshegs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dri med sgron ma zhes pa byon/ /rgyal sras zla ba dri med dang / /nyi ma'i snying po zhes pa byung / /bdag ni 'dzam gling sa yi bdag /'khor los bsgyur ba stobs po che/ /gtsug gi nor bu zhes byar skyes/ /lha mdzes 'od mdzes nyi mdzes gsum/ /btsun mo'i mchog yin gzhan nyis brgya/ /dpal 'bar zla 'od snying rje sogs/ /sras ni gzhon nu sum brgya yod/ /blo gros 'dzam gling sa yi bdag /blo gros snying po la sogs pa/ /blon po dam pa nyis khri yod/ /rgyal phran 'bangs bcas brgyad khri yod/ /pho brang 'tsho ba bzang po zhes/ /chu zheng dpag tshad bzhi cu pa/ /de na rgyal srid 'dod yon la/ /kun nas spyod cing gnas pa na/ /sems dpa' gnyis po der byon nas/ /sangs rgyas 'khor bcas mchod pa dang / /chos ni nyan par bskul gyur kyang / /bdag ni rgyal po'i dregs pa yis/ /sems dpa' gnyis kyi bka' bcag cing /

/brnyas te dus su ma nyan to/ /phyi zhig rgyal po 'gyod gyur nas/ /sems dpa' gnyis la mdong gsol te/ /sangs rgyas 'khor bcas rtag mchod cing / /dam pa'i chos kyang nyan cing bsgoms/ /de nas bdag ni tshe 'phos te/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ngag bcag cing / /brnyas pa'i sdig pas lhung gyur te/ /phug ron skye ba brgya blangs shing / /de nas bya rgod lus nyi shu/ /byi'u sum cu skya ka bcu/ /ne tso bzhi cu khrung khrung gi /skye ba lnga dang lha yul du/ /shang shang te'u'i lus bcu gsum/ /de nas pu shud lus drug cu/ /chu bya lnga bcu rma bya bcu/ /sbrang bu nyi shu sbur bcu gsum/ /de nas mir skyes mun long la/ /tshe lo drug cur sdug bsngal myongs/ /de nas rigs ngan lkugs shing dbul/ /nad kyis lo ni lnga bcur gtses/ /slar yang grog mo'i skye ba gsum/ /ra lnga khyi gsum rta lnga dang / /tha ma lug ni dkar por skyes/ /rdzi bos 'ur rdo 'phangs pas shi /ro de rnal 'byor pa bzhis khyer/ /brag phug dben par tshogs 'khor byas/ /de yis mir skyes bdag rang yin/ /ngan 'gro zad mod sdig lhag gis/ /mig ni mi gsal lce mi bde/ /rna ba 'on pa 'di lags so/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsnyen bkur zhing / /theg pa chen po'i chos thos pas/ /da lta dam pa'i rigs su skyes/ /bla ma grub thob mchog dang mjal/ /zab lam rnal 'byor yan lag drug /nyams su len 'di byung ba yin/ /khyad par ma gcig 'das mchod dus/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rang nyams la/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro rnam lnga byon/ /de rjes bde mchog dkyil 'khor mthong / /mi bskyod snang ba mtha' yas dang / /'jam dpal sgrol ma spyan ras gzigs/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /mi g.yo ba dang byams pa mgon/ /de rnams kyi ni sku mthong gsal/ /de rjes dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams byon te/ /phyag na yid bzhin nor bu bsnams/

/zhal nas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi stsal/ /khyod ni skye 'di'i 'og rol tu/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa grub nas/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su nyer 'gro zhing / /sems can ther 'bum mang po yi/ /don yod grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing / da ni kho bo skye ba bcu drug na sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad sgrol bar byed de/ skye ba dang po mi gdung ba'i lha/ gnyis pa 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal po gdugs kyi nor bu/ gsum pa rgyal po dbang bskur chen po/ bzhi pa rgyal po don yod nor bu/ lnga pa rgyal po 'khor lo nor bu/ drug pa rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / bdun pa rma bya'i rgyal po gser du snang ba/ brgyad pa nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po/ dgu pa rgyal po lag na pad+ma/ bcu pa rgyal po dge ba bkod pa/ bcu gcig pa rgyal po lag na rin po che'i phyag rgya/ bcu gnyis pa rgyal po pho brang ral gri can/ bcu gsum pa rgyal po grags pa mtha' yas/ bcu bzhi pa lha'i bu dbang bsgyur rgyal po/ bco lnga pa 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po pad+ma can/ bcu drug pa rgyal po pad+ma'i nor bu rnams su skyes nas sa bcu bgrod pas smon lam rdzogs shing / sems can thams cad smin par byas te sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa mthar thug nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams pad+ma can zhes bya ba bai ḍur+ya las grub pa'i sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ ngam grog dang lung khung med pa/ gser gyi bye ma brdal ba/ der skyes pa'i sems can thams cad kyang dug gsum med cing longs spyod lhun gyis grub pa/ bud med dang nyan rang med pa/ theg pa dman pa'i sgra yang mi grag pa/ der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang skye ba gcig gis thogs pa sha stag go /der bdag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma'i nor bu zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya ste/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig la theg pa chen po'i chos ston to/

/ston pa de'i phyag zhabs kyi sor mo re re las pad+ma re re 'byung la/ de re re las kyang pad+ma bye ba phrag ther 'bum 'byung zhing / de re re'i nang na sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku bye ba phrag ther 'bum byung nas sems can dpag tu med pa la theg pa chen po'i chos bstan te grol bar mdzad do/ /zhes rang gzhan gyi skye ba 'das ma 'ongs mang po lung bstan/ pho ba lung phug tu snyung ba mi mnga' bar dbyu gu zla ba'i tshes brgyad la sku gdung ring bsrel gyi phung po can bzhag ste chos kyi skur thim mo/ /bla ma 'di la slob ma mang yang mchog tu gyur pa ni/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ dge bshes rma bya pa/ chos rje 'jam gsar ba/ bo dong rin rtse/ lho pa chos ldan dang lnga las/ bla ma khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal ni/ sngar paṇa grub mang du bsten pas chos kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur nas/ chos 'di la lhag par mos pas/ se mo che pa smon mkhar gnas su gdan drangs te sbyor drug gi khrid phran dang bcas pa gsan/ lo tsā ba'i sku tshe'i tshad dang khro phu'i dar rgud la sogs pa lung bstan pas mchog tu gus shing bsngags pa che bar mdzad do/ /chos rje 'jam gsar ba ni/ yul nyang ro'i skyur por yab dpal chen zhes pa la sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i chung shos yin/ mtshan jo sras blo bde zhes pa mi 'khrul dang lugs kyi bstan bcos mtha' dag la mkhas shing / skyes stobs phul du byung bas byis pa'i dus nas gtsang nag pa'i 'grel pa la thun nyan byas te phar phyin la slob gnyer byas/ yab dang mched 'das pa la brten nas 'khor ba las yid byung ste/ chu mig lung du sangs rgyas lam pa'i drung du rab tu byung / mtshan shes rab 'od zer du btags/ chos dus su slob dpon bse dmar ba la phar phyin gsan cing / chos bar la mkhan po la bslab bya dang / bde mchog phag mo/ phyag rgya chen po gsan/ dka' thub la rgyun du gnas pas lus sbyangs/ skabs der shig nad drag po byung ba la bzlog sgom mdzad cing sku lus sbyin par btang bas/

zug rngu ma brten nas thugs dam 'khrungs/ de nas yang mdze nad drag pos bsnyel ba na/ slob dpon la phyag rdor mdo lung zhus te mtshams dam par bcad nas tho rangs yud tsam re ma gtogs/ mnal ye ma log par bzlas pa mdzad pas bskyed rim brtan par byung ste/ mthong ba tsam gyis gdon bgegs thams cad dngangs nas 'gro snyam pa byung / lo gcig dang zla ba drug na yi dam gyi zhal gzigs te snyung ba rtsa ba nas grol zhing / gzhan la 'dre gdon gnod pa na thugs gtad pa tsam gyis 'phral du 'gro ba byung / de nas phar phyin gyi tshig don gsung bgros thams cad ma snyel bar ston nas slob dpon las kyang mkhas zhes grags/ zhang 'brig 'tshams pa la mngon pa byang par bslabs/ de nas gsang phur byon te gnyal zhig la dbu tshad phar phyin rnams gsan/ chos bar la paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shrī la bde mchog dang / gshed dmar gyi dbang dang sngags chos mang du gsan/ paṇ+ḍi tas kyang rje 'di la phar phyin gsan/ de nas sa skya pa rnams dang bgro glang mdzad pas thams cad las rgyal yang thugs ma tshim ste/ lan gcig gnyal zhig la rnam nges kyi chos thon pa'i rjes su khyed de ltar bzhed pa lags sam zhus pas/ thugs rgyal bzhengs te/ 'di ma skyong na gnyal zhig min gsungs nas dam bca' khas blangs/ rjes 'di ma khegs na gtsang ston min zhus te/ phyogs chos dpe la 'gro mi 'gro la nyi ma gsum du mun sros sros kyi bar du bgro glang mdzad pas rje 'di rgyal/ gnyal zhig gis de'i nub mo ja bzang po nyi shu'i mang skol byas/ dar yug gcig btags te/ 'di la nga 'jam dpal dang mnyam pa yin pa yod de/ nga bas kyang khyed shes rab che bar 'dug pas 'jam dpal rang du gda'o gsungs pas 'jam dpal gsar mar mtshan grags te snyan pa'i ba dan gyis kun tu khyab/ gnyal zhig gi bu dgu'i ya gyal du grags/ der tshad ma rdo rje phreng ba mdzad nas gtsang du byon pa dang / slob dpon bse dmar ba grongs 'dug pas thugs skyo ste/

yul gzhis rnams phag tu btsongs nas slob dpon gyi dgongs rdzogs la btang / sa lam gyi rnam gzhag me tog phreng ba mdzad/ thar pa gling du byon nas dpyal lo chos bzang las lo tsā bslabs/ de nas 'dol chung dang rkyang 'dur du bzhugs nas grwa pa phyed dang nyis brgya la phar tshad kyang ṭik+ka mdzad nas gsungs/ khro phu lo tsā ba dang / dpyal kun dga' snying po dang snar thang pa gro chen po dang / zhang chos bla dang / bya mo khung pa rnams la'ang dbang rgyud gdams ngag mang po dang sa sde sogs gsan/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī la dbang gdams pa mang po gsan zhing lo tsā mdzad de/ u rgyan sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs sogs bsgyur/ ko brag pa la lam 'bras gsan pas thugs snang 'gyur te/ sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs dus rdo rje lus kyi rtsa gnas mngon sum du gzigs/ 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug dang zhal mjal ba la/ bdag gis bla ma dang gdams ngag sgom pa gang lags zhus pas/ se mo che pa la dus 'khor dang sbyor drug zhus na lam myur du bgrod par 'gyur zhes lung bstan thob ste/ se mo che pa de g.yas ru grong chung na sprul sku jo 'bum mkha' spyod du byon pa'i chos 'khor mdzad pa'i skabs der 'byon par brtsams pa na/ gnod sbyin chen po bdun gyis gtsos pa'i snang srid lha 'dre mang pos me 'od dang / 'jigs pa'i gzugs ston pa dang / sgra drag po sgrog pa dang / rdo char 'bebs pa sogs cho 'phrul mang po bstan pas/ dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha/ /gnod par sems pa'i 'dre gdon gnyis/ /mi bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/ /lha 'dre gang dga' ma dga' shog /gnyen po thos bsam sgom gsum dang / /spang bya nyon mongs rnam rtog rnams/ /mi bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/ /nyams bzang ngan gang dga' ma dga' shog /'khor brgya dang stong gis bskor ba dang / /rang gcig pur gang bder nyal ba gnyis/ /mi bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/

/'khor mang nyung gang dga' ma dgar shog /tshe ring nad med phun tshogs dang / /dus da lta nyid du 'chi ba gnyis/ /mi bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/ /tshe ring thung gang dga' ma dgar shog /ces sogs chos brgyad ro snyom pa'i mgur gsungs pas zhi/gtsang gzhung la yar byon tsa na/ nam mkha' thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gang ba'i snang ba byung / se mo che pa dang mjal ma thag bla ma de nyid phyag na rdo rje dngos su gzigs te snang ba 'gyur ba'i mos gus tshud 'bul nod rgya chen po mdzad de/ sbyor drug zhus pas sngon 'gro'i khrid tshar ba dang mchog dbang gong ma bskur nas sor bsam gnang ste bsgoms pas/ sngar gyi chos go ba tsho sbun lkog bzhin du bud/ zhag gcig na bsam gtan gyi drod dang rtags rnams byung ste yid ches gsum thob/ slar yang rkyang 'dur du byon dbyar chos grol nas/ bo dong rin rtse sogs slob ma bcu dang lhan cig dus 'khor gsan du byon te/ zhag bcu gsum la dbang rdzogs par thob nas/ zla ba bzhi'i bar du rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa ma lus pa mnos/ de nas rkyang 'dur du thub pa'i dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa zhal gzigs pa la yan lag bdun pa zhig phul/ sangs rgya ba'i rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas kyi drung du sgro 'dogs bcad zin pas chos ni ma zhus gsungs/ rdo rje theg pa mchog gi lam zhugs kyang / /las dang ye shes phyag rgya rtsa rlung dang / /phra mo thig le la sogs bsgoms pa yang / /thun mong dngos grub 'grub kyi mchog min gsungs/ /paṇa chen rnams dang grub chen grangs med dang / /bod yul gsang sngags spyod pa 'bum gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i nye lam mchog /rgyud kun la sbas bltas pas rnyed ma yin/ /bla med rgyud bstan rdo rje rtsa bstan gyis/ /rgyal po'i pho brang mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sgo/ /legs bsdams rdo rje tshig gis sgo lcags bcug

/gsang 'dzin chen po rnams kyis lde mig sbas/ /rigs gsum mgon dang de rnams rjes 'brangs pa'i/ /'grel pa rdo rje sgo 'byed lde mig gis/ /dus 'khor rin chen bang mdzod sgo glegs phye/ /rgyud kun dgongs pa sbyor drug nyid yin par/ /skal ldan bla ma rnams kyis rtogs par gyur/ /dngos grub kun 'byung rin chen sna tshogs dang / /sbyor drug yid bzhin nor bu dngos su gnang / /rtsod ldan shin tu myur bar sangs rgya ba'i/ /zab lam 'di ni bla ma'i man ngag dang / /rgyal sras 'phags pa rnams kyi rgyud 'grel las/ /bsod nams shes rab stobs kyis kho bos rnyed/ /yid bzhin nor bu gos hrul gyis btum nas/ /gter du sbas te 'dzam gling 'di nyid na/ /nga ni nor che smras kyang su yid ches/ /gang zhig la yang phan thogs nus par 'gyur/ /de bas bdag rang 'tshe med 'tsho sla ba'i/ /gnas der bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser btags nas/ /rtse gcig mi rtog sems kyis gsol btab na/ /rang gzhan dgos 'dod 'byung bar the tshom med/ /de phyir kho bo dben par sdod ma dga'/ /'chi med bdud rtsi rnyed nas zas ngan spong / /nor bu rin chen rnyed nas gser yang 'dor/ /mchog thob dman pa 'dor ba ji ltar 'khrul/ /sngon chad gdam ngag brgya phrag du ma bslabs/ /'on kyang da dung gzhan dag 'tshol bar 'dod/ /da ni sangs rgyas thams cad byon lags kyang / /myur du 'tshang rgya'i lam gzhan zhu bsam med/ /kho bo yon tan gyi khyad par 'ga' zhig ma rnyed kyi bar du mgo la me shor ba gsod pa la brtson pa ltar 'bad nas bsgom pa'i ched du dben par mchis pa la mi mnyes pa mchis na bzod par 'tshal/ zhes pa springs yig bai ḍu'i phreng ba zhes pa dang / rnal 'byor bdag gis dka' spyad tshig 'ga' bshad/ /sngon yang bstan 'dir mi lus lan 'ga' thob/ /kha che'i yul du rgyal bu dpal ming can/ /za hor yul du bram ze dga' ba'i blo/

/ko sa la ru khyim bdag grags pa'i ming / /sum cu gsum du nor bu dri ma med/ /de nas 'phos nas da lta 'dir skyes so/ /longs spyod rgya che mnga' ris phun tshogs kyang / /mkhas par sgyu ma brdzun du shes pa ltar/ /ma chags spangs nas dad pas rab tu byung / /byis pa'i dus na chos spyod las la brtson/ /skye 'chis 'jigs pas mtshan ldan bla ma btsal/ /dal ba rnyed tshe rtse gcig gsol ba btab/ /byang chub 'dod min yid la gzhan ma bsam/ /dam pa'i chos phyir lus srog thed la bor/ /'bol ba'i stan spangs span ma'i gdan la bsdag /chos brgyad dpal brjed bzang po'i gos spangs nas/ /phyag dar khrod pa dman pa'i gos la brten/ /de tshe dad pas sdug bsngal lam du khyer/ /las ngan dbang gis lus la shig nad byung / /snying rje bzlog bsgom bdag lus sbyin par btang / /chos nyid rtogs pas zug rngu rang sar grol/ /byams pa'i dbang gis gnod byed pha mar shes/ /mdze nad 'byung po'i gdon gyis btab pa'i tshe/ /so dang sen mo'i mdog shor smin ma byi/ /lo gcig zla drug 'dod lha'i bsnyen pa bskyal/ /de tshe gdon grol rkyen ngan dpal du shar/ /spros bral rnam dag gdod nas gnas pa'i don/ /khrid dang gdam ngag ngo sprod ma bstan par/ /lo brgyad byis pa'i dus nas gsal bar mthong / /gnas lugs don gyis sgro 'dogs legs par bcad/ /chu 'thung rdo 'cha' bdud rtsi'i bcud len la/ /lo brgyad bar du dka' spyad sna tshogs byas/ /byang chub 'dod pas lus srog ther la bor/ /zab mo'i gdams pas bde sdug lam du khyer/ /sa gzhi'i khre sting nam mkha'i bla bres brgyan/ /byin pa'i stan gting lag ngar sngas su bcug /'dod yon kun spangs sprang po'i cha bzung ste/ /lang tsho'i gzi 'od dka' spyad drag pos bcom/ /pha yul nye drung bde skyid blos spangs te/ /byang chub 'dod phyir bkres skom sna tshogs myangs /sdug bsngal bshad na dgra yang mchi ma 'chor/

/gzhon pa'i me tog rgas pa'i sad kyis bcom/ /srod kyi thun la 'dod lha'i gnyen pa bskyal/ /nam phyed thun la 'od gsal ngang la nyal/ /tho rangs nyams len srog rtsol thabs lam bsgoms/ /bgrod dka'i lam chen tshe 'dir kho bos spyad/ /snga dro kha ton 'don dang gsol ba btab/ /nyin phyed sde snod rgyud sde kun la bltas/ /phyi dro phyag dang gtor ma la sogs byas/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'dir kho bos nom pa spyad/ /sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed maṇ+ḍal phul/ /dngos gzhi sems dpa' gsum gyi nyams len byas/ /rjes la dmigs med zab dang rgya che bsngos/ /tshe thung 'di la stong log ma byas so/ /chos pa'i so nam yin pas thos bsam byas/ /chos kyi rtsa ba yin pas gnas lugs bsgoms/ /chos la 'bras bu dgos pas smon lam btab/ /sgo gsum tha mal nam yang ma bzhag go /thog mar 'chi bas 'jigs pas bla ma btsal/ /bar du 'chi brod dgos pas nyams len byas/ /tha mar 'chi rgyu med pas nyal nas bsdad/ /mi rgan nga yi nyams len rnam thar yin/ /bdag la bsgom dang ma bsgom khyad par med/ /bde sdug skye 'chi'i 'du shes zad gyur kyang / /gzhan rnams blo sna bstung phyir dben par 'gro /bdag la som las sgrub pa mdzad par zhu/ /zhes sogs bslab bya zhal thems kyi yi ge rkyang 'dur dang 'dol chung gi ka ba la sbyar nas/ dpon slob gnyis nam la bzhud de rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar thegs nas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs so/ /slob ma rnams kyis phyogs kun tu 'tshol du phyin pas lo mang rab na rnyed de/ slob ma dbu che dang dpon chen pas gdan 'dren pa rta pa mang po rgya nag la brdzangs te/ ri bo rtse lngar phyin/ khyed bod yul du mi 'byon na/ nged rnams dus gcig la lceb pa'i mna' phul bas/ thugs rjes dgongs nas bod du byon/ lam rnams su yang 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ slar rkyang 'dur du phebs pa na/

dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi slob ma dpag tu med pa 'dus te/ klog pa rnams la dus 'khor gtso bor byas pa'i gzhung bshad dang / spong pa pa rnams la sbyor drug gi gdams pa lo drug gi bar du gnang ba'i mthar/ dus 'khor da res las mi bshad pas su nyan 'dod pa shog gsungs pa'i bka' shog phyogs kun tu btang nas/ tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu 'dus pa la dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa rgyas par gnang ste rdzogs ma thag da 'di nas bde ba can du skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong zhing sems can smin par byed gsungs shing / sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i tho rangs 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs dang bcas pas mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan te/ gdung la 'jam dpal dang / dus 'khor dang / phyag rdor gyi sku dang / ring bsrel yungs 'bru lta bu mang du byon to/ /rje 'di'i sras kyi thu bo ni/ rje btsun sga lo dang / kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer dang gnyis yin la/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer ni/ yul nyang stod kyi gnas ut+pal kha phye ba lta bu'i gser sdings su/ gdung sum pa yab grub thob kyi rgyal po gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od dang / yum 'gar btsun ma shes rab rgyan gyi sras su sku skye ba bzung / g.ya' ma ra'i gtsug lag khang gi 'dabs su yum gyi ming po 'gar grags pa dbang phyug la sbrum ma skyong du bcug nas/ shing pho khyi lo'i ston 'bring nyi ma sgra gcan gyis bzung ba dang dus mtshungs par sku bltams/ yum gyis mtshan bdag med rdo rjer btags/ yum gyi lad mo byas pas yi ge 'bri klog dang / chos spyod kyi kha bton rnams tshegs med par mkhyen/ de nas gser sdings su bla ma dge 'dun bsnyen bkur te/ bzod pa gsol nas gser sdings pa chen po'i drung du zhang po dang lhan gcig chos nyan pa na/ shin tu gzhon pas rtse thabs 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' ba gzigs te/

bdag med rdo rje khyod kyi rtsed mgo dang / nga'i chos mgo 'dzugs pa dus mnyam du byed pas/ nga dang chos la ma gus pa zhig gam/ zhes bka' bkyon pas chos rna bas nyan cing / rtsed thabs rkang lag gis byed pa la 'gal ba ci mchis/ chos gsungs pa rnams 'di dang 'di'o zhes lhag chad med par bskyar bas/ kun gyis 'di ni sprul pa zhig go /zhes ya mtshan du sgrog cing sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i tshul brjod pas paṇa chen shākya shrī'i sprul par kun gyis shes so/ /bla ma yang dges te yab tu zhal gyis bzhes nas/ de phyin gyi bstan bcos rnams kyi sbyar byang du/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po zhes mdzad do/ /bcu gsum pa la gnas snying pa chos kyi rin chen gyis mkhan po/ glang pa phang thang pa shākya dar gyis slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung / mtshan yang chos kyi 'od zer du btags/ yab gser sdings pa chen po'i drung du smon 'jug gi sdom pa dang / thog mar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob/ gdams pa mang po zhig gsan pa'i skabs su/ rdo rje 'chang chen gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /byang chub sems la brtan pa thob/ /snang sems srid pa hrul por song / /'gyu ba sems kyi de nyid mthong / /thams cad rtsol med lhun grub rdzogs/ /zhes zhus pas/ 'o de tsug 'ong ba yin/ ngas ji ltar ngo sprad pa bzhin du khyed la par btab pa bzhin rtsol med du byung ba 'di rang brod gsungs nas/ 'dus pa dang / dges rdor gyi dbang / rim lnga chos drug lam 'bras sogs gnang ba na/ gnas pa rtsa yi de nyid shes/ /g.yo ba rlung la rang dbang thob/ /bkod pa byang chub sems kyis brgyan/ /lus ngag sems ni bde gsal stong / /rgyu lam 'bras bu'i bzhugs tshul shes/ /zhes zhus pas/ 'o cag pha bu la de tsam re ste re sar byung / ngas snying po'i lde mig gtad zin gyis/ gzhon dus bshes gnyen phyogs med grangs med bsten la/

theg pa mtha' dag gi lung nod cig sde snod dang rgyud sde thams cad kyi sgo phye la/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i nor bu rnams gdul bya'i sems can ris med pa la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par byin cig snying po bsdus pa'i lde mig gis/ /sgo lcags btsan yang phye ste mchis/ /thog mar nges shes skyes na yang / /da dung rgyu mtshan phyis nas soms/ /de ltar byas na thub bstan dang / /sems can kun la phan pa byas/ /nga yi 'bad pa'ang don dang bcas/ /de ring kho bo'i bsam pa rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs/ dgung lo bco lnga pa nas lo bcu'i bar du gsan sbyong mdzad pas bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mkhyen/ de nas yab kyi zhal nas/ chos rje 'jam gsar ba dang skye ba snga ma nas las 'brel yod pas de'i drung du song zhig ces brdzangs te/ 'jam gsar ba gru khang na bzhud pa'i drung du byon nas/ gshed dmar gyi dbang gsan pa'i tshe/ bla ma gshin rje gshed du gzigs/ gzhan yang dbang byin rlabs/ phar tshad sogs gzhung gdam ngag mang du gsan/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ gzhan blo bum nang nam mkha' tsam/ /'di blo phyi rol nam mkha' 'dra/ /de phyir 'di blo mtshungs med de/ /ma byung 'byung ba shin tu dkon/ /zhes tshogs su bsngags pa mdzad do/ /grub thob se mo che pa la dus 'khor gsan du byon pas/ chos 'di la ngas dam du byas pa yin zhing / gdam ngag dang rgyud rdzogs par zhu ba la bla ma lo mang du bsten dgos pa yin te/ nga bas 'jam gsar ba rgyud mtho bar 'dug khong 'jam dpal dngos su mthong bas ngas thams cad dus gcig la byin nas/ chos 'di'i bdag po khong la gtad pa yin pas/ khyod rang yang chos 'di 'dod na khong la zhus/ khyod gnyis skye ba mang po'i dpon slob yin gsungs nas chos 'brel dang byin rlabs gnang / de nas gru khang du 'jam gsar ba la dus 'khor gyi dbang gsan pa'i tshe/ bla ma rdo rje shugs dngos su gzigs/ 'di ltar gda' zhus pas/

rdo rje shugs dngos yin snyam pa'i dpa' yod pa yin/ 'o skol dpon slob la bgegs kyis mi tshugs gsungs/ ye shes phab pa'i dus saṃ skṛ ta'i skad mang po byung bas kha che paṇa chen gsang 'dus la mkhas pa'i bag chags sad par 'dug gsungs/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i tshe ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs/ dbang bzhi pa'i skabs su nga bzhin du lus gnad 'chos la mi rtog par zhog gsungs pa tsam gyis 'gyu ba phra rags chad de bde stong chen po'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du gyur/ phyis sgom khang du bsgoms pas nyams rtogs 'ur lang ste/ chos rje'i gsung gis gsal ba rab kyi mthar phyin gda'/ gzhan ma'i sgom chen gyi sgom sran la 'o skol gyi gdam ngag 'di yod na lung pa grub thob kyis gang du yod de gsungs/ chos rje des thub pa dang 'jam dpal dngos su gzigs pas ngas lha gang sgom pa ltar khyed kyis mthong bar 'dug pa gzhan la ma gleng gsungs/ phyis rgya nag nas phebs nas kyang rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa mang du gsan/ dang po mjal nas sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes las/ tha mal du nam du'ang ma mthong gsungs/ mtshan bsam pa tsam la'ang spyan chab 'byin/ grang so lung du 'jam rgyal ba la snyung gnas kyi lung zhus pas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag gis dbu la nyul ba'i snang ba byung / khro phur zad ring la mngon pa dang / stag thog tu sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la sgra tshad snyan ngag sdeb sbyor bde dge sogs chos mang po dang / paṇa chen bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra la phreng ba skor gsum bde mchog sbyor drug kha che saṅga shrī la phreng ba'i dbang dang / ka tsan gyi sgra mdo/ dpyal chos bzang la dpyal pa'i chos skor/ dpyal pad+mo can la chos drug rnams gsan/ nyer lnga pa la sngags kyi mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sre'u chung pa lce mdo seṅge la yo ga sogs chos skor mang po gsan/ so brgyad pa la mang mkhar dril chen du sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la dges rdor dbang /

sems skyed/ rigs gter gsan/ khong hor yul du thegs pa'i skyel gdung zhu kun dga' ba'i bar du mdzad/ lha sar jo bo'i drung du mchod pa'i sprin gtibs te gsol ba btab pas jo bo'i sku la 'od zer 'phro ba byung / bdag gis tshogs bskyangs chos bshad dang / /dben par tshogs spangs sgom pa gnyis/ /tshe 'dir dge stobs gang che lags/ /sgom pa'i gnas mchog gang zhig lags/ /zhes zhus pas/ jo bo nyid ston pa dngos su gsal ba'i gsung snyan pos/ khyod kyis dang por brtsams pa nas/ /brtson pas bsgrubs pa'i lus 'di yis/ /sangs rgyas mchog thob 'gyur ba la/ /brtson pa dor ba ma legs so/ /'on kyang nga yi theg chen chos/ /ston par 'dod na 'di rnams sgrubs/ /lhag pa'i lha ni grub pa'i phyir/ /sbyin sreg lan brgya rtsa brgyad gyis/ /sku gzugs 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud bzhin/ /skye bo mang po tshogs par bzhengs/ /gsang sngags gzhung gdams ma lus pa/ /bshes gnyen bzang la lung thob byos/ /rga nad dbul bas sdug bsngal ba'i/ /mi rnams kyi ni mgon skyabs gyis/ /de ltar khyod kyis bsgrub gyur na/ /yon tan gegs kyi las sgrib sel/ /rten 'brel 'grig nas tshe 'di la/ /yon tan rgya chen skye 'gyur te/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dang / /'gro ba'i yid bzhin nor bur 'gyur/ /brag gnas rdo rje'i rtse 'dras brgyan/ /mtho ba'i dgon par skye bo rnams/ /byang chub sems mchog la bkod na/ /sdig spyod rgyal pos gnod mi 'gyur/ /blo ldan gong nas gong du 'gro /zhes lung bstan thob/ der chos rgyal rigs ldan sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyang byon nas thugs dam dbu thog tu bzhag ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor gyis 'gro ba la phan thogs par lung bstan/ de nas gser sdings su zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa mdzad/ so dgu pa la hor dmag bod du lhags dus sems can mang po'i srog bskyabs/

bzang sman grub gling gi dgon pa btab/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang mchims chen po nas/ rdza chung mngal sde'i dka' thub zhus pa yan la bla ma grangs med pa bsten/ bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos ji snyed pa gsan cing / lan re gzigs pa tsam gyis mkhyen pas kun mkhyen du grags la/ nyin mtshan gyi snang ba mtha' dag 'od gsal kho nar 'char bas/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas chos sku 'od zer du mtshan gsol/ 'dol chung chos 'khor chen mo'i dus sde snod 'dzin pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su smra ba'i seng ger gyur cing snyan pas sa thams cad khyab/ rnam rgyal 'khor bde dges 'dus pa dus 'khor sogs thugs dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ phar phyin spyod 'jug gsungs tshe/ gang 'dir ston pa chos kyi char 'bebs kyis/ /gang dag nyan par 'dod pa 'di byos shig /ces gsungs pa na/ sku'i sgo thams cad nas 'od zer sna tshogs 'gyed cing bsdus/ gzhan gyis bltas na gti mug gi bag zhad che ba gcig 'dug na'ang / kho bo la dge sbyor gyi bogs su 'gyur ba zhig gda' gsungs nas mnal mdzad/ kho bo rmi lam rang rgyud pa/ /rmi ba yongs ye ma dran pa/ /bshad nyan sgom la sgrib pa lngas/ /sgrib pa nam yang 'byung ma lags/ /zhes gsungs/ mnyam rjes kyi dbye ba med par mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da'/ nyang chu la ma bying bar zhabs chu la reg tsam mdzad de byon/ gser sdings su gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i tshe sa skam po la chu brdol/ bsam na shes pa tsam las 'das pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med du mnga'/ rang nyid kyis gsan pa'i chos rnams slob ma'i tshogs la so sor gtad/ slob dpon 'od zer mgon gdan sar bskos te dben gnas bya gtang du thegs nas/ don dgu pa chu pho 'brug lo hor zla gsum pa'i nyer dgu la nam mkhar zla ba lta bu la tshom bu so gnyis 'od lngas bskor ba thal byung ste gyen la 'gro ba dang / lha'i spos dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/

/sku gdung bzhus pas thugs ljags rang byon te thugs dge sdings dang / ljags gser sdings kyi gdung khang na bzhugs shing / gdung phal che ba bya btang gi mchod rten na bzhugs/ kun spangs chen pos kyang dge sdings su nang rten ston pa'i gser sku dang / phyi rten rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhengs so/ /bdag nyid chen po de'i sras kyi thu bo zhang kun spangs chen po ni/ yul g.yas ru byang gi ngab 'phyar spangs khang du/ yab 'bro rje dbang phyug yum gnyag mo lcam mo'i sras su chu mo yos la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga pa gnyag tshar sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta sems bskyed gsungs pa la ma'i pang nas gsan/ bdun pa la 'khyog dpon rdzong pa'i drung du dge bsnyen mnos/ dgu pa la 'khyog zhang gis mkhan po/ rdzong pas slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung / mtshan thugs rje brtson 'grus su btags/ nyi shu pa la g.yas ru phyi 'brub dgon gser du lha btsun bsod nams snying pos mkhan po/ mdog lhod pa shākya byang chub kyis las slob/ bsod blo bas gsang ston mdzad nas dad pa'i dge slong lnga bcu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ shangs pa dkon brtsegs/ lha btsun dgon gsar ba/ rdo rje 'jam dbyangs pa/ rig pa'i seṅge/ mdog lhod pa/ mkhan chen mchim pa/ mkhas pa gnyan ston la sogs pa bla ma dam pa rnams bsten/ mdo mangs/ byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos sde nyi shu/ mngon pa gong 'og tshad ma sde bdun/ rigs gter/ ka lā pa/ smra sgo mtshon cha/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ lung sde bzhi/ 'bum nyi khri/ brgyad stong pa/ bsdus pa/ de dag gi rgya 'grel/ spyod 'jug bslab bsdus rnams gsan cing mkhas par sbyangs/ khro phu ba la bde chen ral gcig sogs khro phu'i chos rnams gsan/ ma 'ong pa na jo nang du yun ring du bzhugs nas bstan pa la phan zhes lung bstan/ 'gro mgon phyag na gshegs pa'i chos 'khor gyi tshe lung rigs smra ba'i mchog tu grags/

de'i dus na rtog ge la chu mig pa seṅge dpal mkhas par grags pas/ khong gis dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa la lan med kyi thal 'gyur bcu gsum yod ces gsan pas/ khong snar thang na bzhugs pa'i drung du byon nas/ khong gi grub mtha' la zhag mang po'i bar du brtsod nas dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa'i lan du/ ngas khyed la lan med kyi thal 'gyur 'di rnams song ba yin no zhes grangs 'dzin cing / phyag la ri mo mdzad/ 'jam sgeg la sogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po rnams lung rigs kyis btul/ chu mig gi chos 'khor snga ma phar 'dri ba dang / phyi ma la lan 'debs pa la 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur to/ /don mo ri dang 'dar chos sdings su phar mngon dbu tshad kyi 'chad nyan dang 'khyog po che'i gdan sa lo mang du mdzad/ de'i tshe rkyang 'dur du chos bar la byon nas/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer ba la sbyor drug rigs mi 'dra ba mang po gsan dus/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i sku rags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / phra ba sen mo'i steng na bzhugs pa 'dzam bu'i gling du mi shong snyam pa dang / nang gi dbang po drug gi ting nge 'dzin gyi yul drug la 'byams nas 'gro ba byung / de nas dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor/ bde mchog rtsa sdom/ kye rdor sa lugs/ rngog lugs/ gdan bzhi/ ma ya/ yo ga bya spyod kyi dbang rjes gnang rgyud 'grel gzhung bshad man ngag dang / lam 'bras rim lnga/ nā ro/ nai gu /grub snying sogs chos rnams bum pa gang byor gsan/ gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rjer btags/ de nas rkyang 'dur du 'jam gsar ba'i gdan sar bzhugs nas chos rje'i chos dung btang ste/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ dol po ba ye shes mgon po la srog rtsol gsan te/ rkyang 'dur du 'dag sbyar mdzad nas sbyor drug bsgoms pas nyams snang 'ur lang zhing mngon shes lnga grub/ gegs kyi rnam pa mang du byung ste/

bde ba can du gdan 'dren pa yin zer nas bsu ba'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / de'i dus su bud med gcig gis lde mig gcig khyer byung nas sgo zhig la sgo lcags brgyab 'dug pa de la bkal song / de sgo phye shig pa'i brdar dgongs nas sgo phye ste/ de nas lus sbyong gi mag ngag byung ba bzhin mdzad pas rlung lnga stobs su gyur te/ res phyag ya re la mi bdun bdun gyis bzung ba phyogs gcig tu 'phangs kyang gnod pa mi 'byung / res mi mang pos 'gul bskyod mi nus/ res bsil bas mi rnams 'dar zhing 'khyag res tsha gdung gis lung pa 'geng pa byung zhing / de thams cad kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis dge sdings nas gzigs te byon pa na/ rje 'dis kyang mkhyen nas slob ma rnams bla ma dang mjal bar 'dug gi gsol ba thob gsungs/ sang bla ma byon te/ da res khyed sku gshegs na sku bzhi la 'byor ba 'dug ste/ gdul bya mang po'i don du bzhugs dgos so gsungs nas srog gegs de bsal nas/ bde ba can du bsu ba de rnams da res gdan mi 'drongs pa 'dug zer nas gyes pa'i snang ba byung / dus 'khor ba shar pa ye shes rin chen pa dang rnal 'byor seṅge 'bum sogs bod na sbyor drug mi 'dra ba yod zer tshad la yang gsan pa mdzad/ mang mkhar gnas gsar du bla ma 'jam dpal ba la mdo sgyu sems gsum gsan pas/ mnal lam du mkhar bdun rim skas bdun bdun btsugs pa la 'dzegs pas rtse mor phyin te ting nge 'dzin gyis snang ba rgya chen gzigs/ nying phug pa sangs rgyas 'bum la rdzogs chen gsan/ de nas 'chad nyan gyi spros pa bcad de kha rag tu byon nas dbyar bzhugs mdzad/ de nas ri khrod rnams su sbyor drug dang smar khrid bskyangs pas kun spangs chen por grags/ bse mkhar chung gi gtsug lag khang gsos shing 'brog mi'i sku 'bum la gser gsol bas/ mi ma yin rnams kyis bse mkhar chung pa de da yang 'dir byung zhes sgrog pa gsan/

der jo mo nags rgyal ma byung ste/ khyed la gnas legs pa gcig 'bul zhes zhu ba la lo gsum nas 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ sbyor drug rdzogs par bton pas bka' gnyan par byung bas lha sar byon nas/ jo bo rnam gnyis/ khyad par du bcu gcig zhal gyi drung du nyin mtshan du gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ khrid yig bri ba dang / khrid yig rdzogs par bstan pas 'gro phan rgya chen po 'byung ba'i gnang ba thob/ de nas lhun po rtse sogs g.yas ru ri khrod du sgrub pa mdzad/ de nas jo mo nang du phebs ma thag gdul bya 'ur te/ gtso bor dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi dus chos gsungs shing / slob ma brgya stong mang por sbyor drug gi khrid tshan lnga drug dus mnyam du gnang / khyad par du mkha' spyod bde ldan du byon pa'i tshe/ chos rgyal rigs ldan sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams byon nas byin rlabs dang lung bstan mdzad/ bse mkhar chung du thog ma dang / seg rdzong du bar dang / gnas der tha mar dge ba'i mtshan ma thob nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi snying po rtsa 'grel dang / thog tha bar dge'i khrid yig mdzad/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpag tu med pa 'dus pa la dus kyi 'khor lo gtso bor gyur pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dbang bskur/ rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa/ man ngag gi khrid rim rnams rgya cher bstsal/ sa skya dpon chen sogs skye bo'i tshogs mang po la'ang so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par chos kyis tshims par mdzad pas jo nang pa chen po zhes phyogs kun tu grags par gyur/ chu pho byi ba lo la mar me 'chi khar gsal bya ba yin gsungs sku khams bzang ba'i ngang nas slob ma rnams la chos rnams rdzogs par gtad/ de nas dgun smad sku tshe'i 'du byed btang yang byang sems rgyal ba ye shes ba gdan sa la bsko ba'i ched du srog rtsol brten nas 'tsho ba'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs te/ zla ba phyed tsam na byang sems pa la mgul cham byung yod pa la phan na myur du shog gsungs pas/

byon pa na/ nga da lo me tog khra chil ba'i dus la 'chi rtsis yin pas/ mdang zhag glo bur du rtsa bsdus pa gcig byung / nged 'chi dus khyed dang 'phrad dgos pa la ma sleb pa la/ nga dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor yin/ khyed kyis bstungs na ngas bsrings pas chog snyam ste rlung sbyor 'ga' byas pas rtsa sor chud de 'chi ba bslus bdog gsungs/ sku khams bzang zhing phyag rtsa bde na gshegs pa'i rtags ci lags zhes zhus pas/ rlung sems la dbang thob pa 'gro ba la rtags ci dgos/ do zhag ngas bar dor phyin nas 'jig rten gyi khams mang po'i bar do'i sems can tshad med pa bsgral/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang po bltas shing / bde ba can dang / dga' ldan dang / sham+bha lar yang phyin/ bde ba can na rin po che pad+mo kha phye ba sogs skye sgo mang po gda' yang / mtshan nyid kyi dus nas byams pa'i drung du sgro 'dogs gcod snyam nas 'dun pa drag pos rten 'brel bsgrigs shing / khro phu ba dang dpon slob thams cad rten 'brel 'grig pa gcig byung bas/ da 'di nas bar do rigs mthun du byas nas sems can dpag tu med pa bsgral/ de nas dga' ldan du 'gro gsungs nas byang sems pa gdan sar bskos/ byang sems pa sku khams 'khrugs pa na/ nga 'gro ba'i rtsis yin te/ nga song na de'i rkyen gyis khyed kyang 'grongs par 'dug pas/ khams ma gsos kyi bar du ngas bsdad do gsungs nas zhag nyi shu lhag tu nyin re bzhin chos zab mo'i 'bel gtam mdzad/ don gcig pa chu mo glang gi dpyid 'bring nyi shu lnga'i tho rangs byang sems pa la rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i cho gas rdo rje dril bu gnang nas/ khyed kyi khams ni sor chud 'dug da nga 'gro ba yin/ ro 'di shi ma thag bsregs kyang chog nga ro'i nang du 'od gsal bsgom zhing bsdod bya ba'i lugs min/ kun spangs kyi bya ba mthar phyin/ dga' spro dang bcas pas gsol ba thob gsungs te mya ngan las 'das so/

/de nas zhag bdun na sku gdung bzhus pas dus 'khor la sogs pa'i rten mang po dang / ring bsrel yungs 'bru lta bu'i phung por gyur/ dge 'dun khri phrag gcig 'dus te sku 'dad byas/ skyid phug tu sku 'bum dang / dga' ldan du sku 'bum che ba dang sku 'dra rin po che bzhengs so/ /rje 'di'i slob ma'i tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu las yongs su grags pa ni/ khro phu rin po che bsod nams seṅge/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ kun spangs grags rgyal ba/ 'jam dbyangs mkhon ston thugs rje rin chen sogs sa skya pa'i chen po rnams dang / byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ la stod dbang rgyal/ mu me brag kha ba/ sron pa kun rgyal rnams la kun spangs bu bzhir grags pa dang / kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang rnams so/ /kun spangs chen po'i thugs kyi sras mchog byang sems rgyal ba ye shes ni/ yul khams kyi rta'i rngog gdong / yab yon tan shes rab/ yum bzang mo zhes pa'i sras su me mo sbrul lor 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus su chos rje karma pa shis pha de mi 'dod bzhin du blangs nas/ blo gros seṅge dang / mdog shākya byang chub las rab tu byung / karma pa shi la karma pa'i chos skor mtha' dag gsan/ de nas dbus su phebs nas mtshur phur karma pa'i gsol ka pa yang mdzad/ karma pas ri khrod 'grims shing rtse gcig tu sgoms shig don gnyis 'grub bo zhes lung bstan/ de nas gsang phur 'od zer mgon po dang / zul phu ba bsod nams rin chen las bsnyen par rdzogs shing / mdo rtsa/ phar phyin/ spyod 'jug rnams gsan/ g.ya' lung pa las byams chos lnga/ mngon pa/ lam rim gsan/ chos rgyal 'phags pa la sems bskyed/ bde mchog ma ya sogs gsan/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/ 'phags skor/ bde dges/ 'jigs byed/ rigs tshogs gsan/ dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gsan/

kha che paṇ+ḍi ta bi la shrī grub pa dpal/ grags chen pa sogs bla ma mang po las sde snod rgyud sde'i bka' lung phal che ba gsan/ khyad par jo nang du kun spangs chen po gtso bor bsten pas/ dus 'khor sogs chos rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang / mngon shes lnga grub/ nga bdun pa la jo nang gi gdan sar bzhugs nas chos 'di gtso bor ston pa'i 'phrin las rgyas par mdzad/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod la sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mang po dang / dpon chen byang rdor la sogs pa'i mi chen po rnams kyis kyang zhabs la gtugs/ mdo sde lung sbyor che chung / rgyud sde lung sbyor che chung / rdo rje theg pa'i bcud len sogs bstan bcos yang mang du mdzad/ mthar gtsang po brgal te chos dbyings phug mo'i gnas su rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la bzhugs/ re bzhi pa lcags pho spre'u la mkhas btsun pa gdan sar bskos nas dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes bcu la gshegs/ steng phyogs 'og min gyi lha gnas na bzhugs so zhes karma pa rang byung rdo rjes gsungs so/ /rje 'di nyid la rgyud 'chad pa la mkhas pa dang / sbyor drug la myong rtogs thob pa'i slob ma grangs med cing / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa yang brgya phrag mang du byung ba las mchog tu gyur pa ni/ stag lung pa rat+na ka ra/ sha grags zha dmar cod pan 'dzin pa/ seng pa/ grub thob dar yul ba/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho dang bzhi las/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ gtsang mdog gi dben par sngags pa'i dgon pa mkhar rnying du/ yab kun dga' dpal dang / yum kun skyid kyi sras su lcags pho spre'u la 'khrungs/ gdung lding mched lnga'i tha chung / bcu gsum pa la shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pa la dge bsnyen mnos/ mtshan yang thugs rje dpal du btags/ bco lnga pa la mdar du mdar byang skyabs kyi grwa sar byon/ spyang ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ yon tan dpal gyis slob dpon mdzad de rab tu byung /

mtshan thugs rje rgyal mtshan du btags/ mngon pa kun las btus/ rnam nges/ rigs gter rnams mkhas par sbyangs/ de nas sa skyar byon te 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa la gtugs/ khong gis bu ston kun bzang dpal la sprad/ phar phyin 'jam gsar ba lugs slob tu bcug pas 'phral du mkhyen/ bzhi thog pa mnyes te/ de ring chos khri khar 'bul ba gang byung khyed rang la ster bas chos khri'i steng du sdod/ 'bul ba che chung khyed rang gi bsod nams la rags las so gsungs pa la/ der khams pa zhig gis/ dbu zhwa/ gsol zhal sder/ ber thul/ ja sdum/ gos phyi nang / sar thang sga khab kyi 'bor kha sun/ khra bo/ mdzo sogs 'bul ba byung bas sku bsod che bar grags so/ /bzhi thog pa'i drung du phyi nang gi rgyud sde mang du gsan/ dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen rgya yul du 'byon pa'i phyag phyir byon te/ lo ngo bzhi la sa skyar phebs bzhi thog pa la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel dbang dang bcas pa dang / brtag gnyis phran dang bcas pa gsan/ grub pa dpal bzang po las kyang phyag len bslabs/ de nas sum cu pa la jo mo nang du kun spangs chen po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ sbyor drug gi chos gsan brgya lhag pa gsan/ rgya 'grel sogs kun spangs pa dang / byang sems pa la mnga' ba'i chos rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mkhyen/ mang du gsan pas yon tan rgya mtshor btags/ so bdun pa la bla brang bzhi thog tu 'jam dbyangs chen pos mkhan po/ zhang kun spangs chen pos las slob/ shar ba ye shes rgyal mtshan pas gsang ste ston pa mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ re gcig pa la jo mo nang gi gdan sa mdzad de/ sde snod 'dzin pa'i tshogs chen po la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag gnang ba sogs 'phrin las rgya cher bskyangs/ mngon par shes pa sogs mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan mang po mnga'/ re bdun pa la kun mkhyen chen po gdan sar bskos te/

spyir lo sum cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du jo mo nang nyid du bzhugs nas/ re brgyad pa me mo yos tha skar zla ba'i tshes brgyad la snyel ba med par sa g.yo ba dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te bde bar gshegs/ gdung bzhu la zhen dus 'od kyi gong bu rdza ma tsam pa mang po thon te nam mkha' la 'gro ba byung / ring bsrel rnams sku 'dra dang / phyi rten rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhugs so/ /de dag gis ni bod du dus 'khor la bka' drin che ba ra 'bro gnyis kyi lugs srol byon tshul mdo tsam bstan nas/ da ni gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa rnams las brgyud pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor sa lugs su grags pa byung ba'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ thog mar dus zhabs pa'i dngos kyi slob ma tsa mi lo tsā ba chen pos rjes su bzung ba'i grub thob dpal chen sga lo las/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos sbyor drug gsan nas/ ma rgyud kyai rdo rje'i sbyor drug ces pa'i yi ge yang mdzad de/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo dang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang / khyad par rje btsun la/ bu ngas khyod la chos bstan pa thams cad 'dir 'dus pa yin te/ byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid dngos/ /dang po chos nyid gdan du bya/ /'byung ba rlung la sbar 'dzin bya/ /gtum mo'i me drod rab tu bskyed/ /byang chub chu rgyun dbu mar gzhug /sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du bsdus/ /ye shes lnga ni mngon gyur nas/ /'chi ba med pa'i gnas thob bo/ /zhes gsungs te/ rkang ba dang po gnyis kyis sor bsam/ gsum pas srog rtsol/ bzhi pas 'dzin pa/ lnga pas rjes dran/ drug pas ting nge 'dzin/ tha ma gnyis kyis grub pa ye shes kyi sku bstan to/ /de nas sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rgyus pa gzhon nu seng ge dol po ye shes mgon po/ kun spangs chen po rnams rim par brgyud de sbyor drug sa lugs pa zhes grags so/

/de'i rjes su kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī las/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas gsan cing dar bar mdzad pa yin te/ de'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ paṇa chen de'i dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes pa'i dus su paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu ta tsan+t+ra/ su ga ta shrī /dza ya da ta/ dā na shī la/ saṅgha shrī bu ma ti sā ga ra/ kā la tsakri /dzi na gup+ta/ mahā bo dhi sta 'khor paṇ+ḍi ta dgu dang bcas dza gar+dha ma nas khro phu lo tsā bas gdan drangs te be dur tshong 'dus/ gro mo/ phag ri/ 'grig 'tshams/ rgyang ro rnams su rim gyis byon/ de nas dpyal lo tsā bas khro bo che dang / ma kha gnas su gdan drangs/ kyai rdo rje 'grel ba man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / de nas mgur mo dang / chu mig ring mor dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen pos bskor bas/ khyim pa rnams kyis zhal yang blta dka' ba byung / der sa paṇa gyis kyang mjal/ de nas khro phur phebs/ shing pho byi lo dbyar gnas de nyid du mdzad de tshul shing len pa brgyad brgya byung / lho brag pa byang chub dpal la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / brgyad stong pa a bha ya'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / so thar dang / mdo sde rgyan gsungs/ de nas snar gyi slas mo cher byon/ der thugs bag phebs pas sngar ma gzigs pa'i yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang / dga' ldan pa'i mchod pa'i rnga sgra las chos kyi sgra 'byung ba gsan/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bkod pa dus 'khor nas bshad pa ji ltar bshad pa bzhin mngon sum du gzigs pas/ mngon pa'i lugs de ma dag pa yin nam dgongs pa na/ sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs nas/ gdul bya'i blo dang bstun pas mi 'gal te sde pa bco brgyad lta bu yin/ yang dag pa na 'jig rten rang yang med gsungs/ gtsang po pa bsod nams mdzes kyis mjal te/ bdag bsnyen par rdzogs nas ltung ba byung pa ma dran pas tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i dge ba byang chub tu bsngo bar zhus pas/ dbu zhwa zul gyis phud/

phyag thal mo sbyar nas bsngo rgyu bzang 'di lta bu rgya gar na yang dkon/ kho bo'i rtsar sdod la mchod gnas gyis gsungs te bsngo ba gnang / der bsod snyoms 'dren pa shin tu mang bas gdan gcig gi dus su chos rje nyid la drangs pa'i gdugs tshod kyis dge 'dun nyis brgya'i 'tsho ba sbyor/ chos che phra mang du gsungs shing lam rim dang / chos spyod rgyas pa brtsams/ paṇa chung rnams la sa sde dang / tshad ma sde bdun dang / dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gnang / glang lo'i dbyar gnas kyang slas mo cher mdzad de mdo rtsa dang / me tog phreng 'dzin gsungs/ dgag dbye thon nas chu mig ring mor byon/ rin chen phreng ba dang dpe rgyan gsungs/ rgyan gos gnas su rdo rje dpal la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / de nas srin po ri pas spyan drangs te/ gzhu snye dang mtshur phu nas brgyud lha sa mjal nas srin po rir phebs/ der chag lo dgra bcom gyis kyang mjal ba la byon/ stag lo'i dbyar gnas kyang srin po rir mdzad de/ mngon pa kun las btus dzñā na mi tri'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ spyi chos la mya ngan med lung bstan pa dang / las brgya pa/ gzhan yang byams chos dang rigs tshogs rnams gsungs/ srin po ri'i gdan sa pa la byams chos kyi khrid/ rigs tshogs kyi khrid/ spyod phyogs kyi khrid rnams gnang / de nas lha zhi ba 'od kyis bsam yas su spyan drangs te chos mang du gsungs/ bsam yas kyi bkod pa la mnyes te bi kra ma shī la dang dus mtshungs su 'dug gsungs/ der sangs rgyas dbon ston gyis mjal te rgya ma rin chen sgang du gdan drangs/ slar srin po rir phebs/ phag lo dgra bcom gyis gdan drangs te thang po che dang / rim gyis gnyal lte'u rar phebs/ yos lo'i dbyar gnas de nyid du mdzad/ dge slong tshul shing len pa bdun brgya byung / lo paṇa gnyis kyi mdo sngags kyi chos mang du bsgyur zhing gsungs/ gser phye bum pa'i nub kyis chos khri la lo paṇa gnyis bzhugs nas sems bskyed dang lam rim gsungs/

zhang dad skyal ba la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhengs pas me tog gi char babs/ de nas thang po cher byon bstan rtsis mdzad/ spu gu dor yang chos gsungs/ 'brug lo'i dbyar gnas thang po cher mdzad nas 'on zang ri g.ye gangs bar nas slar yang gnyal lte'u ra dang / de'i bu mag rong rtse dkar chung ngu thegs te zangs chen pa sogs mkhas btsun mang por lam rim gyi khrid dang / me tog phreng brgyud/ brgyad stong pa/ thub pa dgongs rgyan gsungs/ sa lha'i gnas su sgrol ma'i bris skus paṇa chen la chos gsungs/ bya nag rin po che 'od sogs la sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang gnang / lo ro mtsho sna/ lho brag gru shul rnams la'ang lo paṇa gnyis ka byon te chos mang du gsungs/ slar yang lte'u ra/ thang po che/ srin po ri/ rgya ma rin chen sgang rnams su rim gyis byon te/ sbrul lo'i dbyar gnas rin chen sgang du mdzad/ chos bstan pas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa brgyad cu lhag pa byung / ra sgreng du yang byon/ 'bri khung bas gdan 'dren byung pa la ma thegs par chos skyes gnang / de nas rim gyis gtsang du byon nas nyung chung du bzhugs pa na/ sa skya pas gdan drangs te rta lo'i dbyar gnas sa skyar mdzad/ chos rje sa paṇa la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / bka' chen bzhi sogs mang du gsungs shing / khyad par dus 'khor rgyud 'grel phran dang bcas pa gnang / de nas shangs/ 'u yug nyang ro la sogs par byon/ lug lo'i dbyar gnas shang lug gu gdong du mdzad/ de lo than pa che bas char phab pa na klu brgyad dngos su 'ongs nas char phul/ lha btsun gung khang pa la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / jo gdan seṅge dpal la khyod bod la gtang pa med/ rlung re bzung drod len tsam re byung pa dang grub thob tu re bar 'dug gsungs/ gzhan gyis phul ba'i yo byad yod do cog khro phu'i byams chen la gtad/ spre'u lo'i dbyar gnas khro phur mdzad/

dbyar zla 'bring po la byams chen gyi rab gnas mdzad nas rim gyis mnga' ris su thegs/ bod kyi dge slong rjes su 'brangs pa rnams btsang po ba dang / byang rdor gnyis la gtad nas bstan gcig pa'i sde btsugs/ pu hrang du chos kyi rgyal po stag tsha'i bla ma mdzad nas bya lo'i dbyar gnas de nyid du mdzad/ de nas phag lo la kha cher phebs te thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis grub pa'i sgrol ma lha khang du gtso 'khor bzhugs te/ lo bcu dang zla ba drug gi bar du bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad nas dgu bcu go dgu pa shing mo bya'i lo la dga' ldan du gshegs/ spur bzhu ba'i tshe mkha' 'gro'i rol mo las sil snyan bdun pa zhes pa tshigs su bcad pa byung ba paṇ+ḍi ta phyed dang nyis brgyas yi ger bkod yod do/ /paṇa chen 'di la bod kyi slob ma mang du byon pa las/ chos 'di pa'i sras kyi thu bo ni/ dpyal lo tsā ba/ chag lo tsā ba/ sa lo tsā ba gsum yin pa las/ mchog tu gyur pa ni chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po yin te/ de yang skye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar 'jam dpal gyis rjes su bzung bas mkhyen rab 'gran zla dang bral/ bco lnga pa la rje btsun chen po la yab mes kyi chos thams cad thugs su chud/ mnal lam du dbyig gnyen dang mjal bas mngon pa bslab ma dgos par mkhyen/ nyer gsum pa la chu mig ring mor paṇa chen shākya shrī dang mjal/ paṇa chen dbus su byon pa'i bar/ su ga ta shrī sa skyar spyan drangs nas sgra tshad/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod/ zlos gar sogs gsan cing / sngar ma 'gyur ba'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum la gzhi 'gyur mdzad/ paṇa chen yar phebs nas nyer dgu pa la paṇa chen gyis mkhan po/ spyi bo lhas pas las slob/ don mo ri bas gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ paṇa chen la rnam 'grel sogs bka' chen bzhi/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor/
