ye shes zhabs lugs/ bde mchog rnams kyi dbang gzhung bshad man ngag dang bcas pa/ khyad par sbyor drug srog rtsol snyan brgyud gsan/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur/ yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ skyid grong du 'phrog byed dga' po sogs mu stegs kyi ston pa drug btul/ mkhas pa'i grags pas 'phags yul dang rgya nag tshun khyab/ bstan bcos mang du brtsams te bstan pa ches gsal bar mdzad/ bo dong rin po che sogs gdul bya mang po la 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos su bstan/ gsang ba'i gnas bltar mi mngon/ dbu gtsug tor dang ldan/ mdzod spu dung ltar 'khyil/ re gsum pa la rgyal po go dan gyis gdan drangs nas gong du byon/ sprul pa'i sder bzhugs nas rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun thub pa'i bstan pas khyab par mdzad/ rje btsun grags pa/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa gsum gyis mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du rgyal ba dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes par 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan/ bdun bcu pa la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te gshegs so/ /des srog rtsol rdo rje'i snyan brgyud rgyus pa gzhon nu seng ge la gnang / des dol po ye shes mgon/ des kun spangs chen po la gnang ste/ des srog rtsol gyi man ngag 'di nyid la gtso bor mdzad do/ /yang chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i sku'i dbon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches kyang rgya yul nas yar phebs dus ngur smrig tu rje btsun sga lo gdan drangs nas dbang rgyud bshad man ngag rnams gsan te dus 'khor la mkhas pas bstan pa'i bdag por gyur to/ /de dag gi rjes su byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba mtsho'i rnam par sprul pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ dpang lo chen po dang / bu ston sogs la gsan nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa shin tu dar bar mdzad pa yin te/ chos kyi rje 'di nyid yab bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal dang /

yum zha lu ba gzhon nu 'bum gyi sras su chu pho byi ba la sa skyar sku 'khrungs/ zla ba gsum na nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa la dril bu pa'i dbang dang / dgung lo gsum pa la rong pa sher seng la gshed dmar gyi dbang gsan/ brgyad pa la brtag gnyis gsungs/ bcu gcig pa la bla chen kun blo pa la dge bsnyen mnos/ bcu bdun pa la mkhan chen bsod grags pas mkhan po/ dpal ldan seng ge pas slob dpon mdzad de rab tu byung / nyi shu pa la mkhan slob de gnyis dang / rin chen dpal bzang pas gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ mnal lam du paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ pha dam pa rnams dang mjal/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang po la sbyor drug gsan pas stong gzugs kyi 'jam dbyangs longs sku'i rnam pa gzigs/ brag kha ba dang / sron pa chos dpal bzang po dang / mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa la sbyor drug gsan pas rlung rtsol la dbang 'byor/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ gzhon nu dpal bzang po/ dpang blo gros brtan pa/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon po/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ lo chen byang rtse rnams la bsten nas phar tshad/ 'dul mngon dbu ma sogs sde snod kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams dang / sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod la sogs pa tha snyad kyi gzhung lugs mang po dang / khyad par du gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbang rgyud bshad man ngag mtha' dag la sogs par sbyangs pas mkhas pa zla med par gyur/ khyad par du dpang lo la rgyud 'grel gsan dus khyed kyis ci nas kyang legs par mkhyen pa mdzod cig ces do dam cher mdzad nas gsungs pas/ slad mar bu ston rin po che la dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa dang / chos gsan no cog mtha' dag bum pa gang byor gsan pas mchog tu mkhas par gyur/ nyer bdun pa la gong ma'i gdan 'dren lan gsum byung na'ang /

'od zer can gyi man ngag gis bzlogs /de rjes so gsum pa la hor rgyal pos 'ja' sa dang shel dam bzhi phul nas bzhi thog tu bzhugs su gsol te bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tu bkur/ phar tshad brtag gnyis la sogs pa'i bshad grwa btsugs/ lam 'bras la sogs pa'i khrid dang dbang gis gdul bya tshims par mdzad/ so drug pa la dbus su phebs te them bu spyan snga grags pa rgyal mtshan la chos gnang / bsam yas zhig gsos kyi grwa btsugs/ so bdun pa la yang hor gyi gdan 'dren byung pas/ ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan bzhi thog tu bskos rta la chibs pa spangs te/ zhabs thang mdzad de byang 'dam gyi bar byon/ stag lung pa rat+na a ka ra la thugs bskyed gnang / g.yang la la kha ba chen po babs kyang thang rkyang mdzad de byon pas rlangs pa phyu re byung pas kun ngo mtshar du gyur/ ra sgreng du jo bo'i rgya dpe rnams gzigs pas 'ja'i gur phub dge 'dun rnams la chos gsungs pas me tog gi char babs/ dpon slob nyi shu tsam klung shod/ 'ol kha/ dwags po sman lung / ca de yul rnams brgyud de rjam yul gyi mkhar lung bzang du phyag phebs/ lo gcig gi bar du thugs dam 'dag sbyar la bzhugs/ bu ston rin po che gdan 'dren la phebs pas gtsang du 'byon pa ni ma gnang par dbus su skor gcig phebs/ bla chen bsod blo pa gdan sar brdzangs/ slar yang dwags por thegs/ ma gcig snyung ba'i gdan 'dren byung bas mgyogs par byon/ bo dong er yum sras mjal/ ma gcig 'das pa dag pa'i zhing du 'dren par mdzad/ de nas sa skyar mkhas btsun stong phrag mang po la dbang dang lam 'bras kyi khrid gnang / dbus su phebs te nyan por phar phyin gsung dus/ gro pa kun mkhyen pas thub pa chen po sher phyin gsung ba mthong / sher rdor bas chos rje nyid 'jam dbyangs su mthong ste/ maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyan gyi ched du rang nyid kyi lag pa'i sor mo lnga bcad pa na/

chos rje nyid rtab rtab por gyur te de'i sor mo rnams phyag phyis kyis dkris zhal chab btab/ na ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs gnang bas de'i nub mo sor mo sngar bzhin sos/ de nas snye thang du bzhugs nas dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po la phar tshad/ brtag gnyis/ lam 'bras/ sbyor drug rnams gnang / de nas gdan sa thel du spyan snga ba sogs sde snod 'dzin pa mang po la dus 'khor gyi rgyud bshad lam 'bras sbyor drug sogs gnang / de dus lo gcig gi khongs su bsam yas kyi zhig gsos mtha' dag grub/ rab gnas kyi tshe dge 'dun khri phrag lhag tsam 'dus/ lha'i me tog sna lnga pa'i char babs/ de nas sa skyar byon te chos gsungs pa'i skabs su hor gyi gdan 'dren pa byung bas/ dpon slob bco brgyad kyis zla ba gnyis kyi bar du nyin mo bzhugs shing mtshan mo 'bros pa'i dka' ba spyad nas/ zhe brgyad pa la yang mkhar lung bzang du byon/ der lo gcig bar du sku mtshams mdzad nas slob ma mang po la lam 'bras dang / sbyor drug gi khrid bka' mang po bug sgo las gnang / dus 'khor ṭika chen mdzad par brtsams pa na/ mnal lam du bud med sngo sangs rgyan dang bcas pa gcig gis snag snyug gtad nas/ da bris shig zer byung bas mthar phyin pa'i ltas su dgongs/ lnga bcu pa la brag rings zhes pa'i gnas su sku 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa zla ba drug gi bar du thugs dam kho na la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ slob dpon mañdzu shrī las sku lus cung zad re ma bcags na skyon ma mchis lags sam zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin gnad du song na de nyid lus sbyong du'ang 'gro ba yin par 'dug gsungs/ de nas mtha' rgyas su byon nas bla chen bsod blo pa gong du brdzangs/ rtses thang bsam gtan gling du rgyal sras thogs med pa dang lhan cig zla ba gsum thugs dam la bzhugs/ snye thang chos rdzong btab ste/ der si tu chos rin pas zhu ba po mdzad nas sde snod 'dzin pa lnga bcu tsam la thugs rtsom ṭika chen gyi steng nas dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgyas par gnang /

khrid rim yang rgyun mi chad du gnang / de nas yang nga gsum pa la mkhar lung bzang du phebs te/ dus 'khor don du gnyer ba'i dge bshes mang po phyag phyir byon pa rnams la dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgyas pa dang / khrid rim rnams gnang / de nas lo gcig na kong po nos par dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi dkyil 'khor blos bslangs bzhengs/ kong po rol gsum pa la phyag phebs nas skye bo'i tshogs chen po la sems bskyed gnang / lo gcig gi bar rgya bsdams/ sbu chu lha khang du 'bum nag dang 'bum dmar gzigs pas me tog gi char babs/ 'o thang mtsho mos yul sde la gnod pa bsgyur/ nga drug pa la bod klung la brgyud de byar bel ka pho brang yangs rtse rnams su phebs/ gnyal lte'u rar dbyar chos la brtag gnyis dang lam 'bras gnang / gser phye 'bum pa'i drung du sems bskyed gsungs pas/ thams cad kyis gzung du thub pa'i me tog gi char babs/ lha sar jo bo rin po che la khri rgyab phul/ snye thang du dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgyas par gsungs pas/ ra 'bro shong 'gyur gyi dpe 'grems brgya lhag byung / dbus phyogs kyi dus 'khor 'chad nyan pa gcig la de nyid sde snod 'dzin pa'i tshogs 'du che bar grags/ rlung ltas la sku tshe'i bar chad 'ong bar mkhyen nas g.ye go ra gdong du rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'bum phrag gcig mdzad pas lo lnga sku tshe bsrings/ mkhan chen grags rgyal ba la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gnang / 'jam dbyangs gu shrī la sbyor drug gnang / bo dong er dge 'dun bzhi khri lhag 'dus pa la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te gser zho re'i 'gyed gnang / de nas sa skyar phebs te tshogs su dus 'khor gyi chos 'byung mdor bsdus dang po yan gyi bshad pa/ brtag gnyis rnams gsungs/ rten rnams la zhig gso mdzad/ sku khams cung zad bsnyel dus thub pa chen po la gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba mngon sum du gzigs ma thag snyung ba dwangs/

de nas bo dong er lo chen byang rtse sogs gtsang phyogs kyi bla ma rnams kyis thog drangs te sde snod 'dzin pa sha stag dang / bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang du 'dus pa la dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgyas pa/ lam 'bras sbyor drug rim lnga spros med la sogs khrid/ dbang byin rlabs mang du gnang / de nas dpal sdings/ chu mig snar thang / zha lu rnams su'ang chos kyi 'khor lo skor bzhin par byon te dbus phyogs su phebs/ bsam yas su dge 'dun nyi khri 'dus pa la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ gser zho re'i 'gyed gnang / rje 'di'i bka' 'bum po ti nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhugs pa las/ khyad par du dus 'khor skor la bsdus don chos 'byung / stong 'jug gi rtsis/ sbyor drug gi khrid yig ngo sprod/ srung 'khor gnyis/ mngon dkyil/ thugs dkyil mngon rtogs/ rnal 'byor ma'i mchod chog rnams so/ /rje 'dis dge bsnyen dang dge tshul lta zhog bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog pa la stong phrag lnga lhag pa byung / sdom pa 'bogs pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / rab gnas rnams la sla bcos gtan mi mdzad/ tshul khrims kyi dri dang ldan/ kho bo lo bcu bdun pa la rab tu byung nas da'i bar tshul khrims gtsang bar bsrungs pas 'di nga'i 'phrin las kyi gtso bo yin gsungs/ dus phyis bod du byung ba gcig la mkhan chen bu ston pa'i brtson 'grus la sus kyang mi do/ de ma gtogs nga yang brtson 'grus chung rgyu med gsungs/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i thugs mi mnga' ste/ gzigs rtog gi skabs su'ang phyag dpe'i steng du stong gzugs dus rgyun du 'byung gsungs/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i zhabs gnyis la 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan/ sku lus la srin bu'i rigs mi 'byung / skye bo gzhan las mchog tu gyur pa'i gzi 'od 'bar/ gsung snyan cing tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan no/ /re gsum pa la bla ma gzhon rgyal pa la bde ba can na sa chen yab sras kyang bzhugs/

snga phyi kun tu der skye bar smon lam btab pa yin na'ang / byams chos 'di rnams la thos bsam byas pa'i mthu yin nam dga' ldan du 'gro bar 'dug gsungs/ der sde snod 'dzin pa nyer lnga pa tshan pa gsum la dus 'khor gyi dbang rdzogs pa dang / dbang mdor bstan dang / lam 'bras dang / sbyor drug gnang / de nas bsam yas su phebs/ mkhan chen zhi ba mtsho'i dbu thod bla brang du gdan drangs/ nyin re bzhin brgya phyag mdzad cing smon lam btab/ tho rangs bu ston rin po chen dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byon nas/ bu ston pas 'di rang mkha' spyod yin no gsungs pa byung / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mang pos gang ba gzigs/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang po la chag lo tsā ba de la rnam thar bzang po yod pas ltos shig gsungs/ re bzhi pa yos lo zla ba drug pa'i nyi shu lnga la sa g.yo ba dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa dang bcas pa'i cho 'phrul bstan te dga' ldan du gshegs so/ /de dus kyi mkhas btsun rnams dang / khyad par du dus 'khor smra ba phal mo che rje de'i slob mar ma gyur pa med pas bgrang bar mi spyod la/ bye brag tu mtshungs med gzhon nu grags pa ni 'phan yul du sku 'khrungs/ gzhung lugs mang po la legs par sbyangs/ khyad par du 'dul mdzod la mchog tu mkhas/ gnas brtan chen po tshul khrims shin tu gtsang ba/ rgyal sras thogs med pa la thugs bskyed dang blo sbyong gsan pas byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs/ bu ston rin po che la dbang dang gdams ngag mang du mnos shing / khyad par du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mkhar lung bzang du bzhugs pa'i drung du/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang sbyor drug gsan pas sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du gyur/ khrab la khar 'dul mdzod dus chos su gsungs shing / rang nyid zab lam gyi thugs dam la gtso bor bzhugs te rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de la 'khrul zhig pa/

yang dpal ldan bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'khrul zhig pa ste/ de la bla ma dus zhabs pas dpal ldan bla ma'i sbyor drug gi khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa dang / sron lugs kyi gdams pa rnams gsan no/ /yang brgya la ba yon tan 'od kyis dpal ldan bla ma las dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa gsan pas mkhas shing grub pa brnyes/ de la shangs pa kun mkhyen shes rab bzang po/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa mgos lo tsā bas dpal ldan bla ma'i ṭika chen nges don gsal byed kyi lung gsan te/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi thugs sras kyi mchog tu gyur pa bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis chos rje nyid sbyor drug gi khrid gsung ba'i dus su/ khrid gnyer mdzad pa sogs kyi sgo nas chos rje nyid la rgya bod kyi sbyor drug gi rigs ma tshang ba med pa mnga' ba rnams dang / chos rje bla ma rang gi ṭik+ka'i steng nas bshad bka' legs par stsal te/ rgyud 'grel la yang mkhas par gyur pa sogs dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor rnams mtha' chod par gsan cing / de'i drung du grub chen bud+dha shrīs sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid sogs nos nas nyams len snying por mdzad pas/ mnyam rjes kun tu stong gzugs la dag pa'i snang ba rgyun mi 'chad par 'char ba sogs lugs 'di'i nyams rtags thams cad mthar phyin par gyur/ grub chen de'i drung du sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsan te zla ba drug sbyor drug gi khrid bskyangs pa na/ rgyud dang 'grel pa las gsungs pa'i/ re kha nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong par gyur gyi bar du'o/ /zhes dang / de yi dbus su sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs kyi nyams snang rnams 'khrungs/

de dus phyi rol tu stong gzugs la dkyil 'khor du ma'i lha thams cad sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa spyan nam mkha' la log ge byas pa mang du byung / spyan gyen du gzigs pa de rnams ci yin nam snyam ste/ rang gi mig gis byed pa'i rten 'brel yin pa 'dra gsungs/ nang du rtsa dbu ma srog shing gi tshul du gnas pa'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang bcas pa mang du gzigs pa la/ rim gyis steng nas steng du thugs gtad pa la shin tu gyes pa chen po byung mod/ de dus de nas bshad pa'i gegs 'byung nye ba la/ 'grel pa nas bshad pa'i gegs bsal dbang rgyal lugs de dran pas gegs thams cad bsal nus gsungs/ gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang mchod rten/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa gzigs pa sogs rgyas shing ya mtshan che ba yod mod kyi re zhig de tsam mo/ /rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs tshad med pa skyes te/ dpal dam tshig chen po'i rgyud du sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / /dkyil 'khor rnams kyang rgya che ba/ /gzugs sgra de bzhin dri dang ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag skyong bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i ngor chen rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyis kyang dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud man ngag rnams grangs dang tshad med pa'i slob ma rnams phyogs dus kun tu 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa yin la/ yang chos rje bla ma dam pa'i sku'i dbon po theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis kyis kyang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud man ngag rnams chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs la gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes shing spel bar mdzad pa las/ de'i slob ma'i gtso bo sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun dga' rnam gnyis kyi nang tshan/ nyi lde ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis kyang dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor rnams tshang bar theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du gsan pa bzhin/

bshad sgrub kyis gtan la phab ste/ nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / kho bo lam 'bras la mkhas pa yin/ sbyor drug pa nyams myong can yin/ nai gu ba rgan po yin zhes gsungs shing / dpal ldan sa skya sogs su 'chad nyan yang yang mdzad pas/ de dus slob ma rnams sgom skyong ba'i mun khang mang po da lta yang sa skya'i nyi lde bla brang na yod pa 'di yin no/ /yang sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi thugs gus zhen gyi dbang las/ chos rje bla ma nas brgyud pa'i dus 'khor sgra pa sher rin sogs la gsan nas spel ba'i rgyun da lta'i bar du gong dkar rdo rje gdan na dar rgyas su bzhugs so/ /yang dus phyis sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pa sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes thog mar chag lo chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chos rnams gsan par bzhed kyang / dus 'khrugs kyi dbang gis phyag bzhes ma thub pa la/ slar mgos lo dharmā pā la'am/ zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang por grags pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid las/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du nos nas mun khang dang lus gnad byed bcings sogs ji skad bshad pa bzhin mdzad nas thugs dges spro dang bcas bsgoms pas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs dang nyams myong bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs shing / dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang sogs su rang nyid kyi dbon thugs kyi sras mchog snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed 'gran zla dang bral ba dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid gtso bor bzhugs pa'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rdzogs pa rten 'brel legs cha dang bcas gnang bas mtshon pa'i lugs 'di'i dbang rgyud man ngag gi chos kyi 'khor lo yang yang bskor ba la brten 'di skor gyi dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin nos pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo yang /

sku'i gcung bdag chen rin po che nam mkha' 'dod grub pa'i zhal snga nas dang / lung rigs smra ba'i khyu mchog lcags thang rab 'byams pa/ nyams rtogs kyi mnga' bdag mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ gcig tu dben pa la gzhol zhing mkhas btsun gyi yon tan rgya mtsho dang ldan pa byang pa dus 'khor ba rin chen bzang po/ yongs 'dzin e waṃ pa chen po mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub/ gong du smos pa ltar rang nyid kyi sku'i dbon po sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma sku mched sogs spyi dang bye brag gi bstan 'dzin gyi slob bus rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di nyid mdzes par byas pa yin la/ de ltar sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po 'di'i slob brgyud dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan 'dzin so so ba dag gi rnam par thar pa rnams ni 'og sa lo nyid kyi rnam thar gyi rjes su 'chad par 'gyur la/ rgyas par ni 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas mi spro bas rang rang gi rnam thar las shes par bya'o/ /rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs sogs gsan pa'i lo de ni shing pho spre'u lo byang sham+bha lar gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa rigs ldan rnam gnon rgyal sar byon pa'i lo de yin te/ de yang lo de'i sa ka'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes la/ thog mar dbang yongs rdzogs dang / de nas zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i nyams khrid/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel chen po shong 'gyur la/ lo tsā ba blo gros rnam pa gnyis kyis bcos pa'i steng nas bshad bka' sogs lugs 'di'i chos skor rnams rdzogs par gsan par mdzad nas/ de nas lo grangs bcu drug 'das pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo rje e waṃ pa chen po rang nyid dgung lo zhe bzhi bzhes pa'i tshe/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel nas 'byung ba'i rtsis kyi lo dag dang bstun pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsis kyi yi ge mkhas pa'i kha rgyan zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar can de nyid mdzad pa yin de/

de yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa dus nam gyi tshe byung ba dang / sngar lo grangs du tsam 'das shing / ma 'ongs pa bstan pa'i lhag lo du zhig yod pa dang / deng sang sham bha lar rigs ldan su zhig chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i skabs yin pa sogs bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir bstan rtsis mkhas pa'i kha rgyan de nyid 'dir bshad par bya ste/ de yang ji skad du/ tshig nyung don mang 'jug pa bde ba yi/ /rnam gzhag 'di 'dra gang gis shes de mkhas/ /zhes pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i bstan rtsis kyi yi ge de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel las/ /'byung ba'i rtsis kyi lo dag dang / /bstun pa'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsis/ /mkhas pa'i kha rgyan 'dir nges bya/ /thub dbang shing pho byi ba la/ /bltams nas nyer dgu khab bzhugs te/ /lo drug dka' spyad so drug pa/ /sa mo phag lo mngon byang chub/ /brgyad cu bzhes pa chu lug gi /nag pa'i nya la 'bras spungs su/ /zla bzang phyag rdor gyi sprul ba/ sogs la dus 'khor gyi/ /rtsa rgyud gsungs nas sa ga yi/ /nya la mya ngan 'das tshul bstan/ /lo lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i lo/ /drang srong rnams ni smin don du/ /mi bdag grags pa zhes bya ba/ /sham+bha la zhes bya bar 'byung / /zhes dang / 'grel chen las/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyang nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya na zhes rtsa rgyud bstan pa'am/ mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya na grags pa 'byung bar lung bstan pas/ de nyid la ni zla bzang gis /sham bha la ru rtsa rgyud spel/ /shing lo gnyis pa yan la 'grel chen stong phrag drug cu pa brtsams/ gzhal med khang bzhengs nas gshegs pa'i lo/ sprel nas brtsams lha dbang dang / /gzi brjid gshin rje gshed/ can dang zla sgrib bsal/ bas byin/ /lha yi dbang phyug sna khengs byed tshogs gzugs/ /nam snying lha yi dbang ldan rnam drug gis/

/lo brgya lo brgyar rtsa rgyud bstan/ /shing sprel lo nas grags pa yis/ /lo brgyar rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan nas/ /chu mo phag la bsdus rgyud bsdus/ /shing byi lo nas pad dkar spyan ras gzigs dang / /bzang po gshin rje gshed dang ni rnam rgyal sa snying dang / /gshin rje smugs byed bzang dang phyag dmar sgrib sel dang / /khyab 'jug khengs byed sbas dang nyi ma nam snying grags/ /shin tu bgegs dgra bzang brgyad re res kyang / /lo grangs brgya brgyar bsdus rgyud bstan/ /de nas klu yi lo brgya rnams kyi nges par mkha'i yul du kla klo'i chos dag rab tu 'jug ces grags pas bsdus rgyud bsdus nas lo brgyad brgya na ma gar kla klo 'jug par lung bstan pas/ shing sprel lo la ma kha ru/ /kla klo zhugs dang sham+bha lar/ /rgya mtsho phyag rdor rnam rgyal byon dus mtshungs/ /de yis lo brgyar chos bstan rjes/ /shing byi lo la rgyal dka' gshin rje gshed byon/ /de nas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /'das pa me pho khyi yi lo/ /rgyal dkas nyung ngu'i byed 'grel chen las/ kla klo'i dus de las brgyad cu rtsa gnyis lhag pa'i brgyas dman pa ni rgyal dka' gang gi nyung ngus byed pa rnam par sbyong ba rigs ldan rgyal dka'i dus so/ /rtsis mdzad/ /de nas bco brgyad 'das pa yi/ /shing pho 'brug la nyi ma sa snying / byon/ /lo brgya 'das pa shing sprel la/ /sna tshogs gzugs smug byed byon lo brgyar bzhugs/ /shing byi lo la zla ba'i sgrib sel 'od/ /rgyal sar byon nas lo gsum ni/ /'das pa rab byung me yos la/ /dus 'khor 'phags pa'i yul du byon/ /me mkha' rgya mtsho rtsis kyi gzhir/ /'jog pa kla klo zhugs pa nas/ /bar gyi lo 'grel chen las/ de dag gsum lhag pa'i bzhi brgya'i phung po la bsres pa ni kla klo'i lor rab tu 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas so/ /grangs nges phyir te/ /de la brgya dang gya gnyis kyis/

/'phri ba'i lhag ma rgyal dka' yis/ /nyung ngu'i byed rtsis mdzad tshun gyi/ /'das lo yin no mkhas pa rnams/ /me yos de nas go bdun ni/ /'das pa shing pho 'brug lo nas/ /mtha' kheng byed yas dang ni sa skyong nam snying dang / /dpal skyong bgegs dgra dang ni seṅge phyag rdor yis/ /lo brgya lo brgyar dam chos bstan/ /de ltar dus 'khor 'phags yul du/ /byon nas bzhi brgya go bdun ni/ /'das pa shing pho sprel lo la/ /rigs ldan rnam gnon gshin rje gshed rgyal sar byon/ /lo de'i sa ka'i dkar phyogs la/ /'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā las/ /bdag gis dus 'khor dbang rdzogs mnos/ /de nas lcags byi 'di yan la/ /lo grangs bcu drug 'das pa yin/ /de phyir thub dbang mya ngan las/ /'das nas lo 'di yan chad la/ /nyis stong bzhi brgya bcu drug 'das/ /grags pas bsdus pa'i rgyud bsdus nas/ /stong dang bdun brgya bcu drug 'das/ /mkha' yi yul du kla klo'i chos/ /zhugs nas dgu brgya bcu drug 'das/ /rgyal dkas nyung ngu'i rtsis mdzad nas/ /bdun brgya sum cu so bzhi 'das/ /dus 'khor shī ta'i lhor byon nas/ /drug cu skor brgyad dang nyag ma so gsum sogs dril bas/ lnga brgya bcu gsum legs par 'das/ /rnam gnon seṅge'i khrir bzhugs te/ /dam chos bstan nas bcu drug 'das/ /ma 'ongs bstan pa'i lhag ma ni/ /rnam gnon lhag ma gya bzhi dang / /'byon 'gyur rigs ldan stobs sa snying po che/ /ma smug byed 'gags pa dang mi'i sgrib sel seṅge/ /nam snying dbang phyug chen po mtha' phyag rdor yas rnam rgyal dang / /'jam dbyangs grags pa phyi ma drag phyi rol tu le'u dang po nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo can gang yin pa de ni lus la rdo rje can te thugs rdo rje'o zhes gsungs pas phyag rdor gyi sprul pa po ste/ /re res lo brgya dam chos ston/ /de nas lo brgyar kla klo yi/ /chos lugs nag phyogs 'grib pa dang /

/thub bstan dkar phyogs zla ba ni/ /rdzogs ldan gyur pa mnyam du 'byung / /kla klo rdzogs nas lho gling 'dir/ /stong dang brgyad brgyar dam chos 'di yan la sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo lnga stong chig brgya 'das par bzhed/ mdo sde'i phyogs las 'dzam gling 'dir bstan pa lo lnga stong gnas par bshad pa dang yang phyogs tsam mthun no/ /stong brgyad brgya brgyad brgyar gnas pa/ bcu gcig po/ gnas/ /gling gzhan du yang de bzhin no/ /rgyal dka' gnyis la lo grangs lhag /sbyor bar mdzad la dmigs bsal med/ /la la rigs ldan nyer drug tu/ /'dod kyang dgung grangs drug cu par/ /mdzad pa lung dang mthun ma sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya pa phyag na 'khor los bsgyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i mtha'i don mjug la bshad pa yod kyang 'di rdzogs pa'i don yin pas so gsum yin gsungs/ yin/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan so gnyis po/ /mtha' dag dam chos lo brgya brgyar/ /ston pa rgyud dang mthun no zhes/ /kho bo'i 'jam dbyangs bla mas gsungs/ /de ltar 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid kyi/ /'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /'jig rten khams 'dir ji tsam gnas pa'i tshul/ /legs bshad 'di yis thub bstan rgyas gyur cig /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel dang mthun pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsis mkhas pa'i kha rgyan zhes bya ba btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ kun ldan zhes pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo gsal bar bkod pa la slar yang shin tu dag par byas pa'o/ /de ltar shrī e waṃ pa chen po rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub de nyid kyis rgyud 'grel dang mthun pa'i bstan rtsis mkhas pa'i kha rgyan lcags pho byi ba'i lor mdzad pa nas bzung / dus 'khor chos 'byung ngo mtshar dad pa'i shing rta 'di nyid kyi rtsom pa po dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo so dgu lon pa shing mo phag gi lo 'di yan la lo dgu bcu go lnga 'das pa yin pas/

rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir thub dbang mya ngan las 'das nas shing mo phag lo 'di yan chad la lo nyis stong lnga brgya dang bcu gcig 'das shing rigs ldan grags pas bsdus pa'i rgyud bsdus nas stong dang brgyad brgya bcu gcig lon la/ mkha'i yul du kla klo'i chos zhugs nas stong phrag gcig dang bcu gcig 'das shing / rigs ldan rgyal dkas nyung ngu'i rtsis mdzad nas lo brgyad brgya dang nyer dgu lon la/ deng sang sham+bha lar sa snying gi sprul pa rigs ldan stobs po che byon pa'i dus yin la/ de yang shing mo glang gi lo rgyal sar byon nas seṅge'i khri la bzhugs te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nas bzung / shing phag 'di yan la lo bcu gcig 'das pas na/ ma 'ongs pa bstan pa'i lhag ma ni/ stobs po che'i lhag ma lo gya dgu dang / 'byon 'gyur rigs ldan ma 'gags pa nas/ drag po'i bar te lnga phrag gcig yod pas/ re res lo brgyar dam pa'i chos ston cing / rigs ldan phyi ma de nyid kyi dus su kla klo'i chos lo brgya'i bar du rgyas par bshad la/ kla klo de dag rigs ldan tha ma des bcom nas/ slar yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dam pa'i chos stong dang brgyad brgya'i bar du gnas par bshad cing / de yan chad la thub dbang mya ngan las 'das nas lo lnga stong dang chig brgya lon par bzhed la/ rgyu mtshan des na mdo las sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lo lnga stong du gnas par bshad pa dang phyogs mthun tsam yin par mkhas pa rnams bzhed pa yin no/ /de dag gis ni bod yul gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa la bka' drin che ba'i ra 'bro sa gsum gyi bla ma rnams kyi byon tshul rags rim tsam brjod pa yin la/ de'i rjes su dus 'khor bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po jo zhal gnyis sam/ bu dol gnyis su grags pa'i byon tshul la thog mar bu ston chos kyi rgyal po ni yab brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes pa gdung rabs bcu bdun du sngags rnying ma'i grub thob zam ma chad pa'i mkhas grub cig dang /

yum slob dpon ma bsod nams 'bum zhes pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos la mnga' brnyes pa zhig gi sras su lcags pho stag la shab smad bsgom gnas su sku 'khrungs/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī'i sku skyer grags/ 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs/ dus phyis kyang gzigs rtog ma grub par chos gsung ba'i tshe/ yon tan ye shes bzang po'i bstod sgrub re sngon du btang na tshig don thams cad gsal lam me thugs la 'char/ dgung lo lnga drug nas yum gyis klog slob par brtsams pa na/ 'da' ka ye shes dang sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa las sbyar klog mdzad pas klog mkhyen pa dang thugs la zin pa mnyam du byung / mes bla chen tshul khrims dpal bzang po'i phyag dpe gzigs pas 'di bstan bcos rnam dag go /'di ni min no zhes so sor phye bas mes pho'ang shin tu dgyes yig rtsis bslabs pas slob dpon las mkhas par gyur/ bdun pa la khro phu rin po che'i drung du sems bskyed zhus pas/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi thugs bcos min du 'khrungs/ brgyad pa la khro phur rje de'i drung du bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang zhus dus 'di'i dbu la phyag bzhag nas/ 'o 'di la nga'i ngal gsos byed pa lags so gsungs/ khro phu ba'i zab chos rnams gnang / mes po'i drung du gsang sngags rnying ma mang du gsan/ bzo/ sman spyad mkhas par mkhyen/ bco brgyad pa la lo tsho'i mkhan brgyud mkhan po rin chen seṅge dang / slob dpon tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon po las rab tu byung ste/ mtshan rin chen grub tu btags/ slob dpon de'i drung du phar phyin gyi slob gnyer la bzhugs te/ 'di'i phyogs su shi na'ang shi snyam du dgongs te/ nyin mtshan du gsol ba dang mnal gyi long med par gsan sbyangs la 'bad pas sku seng seng par song ste kun gyis snying rje'i gnas su byed/ gzhung ṭika ka nag 'byams thugs su chud cing /

nyi snang / brgyad stong 'grel chen/ byams pa dang 'grel ba'i chos sde nyi shu la mkhas par gyur nas/ khro phur bshad gsar mdzad de sde snod 'dzin pa rnams rigs pas zil gyis mnan/ bod na ka pā li 'grems pa gcig la shes rab che bar grags/ de nas mdo rtsa dang me tog phreng rgyud gsan cing gtso bor rnam nges la sbyangs pas sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa tshegs med du mkhyen/ de nas mngon pa kun las btus la sbyangs te/ snga dro gzhung shog bu mda' tshad ma bdun dang / ṭik+ka shog bu lnga thugs su 'dzin pa dang / phyi dro bshad pa rtsal bshad du gsan pas zla ba gcig la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ spyod 'jug dang rigs tshogs dbu ma'i skor rnams kyang gsan/ yang rtse pa rin chen seṅge la bde mchog sogs sngags chos mang po gsan/ nyer gcig pa la yab lhan cig dbus gtsang gi chos sde phal che bar grwa skor la byon/ dbus nas shāka gzhon/ btsan dgon pa ba/ kha rag byang gzhon/ gtsang nas dpal ldan seṅge/ 'jam skya sogs lung rigs kyis btul bas pha ston bu ston du grags shing / khyad par rje'i grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pas mkhas pa'i grags pas sa thams cad du khyab/ de nas rnam snang ba yon tan rgya mtsho la spyod 'jug don grub dpal ba la brtag gnyis/ yab la phyag rdor/ grang so lung pa la don zhags/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal la rnam 'grel gsan/ de nas khro phur 'chad nyan mdzad de phar tshad mngon gsum la bshad pa'i rkang btsugs/ nyer gsum pa la tshong 'dus mgur mo'i bla brang du ka bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ byang sems bsod nams grags/ bsod nams bzang po ste/ chos lung mkhan po gsum gyis mkhan slob mdzad/ dad pa'i dge 'dun nyer gnyis kyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob la mdo rtsa/ so thar gyi mdo/ karma sha tam blo sbyong rnams gsan/ de nas thar pa gling du thar lo'i drung du zla ba bcu bar ma chad dang / mar lo bzhi bzhugs nas ka tsan gyi mdo byings nyer bsgyur u ṇa dang /

a ma ra ko ṣa rnams saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du thugs 'dzin mdzad nas/ de rnams 'grel pa dang bcas pa legs par sbyangs/ rgya gar shar nub/ kha che/ siṅgha la/ sin+dhu/ rgya mtsho mtha' la sogs pa'i yi ge rigs mang po mkhyen/ lo tsā byang bar gyur/ de nas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas zab lam gyi khrid zhus pas/ chos 'di'i bdag po khyod rang yin pas bgyi'o gsungs nas/ dpe med mtsho dang / sha wa ra'i gdams pa gnang ste/ 'dag 'byar bug sgo can du bzhugs pa na/ rtsa rlung thig le'i gnas tshul mngon sum du gzigs/ gzung 'dzin dbyings su dag nas ye shes chen po'i rtsal rdzogs/ rin chen snang ba dang rin chen sgron ma sogs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma mngon du gyur te nyams rtogs mngon par shes pa thogs pa med pa 'khrungs/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes las tha mal du nam yang ma mthong gsungs/ dbang mdor bstan rgyud phyi ma/ sems 'grel gnyis/ don dam bsnyen pa/ nā ro pa/ a bha ya/ brtson 'grus dpal gyi sbyor drug dbang rab byed kyi 'grel pa/ snying po rgyan/ sa r+hu su tra'i sgrub dkyil/ nyi zla sgrub pa/ ye shes spyan sgrub/ sbas pa mig 'byed/ thar lo nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sbyor drug gi skor sogs mang du gsan/ de nas dpal ldan seṅge'i drung du ra 'bro'i dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba las khyad par phyag len ra lugs gtso bor ston pa'i dbang zhus pa'i tshe/ bla ma rdo rje shugs dngos su gzigs/ gzhan yang bde dge sgyu thod rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang sogs gsan/ de nas rong dben dmar du bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du byon/ zla ba dgu bar ma chad du bsten nas dus 'khor rgyud 'grel ra 'bro'i bzhed tshul so sor phye ba'i rgyud bshad mdzub khrid tshar gnyis cha lag dang bcas pa gsan te tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas par gyur/ bla mas kyang 'o chos bdag po la 'phrod da blo bde'o gsungs/

dus phyis kyang dus 'khor kho na thugs rtsis che zhing / gsung ba'i dus na'ang 'di dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bya ba gzhan gyi rgyud 'grel bas 'di'i dkyil chog kyang dga'/ rgyud gzhan gyi dkyil chog pas 'di'i srung 'khor yang tshan che/ 'di 'dra ba'i chos slob pa la 'o yang zhor la shes pa mi mchi/ 'dir byon cig gsungs nas sa ris la sogs pa rnams dpon slob chos khri'i kha ru bsgrigs nas mdzad/ brjed tho'i dpe chung dang 'phrul 'khor gyi gnad la sogs pa rnams rgyud 'grel dang bstun gyin phyag len mdzad/ 'o skol sngags pa kun la phra mo'i lag len tshun chad la dri gtugs byed pa gcig rang ma byung na/ oṃ sob sob re'i dge bshes la gsha' ma mi mchi/ des na 'di lta bu'i rgyud la slob gnyer byed na/ khal lo thon du dka' dka' la nan tan chen po 'tshal/ ma bde ba byung na dris shig chos zab la rgya che ba sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ bsdu byed rnams kyis bsdus/ paṇa grub rnams kyis bsgyur/ mkhas pa rnams kyis gtan la phab/ bshad pa'i srol ma chag dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ lhad ma zhugs/ 'dres ma khyer/ dam ma nyams/ bka' brgyud grub thob kyi zam ma chad/ byin rlabs kyi na bun ma yal/ mdo rgyud 'grel pa zab mo rnams kyi lde mig sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad kyi spyi lam 'di lta bu'i chos bshad nyan byar yod pa tshogs bsags pa yin pas da chud ma gsan rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod ces nan tan gyi sgo nas gsungs shing / dka' ba'i gnad rnams la dri ba zhus pa la shin tu dgyes/ dza lan+dha ri pa'i dngos slob bi bhu ti dā ma la gtum mo dang gegs sel dang bar phug rong pa gzhon nu grub pa la bka' gdams pa'i lugs mang po gsan/ so gcig pa la sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas gdan drangs/ zha lu gser khang gi gtsug lag khang du phyag phebs nas ka chen bzhi la bshad pa'i rkang mdzad nas bshad nyan gyi grwa btsugs pa na/

grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis chags sdang gi rnam 'gyur mi zad pa bstan pa zhi ba'i ched du dbu mdzad bkra shis bzang po la phar phyin gsan/ 'on kyang da dung ma bzlogs par spyan la rde'u 'phen pa sogs byas pas/ rang la mi phan gzhan la gnod pa yi/ /bdag gi 'chad nyan 'di 'dras ci bgyi lags/ /za 'dug 'gro 'chag nyal sogs ci byas kyang / /gzhan gyi khong khro'i rgyu ru 'gyur la skyo/ /da ni tshe yang ring du mi gnas shing / /nang gi dbang po yongs su mi gsal la/ /skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod par dka'/ /cung zad shes pa nyams len dus la babs/ /gsungs nas re zhig thugs las chung ngu la gzhol ba na/ sku zhang chen po rtab rtob por gyur nas ma rung pa rnams srog gi chad pa la gtugs pa na/ de rnams kyang 'gyod pas nongs pa chags shing rje 'di kho na skyabs su bsten te mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi 'jig skyobs dang bstan pa la dgongs nas slar yang chos kyi 'khor lo zla med pa bskor/ de dus grub ze dmar ba la bde mchog gsan/ de nas sngon jo bo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bsti gnas/ de'i mchod rten yang bzhugs pa'i zha lu'i ri phug tu gtsug lag khang dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa bzhengs/ sngar rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la dus 'khor gsan pa'i dus su gsang 'dus shes pa gcig byung na slob zhus pas/ nged kyi mched grogs slob dpon 'phags pa bya ba 'phags yog dus gsum la mkhas pa zhig ma ngag phyogs na yod gsungs te rtsad bcad pas/ phyis skyis mkhar na bzhugs pa gsan nas gdan 'dren pa btang pas/ mnal lam du bud med bum pa chus cung ma gang ba gcig dang / rnal 'byor pa gcig gis rdo rje dril bu gcig khyer byung nas/ 'di pa sngar khyed rang gi yin pa/ na ning na brag ram na yar la phyin/ da khyed rang la gtod pa yin zer nas gtod du byung ba rmis/ thugs dgyes tshor dang bcas pas kun mkhyen 'phags 'od zha lu ri phug tu gdan drangs pas/

khyed la rgya pa'i rgya lugs dang gar pa'i gar lugs sogs nas dgos pa de ma yin/ 'gag 'dra bshad/ gzhan shar te bklags nas thob che ba gcig bgyi'o gsungs/ bshad pa rdo rus thug pa gcig zhu zhus pas/ a ba snying nas rang slob na/ sngon la rim lnga'i smar khrid bgyi gsungs nas dbang dang khrid gnang / de'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems mang po ting nge 'dzin gyi rtse mo sna tshogs mdzad pa dang / bskyed rim gyi dus su lha so gnyis kyi zhal gzigs/ rdor bzlas kyi dus su rtags lnga dang rlung lnga so sor gsal bar gzigs/ sku lus 'ja' 'od du gyur pa la lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du gzigs/ mnal 'od gsal du zin/ u rgyan du byon nas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang mjal/ mngon dgar byon nas rin po che'i gzhal med khang na sangs rgyas stong gral bsgrigs su bzhugs pa gzigs shing khams dag pa lta na nyi zla la zhon pa'am/ 'od zer la 'ju ba'am/ mkha' lding la zhon pa sogs byas nas gang 'gro 'dod pa'i yul du sleb pa snyam byas na mthong gi 'dug gsungs/ mtshan mo mnal lam du gsung rab gang bzhed la gzigs rtog mdzad nas sang de tshogs su gsungs/ de nas gsang 'dus 'phags skor/ ye shes zhabs lugs/ dus 'khor ra 'bro'i dbang rgyud bshad man ngag gi bka'/ nā ro pa/ jo bo rje/ shākya shrī sha wa ri/ dpyal a mo gha/ gyi jo/ rtsa mi/ sga lo/ zhang tshal pa/ srog pa lung pa/ mar pa bya ze rnams kyi sbyor drug o rgyan bsnyen sgrub sogs sbyor drug gi rigs mi 'dra ba mang po/ bde dges/ gshin rje gshed/ sgyu dra/ gdan bzhi/ ya ma/ grub snying yo ga bya spyod phal mo che'i dbang bshad man ngag gi bka' thams cad nod/ bla ma 'di la rdo rje 'chang gi 'du shes las skad cig kyang mi g.yel/ bla mas kyang chos re re gsung pa'i gsham du chos bdag po la 'phrod do gsungs/ spyir bla ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad mnga'/ mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas dbyar dgun gyi dus chos la ka bzhi/

spyod 'jug 'phags yog dus gsum zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad nas ston dpyid dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel/ rdo rje 'byung ba/ sam+bu ṭi rnams rgyun du gtso bor gsungs/ gzhan mdo rgyud kyi bshad lung man ngag thug pa med par zhar chos su gsungs/ bstan bcos mang du mdzad pa las/ dus 'khor gyi skor la/ rgyud 'grel gyi mchan/ sa bcad/ chos 'byung mkhas pa dga' byed/ lag len gyi rtsis/ myur rtsis kyi lhan thabs/ sgra rig mkhas rgyan/ mdor bsdus dang po'i ṭik+ka /nges don snye ma/ lhan skyes dang / thugs dkyil dang / yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ bstod pa/ dkyil chog de'i lhan thabs/ mchod gar/ sngags gar/ stang thabs bdun pa/ rgyud mchod/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rab gnas/ dus tha ma'i cho ga mchod phreng / go ma'i rnam gzhag zhi ba dang las bzhi'i sbyin sreg thig rtsa/ khor yug gi lha 'god tshul/ dbang mdor bstan gyi ṭik+ka khrid yig ngo sprod 'gal spong rnams mdzad/ sa skya pa don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched kyis brtag gnyis la ṭik+ka mdzad par bskul ba na/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang lan gnyis mjal/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'di'i 'grel pa byed pa de legs/ spyir bka' bstan bcos rnams dang / khyad par gsang sngags kyi bstan bcos la zhus dag dang / yang dgos su nga'i bstan bcos la nga rang gis zhus dag gcig bya snyam na'ang ma grub/ da nyid kyis zhus dag gyis shig ces lung bstan pas/ ga re bla ma rje btsun chen po dang mjal/ sa skya pa'i chos rnams dang / khyad par brtag gnyis la nga bas brgyud thag nye ba ding sang med snyam du dgongs 'grel pa bya bar lung bstan/ gong ma'i yig cha rnams la dgag bsgrub bya bar bkas gnang yang btang snyoms su bzhag nas lung 'grel mdzad/ sku zhang chen po'i rjes su sras kun dga' don 'grub kyis sbyin bdag byas nas/ zha lur rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gzhal yas khang du lha 'bum mdzad de dkyil 'khor lnga brgya lhag logs bris su bris/

bstan 'gyur bzhengs te dkar chag mdzad/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang pos shangs su gdan drangs te/ mchod rten dang lugs ma'i rten mang po zhal bskos/ spyod rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi cu lhag bya rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor sum cu lhag gi lha 'bum mdzad nas ri mor bris/ ri phug tu dus 'khor gyi sku rin po che las grub pa sogs sku mang po dang / bka' 'gyur dang / bod kyi bstan bcos kyang phal mo che bzhengs/ rgya gar/ rgya nag bal po/ hor/ yu gur/ sog po/ 'ga'/ dbus gtsang / mnga' ris/ khams kyi slob ma grangs med pa smin grol du mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched/ bsod nams blo gros sku mched/ chos lung mkhan chen bsod nams grags/ gu shrī chos grags dpal bzang po/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal sogs mkhas btsun gyi slob ma mang du 'dus/ ka chen bzhi dbu spyod kyi tshig don la mkhas pa'i ston pa dang / 'phags yog dus gsum/ gur brtag sam gsum/ lū nag dril gsum/ sgyu thod gdan gsum/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs la mkhas pa'i phyi nang gi rdo rje slob dpon phal che ba dang / bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang / ku sa li la sogs pa'i slob ma grangs kyis mi lang pa thon/ zha lur tshogs pa sum stong brgyad brgya ri phug tu sde snod 'dzin pa sha stag dang / 'dag 'byar bug sgo can la bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun lnga brgya lhag re 'dus/ stag tshal/ 'or mo/ tsha mig bre/ 'bras yul/ shangs dben dmar la sogs par skye bo khri phrag mang po la sems bskyed gnang / rgya gar gyi rgyal po puṇ+ya mal gyis 'phrin yig skyes dang bcas nas phul/ chos zab mo'i skyes lan gnang bas gus par 'dzin/ rgya nag nas rgyal po tho gan thi mur gan gyis gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa btang pa dben par bzhugs pa'i thugs dam gyis bzlogs/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud sogs gsung rab mang por zhu chen mdzad de gzhi nas bsgyur/

'gyur bcos dang hor khong bsab pa mang pos bstan pa'i srog shing mdzad/ re gnyis pa la g.ya' phag gnyis kyi 'khrug sdum la dbus su byon pa'i lam du nyang stod chu mig ra lung sogs su chos mang du gsungs/ rtsis kyi mkhan po nam mkha' rin chen sogs dge slong dge tshul mang po'i mkhan slob mdzad/ ra sog lha btsun gyi bu'i lkugs phye/kha ro dang yar 'brog sna dkar rtse la sogs par so thar dang sems bskyed mang du gnang / yar 'brog mtsho mo che la byon dus gru nang du 'dul ba'i dus go mdzad/ srin po ri/ grwa thang / yar lung rnam rgyal sne sdong / de sngon/ khra 'brug su gu do/ 'ol kha tsha thang rnams su sngags mtshan nyid theg pa che chung gi chos mang du gsungs/ de nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dwags po nas gdan 'dren pa'i ched du stong sde lung pa las yul ma la brgyud de rtsa de yul du byon par brtsams pa na/ yul de'i khrom chen po tshogs pa'i nang du gtsang mo gzugs mi tshad las nyis 'gyur gyis che ba gos ne tso gyon pa rgyan gyis mdzes pa gsum byung nas/ kye'i grong mi rnams nangs par yul rong la skyes bu dam pa khyad par can 'byon gyis/ khyed rnams kyis zam pa 'dzugs pa dang bsu skyel byas na bsod nams chen po thob po zer nas mi snang par gyur pas/ kun ngo mtshar te thang shing gi zam pa 'dzugs pa dang lam 'phrang bcos tshar ba na/ rje nyid phebs te de rnams kyis zam pa la gdan drangs byin rlabs zhus/ de ni sgrol mas chu'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa yin gsungs/ de nas dwags po mkhar lung bzang du phebs/ dpal ldan bla ma gdan 'dren par brtsams pa na/ rong mi kun gyi dmag mis bkangs pas/ dpung gi khrod du thog babs te star ka'i sdong po phye mar brlags pas/ sa skya pa'i 'dre byung zer nas/ skrag ste slar dad par gyur/ sgrum pa dang / bsgom tshigs sogs skye bo mang po la sems bskyed gnang /

sgam po rin po che sogs dam pa mang po'i mkhan slob mdzad/ de nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gdan drangs nas yar byon/ gdan sa thel dang / bsam yas sogs su lha btsun bsod nams 'od zer sogs dge bshes skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag mang po la chos gsungs/ yer pa/ gung thang / 'phrul snang ra mo che/ mtshur phu/ dbu ri/ zhu kun ra/ snye mo/ tsha mig gya ba mdo phug la sogs pa gnas bshad grwi sgom grwa che chung rnams su sngags mtshan nyid kyi bshad srol sngar med pa rnams srol gtod/ yod pa rnams dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ skye dgu'i tshogs 'bum phrag mang po theg pa chen po'i lam la bkod de/ slar ri phug tu phebs te sngar bzhin dus mchod rnams dang / sbyor drug rim lnga/ spros med/ chos drug ngal bso/ zhi byed sogs kyi khrid bka' dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bshad byin rlabs kyi bka' bar ma chad du gnang / re gsum pa la dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi phyag tshad bsgyur/ ri phug tu byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs/ dpon chen dbang brtson sogs skye bo mang po byang chub la bkod/ hor rgyal po pradzñā cing ze'u tsing dbang 'khor hor brgya phrag dang bcas pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnad zab chos la sbyar chos yon du btson gsod nges stong phrag mang po'i srog bskyabs/ khro phur khro lo'i gdan sa mdzad de bshad grwa dang sgom grwa bskyangs/ sa skyar byon nas gdung brgyud pa dang sde snod 'dzin pa gnam gyi skar ma tsam chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ khru so drug pa'i dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa la dbang bskur/ lha khang chen mor rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor blos bslangs rgyu rin po che la grub pa rtsa thig khru bcu gnyis pa'i bkod pa mdzad de bzhengs/ re bdun pa la zha lu'i gdan sar thugs sras lo tsā ba bskos nas ri phug nyid du bzhugs te/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta su ma na shrī byon pa la spyan ras gzigs pad+ma'i dra ba gsan/

chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa/ gu shrī kun dga' rin chen/ ta'i si tu/ 'jam dbyangs gu shrī rnams la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang / ti shrī bsod blo ba la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gnang / dus 'khor sogs phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po'i lo dus kyi sgrub mchod chen mo'i srol btsugs/ bo dong er thugs sras lo tsā ba dang / chos kyi dpal ba dang / tshe 'jam sogs sde snod 'dzin pa mang po la rdo rje phreng ba sogs chos rje nyid la bzhugs pa'i dbang phal mo che gnang / e'i gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas mdzad/ chu mig stag tshal sding kha/ rin spungs/ nyang stod lcang ra/ stag tshang rdzong kha/ zhu 'brog nas/ shangs mthong smon sogs su gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod/ gdan sa ri phug tu gtsang phyogs kyi dge 'dun mtha' dag bsags nas/ nga dga' ldan du 'gro ba'i phyi phyag yin gsungs spong thag mdzad/ skabs shig du mdang gsum rmi lam shin tu bzang / dga' ldan nas skas ring gsum byung ba'i dbus ma la byams pa byon/ gcig la ngas 'dzegs/ gcig la sus phyin nam gsungs/ don bzhi pa la grwa pa klog pa ba rnams zha lur brdzangs/ spong ba pa rnams nang mtshams bsdams/ chos rje nyid kyis mun khang bsrub nas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ 'brug lo'i dpyid sku khams bsnyel ba na/ rgyal sras thogs med pa sogs dge 'dun mang pos gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ mdang gsum nga'i rmi lam na rnam thos kyi bus nad tshe 'gog pa yin zer nas lus la bse khrab lta bu mang po lkogs nas skyur gtong gi gda' gsungs nas sku khams dwangs te gtang rag gi gtor ma mdzad/ slar hor zla lnga pa'i gzhug nas cung zad bsnyel te don lnga pa shing pho 'brug gi lo zla drug pa'i nyi shu gcig gi tho rangs me tog gi char dang bcas te mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan/ nyi shu bdun la gdung sbyangs pas ring bsrel yungs 'bru lta bu'i phung por gyur pas/

rgya gar/ rgya nag bal bod kyi phyogs thams cad khyab par byas/ zha lur nang rten jo bo'i sku tshad ma/ phyi rten gser 'bum/ dben zlum pa'i mchod rten/ gdan sa ri phug tu sku 'dra rin po che rnams bzhengs so/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di la bu slob bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / mchog tu gyur pa dus 'khor la mkhas pa ni/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta sa ma na shrī/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ chos kyi dpal ba gnyis/ lo chen byang rtse/ rgyal thang pa/ skyabs mchog pa/ khyung po lhas pa/ chos grags dpal ba/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal/ dbang rnon pa/ 'jam dkar ba/ dus 'khor ba shākya dpal/ tshe 'jam pa/ 'jam rin pa/ grub pa dpal gzhon nu grub/ mgon dpal ba/ dbang grags pa/ dpal chen pa sogs byung la/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi drung du lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang pos gsan/ de la sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer gyis gsan/ de la stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis gsan/ yang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa la nyang stod pa bla ma chos dpal bas gsan/ de la lo bcu gsum du dus 'khor la dril nas sbyangs pa'i bla ma rin chen bsod nams 'phel gyis gsan/ de la stag tshang lo tsā bas gsan pa sogs bu ston rin po che slob brgyud dang bcas pas kyang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir shin tu gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog tu gyur pa thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu ba chen po'i byon tshul cung zad bshad zin nas/ de'i rjes su bod 'dir rigs ldan gyi rnam 'phrul du grags pa kun mkhyen jo nang pa'am dol po sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul ni/ de yang stod kyi dol po ban tshang du/ yab nam ston ye shes dbang phyug yum jo lcam tshul khrims rgyan gyi sras su chu mo 'brug la 'khrungs/

gdung rus nam/ bla ma skyi stengs pa la 'jam dpal dbang mo che zhus/ mtshan shes rab mgon du btags/ bcu pa la mkhan chen byang chub seṅge la man ngag sogs rnying ma'i skor gsan/ bcu gsum pa la skyi stengs su mkhan po tshul khrims snying po dang / slob dpon ze phug pa las rab tu byung ba'i mtshan shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por btags/ de dus skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis skyi stengs su byon pa la rdo rje phreng ba'i gar thig bslabs pas tshegs med par mkhyen pas/ mkhas pa chen po gcig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs nas shin tu dgyes/ skyi ston pa ya tshe rgyal po'i bla ma la byon nas slar glo bor phebs pa gsan pas/ bco brgyad pa la rang gcig pur dar yug 'ga' zhig dang zangs che ba gcig bsnams glo bor byon/ skyi ston pa la tshad ma bsdus pa gsan/ skyi ston pa sa skyar thegs rjes sher bzang pa dang gzhon bzang pa bsten nas lo gnyis su rnam nges la sbyangs/ de nas sa skyar byon te skyi ston pa'i drung du phar tshad mngon gsum spyod 'jug rdo rje phreng ba rnams kyi slob gnyer dus gcig la mdzad/ skyi ston shākya 'bum/ bdag nyid bzang po dpal/ ti shrī kun blo/ nam legs pa/ shar pa seṅge dpal rnams la phar tshad mngon gsum rnam 'grel rigs gter brtag gnyis rnams gsan/ khyad par kun spangs grags rgyal ba la dus 'khor gyi dbang sgrub skor gsan/ nyer gsum pa la sa skyar phar tshad mngon gsum gyi bshad ston mdzad/ dpyid chos zla ba gnyis la tshogs chen mo'i shar sgo'i steng nas snga dro phar mngon gnyis/ phyi dro rnam nges bsdus pa gnyis gsungs/ gtsang gi chos grwa phal mo cher grwa skor yang mdzad/ nyer bzhi pa la tshong 'dus mgur mor chos lung mkhan chen bsod grags pas mkhan po/ mchog sbyin dpal bas las slob/ mkhan chen bsod bzang pas gsang ston mdzad nas jo gdan tshogs pa'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/

mkhan po la mdo rtsa dang / las slob la so thar gsan/ bsad sha mi gsol ba'i g.yar dam mdzad/ slar yang sa skyar skyi ston pa'i drung du mngon pa mdzod la sbyangs shing / phreng ba zhe gnyis ma dang nyer brgyad ma/ dus 'khor/ bde dge gsang gsum/ sgyu thod gdan gsum/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ dpal rtse dbyings gsum la sogs pa'i dbang rjes gnang nyis brgya bcu bzhi rnams dkyus thog gcig la gsan/ dus 'khor ra lugs sogs rgyud sde mang po'i bshad pa/ tshad ma sde bdun/ byams pa'i chos lnga/ pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad sogs gzhung lugs mang po dang / lung sde bzhi/ sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ phal dkon/ rgyud 'bum sogs rgyud bstan bcos man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ de nas lha sar jo shāka rnam gnyis mjal/ khyad par spyan ras gzigs kyi drung du sems 'grel skor bcu cha lag dang bcas pa'i tshig don ma lus pa thugs su chud nas/ gzhan la ston nus pa'i gsol ba drag tu btab/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma thob/ bsam yas kyang mjal zhing skyi phan gyi grwa pa phal cher grwa skor la byon/ 'jam dbyangs shaka gzhon/ btsan dgon pa/ dben dge ba sogs mkhas par grags pa rnams rigs pas btul/ mkhan po bsod nams grags pa la blo sbyong gsan pas byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs/ 'khrungs yul du byon nas yab dang mjal/ la stod mnga' ris kyi dge bshes rnams rim pas btul bas mnga' ris dbus gtsang thams cad du mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ khab gung thang du shar ba kun bsod la bde mchog gsan/ de nas sa skyar phebs te dus chos su ka chen bzhi sogs po ti lnga drug re sbrel nas gsungs/ dung dga' ldan du kye rdor gyi sgrub mchod mdzad pas bum chu khol/ yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ jo nang du gu shrī rin chen seṅge ba'i dar 'gyed skyel du byon pas/ sgrub pa ba rnams kyi sgrub tshugs la dad pa skyes te/ da gzod 'dir 'ongs nas sgom chig dril gcig bya dgos dgongs pa byung /

bla ma seṅge dpal bas bskul bas rnam 'grel gyi ṭik+ka mdzad/ seṅge dpal ba dbus phyogs kyi chos grwa thams cad du 'byon pa'i phyag phyir byon/ mtshur phur karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i drung du rang stong gi lta ba bzung nas 'bel gtam mdzad pas/ ma 'ongs pa na gzhan stong du 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ seng ge dpal ba gong du bzhud pa'i phyag phyir 'byon dgos gsungs pa la zhu ba nan gyis phul nas/ so gcig pa la jo mo nang du mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gtugs te dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang khrid gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes pas nyams rtogs kyi klong brdol/ rgyud bshad sogs chos skor ma lus pa gsan/ de nas gsang thabs su kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang por dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/ rdo rje phreng ba'i phyag len/ byams pa'i chos lnga sogs gsungs/ de nas kun spangs pa'i zhu ba po mdzad nas mkhas btsun pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang gsan dus/ thig 'debs pa la kun spangs pa las ches mkhas pa byung pas mkhas btsun pa shin tu dgyes te/ rje 'di la khyed kyis dad 'dun can rnams la rgyud 'grel tshar gcig gsung ba zhu gsungs pas/ bde ba can gyi bla yer dbus su dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ phyogs mtshams su thab thig rnams btab pas/ 'jim pas dkyil 'khor dang thab bslangs phyi 'jig rten dang nang rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi bkod pa rnams bzos/ slob ma nyis brgya tsam la rgyas par gsungs pas/ mkhas btsun pas ber thul sogs gnang sbyin chen po mdzad nas tshogs chos kyang gnang bar zhu gsungs pas/ bka' bzhin skyes rabs/ spyod 'jug bslab btus rnams gsungs/ de nas mkhas btsun pas bde dge gsang gsum sogs dbang rgyud man ngag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du rdzogs par gnang / de nas mkha' spyod bde ldan du thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas/ mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med du mnga' ba dang / srog thugs 'dres pa'i bde nyams 'ur langs pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma brtan po brnyes/

so lnga pa la bla ma'i bkas jo mo nang gi gdan sa mdzad/ kun mkhyen chen po zhes mtshan don dang mthun par kun gyis gsol/ so dgu pa la bzang ldan 'og mar mchod rten gyi sa chog mdzad pas sa g.yos shing me tog gi char babs/ de nas sku 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan mthong grol chen mo dpal yon can lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad pa rgya dpangs mnyam pa khru nyis brgya bco lnga pa/ rgyan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ gdugs kyi lha khang na rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor blos bslangs bzhugs pa lo phyed dang bzhi la grub ste rab gnas mdzad pas 'dab ma yu ba dang bcas pa'i me tog gi char kha ba babs pa tsam babs/ lhun po bzhengs pas rgya mtsho brdol ba snyam/ /zhes gsungs te chos kyi gsang mdzod brdol/ lo tsā ba rnam gnyis kyi 'gyur la zhus chen dang bcas mchan bu mdzad/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pas gtso mdzad jo gdan tshogs pa la gzhal yas khang du dus 'khor gyi dbang mo che mdzad/ de ltar lo bcu gsum gyi bar jo mo nang nyid du lo re bzhin mkhas pa mang po la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel dang byams chos rnams dus chos su gsungs shing / ston dpyid sbyor drug gi dus khrid tshogs chos/ dbyar dgun sku mtshams dam po rnams dus las ma yol bar chag med du mdzad nas/ stag lo la lo tsā ba blo gros dpal bzang po gdan sar bskos/ gzim khang bde ba can du bzhugs nas ri chos nges don rgya mtsho/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla'i ṭik+ka sogs mdzad/ gong ma tho gan thi mur gyis gdan 'dren du mngags pa'i gser yig pa byung dus/ gsang dam pos na thung du lo gnyis sngags pa'i cha lugs mdzad nas rta mgrin gyi thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas gser yig pa bzlogs sa skya/ ngam ring / bzang ldan/ chu bzang rnams su snga phyir dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po la dus 'khor la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo zla med pa bskor/

dga' ldan lha khang du dbu ma stod tshogs gsungs dus me tog gi char chen po babs/ rin chen sding dang lha rtser sku mtshams dam por mdzad/ jo mo nang du dus 'khor gyi dar dkyil 'khrul sangs chen mo grub/ rta lo la lo tsā ba sku gshegs rjes chos rje phyogs las pa gdan sar bskos/ gtsang tsho gsum po lo gsum du cha ga bas lo thog bcom pa la bka' shog bsgrags pa tsam gyis gnod pa zhi/ snar thang du dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po la rgyud 'grel dang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs chos mang du gsungs/ re bdun pa la nub chos lung du phebs te dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang mjal/ bka' bsdu bzhi pa rtsa 'grel gnang / dpal ldan bla ma la jo mo nang du gdan sa pa gcig bsko bar zhus pas dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa bskos/ ra lo'i dbon po kun dga' 'phel sogs la dbang khrid gnang / du dben shrī dharmā kartis gong ma'i lung dang gnang sbyin bzang po phul/ de nas khu lung mda'i gnas/ ba de gnas/ ngur smrig bye ma/ tsa dbye/ tsha mig dge 'dun sgang / gzhu kun ra/ gnam khri tshangs/ dbu ri gnam rtse ldang / stod klung rnam rgyal/ dkyil 'khor sdings/ dben tsha stag rnams las rim gyis brgyud de lha sar phebs/ gnas so sor bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis bsu ba dang bsnyen bkur mthon po mdzad pa la/ dus 'khor dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag mang po la sems bskyed sogs theg pa chen po'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ lha sar zla ba bdun gyi bar du bzhugs te/ jo bo'i drung du mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos mchod nas bstan pa dang sems can kho na'i ched du smon lam btab cing dbus phyogs kyi mkhas pa phal mo che 'dus pa la/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag nges don gyi mdo bstan bcos mang po gnang / skor lam rnams kyang khrid pa'i nyams 'ur gyis gar gyi bkang /

tshal dang gung thang rnams su yang thegs/ tshal khri dpon dang gzhon rgyal du dben shwa sogs dpon skya mang po yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ skye bo'i tshogs 'bum phrag mang pos sems bskyed de byang chub tu smin par mdzad/ lha rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs pa la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po byung / chos lung nas brtsams te 'di yan la sor bsam gyi khrid thob pas nyams rtogs bzang po dang ldan pa sha stag stong nyis brgya byung / de nas gtsang nas gdan 'dren dang / rgyal mkhar rtse nas dpon 'phags pa dpon g.yog dang / yar 'brog khri dpon rdor rgyal gdan la phebs pas/ byi ba lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la phyogs ris kyi mjal ba'i mi mang po rnams ra mo che nas nyang bran brag gdong gi bar phreng ma chad par bsgrigs pa la/ 'do li'i steng nas byin rlabs tshim par gnang / de nas rgyal sde dkar chung / gsang mda'/ snye thang / rnam rgyal sgang / 'u shang rdo/ gye re/ chu shul gnas/ rab btsun/ gan pa gnas gsar/ gra ma lung / dpal sde/ yar srib/ nyan po/ sna dkar rtse/ kha bo gangs bzang gi mgul/ ra lung / nying ro'i sman chu kha/ gnas snying / lcang ra/ gnas dkar po/ gser sdings/ zha lu/ mgur mo/ snar thang / khro phu/ bo dong e la sogs pa rnams su bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / mi chen po rnams la dus 'khor gyi dbang khrid gnang / skye bo stong phrag mang po theg pa chen po la bkod nas jo mo nang du phebs/ sku 'bum chen po'i bzo gnas phra mo rnams legs par grub ste/ mthong grol gyi sku 'bum chen mo la/ /nyi gdan gyi steng nas skor ba byed/ /zla gdan gyi steng nas me tog 'bul/ /khyams khra'i nang du gsung rab blta/ /so so'i sgo nas phyag mchod byed/ /e ma skal ldan kun dga' bar byos/ /zhes gsungs shing thugs spro bas skor ba mang du mdzad/ phyogs ris nas 'dus pa'i bu slob mang po la rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa gsungs/

slob ma'i thu bo rnams la yang chos kyi lhag ma ma lus pa stsal/ lo mtshams pa rnams la bug sgo so sor yud kyis phebs nas gegs sel dang gdams pa gnang nas bden pa mthong bar mdzad/ phal che bas ni 'phral du grub pa'i mtshan ma bstan pas chos rje pa yang mnyes/ bdun cu pa lcags mo glang gi hor zla bcu pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin khrid gsar ba rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa gcig gnang nas 'di la rten 'brel thams cad bsgrig dgos/ gal po che yin pas sgoms shig de nas gdan sa pas gnang ngo gsungs/ tshogs pa la nges don rgya mtsho'i chos 'phro de nyin thugs gsal zhing / gzi mdangs che ba'i rnam pas lhag par gsung che bar gsungs te/ 'u cag gi chos bshad mtshams de ka la byed pa yin no gsungs nas chos 'phro bzhag tshes drug gi nam langs ma thag 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag nas dgong mo srod thun dang po la mya ngan las 'das te/ mkha' khyab mkha'i rdo rje yin mod na'ang / sprul pa'i sku ni zhing bde ba can du gshegs par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /zhag bdun gyi bar du gzi mdangs je cher song zhing zhal 'dzum ston/ gsang ba sbubs su nub/ dbu'i gtsug tor 'phags pa la zla ba bdud rtsi lud/ phyi nang rten 'brel gnad gcig pas gtsang po gyen la log ste gram pa'i mthil gyi rdo mthong ba byung / gdung bzhu la zhen pas ring bsrel yungs 'bru lta bu'i phung por gyur cing spyan ras gzigs kyi sku byon/ sku 'bum gyi lha khang bde ba can du 'od dpag med jo bo'i sku tshad ma dang / rdo rje gdan du sku 'dra mthong ba don ldan bzhengs pa'i nang du ring bsrel phal che ba bzhugs so/ /bdag nyid chen po rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku 'di'i slob ma'i thu bo ni/ kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang po/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos dpal mgon po/

chos rje rin tshul ba/ zhang ston rgya bo bsod nams grags pa/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/ la dong sman chu kha ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ lo chen byang rtse/ gser sdings pa blo gros dpal/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ chos grags gsar ma/ nya dpon kun dga'/ bla brang ba bzang po dpal/ thang chen pa kun dga' 'bum/ sa skya mkhan po nam me pa/ shangs pa rdo rje ba/ gnas drug pa blo gros mtshungs med/ 'jam sngon/ 'jam sgeg mkhas pa rin chen mchog khams pa ngag dbang / snar thang pa 'chim blo bzang grags pa/ chos lung mkhan po bsod nams bzang po dang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i blo gros/ ri ston blo chen 'od/ mkhan chen don grub dpal dang yon tan dpal/ chos lung mkhan chen grags tshul pa dang grags pa dpal/ mkhan chen byang chub 'od zer/ nub gnas gsar pa seṅge dpal/ longs gzhon nu sangs rgyas/ snyi thang pa bkras bzang / gra dgon pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos 'khor gling pa byams pa ba/ bde ba can pa 'jam rin/ tsha yig pa yon tan seṅga ེ/ gsang phu ba blo gros seṅge/ tshal pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ khro phu ba nam mkha' bzang po/ e pa nam mkha' grags/ nyang stod sgo ba sangs rgyas dpal/ ngam ring pa brtson rgyal/ spangs 'das rin po che/ ri khrod pa dbang rin chen/ mdzod ma ba ston rin/ dus 'khor ba dge 'dun dpal/ bla ma rtse mo ba/ ba de lung pa/ mkhan po lha btsun/ slob dpon dar dbang / gsang phu ba grags bzang / slob dpon bsod nams dpal/ so stod pa rdo rgyal/ rta nag pa nyi rgyal/ bla ma rgyal 'byung / snye thang pa rdor rgyal/ shes rdor ba/ mkhan chen bkras tshul ba/ brag ram pa bsod nams seṅge/ nags phug pa/ dpal rgyal/ bcom ldan rdo rje snying po sogs dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas shing yongs su grags pa'i slob ma mang du byung la/ ti shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bzhi thog pa la sogs pa sa skya'i gdung brgyud rnams dang /

rtogs ldan dar rgyal ba/ grub thob dbus pa/ bla ma mkha' spyod pa/ bsgom khang pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang po byon no/ /chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal ni/ mtshan gzhan chos kyi rgyal po zhes pa 'khrungs yul mnga' ris pa/ me pho rta la 'khrungs/ gzhon pa'i dus nas dbus phyogs su byon nas chos 'khor gling du phar tshad la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi sde sdod la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur te/ dbus gtsang gnyis kar grwa skor yang mdzad/ grwa skor gyi zhar la kun mkhyen chen po dang mjal bas shin tu dad pas jo nang nyid du phyag phebs te/ kun mkhyen chen po'i drung du dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa dang chos gzhan yang mang du gsan/ man ngag thugs nyams su bzhes pas ting nge 'dzin bzang po 'khrungs te/ bla ma la yid ches pas rang gi bla ma thams cad kyi gtso bor 'dzin/ kun mkhyen chen po'i slob ma byang pa ta dben pas kun mkhyen chen po dpon slob la zhal ta zhus te ngam ring gi chos sde btab/ der kun mkhyen po nyid kyi thogs shig bzhugs/ de nas rje 'di la gtad nas jo mo nang nyid du phebs so/ /rje 'dis kyang phar tshad gtso bor ston pa'i sde snod kyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad/ slob ma blo gsal ba yang mang du 'dus/ phyis bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pa la gdan sa gtad nas zhe dgu pa la jo mo nang gi gdan sa mdzad/ lo lnga na gdan sa de yang gtad nas se mkhar chung du bzhugs nas gtso bor thugs dam mdzad cing chos kyi 'khor lo yang rgya cher bskor/ slar yang kun mkhyen chen po bde ba can gyi zhing du gshegs nas lo lnga lon pa'i dus dgung lo drug cu bzhes par jo mo nang gi gdan sar phebs nas/ bdun cu don gsum pa la dbus su phebs tshal dbus gling du dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud bshad man ngag gi khrid rnams slob ma'i sde chen po la gsungs/

de nas yar klung phyogs la phebs/ rdor lo chen byang rtse la mchog dbang gong ma gnang / khra 'brug la sogs par bzhugs te gdul bya dpag tu med pa legs pa'i lam la bkod/ de nas gtsang la thegs te/ don drug pa la jo mo nang gi gdan sar mkhan chen byang seng pa bskos nas/ se mkhar chung du sku mtshams la bzhugs/ bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa sa pho stag la gshegs so/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di la dus 'khor ba chen po rgyal ba dpal/ 'jam dbyangs chos mgon pa/ nya dbon kun dga'/ rtogs ldan sngo nyal ma ye shes rgyal mtshan/ tshal min pa bsod nams bzang po/ lha khang steng pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ sman chu kha pa sangs rgyas blo gros/ shes rab rdo rje sogs dus kyi 'khor lo'i mkhas grub kyi slob ma mang du byung ste/ chos rje dus 'khor ba chen po rgyal ba dpal ni gzhon nu nyid nas skyes stobs kyi blo gros phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing / chos rje phyogs las pa chen po sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams las zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes shing / lhag par dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu nos te/ thos bsam mthar phyin cing sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan g.yo med du bzung bas nges don gyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur cing / skal ldan las 'phro can gyi slob ma'i tshogs kyang mang du bskrun par mdzad de/ zhing khams gzhan du gdul bya rgya che bar dgongs pa na/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /skyes bu dam pa 'di'i slob ma la dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan 'dzin du ma zhig byung ba las/ kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa ni kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ge sogs mkhas pa rnams kyi mgrin gcig par/ byang phyogs sham+bha la'i rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po'i rnam par sprul pa yin pa'i tshul gyi sgra dbyangs phyogs kun tu sgrog par mdzad pa'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog byang pa chos rgyal rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po nyid yin te/

rigs ldan chen po 'di nyid ni/ kho bo cag gis nos pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos tshul rnams brgyud pa'i bla ma gzhan las bka' drin mchog tu che ba zhig yin pa nas/ 'di'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa rnams cung zad rgyas par bshad par bya ste/ de'ang gang 'dir smra bar bya ba'i gzhi ni/ 'di ltar rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po chen po rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gnas las rjes su brjod pa'i ngo mtshar tshig gi phreng ba thos pa dang mthong ba'i legs byas tsam gyis kyang / gang gi ye shes gzigs pa'i rgyun ma lus pa yid la 'jug pa'i legs lam 'di nyid spel ba la klan ka'i gnas med do/ /de yang 'di ltar thos te/ gang yang chos kyi rgyal po rigs thams cad kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba srid zhi'i dpal mgon dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i nying khus rang gzhan phan bder 'god pa/ dus de tsam gyi mkhas pa'i yang mkhas pa mtha' yas pa'i thod dang cod pan gyis zhabs la mngon par btud pa kun mkhyen smra ba'i dbang po snyigs ma'i dus kyi thams cad gzigs pa'i zla mtha' dag dang bral ba'i skyes bu'i khyu mchog rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog la gzigs pa ma log pa'i mthu grub pa nam du'ang chos smra ba'i ring lugs la gcig tu dgongs pa'i thugs can/ 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa ste mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum la skad gcig gis kyang mi g.yel bar spyod pa/ dris shing brtags pa'i mtha'i lkog na mo'i gnas la yang mngon sum du lung ston pa'i brtul phod mnga' ba/ bka'i zer phra mo'i gnas tsam gyis kyang / gzhung lugs rab 'byams la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob par khas 'che ba dag kyang lan brgyar skyengs pa ster bar mdzad pa/ mkhas rlom du mas sbyar ba'i legs par bshad pa'i khur chen por spyod pa'i glegs bam mthon po pa dag la'ang 'gal 'brel gyi dpyad pas gnas ma yin pa'i khung bur ngang gis 'jug cing /

khengs pa'i ri bo lan brgyar bsnyil ba/ sgrub pa dang sun 'byin gyi de nyid thugs su chud pas rton pa bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas gdul bya'i yid rtog pa'i rnyog mas dkrug par mi mdzad pa'i rig pa'i dbang phyug dam pa/ rig gnas phra mo'i sgo bye ba khrag khrig la yang 'jam pa'i dpal gyi go 'phang brnyes nas/ gnas gang la'ang gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gsung gi mdzod lhug par stsol ba/ ha cang spros pa'i ngal ba kho nas dal 'byor ming stong gi lhag mar 'jog pa'i bstan 'dzin spyi lugs las khyad par du yang nang gi de nyid la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la ji bzhin du rtogs pa'i gdeng thob pas/ thogs med 'bar ba'i gnam lcags kyis kyang brdzi bar mi nus pa'i grub pa'i dbang po/ rim pa gnyis kyi nges gsang la mnyam par sbyor ba'i rten 'brel las/ bdud dang log 'dren 'bum sde'i mthu 'phrog cing bka'i bran du 'khol nus pa/ lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las gang la'ang sngon dang phyi mthas rjes su dpog dang dpog par mi nus pa/ dpal sa'i dbang phyug phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i grags pa'i rgyal rnga mthon po lan brgyar brdungs pa'i skal bzang gi 'dren pa chen po/ rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa'i dbyings chen por 'jug pa'i sgo yang 'di nyid du sems la shar te/ bsdus pa'i don dang rgyas par phye ba'i rab dbye gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gang rigs dang 'brel ba khungs kyi lo rgyus la/ sngon byung ba 'dzam gling dge ba'i grang las kyang / ma hā tsi na zhes yongs su grags pa'i grong chen po/ ma lus pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i legs byas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i zhing / rnam thos kyi bu'i bang mdzod gsar pa'i dga' bas nye bar gang ba'i khyim bzang po bye ba du mas phyogs kyi sa khebs par byas pa'i dbus na/ bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal las grub pa'i rgya nag stong 'khun gyi pho brang chen po rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur mngon par mtho ba'i bsti gnas der/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / grub pa'i rig 'dzin du ma 'gro 'di'i bde skyid mngon mtho spel ba'i klad ma nyid du bsal zhing yang skye ba mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul ston pa zhig las/ skabs der yang dpag tu ye ma mchis pa'i bgrang bas mi spobs pa'i sngon gyi yang sngon/ snga ma'i yang snga mar rgya che ba'i bsags pa khyad par can gyi dbang las/ glo bur 'phrul gyi rgyal po nyid du mnga' dbang gi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ mi nyag se'u rgyal po'i gdung rabs drug gi mthar son pa'i bdun tshigs su gyur pa'i mi nyag rgyal rgod nyid kyi dbon rigs kyi cho 'brangs mtshungs par spyod pa'i dpal mngon du gsal zhing / mtho ris kyi yon tan du ma'i khyad par can gyi rang bzhin dul ba/ shin tu gshin zhing brtul phod pa'i dpa' bo'i ngag dang lhan cig gis byed pa'i mdzad pa'i rang bzhin mthong thos kyi phyogs kyi mgron po mtha' dag gi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes bsod nams chen po'i dbyings las gnam sa'i bdag por dbang bskur bas sa chen skyong ba'i mthu ldan dag phyogs 'di'i bstan pa dang sems can kun gyi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du yang dag pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i phul dang / bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha dag gi mgron du bos pa'i tshul gyis nye bar byon pa na zhes sngon gyi gnas de dag la ring mo zhig tu yid bde'i phreng ba bar ma chad par sems pa'i bsam pa nyid las/ de'ang brjod pa'i tshig tu bsgrags na rna ba'i dbang por thos pa dang / mig gis yongs su brtags pa'i dbang las/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dang / da lta'i yang blo gros kyi skal ba mthon po ba dag gi ga na'i gnas der yid spro bas drangs pa'i dbang las/ rje gong ma'i rnam thar la yid ches thob pa'i rab gus dad pa'i shugs brtan po/ rang gi snying gi thig ler spyod pa 'di lta bu'i legs lam gyi bgos skal rnyed par gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam dang po'i tshes kyi zla ba'am/

btso ma'i gser bzang po'i rang bzhin ltar skyes pa'i mthu las 'di lta bu brjod pa ni/ mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rang bzhin las/ las 'bras ston pa'i me long ltar/ legs nyes 'byed pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /mi yi dbang pos srid 'di srungs/ /'di na rnam dpyod gsal ldan bdag /ye shes snang ba'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dbyangs can ngag gi rgyud mang las/ /sngon med legs bshad 'di ltar sgrog /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po gang / /du ma'i sems can don du yang / /bskul ba med par sprul ba'i sku/ /rgyun mi chad pa'i zlos gar rtsen/ /yid 'ong lha yi gzhal med khang / /yid 'phrog dga' mas gang ba'i khyim/ /yid la bde ba'i dpal ster ba/ /yid kyis yongs su bris pa bzhin/ /gnod sbyin nor gnas khang pa'i dpal/ /yongs su bslangs pas ma tshim par/ /sa chen 'di yi mkho dgu yang / /bka' yis phyogs der drangs par snyam/ /rgyal rigs sā la'i ljon shing gang / /gang gis nyin rer spel ba na/ /na chung gzhon nu stong phrag lnga/ /lnga rtsen grong gi 'dod ldan bzhin/ /mda' lnga pa yi dpal 'byor dang / /mgrin sngon gyi ni 'dod pa'i ro/ /pad dkar mig gi gya gyus kyang / /rgyal po de yi dper mi bsgrun/ /mes pos sprul pa'i yid rlom la/ /khengs pa zlog byed 'phrul gyi sgo/ /mnga' thang chos bzhin skyong mkhas pa'i/ /yid kyi 'dod 'jo 'di ltar spel/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa la thod bzhin/ /rjes su bskur mdzad dam pa'i chos/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong smra ba'i dpal/ /mkhas pa du ma ring nas bkug /thub pa'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dus mthar sa skya'i mtshan 'chang ba'i/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa/ /bka' yi pho nyas yongs su bzung / /dkon nor dpag yas stsol ba'i zol/ /rab lci'i bka' yig gis drangs nas/ /gtsug rgyan nor bu'i 'od kyis kyang / /zhabs sen mchod pa'i dge mtshan bskyed/ /chos rje'i nyin byed nub ri'i spor/

/yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khur 'degs pa'i/ /ngal bso mdzad nas sku yi dbon/ /'phags pa'i zla ba phyogs der bzhag /mkhyen rab 'od dkar 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ /mkhas mang kun+da bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /zin shing mun pa drung 'byin pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin rgyu skar bdag por gyur/ /blo chen 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /gong ma'i cod pan rtser 'khod nas/ /bod yul yangs pa'i rgyal khams la/ /bka' yi rnga chen rab tu bskul/ /chol kha gsum las legs brtsams nas/ /gnam sa'i srid la dbang bsgyur zhes/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i lung gis ni/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon du mngags/ /e ma 'jam mgon chos kyi rje/ /'gro ba'i mgon po gang gi srol/ /mig sman tsam la brten pa yi/ /khyod bstan ming gi lhag mar lus/ /blo chung rang blos gzhal ba'i tshig /dug can zas ltar dug mda'i mtshon/ /yin lugs yin bzhin 'dor mkhas pa'i/ /khengs can khengs pas bstan rtsa bskums/ /gang gi 'phrin las dag pa'i zhing / /rgya nag yul gyi mtha' gru yang / /khyod bstan las bzlog 'ga' yis ni/ /mig karma pa'i/ 'phrul zol gyis bdag gir byas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams kyi/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i rje/ /byang phyogs rigs ldan brgyud par bcas/ /thugs rje'i dpal las 'ongs par snyam/ /de ltar rim gyis bsnyad pa'i ngag /don ldan cho rigs btsun po dag /rwa sa rgod po lung zhes pa'i/ /gnas las slar yang phyogs 'dir phebs/ /skabs der stag sde seng lung du/ /mi dbang thu bo lha yi rje/ /che btsan legs pa'i dper bzhag des/ /khung ldan dga' ma zung dang rol/ /rab bde'i cha shas dgos skal dag /yang yang yid la gnag pa bzhin/ /'jam gnyen lag gis 'khyud mos ni/ /'bral mi phod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ /dkar gsal thigs phreng mu tig rgyun/ /nyi gzhon lang tsho'i sgeg mo yi/ /rin chen pad+ma rā ga'i snod/ /bcud kyi rgyal po nor bus gtams/

/dpa' mdzangs 'phrul gyi ya lad can/ /zhu zhang spun dgu 'phel ba na/ /seṅge'i gling nas nye lung du/ /so sor sa yi dpal la spyod/ /kun las gnam sa'i ngo mthong pa/ /dang por gyur pa'i thu bo che/ /mi mchog seng ge dar gyi sras/ /skye dgu kun dga'i grags pa thob/ /de yi gdung gi cha shas kyis/ /yongs sub rgyan pa'i lha de'i sras/ /yon chen badz+ra shrī pas/ /mkhon ston grags pa'i rgyal mtshan/ zhabs pad bsten/ /sa steng 'di na mtshungs med cing / /skya rengs bu ltar grags pa'i tog /srid rtse bar du nyer song ba'i/ /bstan pa'i sbyin gnas mchog tu khums/ /badz+ra shrī rdo rje dpal sras dkon mchog gi /snyan grags spel la rjes chags pa/ /de yis bskyed pa'i sku mched gsum/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /dpal ldan 'bum sde'i shes bya'i gnas/ /skyob mdzad sangs rgyas skyabs kyi gtso/ /dpal mgon mchog tu bsten pa yi/ /mi yi dbang po de dag gis/ /'jigs med sa skya'i paṇa chen gang / /dpal ldan mkhas pa'i khyu mchog che/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i/ /zhabs la mngon par mchod ces thos/ /dpal ldan 'bum sde'i bdag po des/ /ra lung yul gru'i gnas 'dir ni/ /legs byon sras kyi thu bo drug / sras drug ni yon chen grags pa dpal/ sri non dpal/ dge ba dpal/ rgyal mtshan dpal/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan grags pa ltar rnams la yon sri'i sras dpal ldan mgon po/ de'i sras khri dpon dpal she la sogs te mang du spel/ thog ma'i grags pa dpal dang dge ba dpal la sras brgyud mi mnga'/ rgyal mtshan dpal rab tu byung ba yin zhes thos/ spel nas srid 'di'i mgon du mdzad/ /dus der nor 'dzin thig le na/ /'gran pa'i dpe zla kun bral ba/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa de'i/ /bka' yi 'phrin las dpag med bsgrubs/ /kun la dga' ba'i rgyal mtshan de/ /legs byon lha yi lcam gcig gang /

/'khon ma gcig shar la zug ma/ mtshan dngos kun dga' nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan 'di/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal bas khab tu bzhes/ ti shrī kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang / ti shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rigs zla ba dang 'grogs pas/ /rgyal ba'i myu gu mched gnyis 'khrungs/ /gcung nyid lha sras gzhon nu'i skabs/ /dus kyi lang tshor spyod pa na/ /'jam mgon rigs kyi dbon gyur pa'i/ /ta dben ma gcig bsod nams dpal la/ blo gros rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ /gu shrī dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang lcam mo 'od zer ldan gyi sras/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gang / /chang gu'i yab gyur nyid kyi mtshan/ /kun spangs 'di nyid kyi yum lcam mo byang chub ldan/ chos grags dpal bzang pos/ /bzang ldan chos sde'i dge mtshan spel/ /drug mthar 'khrungs pa'i mi dpon chen mon btsun chen po mtshan dngos grags pa dang / yi dbang / /sa chen skyong ba'i dpal ldan de/ /rje btsun dharmā rak+ṣi ta'i/ /spyan gyis 'tsho ba'i bu bzhin gyur/ /se chen rgyal po'i bka' yi lung / /dges dgur spyod pa'i mnga' dbang dang / /rin chen dam khar bcas pa yi/ /si tu'i las ka legs par blangs/ /dbus gtsang gnyis kyi 'jag go phye/ /rang srid thus mgon 'dzin pa yis/ /'ja' sa'i gnang ba legs bzhes nas/ /gdan sa'i sa skya bya dka'i khur chen btegs/ /slar yang gong ol dza du/ gi bka' btags dag /ti shrī kun dga' blo gros kyi/ /brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis drangs te/ /bod yul bde skyid dpal la sbyar/ /dus der 'dzin ma'i ljongs 'dir ngam ring / ni/ /rgyal ba'i bka' stsal ji snyed pa/ /rin chen khu bas rjes spel zhing / /'dus pa'i dge tshogs rgya cher btsugs/ /shākya'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i phul/ /seng ge'i khri la bsti mdzad pa/ /stag ste la rgyab sku 'khrungs pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes de mkhan por bskos/ /ngo mtshar tshes kyi zla ba che/
