chos rgyal chen po'i bka' lung phebs nas nged la chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dang theg chen pa'i bzhed pa ltar kye rdor bkram gdan dgos gsungs nas/ slar yang dkyil thang brjes nas mdun bskyed bskyar bsgrub mdzad pa la dbang bskur bzhes zhes kyang grags la/ chos rje a nan+d pa la yang mnal ltas sogs rtsub skabs/ chos skyong gi rjes gnang gsan par grags shing / gzhan bka' 'brel yod tsam gnang ba chos rje bsam pa/ chos rje mchog bzang pa/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ chos rje nam mkha' pa/ chos rje grags pa ba/ bla ma bzang phug pa/ lho pa jo bo pa/ bla ma 'od 'phro ba/ bla ma dpal tshul ba/ chos rje nyi ma pa/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po rnams so/ /slad nas kyang rgya gar nas lhags pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta lo ka ta ra dang / mnga' ris nas mar lam sngar brjod pa ltar paṇa chen pa sde snod 'dzin pa zhabs 'bring gi tshogs dang bcas pa/ dbus nas 'khrul khang lo tsa ba sogs lo paṇa mkhas pa ji snyed kyi spyan sngar brdar te chos kyi dga' ston rgya cher spel te yid rab tu mgu ba'i gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa sha stag tu gyur to/ /de tsam nas brtsams te rigs ldan sa chen skyong ba'i dpal dam pa nyid kyang / rang srid phan bde'i gzi 'od rgyas pa'i dbus su ci bde'i sku nyams brtas pa'i 'tsho skyong dang / sgrub mchod gtor zlog sogs kyi cho ga'i rgyab bsnyen du bzhugs pa tsam gnang zhing / mos ldan gser mchog 'od dpal bas rin po che gser gyi maṇ+ḍal bkod nas zhus pa'i tshe/ lam thams cad skad cig tsam gyis rdzogs par byed pa rdzogs rim gyi lam dus gnang zhing / gzhan yang skal bzang dam tshig can 'ga' la yang dag pa'i bdud rtsi zab dgus bskyangs/ mnal lam sogs kyi mtshan mas bskul nas zhal ngo rnam pa la yang sdom pa chen po'i dbang yang stsal/ drung jo skyabs pa'i gzhi 'dzin la gdon drag po longs spyod pa'i yul du bzung ba la phur btab kyi gegs 'dul gnang bas/

yul de'i dpral bar rgyun gyi phyag phur ngos shin tu gtams pa'i rnam cha'i zug ngur spyod pa dang lhan cig smreng bzhin du phyis mi yong ba khas blangs nas bskrad pa'i gnas su mdzad pa la sogs te byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / me yos la mnal lam mi skrun pa'i thugs kyi 'jug pa shar ba la/ sku rim thugs dam ting nge 'dzin kha bsgyur ci gnang nga je rtsub tu gyur tshe/ dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gser sku phyag tu phebs pas kyang rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig cing / de nyid kyi sgrub thabs thugs rtsom gnang bas bar gcod kyi g.yul las yongs su rgyal ba'i dngos grub brnyes so/ /mdor na rigs ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'di nyid la mnal lam 'od gsal gyi ngang du ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan rtsol med du 'char zhing / de nyid kyi phyi nang rten 'brel ma lus pa yongs su 'grig pa nyid du snang ste/ mnal lam du rje btsun mi la ras chen gyi mgur sngon chad ma gsan pa'i tshig 'bru dang dbyangs snyan par bsgrags pa na sngon med kyi legs par bshad pa'i spobs pa khong brdol ba'i legs bshad 'phel ces gsungs shing / yang rje sa skya ba chen pos mdzad pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhung sngon gzigs yul du ma phebs pa'i tshig don bzang po dang ldan pa zhig gzigs pas/ dang ba'i dad pa lhag par g.yos mthar dbu gtsug tu rje sa chen bsgoms nas dung shugs kyis gsol btab gnang bas/ sa skya pa'i dgongs pa'i gnad zab mo sems la shar gsungs la/ yang mnal lam la ri bo shin tu mtho ba'i rtse na thogs med sku mched bzhugs shing / ri de'i g.yas phyogs kyi sgang gcig na dar dkar gyi yol skor shin tu srab pa'i steng na sa skya pa'i rje btsun sku gong ma rnams bzhugs pa'i gzigs snang yang byung zhes thos la/ de las gzhan mnal lam du mkhas pa dag dang bde gshegs snying po'i gnad la 'brel gtam gnang ba'i rtsod pa las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma brnyes shing /

mdo sngags kyi rigs kyi bstan bcos gnyis su grub pa'i mtha'i gnad don gting tshugs su 'god par mdzad la mnyam rjes dbyer med du dgongs pas/ sngar pho brang du gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mtshon gyis kyang cung zad brdzi bar ma nus shing bris thang gi sbyin bdag gi tshul du bris pa'i sku gzugs la yang gnod 'tshe gtan nas med pas ding sang yang mthong ba'i yul du yod la/ srung ma'i dbang po drug cu dang khyad par rdo rje gtum mo drag po las chen gyis lha mo des bka'i bran nyid du zhal gyi 'ches nas/ dus dang gnas skabs kun tu 'phrin las drag po'i las mtha' yas pa'i mnga' dbang gi cho 'phrul grangs las 'das pa bsgrubs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa rgya mtsho lta bu ma lus pa rnams dang gsang ba'i rgyas btab pa'i rnam thar ches gsang ba dag sgrog pa dang yi ger spel zhing 'bri bar ma nus so/ /tshig 'bru tsam la 'tshol ba'i gtan tshigs kyi/ /smra brjod chos kyi ro myong byis nyams la/ /ngo sor spyod pa'i mkhas tshugs 'khrul ngo yi/ /khengs pas 'khor bar nan gyis nye bar drangs/ /mkhas mkhas tshig la gtsor 'dzin tha snyad mkhan/ /btsun btsun mig sngar mdzes bsgyur tshul 'chos mkhan/ /bzang bzang zhig por 'chos pa'i smyon dor mkhan/ /mkhas btsun bzang por btags pas ci la phan/ /mi shes rdzu ba'i gab tshig phal pa'i gtam/ /khrel shor ngo tsha spangs pa'i gyang glu la/ /grub thob gsung du zhen pa'i mun sgom gyis/ /gsung rab zab mo'i tshig sbyor bzhad char 'dzin/ /kye ma deng dus snyigs ma lnga ldan 'dir/ /skyobs pa khyod ni gang gi ma gos par/ /mkhas dang grub pa mtshungs par spyod bzhin du/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgon du byon pa snyam/ /chos spyan dag pas nyes tshogs las rgyal zhing / /bzlas brjod nus pas bdud sde'i dpung 'joms pa/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyis gnam lcags thog rdugs pa/ /grub brnyes grub mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi/

/zhes so/ /de ltar dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig gi bar du bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya cher bshad pa ltar mdzad nas/ slar yang sa la spyod pa'i 'og min gyi bsti gnas lhun grub sdings su zla ba gcig tsam en zhig sku'i 'du ba ma snyom pa lta bu'i tshul bstan rjes/ tshes kyi dpal dang mtshungs par nyin re bzhin je che je che'i lha rdzas me tog dkar po'i char mngon par phul te/ gzim khang gi thog gis kyang mi sgrib par gang gi sku'i lhun po chen po nyid la 'bab pa'i ngang nas snron gyi zla ba'i gral tshes drug gi nyin a wa dhu ti byang chub kyi ljon shing gi nang du bde bar gshegs la/ de'i tshe snang ba'i yul du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu ma mchis pa sngon chad mthong thos kyi yul du ma gyur pa'i snang ba dag rjes su bstan to/ /kye hud lus can bdag cag 'du ba'i gcong / /sum brgya drug cu yis mnar skad cig la/ /nad sel sman pa'i rgyal po khyed gshegs na/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i sman mchog ming du zad/ /rkyang dang ldan pa'i 'du bas dub pa dag /gang la gang gi gnyen pos legs bskyangs te/ /nad med rab bde'i gnas la yongs bzhag nas/ /'chi med dbang po lnga pa'i gnas su bzhud/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pas las rlung 'chi bdag dpung / /gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i gshin rje rab bcom khyod/ /rtswa mchog shing drung thub dbang gzims pa ltar/ /kye ma zhi ba'i dbyings su nye bar sim/ /rig gnas yongs dang mdo rgyud mtha' dag la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khur chen gyis dub na/ /zag med dbyings su mgon khyod ngal bso brten/ /e ma sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i chos bstan to/ /de nas brtsams te dgung zhag gi mthar thug gi bar thams cad du nyin rer yang lta bas mi ngom pa'i 'ja' 'od me tog gi char gyis mos gus can mtha' yas pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa yang 'di ltar/ dbang sngon yongs su bzhu 'dra'i bai ṭūr mdog

/gzung 'dzin rnyog ma'i sprin tshogs rab dwangs te/ /'od gsal 'ja' ris bde stong 'dus ma byas/ /pra phab snang ba'i cho 'phrul yongs la bstan/ /lha rdzas me tog rnam bkra'i mdangs ldan pa/ /ye shes snang bar mi dpogs dri bsung can/ /rnam kun stong pa'i 'dab brgya'i ge sar gyis/ /yongs su spud pa'i char gyis 'dzin ma khyab/ /gzugs med gzugs bzang kun gsal mdzes ma'i gdong / /sna tshogs 'ja' 'od me tog gsar pa'i rgyan/ /gzugs brnyan ma lus bkod pa'i mdzes sdug gi /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i mig gi rol rtsed gyur/ /'ja' 'od rkyang ba'i 'phyang mo la/ /rnam lnga'i bla bre bres pa bzhin/ /gzhan du za 'og gsar ma'i gos/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su bkrams pa 'dra/ /'dzin mkhan med pa'i bar snang la/ /lha rdzas gos kyi 'phur lding can/ /mkhar nyal lag pas bzung ba'i 'phrul/ /dman pa'i mig la gab pa bzhin/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i me tog khyon/ /'ja' zlum 'khrigs pa'i gur khang ltar/ /mthon po'i dbyings nas rab babs pa/ /btud tshe sgyu ma bshigs pa snyam/ /mkha' snang mthing mdog mar gad mdangs/ /yongs su bsgyur pa'i gsal ba'i tshon/ /mthong bas bde gsal mi rtog nyams/ /sgra med skad kyis chos ston bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po de'i dgongs pa'i dbyings zab mo yongs su bskang ba'i rnam grangs du ma'i dge tshogs rlabs po che dpe bral yang dag pa bsgrub par mdzad cing / sku gdung rin po che bsam 'phel nor bu rin chen ni/ rin po che'i mchod sdong dang bcas bkur bsti'i sgo mtha' yas pas sri zhu'i yul du mdzad nas byin rlabs chen po'i bde drod 'bar gyi dge mtshan rang babs su bzhugs pa 'di nyid do/ /slar yang bsdus pa'i don gyi zhabs su rten pa'i tshig gi phreng ba spel ba yang / nam yang mkha' mnyam sems can la/ /phan bde legs pas skyong mdzad des/ /cho bdag mo bzang mo rgyal mtshan ma/

gcen thugs rje sri mnan rgyal mo/ gcung lha chos gnang ba'i mtshan dpal mo ston zhes gsol lo/ rigs btsun mo khab bzhes tshe/ /lcam 'di lhor phebs phun tshogs rgyal mo lcam sring bltams/ gnyis tsam zhig bltams zhes grags/ /de ltar dkon mchog rjes gnang ba'i/ /lung bstan ji bzhin srid 'di'i rje/ /rab gtsang gser mchog ma ma las/ /mnga' 'bangs mgon skyabs 'khrungs ma thag nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rje grags pa dpal bzang po/ /bkra shis skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /'di nyid theg chen rigs sad cing / /mkhyen yangs chos kyi spyan ldan pas/ /lugs gnyis spel la 'gran bral gyur/ /de yum grags 'dzin dpal mo 'od zer/ sras nam mkha'i rin chen gang de'i lcam gcig bde skyid dpal 'dzoms 'khrungs/ /snying stobs gtong phod che ldan zhing / /bla ma la gus 'di yi ni/ /phun tshogs spel ba'i byed por gyur/ /mi dbang sras bdag chen nam mkha' rdo rje pa'i/ mchog bar ma ni/ /gzhon nu rab byung thos bsam ldan/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan mtshan 'chang zhing / /gnam lcags thog rdugs chen po'o/ /gcung gyur kun 'di'i khab tu glo bo nas bdag mo nyi zla dpal sgron bsus/ dga' legs pa zhes/ /dpa' gtum phas rgol rab bcom nas/ /bka' 'bangs nam mkha'i mtha' khyab ste/ /lho byang yongs la mnga' dbang mdzad/ /slad nas rgyal bu byang chub sems/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po/ mtshan can mched rnams rgyal bu kun dga' rin chen pa dang / gcung nam mkha' dpal bzang po/ chos rgyal yid bzhin nor bu/ bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyas sogs/ byon/ /mi dbang gang gi btsun mor ni/ /mnga' ris stod kyi chos rgyal sras/ /mnga' bdag phun tshogs/ rgyal mo khab tu bzhes/ /de las sa dbang chos kyi rgyal/ /nam mkha' bdag la bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i chos rgyal chen po dang / bdag gi ma gcig rgyal yum lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo sogs lcam mched lnga ste drug

tshe dbang phun tshogs kyis/ /dbang gi rgyal po lcam sring bltams/ /chos rgyal de yis btsun mo gnyis/ /khab tu bzhes las lcam gcig glo bo ma dang gting skyes ma gnyis kyi/ phyi ma la lcam phun tshogs rgyal mo byung ba yin no/ /byon/ /bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyal/ mtshan 'chang ba'i/ /btsun mo'i sras ni deng sang gi dbus phyogs na bzhugs pa'i/ bdag po bla ma mched sogs te/ /de ltar rigs rus phun tshogs pa'i/ /chos sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal byang pa'i rgyal rabs rnams/ /byon tshul rigs ldan chen po yi/ /rnam thar rje grol mchog zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang mthun par/ las 'phros don dang bcas te/ bshad zin to/ /de ltar rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po de nyid las bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag gi rgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma nam mkha' dwangs pa la skar ma bkra ba lta bu zhig byon mod kyang / thun mong ma yin pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad srol gyi rkang 'dzin ni/ shangs ston chen po kun dga' dpal ldan te/ skyes bu dam pa 'di yang skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros rab tu gsal bas gzhung lugs kun la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes shing / lhag par sngon gyi smon lam rnam par dag pa'i dbang las rigs ldan chen po dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i legs lam la brten/ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud man ngag gi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu la dbang 'byor bas/ rang nyid mkhas pa dang grub pa'i rtser son cing / gzhan gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa la shin tu mkhas pas/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la sogs pa bstan pa gsal bar nus pa'i zhal slob mang du byon nas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos rgyun rnams dar rgyas su gyur pa yin la/ mthar zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshe yang dag pa'i gzigs snang du ma shar zhing /

ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa dang bcas dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /yang kun mkhyen dol po sangs rgyas dang chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi dngos slob nya dbon kun dga' ni/ nya dbon dar rin gyi dbon po yin de gdon gyis snyel ba la/ kun mkhyen chen po'i drung du byin rlabs zhus ma thag nad las grol/ kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal nas lo sgrub lo gsum gyis dang / spyan ras gzigs dang mngon sum du mjal nas mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'i don thams cad shes pa ngas khag theg ngas kyang mdo rgyud kyi tshig don ma shes pa thams cad bla ma dkon mchog dang thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa shes pa yin/ ma shes pa than thun byung yang thugs rje chen po la zhus pas chog pa yin gsungs pas/ bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas yi dam gyi zhal gzigs/ dus kyi 'khor lo sogs bka' dang bstan bcos rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i zhabs la yang gtugs te/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ 'chad nyan yun ring du mdzad pas slob ma mkhas pa mang du thon pa nyid do/ /de nyid kyi thugs kyi sras kyi thu bo grub chen kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po ni/ mdzes byed ces pa chu mo yos kyi lo shar kha ba'i gdung rgyud du sku 'khrungs/ mtshungs med nya dpon chos rje la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang man ngag rgyud bshad dang bcas pa ma lus pa gsan/ man ngag thugs nyams su bzhes pas mngon par mkhyen pa mnga' zhing / sku'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du ma ston nus pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs shing byin gyis brlabs pa/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal du 'gyur bar lung bstan cing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa de nyid ni rnam par 'phrul pa rmad du byung bas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'od zer chen pos khyab par mdzad nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad cing /

dgung lo bdun cu don brgyad pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te 'og min chos kyi pho brang du gshegs so/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi thugs sras dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po ni/ la ston zha pa gzhung gi dgon pa brag dmar zhes bya bar/ yab dge bshes rgyal mtshan bzang po zhes bya ba byams chos lnga mkhyen cing byams snying rje dang ldan pa de nyid dang / yum brtson 'grus sgron zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro'i mtshan dang ldan pa la/ 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag gi lo sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i dus su mkhan po chos rje rin po chen shes rab bzang po pa dang / slob dpon dkon mchog byang chub gnyis kyis gtso mdzad dge slong gi dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su rab tu byung ste mtshan dkon mchog bzang po zhes bya bar btags/ slob dpon dkon mchog byang chub pa/ mtshungs med chos kyi blo gros pa/ mkhan chen dpal rgyal ba/ lho pa thugs rje dpal/ mkhan chen chos dpal mgon po rnams la phar tshad mngon 'dul sogs sde snod kyi po ti mang po gsan nas dpal ldan sa skyar grwa skor mdzad/ snar thang / rtse thang / gsang sde gung gsum rnams su grwa skor mdzad pa'i tshe/ rtsod pa'i seng ge'i nga ros phas rgol gyi wa tshogs mtha' dag skrag par mdzad do/ /de nas lha sar jo bo'i drung du byon te mchog gi sprul sku dngos su gzigs nas yan lag bdun pa phul nas smon lam btab pas/ jo bo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer sna lnga byung nas rang nyid la thim pas rnam par rtog pa thams cad rang 'gags la song nas bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la yun ring po'i bar du 'byams so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te/ da lan nas dkon mchog gi byin rlabs kyis thub pa'i dbang po dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i nyams gcig byung / de ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par mi rtogs pa ting nge 'dzin gcig yin par 'dug gsungs/

de nas 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po'i sprul pa chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i sku lder gyi drung du byon pas/ de nyid kyi thugs kha nas rang 'dra ba'i bla ma dpag tu med pa 'phros te lha sa sde bzhi'i gnas thams cad khengs/ slar tshur 'dus de nyid kyi thugs kar thim zhing / spyan gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i lta stangs mdzad nas/ yi ge med pa'i brda'i chos du ma ston pa gzigs dus/ smra ru med pa'i nyams rtogs dpag tu med pa du ma 'khrungs nas lus nyams/ ngag nyams/ sems nyams sogs rang dbang med par byung bas/ chos rgyus med pa'i gang zag la la na re/ dge bshes 'di smyo ba yin pa 'dra zer/ de'i tshe bar snang la sgra zhig sgrog pa ni/ kun rdzob chos kun snang grags tsam du zad/ /don dam 'od gsal 'gyur med gtan gyis skyabs/ /lus sems gnad du bsnun na mngon sum gsal/ /bu khyod go bar gyis la nyams su myong / /zhes grags so/ /de nas sne gdong tshogs sde bzhi/ yar 'brog mngon dga'/ gnas rnying / dpal 'khor sde chen rnams su ka chen bco brgyad kyi grwa skor mdzad pas/ gnang sbyin 'bul ba byed pa mang du byung / de rnams sprang po ngan long rnams la sbyin pa sogs mdzad do/ /spos khang du chos lung tshogs pa'i sar/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pas mkhan po mdzad/ mkhan po zla ba blo gros pas las kyi slob dpon/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na bas gsang ste ston pa mdzad nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su dgung lo sum cu'i dus bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ mkhan chen pad+ma bzang po ba/ tshal min chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pa rnams la yang mdo rgyud kyi gsung rab mang po gsan/ sems dpa' chen po rin chen 'bum pa la dbu sems lugs kyi sems bskyed dang / theg chen blo sbyong sogs mang du gsan/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal du 'gyur bar lung bstan pa grub chen kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du/

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud bshad man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa la sogs pa gnyis med kyi rgyud mtha' dag dang / dpal kye rdo rje'i dbang rgyud man ngag sogs ma rgyud kyi skor rnams dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag sogs pha rgyud kyi skor rnams dang / bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs ma rgyud kyi skor rnams dang / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ rdor dbyings rtse mo la sogs rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skor rnams dang / gzhan yang bya spyod kyi skor rnams kyang yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ bsam sdings rin po che la nai gu chos drug sogs shangs pa'i chos skor rnams gsan/ bla ma dpal ldan legs pa la rgyud 'bum/ gzungs bsdus/ rdo rje phreng ba'i bka'/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ rgyud bzhis bsdus pa'i dbang bka' mang po gsan/ rje btsun phyogs las rnam rgyal la gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur mang po gsan no/ /dpal 'khor sde chen/ rtse chen/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang / bsam sdings rnams kyi gdan sa yun ring po'i bar du mdzad nas zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ rgyud 'grel chen po/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum/ chos rje bu'i chos 'byung / jo bo'i chos 'byung / bka' gdams glegs bam/ bka' gdams gzhung drug rgyal sras bka' 'bum/ khro phu ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor gsum/ phyag chen tshe khrid smar khrid/ spros med/ nai gu /zhi byed/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ ma cig blo sbyong sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ ri khrod dga' ldan du mdo lang kar gshegs pa dang / ka chen bzhi'i thog drangs pa'i po ti mang po'i 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i tshe/ lha'i bu rnams kyis me tog gi char phab ste/ bar snang la tshigs bcad gsungs pa ni/ chos mngon shes bya rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /'dul ba bdud rtsi'i snying pos shes rab rgyas/

/mdo sde za ma tog gi rgyan gyis mdzes/ /a la la'o deng sang 'di na dga'/ /ces zer ro/ /khro phur dge 'dun stong phrag mang po la zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dus/ grwa sa 'ga' zhig tu rims nad cung zad byung ba'i tshe/ rje btsun byams mgon la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab ste/ byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ rje btsun mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas/ chos bzhin byed la chos kyi bar chad 'byung / /chos med mi la chos kyi bar chad med/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi dam can srung mas bsgrub/ /skyo bar ma byed dam bca'i rgyun de srings/ /zhes gsungs nas thugs gso bar mdzad do/ /de nas rims nad kun chad cing gsung chos 'phel bar byung ngo / /yang rtse chen chos sde ru chos rje dga' ldan pa sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'i slob dpon mang dag la/ rgyud 'bum sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dus slob dpon kun dga' bas gsol ja zhig zhu yin yod tsa na/ gsung chos tshugs yod chos nyan la byon zer ba'i brda byung / ci yin nam zhal snga nas da lta 'di na bzhugs yod/ 'on kyang bred thabs su phyin pas/ zhal snga nas tshogs khang na rgyud 'bum gsung gin 'dug the tshom zos nas bltas pas kyang de bzhin du 'dug pa dang / khong gi bsam pa la/ bdag gi bla ma 'di grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor bzhin du sku lus sprul bsgyur la dbang thob par 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs so/ /de nas dpal 'khor sde chen du bug sgo mdzad nas sku mtshams dam po la thugs dam spros med kyi ngang la lo 'ga' zhig bzhugs dus/ byi lo'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs sham bha la nas byon zer ba'i rigs ldan kyi rgyal po rnams dang / srung ma drug cu byon nas/ da lta 'di na zab lam 'dom pa la khyod chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi/ chos kyi dung / chos kyi rnga bo che yin pas shod cig gsungs/ sbyor drug gi bshad nyan la bskul bar dgongs nas/

lhun grub bde chen du sgom chen skya ser pho mo sum brgya tsam la zab lam gyi khrid gnang bas la la 'od gsal rtags bcu rdzogs par shar/ la la dag gis lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad mthong / la la dag gis 'od gsal gyi ngang nas dbus gtsang khams gsum mthong / la la dag sgom khang gi gyang dang rtsig pa la thogs pa med par phyir don pa byung / kha cig ser sna'i mdud pa las grol/ kha cig 'khor ba la yid 'byung / kha cig dka' spyad kyi sdug bsngal bzod/ kha cig ri khrod 'grims/ kha cig bden gnyis kyi rnam dbye legs par rtogs nas bde gshegs snying po rtag brtan ther zug gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa dang / bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gnas tshul la mkhas par byed/ kha cig rgyan dang cha lugs spangs nas bla ma la 'bul ba dpag med byung / gsing gshongs su phyogs nas byon pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag mang po la zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel chen po sogs chos kyi 'khor lo zla med pa bskor nas gdul bya rnams chos kyis tshim par mdzad do/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po 'dis 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir/ las nyon gyi skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal las grol kyang / snying rje'i dbang gis bdag sogs rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir du/ dgung lo bdun bcu don brgyad pa shing mo lug gi lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te kun rdzob gzugs sku'i bkod pa rnams 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur nas 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang du bsdus te bde ba can du gshegs so/ /rje 'di'i sras kyi thu bo jo mo nang pa chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ mkhan chen chos rin dpal ba/ jo nang pa rin po che ba dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa/ chos rje mkhar chen pa/ kun mkhyen nam mkha' chos skyong pa/

mkhas grub chos skyong rgyal mtshan pa/ zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po rnams so/ /kun mkhyen nam mkha' chos skyong pa ni me pho 'brug la sku 'khrungs/ yul bzhad mthong smon pa yin/ sku gzhon nu nas sde snod mtha' dag la sbyangs pa chen po mdzad de/ sha tu ba'i grwa tshang tshal gung ba'i slob dpon rgyun ring mdzad pa'i ngang nas byang pa'i bdag po slob dpon chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba'i slob dpon mdzad cing / ka chen bco brgyad kyi grwa skor ya sbrel/ ngam ring chos sde'i mkhan tshab kyang lo mang po'i bar du mdzad/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa dang / kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum/ sems 'grel sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i chos mang du gsan/ jo mo nang gi gdan sa yun ring po'i bar du mdzad de/ de'i ring la zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel sogs zab rgyas kyi 'khor lo zla med par bskor/ sku 'bum chen mo 'dzam gling rgyan gyi chos 'khor rim pa bcu gsum gser zangs kyi phur/ bum pa'i phyi la logs ris khyad par du 'phags pa dang / nyi gdan gyi rdo lha rnams dang / gdugs bre bum pa'i ka ba rnams la ras phrug gi shub khyad 'phags rnams mdzad/ gzhan yang tshogs khang / bla brang / bde ba can/ skyed phug mkha' spyod bde ldan rnams kyi zhig gsos sogs mdzad cing / brgyud pa'i bris sku byin rlabs char 'bebs ngo mtshar can sum cu tham pa bzhengs te/ nges don gyi bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad nas/ dgung lo bdun cu don gnyis pa rab byung zhes pa ma mo yos kyi lo ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas bde bar gshegs so/ /rje 'di la slob ma'i tshogs dpag tu med kyang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad bka' 'dzin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dpal ldan rin chen/

paṇa chen dus zhabs pa nam mkha' dpal bzang po ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje rgyal po ba/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros pa rnams so/ /zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po ni/ kho bo cag gi yab mes sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud man ngag gi chos skor yongs su rdzogs par 'bul bar mdzad pa dang / lhag par tha snyad kyi rig gnas sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod sogs lo tsā ba rang nyid la ji ltar mnga' ba bzhin dges spro dang bcas bum pa gang byor phul nas/ bdag chen nyid la dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pa'i mtshan gyi dge legs dang ldan par mdzad pa'i byed po sprul pa'i lo tsā ba chen po 'di kho na yin pas/ de sogs bka' drin lhag par dran pa'i sgo nas skyes chen dam pa 'di'i rnam par thar pa cung zad rgyas par spel bar bya ba las/ de yang lo chen nyid kyi dngos slob skyogs kyi lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar dang mthun par brjod par bya ste/ de yang 'di skad ces thos te/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa rnams kyi rnam par 'dren pa chen po chos thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po shrī dharma pā la bha dra'i zhal snga nas 'di nyid/ sku tshe 'di'i sngon ma ni 'phags pa'i yul du paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig tu sku skye ba bzung ngo zhes grags te/ de skad du/ 'phags pa'i yul na mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gangs can bstan pa'i dpal du legs 'khrungs nas/ /zhes skyes bu dam pa'i gsung las 'byung ngo / /de nas bdag nyid chen po 'di sher phyin dar bar lung bstan pa'i yul byang phyogs kha ba can du gtsang gi sa'i cha zha lu gser khang gi khang gsar gong ma zhes bya bar/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas dang / bu ston rin po che'i slob ma mngon pa rang las mkhas pa rin chen sangs rgyas mgon zhes bya ba la sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du byung zhing /

dpon rin chen seṅge sogs mi chos pa'ang che bar byung ba'i gdung rus 'gos kyi rigs su/ yab dpon chen bsam 'grub dpal bzang dang / yum dad ldan rin chen chos 'dzom la sras lcam sring bzhi 'khrungs pa las/ rje 'di thog mar 'khrungs pa'i sras po gcig pu nyid de lcags me bya la sku bltams pa'o/ /lhums su zhugs tshe/ yum la mtshan ltas bzang po mang du byung zhing / bltams pa'i tshe na btsas ston yang cher byas shing / ya mtshan gyi cho 'phrul du ma byung bar snang la/ chos skyong 'bum zhes mtshan btags pa'o/ /de nas sku legs par skyed bsrings te gzhon nu rol rtsed la rol ba'i tshe yang thugs rgyud mnyen zhing ngang ring ba dang / dul bar 'dug pa dang / bag yod pa dang / mnyes gshin pa dang ni ldan/ de yang byis pa tha mal pa ltar mi srun pa ni nam yang mi mnga'/ sku rtsed kyi mdzad pa na yang chos 'chad nyan gyi tshul dang dgon pa 'ding pa'i tshul dang / dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang / mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshul mdzad cing / sems can la 'tshe bar 'gyur ba ni gang yang mi mdzad/ cung zad mnal ba'i tshe na mar me du ba'i snang ba 'char ba sogs sngon gyi lung rtogs la sbyangs pa mu med pa rnams kyi 'phro sad pa'i rtags mang du mnga' ste/ gzhon nu de lta bu nas skyes bu dam pa'i mdzad pa lhur mdzad pa zhig go /de nas dgung lo brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe/ shar kha ba dang / rin spungs pa dmag byed pa shar te/ snar thang gi nye logs ba lon du g.yul byas tshe/ rje 'di'i yab kyang shar kha ba'i dmag gi gtso bor phebs yod pas/ g.yul la ha cang dpa' bas rkyen byas te sku gshegs/ de nas rje'i me me drung chos rgyal bas thog mar mi chos la bzhugs par dgongs nas/ shar kha chos kyi rgyal po bdag chen bkra shis 'phags pa'i mdun sar spyan drangs te/ re zhig mi chos dang mthun par mdzad cing / rgyal mkhar rtse ba dang snag gi gnyen du gyur pas/ sri zhu phun sum tshogs pas bkur zhing bzhugs la/

de'i ring du bod yig dbu chen dang / 'bru ma dang / tsheg bris rnams slob dpon kha yar la legs par sbyangs/ bod skad la bag chags chung bas bslab pa dka' mo byung gsungs/ slar zha lur gnas brtan legs rgyal ba las bslabs te brda dag dang bcas pa dpyis phyin pa mkhyen par mdzad do/ /lañtsha dang wartu la sogs kyang khang pa'i sked ris la snang ba gzigs pas thugs dges te/ bal po lha bzo ba yi ge mkhas par shes pa la bslabs pas mkhas par mkhyen/ phyis nas slob dpon la ma ltos par/ kasmi ra dang / na ga ra dang / gau ma dang / ka ma ta dang / sin+dhu dang / dha ri dang / rgya mtsho mtha' yig dang / bru zha dang / puk+kaṃ dang / phu gur dang / hor yig gsar la sogs kyang tshegs med par mkhyen/ rgya bod kyi klog rnams kyang dag par mkhyen pas/ bdag chen gyi drung du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rtogs brjod dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam thar sogs gsan gang spro thun mdzad nas klog pa dang / bdag chen pas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la chos kyi dri ba mdzad pa'i 'phrin pa mdzad cing / sku phra yang thugs rdzogs pas dge bshes kun la gus par mdzad pa dang / thugs dam yang 'bad pa mdzad/ thugs la'ang chos gcig rang byed dgos dgongs pa byung / mi shi 'dug zer ba dang / dud 'gro gsod pa sogs gzigs pa'i tshe/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i snying rje dang nges 'byung chen po rang dbang med par 'khrungs shing / 'khor ba la btson dong dang / thar pa la khang bzang lta bu'i thugs ni rgyun mar byung ngo zhes thos la/ mi chos kyi tshul bstan kyang tshangs spyod 'ba' zhig la gnas par mdzad/ skye bo su la yang mi brnyas shing / tshig rtsub ngan smras sogs gzhan gyi snying la mi 'bab pa ni nam du yang mi gsungs/ gnod lan kyang phan pas bsgrub pa kho na mdzad pa lags so/ /de'i tshe chos kyang 'di dag gsan te/ brag dkar du sku zhang gi khu bo chos rje rgya mtsho dpal ba la/

gshed dmar lha lnga/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i dbang tshe khrid sogs te/ gzhan yang bla ma kha cig la chos mang po gsan no/ /de nas dgung lo bco brgyad tsam bzhes pa'i tshe/ bdag chen gyis kyang zha lu khang gsar gong ma ba'i bu 'di la chos kyi bag chags cher gsal ba snang bas/ btsun pa 'os par 'dug gsungs pa la/ dbon drung pad rgyal bas/ khong tshang rang re'i dpon skya khungs ma yin pa dang / zhal lu'i shar sgo khong tshangs gi 'dzin zhing / khyad par sras bu gcig pu 'di las med pas mi chos rang 'thad zhus pas/ rje 'di thugs khro ba'i go skabs nam yang med pa zhig yin na'ang / chos kyi gegs su gyur dogs pas cung ma dges pa byung gsungs/ de nas thugs la ni bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la thos bsam byas chog pa gcig nam yong dgongs pa las re ba gzhan med/ dkon mchog gi rten drung du de ltar 'grub pa'i smon lam nan tur mdzad cing / bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de nyid kyi mtshan tsam gsan pa dang / sku 'dra gzigs pa na bcos min gyi dad pa spyan chab 'khrug pa byung / de ltar chos kho na thugs la brnag pa nyid kyis/ mo ston mkhas pa zhig yod pa la mo cha mdzad pas/ khong na re/ sprin cog mo tsam zhig nam mkhar byung / /de ji cher song pas nam mkha' khengs/ /zer bas 'di shin tu bzang zer ba'ang byung zhing / bdag chen bkra shis 'phags pa'i sku'i ring la chos mdzad chog pa'i dgongs bzang yod kyang / ha cang thugs mnyes pas phyag phyi mdzad dgos pa byung / de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la chos mdzad pa thag bcad/ yum gyis kyang sngar lhums su zhugs pa dang bltams pa'i dus su ltas bzang po mang du yod pa dang / bag chags gsal ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge bshes chen po gcig yong bsam pas/ pha gzhis 'dzin mkhan med kyang chos rang 'thad gsungs te bkag pa ma mdzad/ phyis nas kyang rje nyid bdag gi ma yum de rang dad pa dang chos nyams che ba gcig yod/

bdag gi chos la gegs cung zad kyang ma mdzad gsungs/ sras po gcig pu yin pas yab gzhis 'dzin dgos pa'i nan tur mi mdzad par/ bstan pa la dgongs pa'i lhag bsam de lta bu sogs las dpags te mkha' 'gro ma zhig yin par gor ma chag go /de ltar sna tshogs zhes pa chu pho rta lo la chos sde chen po dpal 'khor sde chen du dbyar zla tha chung gi nya la/ mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa lung sde bzhi thugs la bzhugs pa/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i zhal snga nas mkhan po/ chos rje kun dga' dpal bzang gis dge tshul gyi slob dpon mdzad/ mkhan slob de dag gi spyan sngar rab tu byung ba mdzad de/ rin chen chos skyong bzang por mtshan btags/ ngur smrig gi na bza' bsnams te/ tshig snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa nos shing / thugs la re ba yongs su grub pas dges pa mu med par byung snang / a a skyes bu dam pa rnams sku phra mo de tsam gyi tshul bzang ba dang / chos la rtse gcig pa'i 'dun pa dang / 'khor ba zhen log de lta bu ni rgya gar gyi paṇa grub phal cher dang / bod kyi'ang sngon gyi dge bshes phal la byung bar ma nges so/ /de ltar rab tu byung nas kyang ltung ba'i gnas shin tu phra mos kyang ma gos par bslab pa rin po che spyan 'bras ltar bsrung zhing / tha na zhal chems tshun/ skra dang kha spu lhan du 'breg par gsungs pa yin dgongs nas bzhar bas/ bal po 'dra zer zer nas/ chos mdzad pa po zhes btags skad do/ /de nas gtsang nyang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa chen po dpal 'khor sde chen grwa khang khang gsar grwa tshang gi slob dpon gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba rin chen ting 'dzin 'od zer ba la gtugs te thog mar rigs pa la 'jug pa'i sgo bsdus grwa 'thab pa nas brtsams te bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba dang / bstan pa'i snying po pha rol tu phyin pa'i bstan bcos 'grel chung don gsal thugs sbyong mdzad/

thugs rab zab pa dang yangs pa nyid brtson pa mu med pas brgyan te gsan sbyong kho na la rtse gcig tu bsgrims pas grwa pa'i mig ltos la phan pa byung / long gtam cal col sogs ngag 'khyal du 'gro ba cung zad mi mdzad par nyin mtshan thog thag tu dpe cha 'dzin bshar/ rigs lung / mno bsam gtong ba sogs 'bad pa ches mtha' yas pa mdzad pas/ gzhan dag gis lo zlar sbyangs pa las/ dam pa 'dis zhag re sbyangs pa yang tshig don la 'dris pa byung ste/ dpang lo chen pos/ sngon tshe sbyangs pas skye ba 'dir/ /gzhung rnams rtsed mo'i zhar la shes/ /zhes gsungs pa de dang mthun par/ sngon nas sbyangs pa mu med pas sku tshe 'dir tshegs chen po mi yong ba yin par snang la/ de ltar rje 'di thugs bskyed ha cang che drags pas kun gyi blor ma chud par/ slob dpon dang grwa ba kun na re/ chos mdzad bal po 'di 'dra ci yin mi shes/ gsung rab rnams zhar la tshig don ma lus pa shes 'gro ba zhig gda' zhes gleng zhing ha las pa byung zhes dpal 'khor sde chen du yun ring du bzhugs pa chos kyi rje rin po che kun tshul ba sogs gsungs par grags so/ /de dus rig pa'i stobs rgyas pas/ phyir rgol ba'i spobs pa 'phrog nus pa byung ste/ grub mtha' ma dag pa 'ga' la dgag bzhag kyang mdzad do/ /de nas slob dpon ting 'dzin nyi ma zhes pa chu mo lug gi ston dus sku gshegs pas gsol btab dgongs rdzogs sogs la brtson pa mdzad cing / de nas mkhas pa'i dbang po chen po chos kyi rje bsod nams grags pa yongs 'dzin du bsten te/ 'grel pa don gsal rong ṭik+ka gi steng nas zhib tu bshad pas/ mdo sde rgyan 'phags pa'i ṭik+ka dang bcas pa/ rgyud bla ma 'byed gnyis dang bcas pa zad pa blo rgyal ba'i ṭik+ka'i steng nas bshad pa/ kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang bka' chos rje don grags pa las brgyud pa phag dkar/ parna sha wa ri/ rnam 'joms rnams kyi rjes gnang /

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel gshong 'gyur la bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchan gyis gsal bar byas pa/ sa bcad/ chos 'byung mdor bsdus dang po'i ṭik+ka rnams kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa/ mkhan chen dharmā shrī ba'i zin bris rnams gsan/ de dag kyang tshig tsam ma yin par ṭik+ka gzhung byin thugs la byang bar bzung ste tshig don thams cad dpyis phyin par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang mtshan brjod jo nang 'gyur gsar/ kun mkhyen chen po jo mo nang pa'i nges don rgya mtsho sa bcad dang bcas pa/ bka' bsdu ba bzhi pa/ sham+bha la'i bstod pa che chung sogs mang du gsan te rgyas par gsan yig las shes shing / de ltar mdo sngags kyi chos mang po thugs su chud nas/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya'i dpyid dus/ zha lu ri phug tu thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston gyi dus mchod chen mo la gzhi byes kyi dge bshes khri phrag du ma'i dbus su byams chos sogs la bshad pa mdzad pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa 'grel ba'i tshig don phun sum tshogs pa byung bas/ dge bshes chen po mang du bzhugs pa rnams ha las pa lta bu'i thugs dges pa byung ste/ 'di lta bu'i bshad pa ya mtshan pa rang sngon byung pa ma dran zhes gsungs shing / kun gyis bstod bkur bsngags pa chen po phul/ de lta bu'i ngo mtshar la lha rnams kyang yid rang bas/ grwa skor mdzad pa'i nyi ma dang po nas me tog gi char pa shin tu che ba babs pa skye bo kun gyis mthong ba sogs ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul bgrang ba las 'das pa byung zhes zha lu'i grwa pa rnams mgrin gcig tu sgrog par gyur to/ /de ltar grwa skor mdzad pa'i mod de nas/ sngon 'phags pa'i yul du 'khrungs pa'i bag chags gsal ba'i dbang gis dang / thugs dgongs la'ang 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa la/ rgyu rig pa'i gnas lnga shes dgos par rgyal ba mi pham pas kyang gsungs shing /

bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung rab 'di rnams la legs par sbyar ba'i skad du gsungs la/ bsdu pa po rnams kyis kyang de ltar bsdus shing / dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mdzad pa rnams kyang legs par sbyar ba'i skad las ma 'das par nges la/ de yang spyir gsung rab thams cad tshig don gnyis su gnas pa las/ thog mar tshig shes dgos/ de las don shes par byed dgos na/ tshig de ni gting mtha' can du nges pa nyid dang / de dag gi rnam 'gyur ngo bo las/ ched du bya ba sogs dang / bdag gzhan dang / dus gsum sogs sgra rig pa las shes dgos pa'i phyir dang / lo tsā ba kha cig gi 'gyur ma dag pa dang / la la yi ge bas bris nor du yod pa rnams kyang rgya dpe la gtugs te dag par ma byas na/ gzhan gyis shes mi nus pa dang / gsang sngags la'ang sngags ma dag par bzlas pas don phyin ci log tu 'gyur ba sogs 'khrul gzhi dang bcas pa thams cad sgra shes na shes nus la/ de yang rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ mkhas pa zer ba mang na yang / /sde snod lhums su zhugs ma zhugs/ /sgra tshad 'phrang la gshar na gsal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ sgra rig pa ni shin tu gces par dgongs nas/ thog mar rtogs sla ba rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos zhes bya ba slob dpon dbang phyug go chas mdzad par grags pa'i ka lā pa gsan par bzhed pa la/ de dus zha lu na skad gnyis smra ba gnas brtan legs rgyal ba bzhugs pas khong sgra la mkhas par yod pas/ khong gi sar phebs te/ kho bo sgra shes par 'dod pas thos so tsam min pa'i dpyis phyin pa zhig bslab par zhus pas/ drung nas gzhan dang mi 'dra rjes su yi rang / mkhas pa zer ba de 'dod na sgra shes dgos par bdog lags/ da ni drung nas rang dang por ka lā pa'i gzhung bying mdo u ṇa sogs rnams khyis bdas kyang thon pa/ zhal ba'i khar sran ma bkrams pa lta bu gang 'dod nas blangs chog pa gcig mdzad par zhu/ de nas 'am bus a ru ra lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar sgra rig pa phyag tu gsal sing 'bul ba lags gsungs pas/

de kha bzhin mdzad do/ /gsum po thugs la byang bar bzung ste/ snar thang lo tsā ba'i rnam bshad las gsan/ sa ris bskyar cag sogs la brtson pa chen po mdzad pas zla ba gnyis na shin tu byang ba dang bcas te rdzogs par mkhyen/ de'i zhar la sdeb sbyor yang slob dpon shan+ti pa nyid kyi gzhung rtsa 'grel las rdzogs par gsan te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud pa la legs sbyar gyi skad du/ dbang po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor gyis bcings pa'i snyan ngag gi bstod pa'ang mdzad/ slob dpon daṇ+ḍa'i snyan ngag me long yang dpang lo chen po'i 'grel pa'i steng nas zhib tu gsan te snyan ngag rtsom pa la skal ba chen po brnyes par gyur to/ /de ltar na zla ba gnyis kyi ring la ka lā pa dang / sdeb sbyor dang / tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos rnams mthar thug pa mkhyen/ de la ka lā pa ni/ uṇa sogs/ si sogs/ ti sogs/ nyer bsgyur dang bcas pa'i zur bkol rnams kyang mtha' dpyad dang bcas pa thugs la long ste mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa mkhyen pas/ slob dpon rin po che skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po legs rgyal ba nyid thugs dges te/ drung nas thugs sngon nas sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa zhig yin par gda' na'ang / slob pa'i tshul bstan te mchi gsungs nas bya dga' dang yi rang chen po mdzad do/ /gzhan dag gi mtshams sbyor lnga pa yang zla chos yin na/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni zla ba gcig la ka lā pa cha lag dang bcas pa/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor rnams yongs su rdzogs par mkhyen pa lags so/ /de lta bu'i mkhyen pa'i snyan grags kyang phyogs kyi khongs su khyab pa las/ lo de'i dbyar smad bsam gling du bzhugs tshe/ phyogs phyogs nas sgra don gnyer gyi grwa pa mang du 'dus pa la bshad nyan yang mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /de yang sngon gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir ka lā pa 'chad pa rnams/ grub pa yi ge zhes pa nas phyir bsgrub dang bcas te 'chad pas tshegs shin tu che zhing gzhung gi 'bru gnyer ba'ang shin tu dka' ba yod skad/

phyis paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ma ṇi ka la rje btsun 'jam dpal gyis zhal dngos su bstan nas man ngag gi bshad pa rtogs sla ba/ gzhung gi don rnams blo yul du 'char bde ba 'di bstan/ paṇ+ḍi ta des bo dong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gsungs/ khong gis snar thang lo tsā ba saṃb+gha shrī la gsungs/ des gnas brtan legs rgyal pa/ de la rje 'dis gsan pas na sngon med pa'i man ngag gi bshad pa tshegs chung ngus shes par 'gyur ba ni/ deng sang rje 'di nyid kyi gsung las 'chad pa las gzhan med par gda'o/ /de ltar na phul du byung ba'i legs bshad kyi srol gtod pa'i shing rta chen po yang rje 'di nyid kho na'o/ /de nas sngar rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po chos rje 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rtse chen chos sde na sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid gsung ba gsan te/ thugs dgongs la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma la sogs pa las/ so sor bsdud dang bsam gtan dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa/ theg pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i tshul bstan pa rab 'byams rgya mtsho lta bu'i snying po/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mchog rnal 'byor pa skal ba bzang po can rnams kyis skye ba 'di la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i nye lam yid ches pa gsum ldan gyi phyag rgya chen po zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid cis kyang nyan dgos/ de yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul/ rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen chen po dpal jo mo nang pa'i zhal snga nas thugs nyams su bzhes/ don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i bshad srol byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal/

brgyud pa zam ma chad pa'i bka' babs chen po mnga' ba/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i zhal snga nas te/ sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs dang mi gnyis pa'i mkhas pa chen po rtogs pa mchog brnyes pa yin pas ci nas nyan te nyams su blang dgongs nas bsam gling nas rtse chen du phyag phebs nyams khrid du rgyas par ni gsan/ sngon 'gro nas brtsams te sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ byed bcings kyang dam par mdzad de/ khrid yig thog mtha' bar dge ngo sprod gsang don rab gsal/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang don gsal byed dang bcas pa la sogs pa nas gsan te/ sku nyams su bstar ba las thugs la rtogs pa ji ltar bshad pa bzhin 'khrungs so/ /gzhan yang bka' lung snga phyir 'di ltar gsan te/ dge slong ma'i so sor thar ba'i mdo/ rgyud bla dbus mtha' rnam 'byed rnams kyi bshad pa/ dus 'khor chos 'byung chos rje phyogs las pas mdzad pa/ rgyud 'bum po ti bzhi gsan pa'i dum bu dang po na/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa/ rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud le'u lnga pa/ rgyud phyi ma kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang gis bsgyur pa/ rigs drug mnyam par ston pa sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ mngon brjod bla ma/ dum bu gnyis pa na dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde mchog sdom 'byung / mkha' 'gro'i rgya mtsho/ he ru ka mngon 'byung / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor gyi rgyud/ phag mo mngon 'byung / phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ dum bu gsum pa na dpal sam+bu ṭi gsang ba rdo rje/ gsang ba kun spyod/ gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ nam mkha' sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud rin chen phreng ba/ dam tshig chen po/ stobs po che/ ye shes gsang ba/ ye shes phung ba/ ye shes 'bar ba/ zla ba'i phreng ba/

rin chen 'bar ba/ nyi ma'i 'khor lo/ ye shes rgyal po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba/ gsang ba me 'bar/ gsang ba bdud rtsi/ dur khrod rgyan/ rdo rje rgyal po/ ye shes gsang ba/ chags pa'i rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ma'i sdom pa/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba 'bar ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rnam par 'joms pa/ rdo rje grub pa dra ba sdom pa/ stobs chen ye shes rgyal po/ dur khrod rgyan rmad du byung ba/ bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba/ brtag pa gnyis pa/ rdo rje gur/ phyag chen thig le/ ye shes snying po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ ye shes thig le/ de kho na nyid sgron ma/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud/ badz+ra a ra li/ ri gi a ra li/ dum bu bzhi pa na rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud gnyis/ gdan bzhi'i bshad rgyud sngags kyi cha/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad gsang ba'i rgyal po/ gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud rnams kyi lung sogs rgya cher gsan te/ rgyas par gsan yig las shes par bya'o/ /gsung chos de dag gsan ring / rtse chen nas zha lu sku zhang gi sras mo bdag mo bde bzang mas gsol chas zhabs tog thon par mdzad do/ /de nas skyis mkhar dgon pa rdzong du phebs te/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags pa bzang po'i bu chen chos kyi rje rin dpal ba la chos mngon pa kun las btus dang / 'dul ba mdo rtsa ṭik+ka dang bcas pa snga chos dgong chos mdzad phal che ba gsan grub/ de nas re zhig dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs te chos rje rin chen bsod nams grags pa yongs 'dzin du bsten bzhin pa las gsung rab la gzigs rtog sogs gsan pa dang thos bsam gyi 'khor lo rgyun chags pa mdzad cing / de dus ngor e waṃ chos ldan du thog cig phebs/ mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa la lam 'bras gsan par bzhed de/ de yang rgyud sde mtha' dag gi nying khu/

rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ru pa'i khyad chos/ grub chen ga ya dha ra'i gser chos lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa/ skyon yon tan du slong ba/ bar chad dngos grub tu len pa la sogs pa'i zab gnad ston pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho las 'byung ba'i dbang bzhi'i nyams len thun mong ma yin pa/ dbang po rno rtul bar ma gsum la thabs khyad par du 'phags pas tshe 'di nyid dam/ skye ba bdun nam/ tha na yang skye ba bcu drug na bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i thabs ston pa'i gsung ngag rin po che gsan pa la thugs 'dun drag par byung pas/ rje nyid la gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pas thugs dges pa dang bcas pas/ kye rdor rgyu dbang lam dbang / bdag med ma'i dbang / lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid rdzogs par gsan cing / gzhan yang snga phyir gsan pa ni/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi dbang / na ro mkha' spyod kyi rjes gnang / gur lha bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang / 'grel pa dag ldan/ mngon rtogs ljon shing / rgyud sde spyi rnam/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong / kyai rdor mngon dkyil mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ gtor chog las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rab gnas bzang drug ma rnams kyi bshad pa la sogs pa gsan no/ /ngor du bzhugs ring de la'ang sgra rig don gnyer ba kha cig 'dus pa la/ ka lā pa'i 'chad nyan legs par mdzad do/ /de nas slar dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs tshe/ mkhar gdan chos rje skad gnyis smra ba mkhas pa chen po shes rab rin chen pa'i zhal snga nas dang mjal te chos 'khor sgang du zhabs 'bring yang mdzad/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bdun gong ma dang bcas pa/ rgyud 'grel gyi bshad lung / nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel kyi sa bcad/ 'grel chen spyi don/ bde mchog bstod 'grel/ rdo rje snying 'grel la sogs pa gsan no/

/de nas dpal 'khor sde chen du dgung lo nyer drug pa mi zad ces bya ba me pho khyi'i lo nyang stod kyi sa'i thig le dpal 'khor sde chen zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du mkhan po rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi mnga' bdag chos kyi rje don grub grags pa dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / las kyi slob dpon gnas brtan chen po sde snod bzhi pa bka' bcu 'dzin pa bsod nams grags pa'i zhabs dang / gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon lung rigs smra ba'i dbang po bla ma mkhar chen grags pa bsod nams blo gros pa dang / dad pa'i dge 'dun kun dga' blo gros la sogs kyis las kyi kha bskangs te/ mtha' 'khob tu bcu'i tshogs grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa mnos te bslab khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum mtha' dag la nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos pa'i sdom brtson chen por bzhugs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang sa'i yongs sbyong nas bshad pa ltar mang du gsan pas ngom pa med pa'i rje btsun dam pa'i zhal lnga nas 'di nyid slar yang chos 'khor sgang du thegs te/ 'u yug gling dkar rdzong dkar sogs su chos dbar la thegs pa'i phyag phyi mdzad de/ bi kra ma shri la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a bha ya ka ras phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bka' kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs las brgyud pa dang / dkyil chog rdo rje'i phreng ba/ mngon rtogs rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng / sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye ma ste phreng skor gsum du grags pa'i lung / gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang / sgrol ma bla med lha bcu bdun gyi dbang / phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig ma'i lung / bya ba'i rgyud chen bzhir grags pa dang / so so'i rgyud gnyis yod pa'i so so'i rgyud la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs/ nor can gyi rigs/

lnga rtsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs dang drug yod pa'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la/ rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po/ rigs kyi gtsug tor/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya mo/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bsdu ba'i byang sems/ gnas gtsang gi lha la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams su yod pa'i rigs kyi yum/ stong chen rab 'joms/ rma bya chen mo/ so sor phreng ma/ bsil ba tshal/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin te gzungs grwa lngar grags pa'i dbang / bya rgyud kyi gtsug tor gyi rigs gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang / 'dul ba mdo rtsa dang so so thar ba'i mdo'i bshad pa/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i sbas don dngos brgyad don bdun cur bsdus nas ston pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel ba don gsal dang bcas pa'i bshad bka'/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis dga' ldan du rdzu 'phrul bstan nas byon te/ byams pa'i gsung la zin bris mdzad par grags pa'i sa sde lnga dang sdom rnam gnyis kyi nang nas theg pa thun mong ba'i sdom bden pa rnam nges dang / thob pa rnam nges dang / chos rnam nges dang / 'bel gtam rnam nges dang bzhi ston pa/ mngon pa kun las btus kyi bshad pa zhib mo/ gzhan yang 'jam bsdud bzang gsum/ bya rgyud bdag po'i rigs dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud/ 'dul ba sum brgya pa 'grel pa 'od ldan dang bcas te zhib bshad/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa'i rnam dag gtsug nor ma/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstan pa spyi bstod/ nyid kyi bstod pa bsod nams skyes la gdams pa/ lam rim smon lam/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya rnams kyi bshad pa/ sher phyin/ rdo rje gcod pa/ dpang lo chen pos bsgrigs pa'i gzungs 'bum/ 'dul ba lung rnam 'byed kyi kha dog bsgyur ba'i ltung byed las/ ma rnams kyi pham pa dang po yan/ phran tshegs bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa la/ mjug nas bam po bdun ma gtogs tshangs pa'i lung /

mngon pa mdzod kyi mtshan las ming ni 'pho ba'i phyir zhes pa nas/ gang zag bstan pa yan/ spyod 'jug gi bzod le brtson 'grus le'u rnams kyi bshad pa rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ṭik+kā'i steng nas gsan/ yang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i grub mtha' kun shes rtsa 'grel kyi bshad pa/ bka' gdams glegs bam/ thig le bcu drug gi dbang bka'/ pha chos bu chos cha lag dang bcas pa la bka' gdams glegs bam du grags pa'i lung rnams gsan pa yin no/ /ka lā pa'i tshig don byang bar mkhyen yang legs bshad kyi cha 'dra 'ong ngam dgongs nas nyid kyi ṭik+kā las/ kun bshad yan tsam gsan te/ sngar las lhag pa'i cha mi snang zhing / bying sgrub kha cig gi rjes 'brel dbye ba'i mdo ma rnyed snang ba sogs la/ legs bshad rje nyid la phar phul chog pa byung bas/ rje nyid thugs shin tu dges pa byung zhing / snyan ngag me long yang dpang ṭik+kā las gsan te/ de ltar na zla ba bcu phyin zhabs pad bsten par mdzad de dpon slob thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu gyur pa byung bas so/ /de nas dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs/ slar yang ngor la skor gcig phebs te gsung chos kyang gsan la/ chos kyi rnam grangs ni sngar smos te sdom pa ltar ro/ /ngor du bzhugs ring la 'grel pa sgron gsal/ kri ya sa muñtsa sogs rgya dpe mang du gzigs te bod dpe dang sbyar ba'i zhu chen rgya chen po mdzad do/ /ngor nas rje nyid dpon slob gsum rang mdzad de/ khro phu'i gnas mjal la phebs shing / sngon nas slob dpon tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa'i tsan+t+ra bya ka ra ṇa gsan par bzhed pa la/ sngar chos rje shes rin pa la slob pa zhus na'ang / ṭik+kā mi 'dug pas mi yong / lo chen thugs rje dpal ba'i zhabs 'bring yun ring du mdzad pa/ dpal sdings lo tsā ba grags pa blo gros pa mkhas pa bdog pas/ khong la bslab par zhu gsungs pa'i lung bstan yang yod pa bzhin khro phu nas tshur lam dpal sdings su phebs te/

lo tsā ba la ja 'dren dang 'bul nod kyang mdzad tsan+t+ra pa dpyis phyin par bslab par zhu ba mdzad pas/ khong gis yi rang dang dges pa chen po dang bcas te zhal gyis bzhes/ de ltar snyan lcag mdzad nas slar dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs/ sku chas nyer spyad rnams bsgrubs te dpal sdings su phyag phebs/ thog mar tsan+t+ra pa'i mdo bying gi tshogs/ uṇa sogs dang bcas pa rgya gar gyi skad du thugs 'dzin mdzad de/ 'grel pa dharmā dā pa dang / lo chen thugs rje dpal ba'i rnam bshad chen mo las gsan zhing / rnam bshad dang 'grel pa dharmā dā pa dag gis gsal bar mi ston pa kha cig dka' gnas su yod pa rnams ni/ 'grel bshad rat+na ma ti'i rgya dpe'i steng nas mtha' dpyad dang bcas pa gsan pas/ rnam bshad la mi mthun pa dum re snang ba rnams kyang dag par mdzad nus pa byung zhing / gzhan yang tsan+t+ra pa'i cha lag yi ge'i mdo/ gting mtha' dang / sum mtha' dang / uṇa sogs kyi 'grel pa dang / nyer bsgyur gyi 'grel pa la sogs pa rnams kyang gsan zhing / mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod/ thon mi'i sum rtags/ sngags klog mun sel sgron me/ dpang lo chen po'i tshogs gsum gsal ba rnams gsan te zla ba bzhi la yongs su rdzogs par byang bar mkhyen no/ /de yang spyir 'phags pa'i yul na an+t+ra byā ka ra ṇa dang / pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa dang / 'jam dpal gyi byā ka ra ṇa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi byā ka ra ṇa dang / slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i sgra mdo kun tu bzang po dang / tsan+t+ra byā ka ra ṇa dang / ka lā pa sogs sgra mdo mtha' yas pa bzhugs kyang / tshig nyung ngus don gsal zhing rdzogs par bstan pa ni tsan+t+ra pa kho na yin no/ /de'i phyir paṇ+ṭi ta chos 'bangs kyis 'grel pa dharmā dā pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen blo gros kyis 'grel bshad rat+na ma ti dang / paṇ+ḍi ta sūr+ṇa tsan+t+ras 'grel bshad kyi bshad pa stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa zhig mdzad cing /

'phags pa'i yul na shin tu dar zhing rtsis che bar mdzad pa'i bstan bcos sh+lau ka bdun brgya pa pā ṇi ṇa'i rjes su 'brangs te mdzad do/ /de yang slob dpon tsan+t+ra go mi ni dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma la sogs pa las lung bstan pa'i mkhas pa chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba yin la/ de'i legs bshad kyi srol bod du ni gshong ston mkhas pa'i dbang po rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis btsugs pa nas bzung / thugs rje dpal ba dpon slob yan la dar bar yod na'ang / phyis bdag nyid chen po 'di ma gtogs pa/ tsan+t+ra pa 'chad nus pa gcig kyang ma byung bar bshad la/ da lta'i tsan+t+ra ba'i rgyun 'di rnams rje'i gsung las 'chad pa mang bar bzhugs so/ /de'i phyir phul du byung ba'i legs bshad kyi srol mi nub pa'i nyin mor byed pa gcig pu kho na yin no/ /de ltar dpal sdings su tsan+t+ra pa gsan ring / bdag chen bkra shis rab brtan pas/ bdag po phag rgod khyung rgyal la phyag dam mdzad de/ seng ge rtse nas zhabs tog mtha' yas pa mdzad do/ /de nas bod du 'gyur ba'i sgra mdo chen po gnyis cha lag dang bcas pa/ tshig rgyan/ mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor la sogs pa la rang dbang du gyur pas lo tsā ba chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad cing / phyogs su yang lo tsā mkhas pa'i snyan pa chen po byung pas bstan pa la gces spras su byed pa'i lha mi rnams kyi yid gsos dam par gyur to zhes thos so/ /de nas lce khyi 'brug dang / lce sgom ljongs pa sogs mkhas grub rim par byon zhing / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sku khang chen po'i gdung brgyud/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi sprul par zhal gyis bzhes pa/ don gyi na rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bor gyur pa lha sar phebs pa na/ mkha' 'gro mas jo shāka rnam gnyis la zhal gser rgyu'i gser btul ma phul ba/ zha lu'i dpal ldan mas rjes bzhin du 'brangs te 'phrin las sgrub pa'i skyes chen dam pa sku zhang chos rje rin po che mkhyen rab mchog grub dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas de nyid ni bdag nyid chen po 'di la bka' drin zla ma mchis shing thugs dad rang dbang med par tshud pa'i sku tshe sngon ma nas kyi bla ma yin zhing /

dus phyis nas kyang sku zhang chos rje'i rnam thar dang 'phros gleng cung zad re byung na'ang spyan chab dbang med du 'khrug pa zhig yod par grags la/ de yang dang po sku zhang chos rje nyid kyi mtshan gsan pa na'ang / thugs dad bcos min du 'khrungs pas skom pa chu 'dod pa ltar mjal ba'i thugs 'dun drag po byung bas sngar zha lur gnas brtan lo tsā ba la sgra gsan pa'i dus mjal ba sogs nas bzung / dpon slob thun mong ma yin pa'i thugs rtse gcig pa pha dang bu'i rnam thar las gzhan du ma 'das pa zhig byung bar bshad la/ de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa la gsung chos kyi bka' drin snga phyir nod pa yang 'di dag ste/ bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang / spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang / sku mi zad pa rgyan kyi bkod pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang / spyod rgyud phyag rdor 'gro bzang gi dbang / 'gro bzang lugs kyi phyag rdor rnam sras zhi drag gi rjes gnang / rnal 'byor rgyud rdor dbyings kyi dbang / rdo rje 'byung ba'i rnam bshad rin chen bsam 'phel gyi bshad pa/ mi 'khrug pa jo bo lugs kyi dbang dkyil chog gi lung / dus 'khor dkyil chog bus mdzad pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i phyag len zin bris kyi lung / sgyu 'phrul chen po lha lnga'i dbang / mngon rtogs gnyis dang dkyil chog gi lung / bla med pha rgyud gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang / 'grel ba sgron gsal gyi lung / gshed dmar gyi dbang bzhi/ shin tu spros med kyi khrid/ rang byin rlabs/ rnam rtog 'od gsal kyi byin rlabs/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i mngon dkyil/ sbyin sreg mchod phreng / drug cu pa'i gtor chog gshed dmar spros med kyi rtsa ba mthu stobs dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ glo bo lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i khrid yig nag 'bum du grags pa/

rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor zhal shes/ 'phags pa'i dris lan/ gong mo mkhar pa shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnam rtog 'od gsal/ phyir bzlog skor gsum/ rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi rtsa ba bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ 'grel pa 'jug bde rnam gsal/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim/ spros med dpyal lugs niṣ+ka laṅka'i gsung la dpyal los zin bris mdzad pa/ chos rje thugs sras pa spros med gsung dus chos grub dar gyis zin bris mdzad pa rnams kyi lung / dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma/ nges don snye ma/ dbang mdor bstan gyi ṭik+ka mkhas pa dga' byed/ sbyin sreg 'khrul 'khor gyi dpe/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi thog mtha' bar dge'i khrid/ ngo sprod gcer mthong ngo shes nyams khrid du gsan cing / gzhan yang dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang / tho yig gi lung / mai tri mkha' spyod kyi rjes gnang la sogs pa rnams gsan te/ rgyas par gsan yig las shes so/ /de nas rgyal mkhar rtse pa'i bdag chen 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul chos rgyal mi'i dbang po bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa/ skye dgu mtha' dag gi nyer 'tsho chen por gyur pa/ ta'i si tu dpal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas de nyid kyis mdzad pa rmad byung rnam dkar rgya chen po'i srol gtod pa/ phyag bzhes su rgyun chags par 'debs par mtha' yas pa phun tshogs bco brgyad du grags pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lo re bzhin bka' 'gyur gser chos po ti bcu gsum re dang / bstan 'gyur skya chos po ti bcu gsum re bzhengs kyi yod pa la/ zhu dag pa'ang sde sdod gsum pa 'dzin pa/ theg pa gsum la nges par sbyangs pa/ rig pa'i gnas bcu khongs su tshud pa re spyan 'dren pa yin skad/ de la bdag chen bkra shis rab brtan pas/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la mchid gsol te/ nged kyi khu bo bdag chen chos kyi rgyal pos srol gtod pa'i dge ba'i mdzad pa rlabs po che'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/

gsung rab yi ger 'god pa 'di'i srol che bzang du gyur na'ang zhus dag pa mchog tu gyur pa dkon na/ nyid lta bu chos du ma la mkhyen pa'i spyan bkra bas/ bstan pa la gces spras su 'gyur ba'i zhu chen mdzod pa'i lung nod pas/ rje nyid kyi thugs la'ang spyir bka' bstan bcos blta rtog bgyi pa la dpe cha'ang 'dzom pa yong bar snang zhing / gsung rab bzhengs pa mang na'ang dag po ches dkon par gda' bas/ zhu chen dag po bgyis na bstan pa la phan mchis dgongs te zhal gyis bzhes shing phyag len la btab/ de yang phyi mo la legs par gtugs te/ don zhus dang tshig zhus kyi cha dpyis phyin par mdzad/ bod kyi sgra mdo sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug dang bstun te/ zhus dag la mkho ba'i dag yig kyang thugs rtsom mdzad/ rgya dpe rnyed pa kha cig ni rgya dpe la gtugs te 'gyur chad rnams bsab pa dang / mi bcos su mi rung ba dag bcos shing gtan la phab pas/ deng sang rje nyid kyis zhus dag mdzad pa'i glegs bam rnams kho na la dpang po zhus te bgyid par snang ngo / /de lta bu ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa la byi dor phyag rjes rgya chen 'gran zla dang bral ba kho na yin no/ /de ltar dgung lo nyer lnga nas bzhi cu'i bar tsam du mdzad de lo bco lnga'i ring tsam mo/ /zhu dag mdzad de yang dpyid dang dbyar gyi ring mdzad/ ston dgun gung seng gi tshul du zha lu sogs su phebs pa dang / gsung chos gsan pa dang / 'chad pa dang / phyag dpe 'bri ba dang / chos bsgyur ba dang / rtsom pa dang / thugs dam zab mo'i ngang du sku mtshams sogs mdzad/ ri khrod dga' ldan pa sogs la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel kyi bshad pa gsungs/ de la dus re zhig gi tshe zha lur sgra don gnyer ba kha cig la gsung chos gnang / de dus sku zhang chos rje rin po ches gnang ba'i ther ma sku thabs kyi rgyu bzang ba gcig yod pa la tshos mdzad de/ nyin gcig bla yer skams su bzhag

khang thog nas dpon slob tshos sa ris mdzad pa dang bstun te thugs rtog 'jug pa'i lugs mdzad na'ang sa ris la thugs g.yengs/ re zhig gzigs pa ma byung / de nas gzigs tshe ther ma mis khyer nas mi gda' skad/ phyis sku zhang chos rje'i gcung po chos rje mthu stobs pas khung chod nas/ rje nyid la kha sang gi ther ma rku mi kho nged kyis shes byung pas/ kho la chad las dang / ther ma long pa nged kyis bgyid gsungs pa phebs gnang / rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid rnam pa thams cad du bdag pas gzhan gces kyi mdzad pa kho na sku nyams su bzhes pa zhig lags pas/ sku zhang la ther ma bdag gis blos btang tshar bas mi dgos lags na/ chad las smos ci 'tshal bar zhus pas/ skyes bu dam pa gsungs nas yi rang mang po yang mdzad/ de ltar thos pa rnams kyang dad pa dbang med du tshud pa byung zhes pa sogs de dus kyi zha lu pa rnams yang yang gleng bar grags so/ /dpal 'khor sde chen du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyi nang gsang gsum la shin tu mkhas pa'i dus zhabs pa chen po thar pa bzang po'i spyan sngar/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ gong ma bzhi/ gong ma chen po rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas pa gsan/ mi 'khrugs pa jo bo lugs 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba'i yig cha'i steng nas gsan no/ /de nas dgung lo so bdun tsam gyi dus rje nyid kyi yum rang bzhin gyi mkha' 'gro ma de nyid sku gshegs te/ dpal 'khor sde chen du spyan 'dren pa byung pa/ rje nyid yum la shin tu gus pas thugs la nges 'byung dang skyo shas cher byung pa na/ spyir 'dus byas thams cad kyi ngang tshul 'di las ma 'das/ khyad par bdag gi ma des dang por lus bskyed/ bar du brtse bas bskyangs/ da ni chos la bskul ba'i thabs byas so dgongs nas chos thog tu bzhag na'ang / thugs la dran pa rang byung gsungs shing / de nas bzung ste thugs sna thung bun song bar grags so/

/de nas dgongs rdzogs dmigs su 'gro ba mdzad/ gdung zhugs la sbyangs te sāñtsha btab/ zha lur shar chen pa dang brang chen pa la nag nya sgrub mchod kyi thebs su zhing bzang po kha cig kyang phul te deng sang gi bar brtan chags pa yin zhes thos la/ de ltar drin can gyi yum rin po che'i bka' drin bsab cing / de nas skabs shig tu rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i gnas gtsang la stod grom pa rgyang gi sa'i cha/ 'jam dbyangs gdung brgyud du 'khrungs pas bstan pa'i 'byung khungs lta bu bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang mjal ba la thegs te/ gnas rnams zhib mor mjal bas thugs dad dang mi rtag pa dag lhan cig tu rgyas shing / bdag chen rgya dkar ba'i drung du sa skya pa'i khyad chos dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs gsan cing / sgo rum du zhag 'ga' bzhugs te rgya dpe rnams la gzigs rtog zhib mo gnang / kha cig bod dpe dang gtugs te zhu chen yang mdzad cing / theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud ces bya ba sngar ma 'gyur ba zhig bsgyur ba'i dgongs pas bsnams/ de nas gnam kha 'ur phebs te bdag chen blo gros pa la mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / mgon po zhal gyi rjes gnang bka' bsgo /kha'u skyed lhas kyi brag sgo la dbu gtugs pa/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi yig cha mang po'i lung sogs gsan no/ /de nas zha lur phebs te ri phug tu sa skya nas bsnams pa'i rgyud bsgyur ba dang / mkhas grub pas mdzad pa'i dus 'khor gyi yig cha la mi 'thad pa snang ba rnams la dpyad pa sogs mdzad de re zhig bzhugs/ de'i tshe phyogs su sngar ma 'gyur ba'i rgyud bsgyur gyis gda' zer ba dang / mkhas grub pa'i yig cha la dgag pa byed kyis yod par gda' zer nas grags pa chen po byung bas/ kha gcig 'ud yin bsam pa byung / phal cher ni dad pa dang yi rang chen po byung zhing /

la la na re/ khong lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sprul pa yin yang zer/ 'ga' zhig ni thon mi sam+bho ṭa'i sprul pa yin nam zer nas snyan grags mtha' khyab tu byung ngo / /de nas slar dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs te/ sa skya bdag chen blo gros pas gsung ngag tshar gnyis gsungs pa'i rjes ma la/ rje nyid kyis kyang kye rdor yab yum kyi bka'/ lam 'bras kyi khrid la sogs pa gsan no/ /slar yang zha lur yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen slob dpon gsal ba grags pa las rgyal tshab byams pas 'od byed pa'i sa brnyes pa'i 'phags pa thogs med la gsungs nas/ thogs med kyis zin bris sam bsdu ba mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po'i sa dang lam gyi rnam bzhag mtha' dag gtan la 'bebs pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa chen po gzhi bcu bdun gyi ya gyal du gyur pa nyan thos kyi sa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba dang / gzhi bsdu ba dang / mdo sde bsdu ba dang / 'dul ba bsdu ba dang / 'di nyid chos mngon pa'i sde snod yin pas mngon pa bsdu ba zur na med la/ rnam grangs bsdu ba/ rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba ste sa sde lngar grags pa'i lung yongs su rdzogs pa sogs gsan/ gzhan yang dpal 'khor sde chen du khang gsar ba'i slob dpon rin po che mkhar chen brag pa bsod nams blo gros pa la/ byams chos kyi gzhung chos thor bu ba dang / rnam 'grel sogs tshad ma skor gyi thal rang dang / spyi don gzhung chos sogs gsan no/ /yang zha lur rtse mo ba'i slob dpon rin chen brag dmar rab 'byams pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa la phar phyin/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i ṭik+ka lung gi snye ma las bshad pa gsan cing / slob dpon rgyal mtshan rdo rje la gshed dmar lha lnga/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / gzungs gra lnga'i dbang la sogs gsan no/ /de dag ni dgung lo bzhi cu phan tsam du gtsang gi sa'i char bzhugs pa'i rnam thar sa bon tsam smos zin la/

da ni nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams su phebs pa'i tshul cung zad ston te/ de yang lcags pho byi ba'i lo shar ba na/ ji ltar mkhan po bo dhi sa twa dang / jo bo a ti sha la sogs za hor gyi yul du 'khrungs kyang / 'phrin las bod du spel ba dang mtshungs par/ rje nyid kyang dbus su 'phrin las rgyas pa'i dge mtshan dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu dang / 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos dge bcu'i khrims bcas te skye bo kun rnam par dag pa'i lam la bkod de/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo sde bsgyur pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam sprul khri srong lde'u btsan gyis lo paṇa khyad par can rnams spyan drangs te/ sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod/ mdo sngags kyi chos phal cher bsgyur pa'i gtsug lag khang lha sa bsam yas sogs kyi bsngags pa gsan pas thugs 'phrogs shing gzigs par bzhed pas/ rje nyid sku 'khor 'ga' dang bcas te chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur to/ /de nas 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtog pa las lung bstan pa'i ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du phebs te/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos rab gnas mdzad pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne dang / rang byon lnga ldan du grags pa jo bo bcu gcig zhal dang / ra mo che'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje la sogs pa'i spyan sngar 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa dang bcas pa bshams nas thub pa'i mdzad pa la dmigs pa'i dad pa'i shugs drag pos nyin mtshan du gsol ba 'debs pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba'i mdor skor ba'i phan yon gsungs pa sogs thugs la bcags pas zhabs skor la brtson par mdzad pa na/ sngon gyi mkhas grub dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos jo bo shākya rnam gnyis la gsol ba btab pa las/

bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che 'grub pa'i rten 'brel rang babs su 'grig pa bzhin/ rje rin po che 'dis kyang bstan pa dang rang gzhan thams cad kyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa dang / jo bo shākya nyid kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mtshan ma gsal po byung bar gdon mi za'o/ /de ltar lha sa mjal ba'i thugs dun yongs su gang nas/ yer pa lha ri snying po dang / gung thang / tshal la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par 'phags pa rnams kyang mjal te/ skabs su 'tshams pa'i mchod pa mdzad de rim gyis bsam yas su phebs/ mkhan po rin po che'i dbu thod dang / g.yu'i thub pa'i sku sogs kyi rten rnams mjal zhing / de dag tu'ang sngar bzhin sems can gyi don 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam sogs mdzad cing dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi bkod pa dang / brda sbyor tshangs pa gling dang / sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling la sogs pa'i gling phran so so dang bcas pa spyan lam du phebs pa na/ sngon byon pa'i rgyal blon lo paṇa de rnams sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa sha stag tu 'dug dgongs pa'i thugs dad bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / khyad par rang res kyang sngar ma 'gyur ba'i bka' bstan bcos mang po zhig bsgyur pa dang / sngar 'gyur zin pa rnams la'ang brda gsar rnying dang skabs thob kyi 'gyur mi bde ba'i cha rnams bsal te 'gyur bcos byed pa sogs ci nas kyang bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed du 'gyur ba zhig bya dgos dgongs pa'i thugs kyi nges pa dang dam bca' ba brtan po zhal gyis bzhes par mdzad do/ /de nas rim par phebs te/ lugs gnyis kyi mnga' bdag rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan spyan snga ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas rje 'di'i snyan pa gsan pas bka' lung mdzad pas/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa mtshan gzhan dge mo rin po cher grags pa des/ tshong 'dus brag kha'i klu khang du gzhi len rgya chen po mdzad cing /

'bel gtam mang po dang sgra snyan sdeb sbyor la dri rtsad mang du mdzad pas/ rje nyid kyi snyan grags skye bo kun gyi rna lam na mdzes pa byung ngo / /de nas phag mo grub pa'i gdan sa thar rtse zhes bya ba gdan sa chen po thel mjal ba la phebs/ rten chen sgo mang mchod rdzas khyad par can rnams gzigs pa na/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag rjes dang / stod hor gyi rgyal po hu la'i gtong phod sogs la thugs dad dang yi rang 'khrungs te ya mtshan pa'i gnas su dgongs so/ /de nas gang mkhas par grags pa de dag ni rgyal po'i 'dun sar grags pa kho na yin pas/ de'i phyir rje nyid kyi mkhas pa'i go 'phang yang gsal bar byas/ smra ba ngan pa dag kyang tshar bcad par bya zhing thabs de nyid kyis skye bo mang po yang dag pa'i lam la dkri bar bya'o snyam du dgongs pas/ gangs can rgyal po'i 'byung khungs sne gdong rtser phebs te/ lho brag gu ru chos dbang gi skye ba bcu gsum gyi mtha' ma bdag po kun dga' legs pa la saṃskṛ ta'i skad zhu yig bod skad kyis gsal ba dang bcas pa mdzad pas/ bdag po'ang mkhyen pa che bar yod pas mkhas pa chen por shes te spyan drangs/ legs bshad kyi skyes mang po phul bas mchog tu mnyes te/ nyid lo tsā ba chen por gda' gsungs/ 'on kyang nyams sad pa'i phyir rgya dpe mang po bshams/ rtsis sogs la mkhas par rlom pa'i dge bshes kha cig kyang bsdus te dri ba mang po byas/ khyad par rgya dpe rnams klogs gsungs pas/ thog mar rgya skad du shar pa re klog de nas bod skad du tshar tshar bton pas mnyes te/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba chen po de tsho 'di 'dra gcig yod thang gsungs nas gus pa chen po mdzad de/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa slob dpon dbu ma la dga' bas mdzad pa 'di sngar bod du ma 'gyur bas cis kyang bsgyur ba'i mchid gsol bas bstan pa la phan par dgongs te legs par bsgyur bas/ 'gyur 'jam zhing don bzang pa'i tshad du gyur pa byung ste lo tsā ba chen por mtshan gsol zhing grags so/

/de'i ring gong ma nyid la gsung chos kyang 'di dag gsan te/ mtshan brjod phan yon dang bcas pa'i lung / dbang mdor bstan gyi lung / na ro zhabs kyi dbang mdor bstan 'grel pa/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa nyi ma dpal gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan/ don dam bsnyen pa pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa/ nyi zla sgrub pa/ ye shes spyan sgrub pa/ dus zhabs snyan brgyud/ sha wa ri'i sbyor drug ngag dbang grags pa'i 'chi bslu/ dpe med mtsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/ paṇa chen nags rin lugs kyi sbyor drug dus 'khor dbang yongs rdzogs nags rin las brgyud pa/ zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang de las brgyud pa la sogs pa gsan no/ /de nas 'phying nga stag rtser phebs te nang so cho brtan pa yab sras kyis bsnyen bkur sri zhus mchod cing / rig gnas kyi phan gdags dang / khyad par mtshams sbyor dang / ming lo dang / sngags klog sogs bshad cing / nang so nyid kyis bskul te ka lā pa'i yig cha phran tshegs kyang brtsams/ rgyal mkhar rtse na yod pa'i bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur las stag rtse na med pa rnams bsnan/ rgyal mkhar rtse na med pa kha cig stag rtse nas spyan drangs te byon/ de nas gong dkar rdo rje gdan du phebs/ gnas mjal dang / mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa kun dga' rnam rgyal dang mjal te/ 'bel ba'i bka' mchid mang du mdzad pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ drung pa sngar nas snyan pa che bar 'dug de bas kyang mjal nas yid ches shing ya mtshan pa zhig byung gsungs nas thugs dges pa chen pos sri zhu chen po mdzad cing / rig gnas thams cad la dri rtsad dogs dpyod/ phyag len skor gyi sngags mang po la bying sgrub kyis gtan la phab pa'i zhu dag sogs mdzad cing / brtag gnyis skad dod ngo spod 'bul ba dang / de'i rgya dpe phyag bris mdzad pa dang / ka lā pa'i gzhung las 'phros pa'i dogs dpyod kyang 'bul ba sogs mdzad cing /

grwa pa kha cig la sgra'i sa ris kyang bshad pa mdzad/ gzhan yang gsung rab mang po rgya dpe la gtugs pa'i zhu chen sogs mdzad do/ /de nas gsung chos kyang 'di dag gsan te/ ras chen pa'i gtum mo/ gza' yum gyi dbang / gur lha brgyad ma dang / lha bcu gnyis kyi thun mong gi dbang bka'/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang / nag po pa/ dril bu pa'i rdul tshon lha lnga dang lus dkyil gyi dbang / gshin rje gshed la zhal dgu pa/ zhal drug pa/ zhal gsum pa/ zhal gcig pa dang bzhir yod pa'i/ zhal dgu pa/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang / zhal gcig pa gshed mar bcu gsum ma'i dbang / mi g.yo ba sems dpa' gsum brtsegs chu bsrungs dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang sogs gsan no/ /slar gtsang la phebs/ dpal 'khor sde chen du zhu dag gi 'phro mdzad bzhin pa las/ lan gcig mnal lam na zhu dag pa'i sku chas do dam pa chos khrims bsod don pa zer ba zhig yod pa khong gis sku 'gag gcig phul byung pa sku la bsnams pas/ gong pa phrag lhan rnams gser chos la byas par 'dug pas/ 'di gang yin mi rung ngam gsungs pas/ me gtong ba la mkho ba yin/ 'o na mdun de'ang gser chos las byas pa yin zer ba rmis pas/ mnal sad ma thag zhus dag 'di sngar bstan pa la bsams te bgyis pa yin na'ang / rmi lam 'dis da ni dkor gyi rang bzhin du zad do dgongs te/ de nas thabs mkhas kyis zhu dag gi khur 'bul ba mdzad nas zha lu sogs su lo gcig lhag tsam bzhugs te/ sku nye skor zhal slob mang po la gsung chos dang / bslab bya sogs gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas 'gro don mdzad cing / 'gyur thor bu dang sku zhang rin po che la gsung chos gsan pa dang / dus 'khor phyag len sogs kha cig bskul ba po mdzad cing / zha lu mkhan chen chos grub pa la chos 'brel yang gsan te/ mdor na nyin zhag re re bzhin yang chos spyod bcu ma chag pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas sngar gong dkar rdo rje gdan du phebs dgos pa'i bka' lung yod pa sogs kyis chu pho stag lo'i nang du dbus la phebs/

gong dkar du chos rje rin po che gdan sa pa la chos kha cig gsan pa dang 'bel ba'i mchid 'bul ba sogs mdzad/ de dus rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag gi sprul pa zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa rje btsun sprul pa'i sku rin po che dpal chos kyi grags pa'i zhal snga nas phebs pa dang mjal te byin rlabs zhu ba mdzad cing snyan grags chen po yod pas thugs mthong chen po mdzad do/ /de nas stag lung du phebs te bsgrub rgyud bstan pa'i bdag po mkhas grub stag lung rin po che ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs drung du mjal ba la phebs/ de yang rje stag lung pa de nyid sgra la mkhas par yod pas rig gnas phal che ba la dri rtsad dang 'bel gtam mang po mdzad pas/ mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung na mdzes pa ltar/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ kha sing snga thog sne gdong nas gong ma'i chab shog byung pa na/ 'dir lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po zhig byon pas sngar ma 'gyur ba bsgyur ba dang / 'gyur bcos sogs mdzad kyi yod pas/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa sogs rgya dpe dgos gsungs pa byung pas/ de rang mi bden snyam nas sngon gyi lo tsā ba tsho las mkhas pa rang mi yong / dus phyis kyi lo tsā ba 'di tsho rang / ka lā pa'i sa ris re tsam las shes pa mi snang zer ba'i zhu lan byas te/ khyed rang lo tsā ba chen por snang gsungs nas dges pa chen po byung sri zhu bla bhag tu mdzad de/ sgra la brten pa'i dogs pa mang po gda' ba rnams sel nus pa byung zhing / gur gyi rgyud la 'gyur bcos sogs mdzad/ chos rje kun spangs pa la ka lā pa'i sa ris bstan/ lañtsha sogs rgya yig kha cig bslabs/ gzhan yang zhu chen dang / phag mo sgrub thabs shig bit+pa dang bcos pa sogs mdzad pas shin tu dges te/ da res drung nas byon pa 'di la don chen po byung gsungs nas bya dga' mang du mdzad/ de dus nā ro ma nas bying sgrub dang bcas pa'i tshogs chen po de ka yin snang bas thugs la ma long skad/

de nas rje nyid la gsan te man ngag gi bshad pa mdzad pas legs par mkhyen/ brgyad stong pa las rgya klog sogs kyang bslabs/ gzhan yang chos mang po la 'bel ba'i mchid kyis mkhas par mdzad do/ /de ltar re zhig mi dbang dam pa de nyid kyis bsnyen cing bkur te bzhugs pa las skye bo mang po la blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos bstan te phan gdags pa dang / chos bsgyur ba dang / rtsom pa dang / zhu chen sogs mdzad de/ bstan pa rin po che la phyag rjes bzang po rgyun chags par 'jog par mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas spre'u'i lo lhun grub gling du gar dbang sprul pa'i sku rin po che zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa'i zhal snga nas phebs pa dang mjal te/ chos kyi gtsug lag khang mang po las brtsams pa'i gleng gleng ba mtha' yas pa mdzad pas mkhas pa chen por dgongs te bsngags bkur gya nom pa mdzad cing / de nas slob dpon dbyig gnyen la rang las mkhas pa'i slob ma bzhi yod par grags pa'i mngon pa rang las mkhas pa slob dpon blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa mdzod 'grel gnam lcags thog zer gyi rgya dpe la stod byang pa'i bdag po rnam rgyal grags pa'i phyag tu byung ba/ chos rje yid bzang rtse pa'i phyag tu phul te bsgyur ba'i rtsis mdzad na'ang / sku na byon zhing spyan 'grib pa sogs kyis ma 'gyur ba de/ rje spyan snga rin po ches bdag nyid chen po 'di la bsgyur bar bskul te/ lhun grub gling du bsgyur ba'i mgo btsugs nas/ kong po bar zhabs 'bring mdzad/ legs par bsgyur cing gtan la phab/ de yang spyir 'gyur byed pa la dka' tshegs yod pa'i tshul ni/ sgra mdo rnams kyi don phyin ci ma log par blo yul du long pa gcig dgos/ de nas skad rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi dang / gzhan yang skad so so ra se na dang / gau ḍa dang / lā dha sogs kyi skad dod rnam grangs thug pa med pa la byang ba zhig dgos/ chos gang dang gang bsgyur de dang de'i chos skad don dpyis phyin du shes pa zhig dgos/
