snyan ngag mngon brjod sogs kyang byang chub pa zhig dgos/ gsung rab spyi la'ang shin tu rgyus che ba so so'i don rnams blo yul du khra lam me ba zhig dgos/ de rnams tshang ba dang / dang por rgya dpe las tshig don shes par byas/ de nas don dang 'gal ba med pa de gang bder bsgyur na 'gyur bzang po 'ong ba yin/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la de rnams ma lus pa mnga'/ de la sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams ni paṇ+ḍi ta la dri ba byas chog pas cung zad sla ba yin la/ deng sang paṇ+ḍi ta med pas lo tsā mkhas pa rang ma gtogs 'gyur mi thub/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni chos gang bsgyur kyang mkhas pa yin/ de yang shin tu dka' ba rnams kyang thugs bsam legs por btang nas mi mkhyen mi srid de/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi gnyis pa kho nar rig par bya ste/ nyid kyis bsgyur pa'i gsung rab rnams la bltas pas go ba yin no/ /de ltar 'gyur mdzad pa sogs kyi ring du spyan snga rin po che'i zhabs las gsung chos kyang 'di dag gsan te/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po/ 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud/ sher phyin brgyad stong pa/ chos rje mkha' spyod dbang po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ mdo sde mngon par 'byung ba/ sgam po ba'i thar rgyan/ thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rje'i bka' 'bum gyi lung rnams gsan/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang / grub chen yu mo'i gsal sgron bzhi'i lung / gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od kyi gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid yig gdams phran dang bcas pa/ rim lnga'i khrid yig rje bus mdzad pa/ 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi lung dang / u rgyan bsnyen sgrub nyams khrid du gsan nas/ rtsa ba zla bzang gi 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ khrid yig lo rgyus gegs sel dang yig phran skor/ grub chen pa'i rnam thar/ phreng skor tshang ba dang bcas pa gsan no/ /mdo sde las brgya'i lung / 'bri khung zab chos/ tsan+t+ra go mas mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa mjing yon du grags pa rnams kyi lung gsan/

gzhan yang de dus chos mang po gsan par mdzad cing / de dus kyang sgar pa kha cig la gsung chos 'chad pa dang / rje spyan snga nyid la gsan pa dang / chos bsgyur ba dang / 'dri ba dang / thugs dam zab mo la mnyam par 'jog pa sogs te/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i rnam thar las 'byung ba ltar/ nyin zhag phrugs re bzhin ma pham pas dbus mtha' rnam 'byed du bshad pa'i chos spyod bcu ma chag par mdzad cing / kong po'i skye bo shing ltar gyong pa mang po yang chos la btsud do/ /de dus kong po zhig gis phor stang gnyis phul byung ba ste/ phyag phyir khams pa brtson 'grus bya ba gcig yod pa khos phor stang khyer nas bros pa/ nye gnas rnams dang sgar pas zin khrims la gtugs pa'i nyes pa byung pa la/ rje nyid 'gro ba thams cad la bcos min gyi snying rje mnga' bas bka' gnang ste/ phor pa blos btang / dge ba bsngos tshar gsungs nas phor stang kho rang la gnang nas nyes pa med par mdzad pa sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mang po mdzad de mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum 'khor lo rgyun ma chad pa mdzad do/ /de nas khyi lo sprul sku rin po che'i phyag phyi mdzad de phyir phebs/ de dus sngar kong po la phebs pa'i tshe sde pa yar mar gyis phul ba'i na bza' kha cig yod pa sne gdong gzhol gyi gnas tshang la bcol yod pas/ phyir phebs dus khong gis btsongs tshar snang bas/ phyag phyi ba rnams kyis sne gdong du zhus pa'i nyes dmigs la thug na'ang / rje nyid kyis gtod len yang mi dgos na khrims lta ci smos pa'i zhu gnang mdzad pas nyes chad ma byung zhing / gong ma chen po'ang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par gda' gsungs dad skad/ de nas bsam sder phebs/ g.ya' bzang spyan snga chos kyi rje kon ting gu shrī'i rab byung gi las slob mdzad/ slar yang yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po chen pos spyan drangs te phul du byung ba'i bsnyen bkur gyis mchod nas re zhig bzhugs shing /

de yang e waṃ thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid mkhyen brtse mtha' yas shing bstan pa la gces spras ches thang du mdzad pa yin pas/ rje 'di lta bu'i mkhyen rab kyis gsung rab spyi dang / khyad par tha snyad skor la yig cha rtsom pa bzhin byung na ci nas kyang bstan pa la phan pa 'dug dgongs pa dang / de yang dus phyis byon pa'i skad gnyis smra ba phal cher skad dod thor bu tsam las/ ka tsan gyi gzhung la gzigs rtog tshud pa'i gsan sbyong dkon te/ dpang lo chen pos gsungs pa bzhin yin na cis kyang rtsom pa'i bskul ba po bgyid dgongs nas zhabs tog shin tu bzang po bshams te dben gnas dam pa e waṃ du spyan drangs/ re zhig bzhugs par gsol te/ thog mar ka tsan gyi gzhung rgya dpe la gtugs pa'i zhu chen mdzad/ de yang tsan+t+ra pa'i gzhung la zhu chen mdzad pa rnams ni shin tu ngo mtshar ba yod cing / de nas dang por ka lā pa'i 'grel pa gzhung don gsal ba zhes bya ba gzhung gi 'bru zhib tu gnyer cing dper brjod dang bcas te ston pas/ nyung zhing 'gril la rtogs sla ba zhig mdzad/ tsan+t+ra pa la'ang 'grel pa sgra rig rgya mtsho'i gru gzings zhes bya ba gzhung don dpyis phyin par 'grel pa tshig nyung zhing don gsal ba zhig mdzad/ de dag kyang so so'i rgya 'grel ngur sing dang / slob phan sogs dang / dharmā dā pa dang / rat+na ma ti la sogs kyi nying khu blangs te brtsams/ gzhung yang thog ma rgya skad bkod/ de nas bod skad bkod de 'bru bsnan pas shin tu legs pa yod/ de yang sngon gyi slob dpon kha cig gis byas pa'i bod 'grel rnams gzhung gi 'bru zhib tu gnyer ba med cing / dper brjod kyi tshig grogs rnams kyang bying sgrub byas pas/ mang ches mgo rmongs par 'gyur ba las med la/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni snga ma nyid las ches khyad par du 'phags pa kho na snang ngo / /de dus mi'i dbang po de nyid kyi dus kyis 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel zhu ba'i mchid nan tan du gsol na'ang /

rje nyid kyis rang gi bla ma'i 'phrin las su 'gyur bar dgongs nas/ bdag gis 'bul mi thub pas/ dus 'khor la shin tu mkhas pa chos rje rin po che bsod nams grags pa bya ba dpal 'khor sde chen na bzhugs pas/ de la gsan pa'i 'thad bkod zhus pas/ de ka bzhin gdan 'dren mdzad/ yon mchod lhan du gsan pa yin la/ dus deng sang ni bla ma slob dpon tsho rang re la phyis byung na de la a tshi ba rang du byed/ dam pa 'di ni bla ma'i 'phrin las 'phel thabs kho na lhur mdzad pa yin no/ /gzhan yang e waṃ du chos bsgyur ba dang / zhu chen yang mang po mdzad/ skye bo du ma la blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos bshad/ rgyal chen gling du dpon sa yum pa mkhyen rab kyi dbang mo dpon g.yog kha cig la ka lā pa'i sa ris dang / sdeb sbyor snyan ngag dang / brgyad stong pa'i rgya klog sogs thugs bzhed dang bstun pa bshad de/ sems can don la ngal ba med pa'i brtson pa mdzad cing / de'i tshe na mi'i dbang po rgyal srid chos kyi snying por skyong bas bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i nyin mo'i dbang phyug mkhyen rab phul du phyin pa mnga' ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dpon chen rin chen rnam rgyal dbang po'i sde phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha'i zhal snga nas de nyid sku na phra mo'i tshe na/ sku tshe sngon nas smon lam khyad par can mnga' bas/ rje nyid la bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad pa dang dges pa chen po yod pas/ phal cher de'i drung du bzhugs te gus 'dud chen po mdzad cing / de nas bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang gsan te/ dpon slob pha dang bu'i rnam thar la nges par gnas par mdzad cing / bsnyen bkur gyi mchod pa gya nom du bshams pa'i ngang las mi g.yo ba yin no/ /de nas skabs shig tu stag lung du phebs te/ pha rin po che gsung chos gsan pa dang / tha snyad kyi gleng ba slangs bas de nyid kyi mkhyen pa brtas par mdzad do/

/de dus stag lung na sin+dhu ra'i yi ge bris pa'i rgya dpe yod snang ba kun gyis ma khrol bas/ rje nyid kyis klog bsgyur mdzad pas mkhas pa'i dbus na mngon par mtho ba byung skad do/ /gzhan yang skye bo du ma'i mi shes pa sel bar mdzad do/ /de nas yar rgyab tu phebs te skabs shig na/ rigs pa dang lung gi smra ba'i dbang po mkhas pa chen po shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta don grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dge 'dun brgya phrag mang pos bskor te sde pas chos dbar la gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ bying lhun grub brag khar rje 'di nyid spyan 'dren du btang byung bas bstan pa la dgongs te phebs/ sgra ka lā pa'i sa ris/ sdeb sbyor sogs bshad de mkhas par mdzad cing / slar mkhas pa de nyid la tshad ma rnam 'grel sogs tshad ma'i skor gyi gzhung don yang mang po gsan no/ /gzhan yang de dus mkhas pa'i dbang po paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa rin chen chos kyi dbang po dang / gter mdzod pa dang / rab 'byams pa bsod rgyal dang / rab 'byams grags 'od sogs 'chad nyan pa chen po rnams la ka lā pa'i sa ris sogs chos mang du bshad de/ de dag gi blo gros mkhas par mdzad cing / gzhan yang dbang lung man ngag sogs kyi rnam grangs mu mdor bstan te sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas slar phebs te e waṃ sogs su bzhugs bzhin pa la/ rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po chos rje dge bzang pa la mdzod rang 'grel gyi bshad pa dang / bzhi brgya pa/ snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing gi lung yang gsan no/ /de nas glang lo mi'i dbang po rnams kyis rje nyid phyogs 'dir yun ring du bzhugs ched sogs kyis/ rgya ston chen po lcags ri pa'i gdan sar mnga' gsol te/ dga' ldan byams pa'i gling gi bshes gnyen mang po la blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos bstan te/ bstan pa la byi dor mtha' khyab tu mdzad de/ skyes chen dam pa rgya ston byang chub rnam rgyal de nyid la phag mo gzhung drug gi byin rlabs dang lung /

dbu ma rtsa shes/ chos dbyings bstod pa/ bshes springs/ dbu ma rin chen phreng ba/ bslab btus/ spyod 'jug rnams kyi lung / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rigs rkyang ma dang bsdus pa'i dbang / sngags 'dul chen mo/ rin chen rna rgyan/ mi 'jigs zhal lung / dus 'khor mdor bsdus dang po'i ṭik+ka/ mngon rtogs mtha' dpyad/ sgrub le'i ṭik+ka rnams thams cad mkhyen pa byams gling pas mdzad pa'i lung rnams gsan no/ /de nas yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen grwa pa mngon shes kyis bzhengs pa'i grwa thang gi gtsug lag khang bstan pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhi'i nang tshan gra thang gi gdan sa chen por shing mo yos kyi lo'i 'grub sbyor bzang po dang ldan pa'i tshes la mi'i dbang po yab yum sras bcas kyis dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan du mnga' gsol te/ mdo sngags tha snyad la sogs pa'i rig pa'i gnas lnga'i sgo nas bshad nyan dbang bskur rgyun chags su mdzad cing / nag pa zla ba la dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi sgrub mchod sogs kyi dge rgyun mang po btsugs/ mnga' ris nas chos rje gzhi sde pa sogs dang / sa skya/ ngam ring / rta nag zi lung / skyid tshal/ gsang phu/ rtse thang / 'bras ser/ na len+t+ra/ dwags kong / mdo khams sogs nas chos nyan dge bshes mang du 'dus pa la gang la ci 'dod kyi chos bshad/ khyad par ka tsan gyi gzhung chos sogs tha snyad la nyan bshad khor yug tu mdzad/ lhun grub gling du mi'i dbang po la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang / lam 'bras/ sa skya bka' 'bum kyi lung sogs mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsungs/ grwa thang nyid du sbyor drug lam 'bras/ gshed dmar/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang bshad pa sogs lo ltar chags lta bur gsungs so/ /de nas khyad par du mdo sngags tha snyad dang bcas pa la 'gran zla med pa'i mkhyen spyan yangs pa bod yul sde snod 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi ral pa mdzes par byed pa'i cod pan/

rje btsun thon mi paṇ+ṭi ta gsum pa/ byams pa gling nas chos rje shrī wā gi shwa ra pun+dha bi dza yi shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas la snga phyir ka tsan/ sdeb sbyor/ snyan ngag sogs tha snyad cha lag dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gzhan yang dbang lung bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa mtha' yas pa gsungs shing / mkhyen pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i rje nyid kyi slob ma'i mchog gcig tu bzhugs pa yin no/ /de nas spre'u'i lo sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che gtsang la phebs pa'i zhabs 'bring mdzad de/ 'jam dpal gyi sgra mdo rtsa 'grel bying gi tshogs dang bcas pa/ sngon ma 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos khyad par can bsgyur cing / zha lur sngon gyi grwa slob/ sku nye/ phyag phyi ba sogs la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas bskyangs shing / rje spyan snga pa nyid la chos kyang gsan no/ /rtsom pa dang 'gyur zhus kyang mang rab tu mdzad/ gser mdog can du ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyi zhal snga nas la 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa gang blo ma'i lung yang gsan/ skye bo mang po la blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyang mang shas gcig bshad de/ bya lo gtsang nas spyan snga rin po che'i zhabs 'bring mdzad de phyir phebs skabs shig stong ra phyogs su spyan drangs/ ri dor phebs/ stong ra chos rje shākya don grub dpal bzang po la sngar na len+t+rar mtshams sbyor lnga pa gsungs shing / 'di dus mngon rtogs ljon shing dang brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa/ skyes bu dam pa de nyid dang zhal ngo rnams la'ang gsungs/ gzhan yang su kha chos drug gshed dmar gyi dbang / spros med kyi khrid sogs chos lung dbang bka' mtha' yas pa gsungs/ sgra'i dogs pa dpyad de/ skyes bu dam pa de nyid kyi mkhyen pa brtas par mdzad/ mkhas grub de nyid la slar rje nyid kyis kyang lam 'bras pod dmar gyi lung / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang sogs kyang gsan te re zhig kyang bzhugs so/

/de nas slar grwa thang sogs su bshad nyan sku mtshams sogs kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ dpal 'byor rab brtan/ lhun grub gling sogs su phebs te gsung chos sgo du ma nas ci 'dod du gsungs/ rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs mang po bsgrubs te/ mdor na btsun pa rnams sdom pa la bkod/ sngags pa rnams dam tshig la bkod/ khyim pa rnams bsnyen gnas la bkod de skye bo mang po rnam par grol ba'i sa la 'god par mdzad cing / de yang sngon jo bo rje bod du byon pa ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyin mo ltar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas mtshal min du thog gcig phebs/ rje btsun byams pa gling pa la sa sde'i lung dang / rje bsod nams bzang po'i zhabs kyis karma pa la dbang phul ba'i gos chen 'ding dkyil las dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gsungs/ gzhan yang na len+t+ra'i mkhan po chos rje gzhi sde bas spyan drangs/ gzhis dga' sne'ur phebs/ khong pa la ka tsan cha lag dang bcas pa/ dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs chos mang po bshad/ gzhan yang skye bo mang po la dbang lung sogs rgya cher gsungs/ mi'i dbang po hor don yod rdo rje pas bsnyen bkur gya nom du bsgrubs/ khong pa la 'bel gtam gyi sgo nas chos zab mo bstan no/ /gzhan don la skyo ngal spangs nas dus thams cad du de kho na lhur mdzad pa yin la/ de nas karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas dang 'phrang po sogs su mjal te/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs gsan cing / kong por yang mjal/ phag lo lha sar mjal du phebs te chos du ma la 'bel ba'i gtam mdzad pas/ nyid lo tsā ba chen por 'dug gsungs nas bsnyen bkur gya nom pa mdzad cing / khyad par du gangs can gyi chos smra ba mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bur mnga' gsol ba'i las kha chen po gnang ste/ gnang sbyin yang shin tu bzang po mdzad nas/ las kha'i yi ger yang lo tsā ba chen po 'di nyid chos thams cad la mkhas pa yin pas/

tha snyad sogs rig pa'i gnas lnga 'chad pa'i slob dpon du mnga' gsol ba yin pas/ gangs can pa rnams kyis de ltar shes pa gyis shig pa'i shel dam bzang po mdzad cing / re zhig zhabs 'bring yang mdzad de/ phyag chen skor gyi chos kyang du ma gsan/ phyag chen skor kyis sngags mang po la zhu dag dang / rgya gar chu bo e ran+ḍa'i grong gi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po yid kyi shing rta zhes bya bas/ karma pa la zhu yig snyan ngag shin tu bzang po dang / paṇ+ḍi ta sgra gcan 'dzin gzhon nu dang / kha che'i rgyal po chen po rnams kyis karma pa la phul ba'i zhu yig rnams bsgyur/ ar+ya de wa'i khab kyi tsher ma sogs kyang bsgyur te mkhas pa'i bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing chos kyang mang du gsungs/ karma pas mdo sngags tha snyad dang bcas pa'i dka' gnas mang por dri ba dam por mdzad pa la/ dris lan dpyis phyin du phul bas/ rje karma pa de nyid kyi mkhyen rab kyang brtas par mdzad/ skye bo kha cig la chos kyang bshad/ khyad par mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu dam pa rje btsun snyug la ba la ka tsan gyi lung sogs chos mang du gsungs/ rgya gar gyi dge slong ar+ya baṃ pa sogs rgya gar ba kha cig la chos kyang gsungs te sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de nas slar grwa thang du phebs te/ 'brong dkar rdzong du mkhas pa'i dbang po mtshungs med karma 'phrin las kyi zhal snga nas dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma dang bcas te chos bar la phebs dus/ rje nyid spyan drangs/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud sogs chos du ma gsungs/ ka bcu rab 'byams pa mang po la sgra ka lā pa yang bshad cing / e waṃ du rgya bla ma dpal ldan blo gros pa la dbang bka' lam 'bras sogs chos mang po gsungs/ sne gdong pa'i las kha skyel mi gong ma rgyal po cen 'de'i hu shrī ba rnams la bsnyen rdzogs kyang bsgrubs te sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de nas bya lo dgung skeg kyang yin pas/

rgya dril rten phebs sogs mchod cha gser dngul gos dar/ na bza' skor rta drel/ dkar spyad/ go khrab/ khro zangs/ rang 'gag li 'gag tib ri sogs phyag rdzas rnams thams cad bsdoms te chos sde chen po zha lur 'gyed chen mdzad pa shar/ de dus zha lu mkhan chen dkon tshul ba la zhu yig mdzad pa na/ da res spongs thag brda mtshon bsgrubs pa 'di nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma kun mkhyen bu ston yab sras/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir du yin zhu ba'i phyag dam mdzad cing / sku zhang chos rje thugs la dran pas spyan chab kyang mang po mdzad/ de ltar 'gyed chen gnang ba la drung chen bkra shis dpal ldan pa dpon slob brdzangs pa/ ri phug gzim khang la zhig gsos byas pa'i dga' ston dang 'grig pas skabs su bab cing rgan rabs kyi dran pa tshun de las 'gyed bzang ba ma byung skad/ de nas bdag nyid chen po 'di zha lu'i gdan sar spyan 'dren gros kyang bshams/ gdan sa su 'os la zan ril gtong ba'i srol yod na'ang / rje nyid la dge 'dun byin mthun grub pas zan ril ma dgos shing / de nas mkhan chen pa/ las chen slob dpon/ mo ban dang bcas pa so so'i zhu yig nan tan bris pa 'bul nod dang bcas/ las chen brag dkar rab 'byams pa dpon slob snga phyir byon na'ang / mi'i dbang po sku mched kyis nan zhus gsol bas/ nged kyi rje bu ston gyi gdan sa pher pa'i yon tan med gsungs pa'i kheng skyung ba'i phyag dam mdzad de thegs pa ma grub/ slar zha lu nas drung chen gnyis/ las chen bdun dang bcas pa rnams do gal shin tu chen pos byon zhing / rgyan gong du dpal ldan ma babs te/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bod du 'gro zer ba sogs dad gus kyi rnam 'gyur du ma bstan cing / de dus grwa thang ba rnams kyang rje nyid la dad gus mtha' yas pas/ gzhan du thegs 'jug pa ma bzod nas/ zhal lu ba dang thug 'phrad yong nyen sogs kyi thugs g.yeng du gyur na'ang /

blo sbyong sgom pa la khyad che gsungs nas skyon pa mi mdzad/ de nas chos kyi rgyal po sku mched pas nan tur gyis bzhugs pa'i gsol btab cing / chos sde chen po grwa thang gis gtso byas dbus kyi grwa slob byin gyis sku na byon pa dang / dbus phyogs 'di bzhugs spro zhing thugs dam yang 'phel tshul sogs zhus pa la/ dbus skyid cing dge sbyor dmar yang / de bas gzhan la tshig re tsam phan na'ang de rang dga'/ gzhan la phan na ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yang dang du len nus pa zhig dgos na/ dge sbyor than thun dang bde skyid don du mi gnyer/ na tshod mtho yang re zhig a tho yong / zha lu pa rnams de tsam rang du dad na/ khong rnams kyi bsam pa mi ldog dge 'dun gyi ngag kyang mi gcog pa yin gsungs phebs par thag bcad/ slar mi'i dbang po sku mched kyis gtsos pa'i skye bo rnams kyi don du phebs pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po dang spyan snga rin po che nas kyang 'phrin las gzhan phan legs po yong ba'i lung bstan mdzad/ de dus zha lur mi 'degs gong spyan snga rin po che'i spyan 'dren byung bas/ tshur bu gnas nang du mjal ba la phebs/ lugs gnyis kyi gleng slong bka' mchid mang du mdzad de gnang sbyin bya dga' chen po mdzad/ de'i zhar la zur phur phebs te chag lo tsa ba mkhas pa'i dbang po rin chen chos kyi rgyal po la/ sbyin bdag la la'i 'dod pas zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul dang / tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang yang gsan/ sgra'i gtsug lag gi 'bel gtam mdzad nas de nyid kyi mkhyen pa brtas par mdzad cing / de dus chu shul du rin spungs sde pa rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam rgyal pas spyan drangs/ dus kyi 'khor lo las brtsams pa'i dogs dpyod/ 'bel gtam/ lugs kha cig la brgal brtag gis sun 'byin dang bcas pa mdzad cing / rgya dpe mang po bsgyur 'grel dang khyad par rgya dpe'i steng nas bod skad thogs med gsungs pas/

mi'i dbang po bshes gnyen du ma dang bcas pa rnams yi rang zhing ha las te/ sngon gyi lo chen de dag kyang 'di lta bu gcig yod thang zer nas dad skad/ chu shul du bzhugs dus me tog gi char mthun snang grub pa babs shing / de ltar bar lam kun tu bsnyen bkur zhabs tog bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams/ skye bo shin tu mang po la chos kyang sna tshogs pa bshad/ khyad par mkhas grub dam pa chos rje 'bun rdzong pa chos skyong rgyal mtshan pa sogs la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi lung zhag drug la rdzogs par gsungs/ de nas rje btsun snyug la ba'i zhal snga nas kyis snyug la rdzong du spyan drangs te/ lha'i longs spyod lta bus mchod cing 'bel ba'i mchid du ma dang / zhabs spyi bor blangs pa'i gus 'dud chen po mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rim par phebs te sngar smos pa bzhin zha lu pas gdan 'dren byung pas phebs par chas pa'i tshe/ chos rgyal sku mched gsum gyis gzhi dga' byams gling / rgyal chen gling sogs su spyan drangs/ 'bul nod bzang zhing rlabs che ba mtha' yas pa mdzad/ dol sna po la bar chos rgyal chung bas zhabs 'bring mdzad de skyid gshong du bcags mal bzhugs/ nang so rnam pa dang / ra ba smad pa'i slob dpon la gzungs gra lnga'i dbang sogs chos kha cig gsungs te rim par phebs/ gam pa phur snyug la bas gzhi len thab 'dzin bzang po brdzangs/ slar dbus kyi rgyal khams su phebs dgos pa dang / zhabs brtan pa'i shis brjod kyi zhu 'phrin bzang po slebs/ de nas rim par phebs te rin spungs na mi'i dbang po chen po bzhugs pas zhag lnga'i bar bsnyen bkur mtha' yas pa mdzad cing / sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa sogs kyi rgya dpe bsgyur 'grel sogs ngo sprod dang / sngar lhun grub gling du bsgyur ba'i 'phro gnas brtan 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i glang ru lung bstan gyi bstan bcos rdzogs par bsgyur/

de nas stag gru khar zha lu pa'i thab 'dzin bzang ba slebs/ de nas rim par dga' ba gdong du phebs/ nang so lhun grub rtse pas gzhi len zab par bsgrubs shing / hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgu pa zha lur phebs pa yin la/ de yang chos sde chen po zha lu gser khang du grags pa 'di nyid/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi slob ma lce btsun gyis btab/ 'go ba ye shes g.yung drung gis 'dul ba'i bshad grwa btsugs/ jo bo rje phyag phebs/ paṇ+ṭi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang lo chen blo ldan shes rab kyis bshad grwa btsugs/ 'dre khyung gnyis kyi mchod gzhi byas/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gcig pu skal ldan gyi 'dren pa dam pa kun mkhyen bu ston lo tsa ba dpal rin chen grab kyi zhal snga nas zhes snyan pa'i grags pas 'jig rten thams cad khyab pa'i mkhas pa de lta bus mdo sngags tha snyad la sogs pa rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad 'chad pa dang bsgyur ba dang / rtsom pa dang / khrid zab mo'i sgo nas rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar du mdzad pa nas/ deng sang gi bar du bshad sgrub rgyun ma chad pa'i grwa sa yin la/ de lta bu'i grwa sar phebs pa'i nyin yang nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od khra bo dang / dkar po ci rigs pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ljon shing gi rnam pas khyab cing / dge 'dun brgya phrag shin tu mang pos kyang rol mo sna tshogs dang / gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs mchod rdzas mtha' yas pa thogs te spyan drangs/ gzhan yang glu gar sogs rtsed sna mi 'dra ba mang po bshams/ skye bo'i tshogs bgrang yas pa 'dus pas phag pa la gong nas zha lu bar khrom gyis 'brel ba byung zhing / skya ser thams cad mgrin gcig tu dga' ba'i dad gus bde skyid mtha' khyab tu byung / de lta bu sngon zha lu'i mkhan po su la'ang ma byung zer bar grags/ de nas rten 'brel ni cha du ma nas 'grigs/

tshes bcu dgu la phebs pa'i nyi shu la ngal bso mdzad/ nyi shu gcig la thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i dus kyi mchod pa khyad par can la khri thog tu mnga' gsol/ chos rgyal seng ge rtse pas khri ston 'bul nod dang bcas pa bzang po bsgrubs/ bla brang nas mkhan chen rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun tshul ba'i zhal snga nas kyis kyang 'bul ba 'gyed dang bcas pa gya nom pa mdzad/ chen slob sogs kyis kyang 'bul nod mtha' yas pa byas te shis pa brjod nas mnga' gsol la/ de'i tshe nam mkha' shin tu dwangs par 'ja' 'od kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pas khyab pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa byung / skye bo kun kyang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa slar khri thog tu byon no zer nas bstod cing dga' mgu yi rang par gyur/ de nas zha lu dang ri phug gi stod rnams rtsis bzhes/ ri phug tu 'dus pa rgya mtsho la mang ja dang 'gyed shin tu bzang ba gcig gnang / mkhan chen rin po che la'ang 'bul ba bzang po mdzad cing / mkhan chen pa yang bzhugs te bsnyen rdzogs mang po bsgrubs shing / de nas gzhis dga' ba/ rtse shar nub/ dpal rnam pa/ tshong 'dus pa/ lcags stod sogs nas bsnyen bkur legs cha zhu mi mang ba rim pas slebs/ khyad par gnam rtse 'ding bde chen yangs pa can nas spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs kyis/ rje nyid khri thog tu phebs pa'i legs ja brtan bzhugs shis brjod dang bcas pa'i bka' yig nang na 'di ltar/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags mtha' dag dang / /tha snyad gtsug lag rab 'byams thugs chud nas/ /gangs can bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gtsor gyur pa/ /kun mkhyen bu ston ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid kyi seng ge'i khri la mngon par 'khod nas/ bstan pa mtha' dag 'dzin pa'i rgyal thabs la dbang bskur ba skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po gang gi phyag tu bzhes pa nas/

sku khams bde bar gdan sa'i 'dren pa dam pa gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dus pa rgya mtshos bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba grub pa'i skabs su/ 'di nas kyang spro ba dang bcas pa'i ngag gis/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la bden pa bskul ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa byas te/ ding nas bzung ste bstan pa 'dzin pa'i 'phrin las yun ring du skyong ba'i bzhed pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong du 'phel bar gyur cig ces sogs kyi bka' yig dang / ja gos dar gyi gnang sbyin bzang po byung / de ltar zha lu nyid du sa skya chu byang / dpal 'khor sde chen sogs gtsang gi chos grwa thams cad nas chos nyan dge bshes mang ba 'dus pa dang zha lu'i bla ma slob dpon grwa pa dang bcas pa la ka lā pa dang / snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dang bcas pa mkhas pa dga' byed sogs khor yug tu gsungs/ rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyang mang rab bsgrubs/ chos sde chen po'i sgrig rnam gzhag rnams dam par mdzad/ sde pa rnam pas 'bul ba'i dge ba rgyun chags pa rnams blangs te/ spyi bskyur thebs la sbyar/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs su'ang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' chems kyi yi ge rnams lan mang du klog pa mdzad de/ tshogs kyang kun spyod nyin re bzhin 'jam du song / spyi sgos gang du'ang khrims 'jags pa mdzad/ mkhan po'i bya ba'ang bu ston gyi mkhan po la gdams pa'i bka' chems nas 'byung ba ji lta ba bzhin mdzad/ de nas zha lu'i dgun chos gsungs te/ thog mar mtho ba'i don du bu ston gyi phar phyin ṭik+ka lung gi snye ma'i steng nas gsungs/ de nas kun gyis go sla bas chos 'byung chen mo gsungs/ skye bo'i tshogs shin tu mang po rnams la bsnyen gnas dang / skyabs 'gro dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas sogs nyin re bzhin chos mi 'dra ba re gsungs te/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun bgrang ba las 'das pa lta bu byung /

de ltar chos gsung ba na/ tshig zur phyin pa dang / rna bar snyan pa'i gdangs snyan pas so/ /bsdu na sh+lau ka gcig tu chos thams cad 'dus par 'chad thub pa dang / rgyas par na sh+lauka gcig gis nyin 'khyongs pa 'chad nus shing / mdor na ci gsung rab kyi gnad dang sems la phan pa 'ba' zhig byung bar grags la/ de dus chos ra rgya che ba rang du byung pa la/ chos khri'i nye logs su bsdad pa la gsung ha cang mi che ba dang / chos ra'i mtha' ring por bsdad pa la gsung ha cang mi chung ba sogs ya mtshan gyi rtags du ma byung / me tog gi char pa shin tu che ba babs te/ kha cig gis lag pas 'dzin thub pa byung zer/ de nas phal che ba ri phug tu bzhugs/ sku zhang chos rje rin po ches bskul te rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang btsugs/ grwa slob shin tu mang po la gnang / sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'ang dge 'dun mang ba la gsungs/ de nas bsam 'grub rtser lo gsar la phebs/ gnyer chen sogs la chos kyang gsungs shing / de nas slar ri phug tu bco brgyad pa chos rje 'jam dbyangs pas bskul te/ dge 'dun mang po la rdo rje phreng ba/ thogs zhig la sbyor drug kyang bshad/ ri phug gi chos khri khar phebs te brgyad stong pa'i lung sogs nyi ma mang po'i bar dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma'i tshogs la gsungs shing / bu ston rin po che'i rnam thar gyi lung yang gsungs/ de nyin nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon shin tu bkra ba/ bzo dbyibs ngo mtshar ba sna tshogs pa ri mor bris pa lta bu ches khyad par du 'phags pa byung zhing / bu ston sku gshegs pa'i rnam thar gyi skabs su spyan chab kyang mdzad/ sems la phan pa'i chos kyi gtam mang po gsungs te/ shin tu yid mi srun pa rnams kyang chos la blo phyogs pa byung la/ de lta bu'i chos dmar ba dang chos nyan mang lugs/ bu ston bzhugs dus la 'gran bzod pa byung zhes grags/ mdor na btsun pa rnams sdom pa la bkod/ sngags pa rnams dam tshig la bkod/

khyim pa rnams bsnyen gnas la bkod sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa sa skya bdag chen gyis mkhyen brtse lo tsā ba sogs brgyud de snyan lcag byung pa ltar/ zha lur phebs yod tshul sogs kyi zhu yig kyang mdzad pa/ de nub bdag chen gyi mnal lam na/ paṇ+ḍi tas sngags mang po bton byung pa rnams bdag chen rang gis 'phral du mkhyen pa rmis pas/ de ring du byung yang thongs gsungs pas/ de'i nyin rje'i phyag dam son pa yin skad/ de nas sgra gsan pa'i zhu yig bsngags pa can mdzad byung bas/ de ltar bstan pa la dgongs te zhal gyis bzhes/ rtse gdong du hor zla bzhi pa la thegs/ de dus bsam 'grub rtse nas mi'i dbang po dpon slob mang pos rgyang ring po nas bsu ba dang / zhabs spyi bor blangs pa'i gus 'dud chen po dang bsnyen bkur bzang po mdzad/ de nas rtse gdong rin chen sgang du phebs/ dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba ser phreng mdzad/ bdag chen rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dpal bzang po pas thog mar 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang gsan/ de nas ka lā pa bshad de zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis na rdzogs shing / tsan+t+ra pa dang zhag nyi shu rtsa brgyad tshun la rdzogs/ sdeb sbyor snyan ngag rgya klog dang yig rigs mang po rnams zhar la bslabs/ sbyor drug dang / dus 'khor gyi dbang tshar gsum dang lung rnams kyang gsungs te/ gzhan yang chos mang po bshad/ zla ba phyed dang gsum bzhugs te bla mas mkhas shing 'chad nus pa'i thog bcad/ slob mas thugs rab che zhing nyan nus pa'i thog chod pa byung / de dus sa lo chen po'i thugs rab la lo chen nyid thugs ha las par gyur te phyag thal mo sbyar nas/ tshe 'dir lan re zung re thos tsam gyis/ /gzhung lugs kun shes kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/

/zhes pa de khyed kho nar 'dug pa zhes gsungs shing dad gus dang bsnyen bkur mtha' yas pa mdzad do/ /de dus rgya dpe kha cig 'dug pa la bsgyur 'grel yang mdzad/ de ltar bdag chen de lta bu la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis par bsgrubs shing / de nas sngar bka' bzhes kyang mdzad pa dang / yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po sku mched pas gdan 'dren yang snga phyir byung zhing / zha lu ba rnams lugs gnyis ka'i sgo nas brtse bas bskyangs grub pas zha lu sogs su lo gcig bzhugs nas/ phag lo zla ba bcu pa la yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan 'dren byung bas/ zhal lu ba rnams sems 'theng par 'dug na'ang / nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams chen por rim pas phebs te/ sna bo la nas mi dbang chen pos bsu ba mdzad/ dbus kyi grwa slob rnams bsam pa yongs su gang zhing / grwa thang gi dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshos rol mo dang gdugs rgyal mtshan mtha' yas pa thogs te spyan drangs/ 'bul nod bzang po mdzad cing / gzhis dga' byams pa gling / rgyal chen gling sogs su spyan drangs/ bsnyen bkur 'bul nod dga' ston mtha' yas pa mdzad/ de nas byams pa gling du chos kyi rje rin po che dpon slob mang po la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gsungs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gi nyin me tog gi char chen po babs te/ bla ma sman chu ba sogs kyi lag pas 'dzin thub pa byung zer/ gzhan yang lung mang po gsungs so/ /de nas grwa thang du nyang stod rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po sogs la u rgyan bsnyen sgrub sogs gsungs/ grwa thang gi bshes gnyen 'dus pa rgya mtsho la lam 'bras sogs khrid mang po gsungs shing / de nas dol gzhir dgar thog cig bzhugs te/ sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos sngar ma 'gyur ba kha cig bsgyur/ mdzod rang 'grel la rgya dpe dang sbyar ba'i gzigs rtog dang / shan+ti pa'i sdeb sbyor la 'gyur zhus dag sogs mdzad do/ /de nas zha lu bas spyan 'dren chen slob byon kyang /

mi dbang sku mched pas gsol ba btab pas 'phral du phebs pa ma mdzad de/ dpal 'byor rab brtan du spyan drangs/ rje dpon slob la dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad pa rgyas pa/ bu'i mchan mdor bsdus dang po'i ṭik+ka chos 'byung sa bcad/ mkhan chen dharmā shrī ba'i zin bris rnams la skabs skabs su legs bshad mtha' yas pas brgyan te gsungs so/ /de nas glang lo'i dbyar gtsang phyogs su phebs te/ gtsang du dus zing chen pos skye bo du ma'i srog gi dbang po 'phrog par byed pa dang / zhag dang zla ba'i bar du chings la gnas par mdzad cing / dpal 'khor sde chen la sogs pa 'dus pa grangs med pas gtams pa'i chos sde mang po la'ang dmag gi gnod pa las bskyabs par mdzad/ rgyal mkhar rtse pa la sogs pa'i sa skyong mang po/ dpung gi bkod pa'am 'khor lo mi zad pa las dbugs dbyung ba mdzad/ de dag kyang g.yo dang sgyus mdzad pa ma yin par/ kha cig tu dmag bzlog par gyur cig ces gsungs pa tsam gyis bzlogs pa dang / la lar dam pa chos skyong ba rnams la 'di'i las kyis shig ces bka' bsgos pa tsam gyis grub pa dang / skabs 'ga' dmag gi mi dag gis gsung las cung zad 'gal ba na/ khro ba mi mnga' na'ang / thugs dam gtor ma'i dbus na me stag 'phro ba dang / da dung de dag gi bkod pa lugs su mi 'gro ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa mi zad pas phan pa dang bde ba'i bya dga' stsol bar mdzad pa lags/ de nas dpal ldan zha lur bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrubs pa'i gzim khang du bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i sta gon yang dag par gnang ste/ rgyud sde nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bsgrub pa gnang ba'i skabs su yi dam gyi lha dang bla ma mang po zhal gzigs te gsol ba btab pas/ thugs nyams 'ur ba'i tshul dang / phyogs thams cad dri bzang gis khyab pas/ bya ri dwags 'du ba la sogs pa byung zhing / bdud rtsi'i rdzas rnams khol zhing lud pa dang mang por 'phel ba sogs bsam pa'i re ba las 'das pa rnams ni sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum gyi nus pa dang ldan pa las gzhan du ma mchis/

de rjes zha lu pa rnams chos kyis tshims par mdzad cing / mar nas sogs phyag rdzas rnams gril te zang zing gi longs spyod thams cad la phyi bzhag gi tshul gyis mang ja 'gyed bcas snga phyir gnang ste phyir phebs/ chos kyi rgyal po sde pa yar rgyab pa sku mched kyis spyan 'dren zhus te bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bla na ma mchis pa skabs ma mchis pa bskor/ de nas gnam lha brgyad gangs kyi ra ba bde chen yangs pa can du phebs/ thams cad mkhyen pa spyan snga rin po che'i zhal snga nas dang chos kyi 'bel gtam bka' mchid mang pos thugs tshims par mdzad cing / dpon che chung sogs la dbang lung man ngag sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang ste thar pa'i myu gu bskrun par mdzad/ de nas byang stag lung gi chos sde chen por phebs/ chos rje'i mchod khang steng nas sngar ka lā pa'i sa ris gnang ba sogs kyi dogs dpyod dang / mdo sngags kyi zab pa'i gnad mang shas gcig phul/ stag lung gi mkhan slob che gnyan thams cad kyang chos kyi sbyin pas tshims par mdzad/ ja gos dar mdzo rta sogs 'bul ba'i dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyang / gzhan dag bsod nams spel ba'i slad du bzhes te rim pas phyir phebs pa'i lam du'ang skye bo dpag tu med pa la chos kyi bdud rtsi khor yug tu stsal/ slar dga' ldan byams pa gling gi rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i sku dang / chos kyi rje rin po che ngag dbang bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'i dngul gdung rin po che la rgyud sde zab mo nas ji ltar bshad pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i ye shes sems dpa' mngon sum du bzhugs te byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od chen po rab tu sbar nas yul phyogs dang yul 'khor thams cad bkra shis par mdzad/ de nas rje btsun dam pa nyid sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nas bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa'i slad du gra thang du/

byams pa gling gi dge 'dun gnyug mar gnas pa lus pa med pa dang / lung nang gi dgon pa che chung ma lus gnas gsungs ji ltar bos pa dang / de dag gi 'dren pa dam par chos kyi rje mkhan rin po che spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur 'bul nod 'gyed dang bcas pa gnang / skye bo'i tshogs grangs med pa glo bur du lhags pa la'ang sbyin pa'i phyag ring po glang po che'i sna lta bur skyong bar mdzad do/ /de nas nyid kyi dben pa'i gnas nyang po ma la yi skyed mos tshal du yun ring du bzhugs dus/ gnam sa thams cad kyi bdag po chen po mi'i dbang po dpon sa gong ma chen po gzhis dga' lhun grub gling du bzhugs pa dang mthun te spyan 'dren zhus/ de dus phyogs mthar rims nad phran bu yod pas/ lo ma gyon ma'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs dang bcas pa'i thugs rtsom gnang / de'i lung 'bul ba sogs chos kyi gtam gyis thugs kyi bum pa gang bar mdzad cing / de nas bya lo zla ba bzhi pa la yar stod lhun sgang du bstan pa ris med pa'i sbyin bdag lha'i rigs kyi sa skyong ba chen pos spyan drangs te rim pas phebs/ lam du mkhas pa'i dbang po paṇa chen 'bum ram pa sogs kyang gsung gi bdud rtsis tshims par mdzad cing / lhun po sgang du mchog dbang sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i khrid/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bsam pa'i ra ba las 'das pa gsungs/ brda sprod pa cha lag dang bcas pa'ang cher gsungs pa gnang ste/ mdor na gdul bya rang rang gi khams dang dbang po dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba mkhyen bzhin pas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad de/ ma smin pa smin pa dang / smin pa grol ba dang / grol ba mthar phyin pa'i lam la 'god bzhin pas lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ bsnyen bkur gya nom pa lha'i 'byor pa mngon sum pa'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa mi zad pas ci rigs par mchod do/

/de nas bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gus pas mchod de rgyal srid chos kyi snying por skyong ba'i mi'i dbang po rgyal chen gling nas yum sras kyi spyan 'dren byung ba ltar rim pas phebs/ yar stod du bzhugs dus dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gser zangs las grub pa/ zhabs pad nas gtsug tor nor bu'i bar mtho drug gi tshad dang ldan pa/ mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes pa sham+bha la'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku dang dbyer med pa bzhengs gnang ba dang phebs pa dus mtshungs/ yar lam chos kyi srid skyong ba chen po lhag par dad pa'i thugs can nang so rnam sras gling nas zab mo'i gdams pa gsan dang phun sum tshogs pa'i zhabs tog gnang zhag 'ga' bzhugs/ de nas rim gyis nyang por phebs te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku grwa tha du spyan drangs nas grwa thang chos sde pa rnams kyi bsu ba ser phreng / g.yag gzengs stag seng / rnga / dar dpyang / 'phan/ gdugs/ phye ma phur ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang bcas te spyan drangs nas/ de'i nub char chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa babs pas/ thams cad kyis zhal dro ba'i snyan pa phul/ nag pa sgrub mchod kyang btsugs/ rab tu gnas pa'i sta gon gzungs gzhug 'bul ba sogs rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyud sde dang mthun pa gnang / dngos gzhi nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga dang 'grig pas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang khyad med par bzhugs pa yin no/ /de nyin dpon mo che pa nang pa snyan mkhar nas dpon slob rnams la bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba'i dngos po gya nom pas tshim par mdzad/ grwa thang tshogs pa/ byams pa gling nas dge 'dun brgya phrag dang bcas pa la rab ston gyi tsha ra 'gyed bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang / sgrub mchod grol bstun sde pa yum sras kyis yar stod nas phebs pa'i dgyes spro la dpal 'byor rab brtan du spyan drangs/ mchod sprin mtha' yas pa bkod do/

/de dus dus 'khor gyi sku gzim khang gi 'jigs byed lha khang du spyan drangs/ mchod ong bre gang tsam 'gro ba'i nang du dkar me phul nas mchod khang la sgo bca' byas/ de nas zhag gsum na mchod me bskyar nas sgron pa la yong dus/ nang dri bzang gis khengs pa dang / mchod me kha bri ba tsam yang mi 'dug pas ya mtshan pa'i gnas su byas/ slar dpal 'byor rab brtan du snyan du phul dus/ cis kyang yong thang gsungs zhag bdun bzhugs/ de nas phyir phebs dus kyang / sngar las cung zad bri ba tsam ma gtogs mi 'dug pa la/ mi mang pos bltas gleng brjod byas pas mtshan gcig la zad pa sogs byas pas ye shes pa dngos su bzhugs par gor ma chag de nas nyang por sku mtshams pa la phebs/ de dus grwa phyi nang gi skya ser thams cad kyis yar stod nas phyir phebs pa'i dgyes spro'i spyan 'dren dang mjal kha bsnyen bkur zhu ba sogs 'du ba shin tu mang ba la brten/ sku grib kyi mtshan ma cung zad kyis khyi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin grwa thang du slar yang phyir phebs/ zhag 'ga' sku snyel ba'i tshul bstan pa'i dus su sa skya sman grong pa byon/ 'phrod bsten man ngag phul bas sku khams bde skyed yod pa byung ba ltar rim gyis bde ru song pa nas/ grwa thang gi gdan sar rje nyid kyi sku'i dbon po lugs gnyis ka nas rgyal tshab tu 'os pa rtse mthun pas/ phag lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin/ dpon sa yum sras kyi lung bzang po dang bcas ste pa rin po che dpon sa sku ngos kyis phebs bsko bzhag mnga' gsol shis brjod dang bcas pa'i skabs su/ rtse nas dpon sa gong ma chen mo'i zhal snga nas kyang cis kyang legs pa'i lung bzang po gsol ja gnang sbyin dang bcas pa phebs/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba la rgyu skar gyi phreng bas bskor ba ltar bzhugs pa la/ rgyal chen gling nas khri ston gyi tsha ra bzang bsham gnang sbyin dang bcas pa gnang /

chos rje gdan sa pa nyid kyi bsngo gtam legs pa'i thog chod pa byung / zhabs drung du snyan du phul dus/ de tsam los yong nged kyi byin gyis brlabs pa yin gsungs pa'ang gnang ste/ legs tshogs mtha' khyab tu 'phel bar gyur cing / de nas mi ring par bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par zhabs drung nyid la mi phyed pa'i thugs dad brtan po dang ldan pas rje nyid kyi dgongs pa lhur bzhes pa nang so rnam sras gling nas yab yum pa phebs/ khri ston legs ja la tsha ra mang ja 'gyed bcas/ dpon slob drung du 'bul ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang / de nas rgyal chen gling nas gsol ba 'debs pa dang / rgyu sbyor ba gnang ste/ phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer drug gi rgyal phur 'grub sbyor yod pa'i gza' skar bzang po la bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i sku mtshams sdom pa gnang / zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar bsgrub par gnang ba na/ rdzas kyi 'phel ga de las che ba ma byung gsungs/ de dus kyang bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mang po zhal gzigs/ khyad par rje btsun byams pa dang / 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba chen po blo ldan shes rab kyis phar phyin gyi ṭik+ka mang po byas te 'phrin las ma byung / da khyod kyi 'phrin las gyis gsungs phyag dpe dngos su gtad pa sogs dag pa'i thugs snang nyin mtshan khor yug tu khyab pa byung / gzhan yang sku grib zon gyi sku mtshams par bzhugs/ thugs dam zab mo'i ngang las mi g.yo bas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ zhabs drung de nyid bde mchog 'khor lo'i sku dngos su bzhengs te/ snying po rtsa sngags gsungs pa sogs gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams brjod par ma nus/ de nas skal bzang gi sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge'i rnam 'phrul chos rje karma pa'i sku skye brgyad pas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan por/

mkhan chen rin po che chos grub seng ge spyan 'dren du byung dus/ zhabs drung du thugs dam brtag pa zhus dus bka' gnang la/ karma pa la bsnyen rdzogs 'bul ba thub nas phyir phebs pa'ang yong / lam gyi 'gal rkyen phran bu sel ba la rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs par zab par lung bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin mngon du gyur pa sogs lkog tu gyur pa'i gnas rnams kyang thogs pa med par gzigs pa mnga' ba'i rnam par thar pa mtha' yas so/ /de nas lho brag pa'i drung yig sangs rgyas bde legs pa sku tshe sngon ma'i gdul byar gyur pas/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ba spu g.yo ba'i thugs dad yod pa la dgongs/ brgyad stong pa phreng ba can gyi glegs bam bzhengs 'dod pas/ khyod kyis shog bu nyos zhes rin gyi gser gnang / las sgor sngar thon ma myong ba'i shog bu khyad par can rje nyid kyi rin dang 'tshams pa 'thon/ de nas rjes su ma byung bas rje nyid kyi thugs rje chen po dran pa tsam gyis 'dod pa'i don 'grub par go /de nas dpon yig sangs rgyas bde legs pas shog tshos nas dbu tshugs te rdzogs par grub/ glegs bam rab gnas byi lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu drug la rje nyid kyi phyag phyir chos rje gdan sa pa sogs dge slong 'ga' shas kyis rgyud sde dang mthun pa gnang / tshes bcu bdun la grwa thang pa rnams la tsha ra 'gyed bcas gnang zhing / nyer bdun la dpon yig rnams la chos kyi zab gnad lag khyer du ston pa'i gsung bgros dang / zang zing gya nom pas ngoms par mdzad de rdzong pa gnang / bdag nyid chen po'i zhal snga nyid de gong nas zhing gzhan du 'gro don che ba dang / snyigs dus kyi skye bo rnams rtag 'dzin zlog pa'i phyir/ gzugs sku'i rnam pa chos skur thim par dgongs kyang / gsung rab bzhengs pa'i bar chad du song dogs/ bka' lung cung zad tsam yang mi gnang ba la rab gnas grub nas/ rje'i gsung las/

gsung rab bzhengs pa'ang grub/ lo yang mang po song / rkang lag gis lus mi thegs par bsdad kyang dgos pa med gsungs phebs pa la/ chos rje gdan sa pa dang / drung gnas bka' bcu pas gsol ba nan gyis btab kyang / mi rnams tshe ring ba la smon/ /rgas pa la ni 'jig par lta/ /zer bas bsdad kyang dgos pa med gsungs pa sogs nyer dgu la bka' phebs nas/ gnam gang gi gsol ba gdan bzhes sngar bzhin grol nas/ thugs dam bsil gtor brgya rtsa dang / srung ma drug cu gnang tshar ba'i bar der sku gshegs pa'i tshul bstan te/ de yang mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas lo nyis stong bzhi brgya dang lnga 'das pa/ me mkha' rgya mtsho la drug cu phrag brgyad dang / nyag ma so dgu ma long pa/ kun 'dzin zhes bya ba sa pho byi ba'i lo chu stod zla ba'i gnam gang gi snga dro'i char/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i bla ma dam pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis phan bde'i rgyun mi zad pa la sbyor bar mdzad pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi mig gcig pu/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po de nyid dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan par gyur to/ /de dag ni thun mong du bsgrags par 'os pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams mdo tsam brjod pa yin la/ gzhan yang rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'di nyid kyi sngon gyi mdzad pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i mdzad pa ji ltar ston pa dang / yi dam gyi lha gzigs shing mngon par mkhyen pa mnga' ba dang / thugs dam khyad par can 'khrungs pa rnams ni gzhan la ye mi gsung bas rnam thar mdzad pa po sus kyang 'bri bar ma spobs te/ de yang jo bo rje a ti sha la/ dge bshes 'phya dar ba la sogs pa bod ston kha cig gis/ ngo bo skye ba snga ma ji ltar yin bya ba dang / phyi ma ji ltar skye ba dang / 'tshang rgya na ji ltar rgya ba'i lo rgyus shig yi ger 'bri ba zhu zhus pas/

jo bo'i zhal nas/ khyed kyis gtsug tor 'don myong ngam gsungs pas/ myong lags zhus pas/ 'o na gtsug tor nas bcad de mnan te phur bus btab bo bya ba de gdon bgegs ma lus pa byas pa yin gsungs/ de bzhin du bka' dang bla ma'i man ngag bya ba la tshig gi phur bus btab pas byin rlabs chung du 'gro ba yin/ de bas na chos tshong dus kyi 'o ma bzhin du 'gro bas tshig zin par bya/ don go bar bya/ yi ger mi 'bri bar bya gsungs/ de bzhin du rje nyid kyang lta ba dang yon tan thol byung du smra ba rnams la gdams par dgongs nas/ thugs dam gyi 'char sgo 'di dang 'di byung ngo zhes gzhan dag la zur tsam yang mi gsung bar thugs nyams su bzhes pa gtso bor mdzad pa 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad srol bla na med pa byang grol don du gnyer ba'i skye bo rnams kyi mig gi yar dper rung ba yin no/ /mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di ni log sgrub byed pa'i skye bo la'ang lhag par brtse bas dus thams cad du bdag pas gzhan gces mdzad pa las mi 'da'/ sngar blo sbyong gsan dus bla mas khyed rang gi dgra la'ang byams pa sgoms gsungs te/ nga la dgra zer nas snying na ba tsam su yang med gsungs/ slob ma la yang dam tshig la skyon byung bya nam yang mi srid/ gal te gzhan la phan na sku srog 'dor nus pa dang / sems can shin tu mi srun pa gcig yin yang / rje nyid mthong ba tsam gyis rgyud dul bar 'gyur ba dang / rnam pa thams cad du 'gro don kho na sku nyams su bzhes pa sogs byang chub kyi sems rin po che rkyen gzhan gyis mi 'phrog pa mnga' zhing / sdom pa gsum gyi dbang du byas na bshad ma thag pa ltar/ theg pa chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgor zhugs nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa shin tu brtan zhing / byams pa dang snying rjes thugs kyi rgyud brlan pas 'gro ba mtha' dag la dngos dang brgyud pa'i phan pa dang bde ba'i don du g.yo dang sgyu med par lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun du sku nyams su bzhes pas byang chub sems dpa' chen por gyur pa yin la/

de ltar byang sdom rnam par dag pas sngags sdom yang rnam par dag pa yin zhing / de la'ang bla med dang / rnal 'byor rgyud dang / bya spyod gsum du dbyer yod pa las/ so so'i bslab par bya ba la nyes ltung mi mnga' ba ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i byang sdom gyis kyang 'grub pa lags so/ /gzhan yang gzhi thams cad la gya gyu med pa'i bsam pa dang / nyes spyod las ldog cing bla med rdzogs byang bsgrub pa'i gegs ma lus pa spong ba'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang / dam pa'i chos gsan pa ngom pa mi mnga' zhing / ting nge 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul gyis sangs rgyas mang po la chos gsan pa'i tshig don thugs su chud de/ mkhas rlom gzhan gyi rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i gsung rab shin tu mang po mkhyen pa dang / rang gi don dang theg pa dman pa yid la byed pas rnam par dben pa'i dgon pa 'ba' zhig tu mi bzhugs pa dang / 'dris pa dang 'khrin pa mi mnga' bas sku skye ba snga ma rnams su brdzus te skye ba'i tshul mang du bstan pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing nyan rang gi sa ma yin dgos pa dang / bdag tu 'dzin pa sogs cung zad kyang mi mnga' zhing / rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor pa sogs sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar gyi yongs sbyong gi rtags rnams kyang mnga' zhing / gzhan dag gis bskal par yang 'grub mi srid pa'i bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i mtshan ma tsam yang mi mnga' bar bde blag tu 'grub pa rnams ni lha'i bu'i bdud bcom pa'i rtags dang / cung zad bsnyel ba na sman pa la ma ltos pa thugs dam kho na'i stobs kyis bsnyun pa las grol bar mdzad pa sogs ni nang du dug bcom pa las te nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom pa'i rtags dang / 'chi ba med pa'i rig 'dzin mngon du mdzad pas sku tshe ring po'i tshad du gyur pa sogs ni 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom pa'i rtags dang /

gzhan snang la so so skye bo'i tshul 'dzin kyang / skyogs lo tsa ba la gzim mal du sku mi snang ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa 'ja' lus brnyes pa sogs gsang ba'i rnam thar rnams ni phung po'i bdud bcom pa'i rtags dang / phyis bgres nas nyin mo'i thun mtshams 'ga' zhig tu gzhan snang la mnal ba ltar snang yang / mtshan mo tha mal du nam yang mi mnal bar 'od gsal chen por bzhugs pa sogs ni ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs pa'i rtags dang / rnam grol don du gnyer ba rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i don mi mkhyen pa gang yang mi mnga' ba ni shes bya la blo gros rgyas pa'i rtags dang / 'bad rtsol med par bstan pa dang sems can gyi phan bde shugs kyis 'grub pa ni khyab pa dang rtag pa'i bdag nyid can gyi 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i rtags la sogs pa mnga' ste/ mtha' dag pa ni 'phags pa'i spyod yul du rig par bya'o/ /mdor na dang por thos bsam mdzad lugs la bltas na/ dus thams cad du de kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba dang / chos gsan pa dang rtsom pa dang bsgyur ba dang / 'gyur chad bsab pa la bltas na/ dus thams cad du de ka mdzad pa 'dra ba dang / 'chad nyan dang dbang lung man ngag gi sgo nas gzhan don mdzad pa la bltas na/ dus thams cad du de ka mdzad pa 'dra ba dang / sgom sgrub dang bzlas pa mdzad pa la bltas na/ dus thams cad du de ka mdzad pa 'dra ba dang / rgya yig mi 'dra ba shin tu mang po'i glegs bam dang / bod yig dang / gsum bita dang / nyis bita sogs kyi phyag dpe phyag bris kho na las grub pa mtha' yas pa rnams la bltas na/ dus thams cad du de ka mdzad pa 'dra ba zhig yod pa yin no/ /zhes thos la/ rje 'di'i mdzad pa'i cha nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi dbang du byas na'ang / nangs par snga mo nas thugs dam mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rim pa grol nas/ slar yang rlung la sogs pa la gnad du bsnun pa dang / de nas nyin mo chos 'chad pa dang / bsgyur ba dang /

zhu chen dang rtsom pa sogs mdzad/ de la chos nyan shes rab shin tu chung ba la'ang sun mi mnga' bar tshar mang po bskyor ba mdzad de/ khyed rnams kyis nyan nus na bdag gis 'chad nus pa byed gsungs nas nyin 'khyongs pa gsungs shing / thun mtshams su mkhas pa dpe dang ma bral ba gsungs te/ phyag dpe rang kho na gzigs rtog mdzad/ skabs skabs su dpang lo dang kun mkhyen chen po sogs kyi rnam thar yang klog nub mo bla ma gong ma'i gsol 'debs dang smon lam mang po mdzad cing / byang chub kyi sems rang sgom pa gal che yang yang gsungs/ de nas bsil gtor grol nas gzim mal du thugs dam la bzhugs pa yin no zhes thos so/ /mdor na rje bla ma dam pa chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di nyid rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis par gyur pas/ dus mtshungs pa'i mkhas grub gzu bor gnas pa rnams rje 'di'i gsung tshad mar mi byed pa gcig kyang med de/ rje btsun sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa sku mched sogs dang karma pa zhwa dmar ba sogs kyis ni rnam pa thams cad du bstod cing bsngags par mdzad pa dang / mkhas pa chen po chag lo tsā ba'i zhal nas kyang / rje btsun zha lu lo chen gyi mkhyen rab 'di lta bu tshe dpag tu med pa nas sbyangs pa yin/ skye ba gcig la 'di tsam shes mi thub gsungs pa dang / spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi sprul ba bla ma snyug la ba'ang / mkhas mchog thams cad mkhyen pa khyed med na/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mgrin bzang ra ba bzhin/ /zhes gsungs shing / rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā tshun la rje 'di las mkhas pa med par gsungs pa dang / khong la mngon shes kyang yod par grags pa yin no/ /rgya gar gyi dza gi la mahā bo dhi'i bstod pa saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du sdeb sbyor dang ldan pa brtsams te/ rdo rje gdan gyi sgo la glan par bskur bas/ saṃ skṛ ta bzang / bod na mkhas pa yod 'dug zer nas sangs rgyas pa rnams dga' ba dang yi rang ba byung skad/

phyi pa rnams yid skrag par byung ste/ rgya gar na'ang mkhas pa'i grags che ba yin la/ gzhan yang rje 'di nyid sbyin bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs pa'i phyir nor rdzas la 'phral du dges dges ltar mdzad na'ang / zhen pa cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin de/ gong gi rnam thar rnams kyis shes pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i rje btsun lo tswa pa chen po 'di nyid kyis bstan 'gro la dgongs te/ sngon med pa'i legs bshad kyi rtsom pa 'di dag mdzad de/ bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ sgra'i bstan bcos ka lā pa'i 'grel pa/ tsan+t+ra pa'i 'grel pa/ ka lā pa'i mtshams sbyor lnga bye brag tu bshad pa ming le yan gyi spyi bshad/ ka lā pa'i sa bcad/ ka lā pa'i spyi don/ me long gi bsdus don/ sdeb sbyor gyi bsdus don/ tsan+t+ra pa'i yi ge bsdu ba/ sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug gi 'grel pa/ dag yig don gcig ming du ma 'jug tshul gyi tshigs bcad/ nyer bsgyur gyi bshad pa brgya pa dang bsdus don lce khyi 'brug gi gnas brgyad rtsa 'grel bsdus pa/ ka lā pa'i uṇa sogs bsdus pa/ mngon brjod bsdus pa/ dbus pa blo gsal bas byas pa'i brda gsar rnying la dpyad pa sogs sgra skor/ 'dul ba'i ma phyin len gyi rin thang gi skabs su dpyad pa/ dus 'khor phyag len rnal 'byor tshang ma/ dril bu pa'i lus dkyil cho ga bsdus pa/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i cho ga sogs phyag len skor/ brgyud pa'i bla ma la bstod pa/ sku zhang chos rje la bstod pa/ rdor phreng brgyud pa dang / sbyor drug brgyud pa/ spros med brgyud pa la bstod pa/ rje btsun skyabs che ba la bstod pa/ mkhas pa kun dga' dpal 'byor la bstod pa/ mkhan po zhi ba mtsho la bstod pa/ sa skya bdag chen la bstod pa/ snyug la ba chen po la bstod pa/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa chen po la bstod pa/ dus 'khor brgyud pa la bstod pa/ ma hā bo dhi la legs sbyar du bstod pa/

grwa pa mngon shes la bstod pa/ thub pa la mdzad pa bcus bstod pa/ dbyangs can ma la bstod pa la sogs pa bstod pa'i skor/ glo bo chos rje bsod nams lhun grub pa'i dris lan/ bhik+ṇu de wā ka ra'i dris lan sogs dris lan skor/ dpang lo dang / kun mkhyen chen po dang / sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje'i rnam thar sogs rnam thar skor/ smon lam tshigs su bcad pa sogs te/ de ltar thugs rtsom mdzad pa rnams kyang rjod byed kyi tshig snga phyi 'brel chags pa dang / brjod bya'i don phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa/ nyan pa po rnams kyis go sla zhing yid 'phrog pas mkhas pa thams cad kyi rna rgyan dang / bstan pa'i sgron me dam par gyur pa yin no/ /rgyas par bka' 'bum las shes par bya ste/ thugs rtsom la ha cang mi dges pas mang po ni mi bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang bka' bstan bcos gsar du bsgyur pa dang / 'gyur rtsom mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mdzad pa bstan pa'i tshul ni/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi mig tu gyur pa'i rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po 'dis sngar ma 'gyur ba'i chos khyad par du 'phags pa 'di dag bsgyur te/ lang dkar gshegs pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa dbu ma la dga' bas mdzad pa/ theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud/ rgyud gsum mchod chog paṇ+ḍi ta dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs sha wā ras mdzad pa/ chos kyi dung zhes bya ba'i mdo/ gan+ḍe'i bstod pa ar+ya de was mdzad pa/ tsan+t+ra pa'i don bsdus pa 'grel pa grub pa paṇ+ḍi ta nyi ma'i snying pos mdzad pa/ rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'dod 'jo'i mi'i sde tshan man gyi bsgyur 'phro kha bskangs nas bsgyur pa/ dus 'khor mai tri pas mdzad pa/

bde mchog gi sgrub thabs tshigs bcad sum cu pa paṇ+ḍi ta sprin gyi bzhon pa'i lhas mdzad pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i lnga bsdus dang gza' lnga'i 'grel chung / bhik+ṣu a nan ྄pradzñā'i rgya dpe las byung ba'i dam tshig lnga bsdus pa/ nag po chen po'i bstod pa brgyad pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa gnam lcags thog gzer du grags pa slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa/ bkra shis kyi mdo/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ nyi ma'i mdo/ zla ba'i mdo/ bden pa bsdus pa'i le'u dang po paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā kirtis mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i phreng ba blo bzang seng ges mdzad pa/ kyai rdor 'grel pa pad+ma can gyi rnam bshad paṇ+ḍi ta ne ru hans mdzad pa/ rab gnas sbyin sreg gi cho ga ka lā da pas mdzad pa dbyig gi phreng ba/ ma hā bo dhi'i bstod pa mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ zla ba grags pa'i smon lam/ kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi mdo'i bying gi tshogs dang gzhung skabs brgyad sh+lauka brgya phrag bdun yod pa 'jam dpal gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta sā dhu kirtis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa phyed lhag pa pā ṇi na'i sgra mdo nyung ngu / mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos chen po mu tig phreng ba'am sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta dpal 'dzin sdes bkod pa/ gzhon nu ma drug gi rtogs brjod/ gnas brtan bcu drug lung bstan/ glang ru lung bstan 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ ar+ya de wa'i khab kyi tsher ma klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ bram ze'i 'dod pa 'god byed/ nag mo'i 'bangs kyi bkris/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bstod pa dza ya se nas mdzad pa/ seng ge sgra'i bstod pa gnyis skyes bsrung bas byas pa/ tshigs bcad gcig pa'i don 'grel bstod pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ mdzod kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/

klu sgrub kyi sangs rgyas la bstod pa rgyun chags/ sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung nyung ngu sogs dang / paṇ+ḍi ta yid kyi shing rtas karma pa la phul ba'i zhu yig paṇ+ḍi ta sgra gcan 'dzin gzhon nu dang / kha che'i rgyal pos karma pa la phul ba'i zhu yig paṇ+ḍi ta shi ro ma ṇis ngor chen kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa dang / bhik+ṣu de wa ka ras gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa chen po la bstod pa la sogs pa rnams so/ /de ltar rmad du byung ba'i chos bsgyur pa mdzad pa rnams ni 'gyur legs pa'i dpe thub pa yod pas/ de rnams la bltas na blo ldan rnams dad pa mi 'gro ba'i dbang med pa lags so/ /de nas snga 'gyur pa la'ang 'gyur mi bde ba dang / 'gyur log pa/ 'gyur thal ba dang / 'gyur chad pa sogs dang / phyis yi ge bas bris nor byas pa sogs mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams rgya dpe la gtugs pa'i zhu chen mdzad pa ni/ bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur phal che ba la yod kyang yi ge mang pa'i 'jigs pas 'dir kha cig tsam zhig 'bri na/ mi g.yo brtul phod kyi rgyud/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ dbang mdor bstan/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud/ 'chi med mdzod rtsa ba/ 'dod 'jo'i bstod pa/ dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud/ chos dbyings bstod pa/ nor rgyun mas mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa brgyad pa/ gaṇ+ḍe'i bstod pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa/ slob ma la springs pa bshes springs/ ched du brjod pa'i tshom/ ka lā pa'i mdo/ bying gi tshogs/ tsan+t+ra pa'i mdo/ u ṇa sogs rtsa 'grel/ sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu / gza' yum gzungs/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i gzungs/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud/ gdugs dkar phyir zlog ma chen mo/

kye rdor mngon rtogs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ rnam rgyal/ ltung bshags/ bzang spyod/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs/ dril bu pas mdzad pa'i sdom pa lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel ba brtson 'grus dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs in+t+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sems rnam par dag pa'i rab dbye/ des mdzad pa chos dbyings bstod pa/ tshe mdo/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya/ kyai rdor pad+ma can mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ phyag bzhi pa'i bstod pa brgyad pa/ bsngags 'os bsngags bstod le'u dang / byams chos lnga/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sher snying / dpag bsam 'khri shing / me long / sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rtsa 'grel/ klu sgrub kyi yum rgyas pa dum bu bzhi'i dngos don bstod pa/ spyod 'jug bsngo le/ mngon pa mdzod/ 'dul ba'i so thar mdo/ mdo bsdus pa/ kun rig gi mtshan brgya/ mngon pa kun las btus/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ mdo sde stag na/ rmi lam gyi phreng ba lung bstan pa'i cho ga su kaṃ gi bhik+ṣu de wa ka ra dang / glo bo lo tsā bas bsgyur pa rje nyid kyis gtan la phab pa tsan+t+ra pa'i ring mtha' rgyas pa dang / yi ge'i mdo'i 'grel pa sngar ma 'gyur ba skyogs lo tsā ba'i 'gyur byang yod pa'ang rje nyid kyi gsung las byung bar bshad pa lags so/ /'o na sngon gyi lo tsā ba de dag gis bsgyur pa 'chos mi dgos snyam na ma yin te/ dpang lo chen pos ka lcog rnam gnyis rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab shong ston rdor rgyal sogs/ /mkhas pas bsgyur la'ang 'gyur nyes phra mo dag /'byung na gzhan dag rnams la smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / der ma zad phyis bod kyi yi ge pa blun po dang 'chad pa po rnams kyi rang bzos bcos pa mang bas zhu chen cis kyang gces pa yin no/

/'di ltar zhus chen mdzad pa dang / 'gyur chad bsab pa rnams shin tu ngo mtshar ba bla na med pa yod pas 'dir kha cig rgya skad dang bcas te bris na/ blo ldan rnams dad gus bskyed pa yod na'ang / shes par 'dod pas ni bstan bcos de dag las rtogs shing / 'dir bkod kyang bstan bcos la blo ma byang ba rnams kyis go mi nus pas ma bris so/ /de lta bu'i bstan pa la phyag rjes sngon med pa mdzad pa'i rje lo tsā ba chen po 'di nyid kyi gsung las 'khrungs pa'i mkhas grub mtha' yas pa las ches mtha' yas pa bzhugs pas/ ma lus pa ni 'bri bar mi lang zhing / grags che ba kha cig brjod na/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa sa skya bdag chen chos kyi rje sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dpal bzang po/ 'bri khung dbon rin po che/ sa skya bdag chen shar pa/ sgo rum pa/ mang thos rab 'byams pa/ glang thang spyan snga pa chen po/ thon mi paṇ+ṭi ta gsum pa skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po rje btsun byams pa gling pa'i zhal snga nas/ sgam po spyan snga/ g.ya' bzang spyan snga/ tshogs chen mo'i mkhan po paṇa chen dwags po rab 'byams pa dang / mkhyen rab dbang phyug pa/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po chos grub seng ge dang nor bu pa/ bye rdzing mkhan po zla chos pa/ zla bkras pa/ rab 'byor pa/ kong 'phags mkhan po dpal 'byor ba/ dge legs dpal ba/ de'i khri thog pa/ gtsang 'phags mkhan po bsod nams dpal bzang dang / rin chen grags pa/ ri bo dga' ldan gyi gdan sa pa chos kyi bshes gnyen pa/ lha khang ke ru'i mkhan po rin po che dang / gdan sa pa chos rgyal/ chos rje karma 'phrin las pa/ chos rje snyug la ba/ chos rje stong ra ba/ ban mkhar bstan pa rgya mtsho/ stag lung chos rje rnam rgyal grags pa dpal bzang po/ bsam yas bu tshal pa'i sras lha btsun pa/

na len+t+ra'i mkhan po bzhi sde ba rnam rgyal/ mngon dga'i mkhan po 'chi med grub pa'i sku skye/ ru dgon gsar gyi mkhan po sku zhang chos rje rin chen bsod nams mchog grub dpal bzang po/ jo nang gi mkhan po chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ snar thang mkhan po bsod nams dbang phyug rgya nag rgyal po'i bla ma dpal ldan blo gros/ ljang rgyal po'i bla ma rong chung sangs rgyas bzang po/ yang ljang gi bla ma bsod nams bzang po/ slob dpon kun tu bzang po sogs/ chu byang ba'i slob dpon rdzong mkhar chos rje/ rab 'byams pa chos bshes gnyen sogs rdzong mkhar ba'i mkhan po/ slob dpon chos nyi ba dang / legs ldan sogs chos lung gi slob dpon/ nyang stod rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po dang / rab 'byams pa bzod pa sogs dpal 'khor sde chen gyi slob dpon/ slob dpon shes rab sogs rtse chen gyi slob dpon/ slob dpon zla rgyal sogs byams chen gyi slob dpon/ mnga' ris rdzong kha ba'i bla ma rab 'byams pa dpal bkras/ chen po don grub legs bzang dang / slob dpon 'od srung sogs gsang phu'i slob dpon/ chen po sde bdun pa dang / rab 'byams pa bsod nams rgyal sogs dang / slob dpon kun dga' rgyal bo sogs gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi slob dpon/ chos grwa rtse thang gi chen po ha la sgang pa sogs rtse thang gi chen slob/ chos 'khor sgang gi gdan sa pa rab 'byams pa tshe dbang sogs dga' ldan byams pa'i gling gi slob dpon/ thol gyi chos sgo ba paṇa chen 'bum rab 'byams pa sogs gdan sa thel gyi bla ma slob dpon/ rab 'byams pa 'phrin las dbang phyug dang / sbyor sgrol nus pa'i sngags 'chang chen po rgyal rdzong pa/ bco brgyad pa/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs pa sogs na len+t+ra'i slob dpon dang dus mchod pa/ stag lung gdan sa pa'i slob dpon dpal 'byor rgya mtsho sogs stag lung gi slob dpon/ dpon rin chen kun legs pa/

co ro ka bcu pa/ rtogs ldan chen po gser thang pa/ rtogs ldan chen po ko brag pa/ gnas mchog dpal gyi rtsa ri'i cig car rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs sgrub brgyud pa rnams dang / rgya gar puk+kaṃ gi paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā de wā ga ra/ ar+ya baṃ sa/ sar+dharma baṃ sa/ shī la sa ga ta/ rba dharma kirti sogs rgya gar ba paṇa grub rnams dang / slob dpon bo lo tsā ba dpal ldan grags pa/ mkhyen brtse lo tsā ba rab legs/ se ra lo tsā ba kun dga' bzang po/ sne gdong pa'i dbang gi las kha skyel mi he shrī lhun grub bkra shis/ dbang ldan chos 'khor gyi gdan sa pa/ thar gling gdan sa pa ka bcu smra ba/ skyog lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis sogs mkhas pa dang grub pa dang / chos sde chen po'i mkhan slob tu gyur pa dang / rigs rus kyis 'phags pa sogs mtha' yas te/ mdor na bod dang / bod chen po dang / rgya nag dang rgya nag chen po dang / 'phags pa'i yul gyi bar du bdag nyid chen po 'di'i slob ma dang yang slob kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur to/ /de ltar bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa lo chen zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam 'di nyid mkhas pa'i dbang po mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu gson pa/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa rin chen chos kyi dbang po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba yod pa las btus shing / phyis kyi mdzad pa'i phreng ba 'ga' zhig bsnan te/ skyogs lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis kyis legs par bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar dang mthun pa 'dir bkod pa yin pas/ rgyas par shes par 'dod na rnam thar chen mo de dag tu blta'o/ /de ltar zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po de nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gong du smos pa de dag gi gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gyur pa ni/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje de nyid yin pas/

de'i rnam par thar pa ni/ yab gangs can na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i lha rigs 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa bdag chen nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / yum dma' ze hor mo tshe brtan zhes bya ba'i sras su bsam bzhin du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa yin te/ ji skad du/ dang por zab gsal gnyis med 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bar du rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa'i zhabs/ /tha mar gnas lnga rig pa sa skya pa/ /bdag nyid chen po'i sngon gyi skyes rabs yin/ /zhes pa ltar dang po bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi mkhyen rab thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ bar du rigs ldan sa skyong chen po mi'i dbang po 'jam dpal grags pa/ tha mar gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya ba rnams su sku'i rnam 'phrul brgyud mar bzhes nas/ slar yang gangs ri'i khrod kyi gdul bya skal ldan rnams kyi smon lam dang legs byas kyis bskul nas dbus 'gyur gyi tshal rdo rje'i gdan nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya tsam bgrod pa'i sa'i cha yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung khungs/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi bsti gnas/ 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas pa rgyun mi chad pa byon pa'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa'i gtsang grom pa la stod dpal ldan sa skya zhes grags pa'i dgon pa nas dbang po'i phyogs su ha cang mi ring ba zhig bgrod pa'i nor 'dzin gyi mthil/ phyi nang gi dpal 'byor du ma 'byung 'i bsti gnas/ dpal rtse gdong gi phun tshogs gling zhes pa'i khang bzang chen po der/ phun tshogs gnas dang skyon med rigs bzang dang / /kha na ma tho med pa'i yab dang yum/ /skal bar ldan pa'i 'khor tshogs la dgongs nas/ /zas gtsang sras bzhin dge mtshan bcas te bltams/ /zhes pa ltar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas legs par 'khrungs pa yin te/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i yum rtse gdong bla brang du ma phebs tsam gyi nub cig mnal lam du ri gcig la 'dzeg gin 'dug pa na/

mun pa ches nas lam mi rnyed snyam pa na/ rum nas nyi zla gnyis thon nas phyogs thams cad gsal bar byas pa rmis shing / yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ rtse gdong gi byang phyogs na rje btsun sa skya pa'i bla mtsho yin pa'i mtsho zhig yod pa de cher rgyas pa dang / gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa 'bol ston ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi mnal lam du/ rtse gdong bla brang pa'i gsol zhing chen mo la yab gung na bzhugs nas sa bon 'debs shing / skye bo gzhan du ma dang bcas pas phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis byed pa dang / rmi ltas pa 'ga' zhig gi rmi lam du/ bla brang la sa dkar gsol ba dang / steng na dar 'phyar ba dang / nyi zla shar ba la sogs pa byung zhing / khyad par du yum la rmi ltas bzang po du ma dang / nyin bar gyi tshe yang shes pa gsal zhing bde bas brgyan pa dang / lus ldang ba yang zhing zo ldog bde ba la sogs pa'i rtags khyad par can du ma byung bar grags la/ de ltar ltas du ma dang bcas shing zla grangs rnams thim nas/ shing mo sbrul gyi lo chu stod zla ba'i nyer brgyad kyi nyin bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas bltams shing / de'i skabs su shar mi nyag gi paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rje bas gzhon nu gzugs bzang zhing mdzes la lta na sdug pa de'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gzigs pa na/ a rok+ṣa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba zin a gsungs shing sku pang du bzhes nas/ rgyal ba'i thugs sras sngon sbyangs dge ba yis/ /yon tan thams cad 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ /chung ngu nyid nas dam pa'i spyod pa mdzad/ /bu chung 'phags pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod cing mtshan rdo rje rgya sog bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bar gsol te/ de nas paṇ+ḍi ta de'i drung du dam pa'i chos kyang mang du gsan par mdzad ces thos la/ de dag gi skabs su bla ma legs pa bzang po pa bya bas yon tan thams cad kyi phyi mo 'bri klog phul ba na/

brda bstan pa tsam gyis 'bri klog gnyis ka thogs med du mkhyen cing / yi ge'i rigs kyang bod yig mi the ba'i rgya gar gyi yig rigs drug tsam dang / mkha' 'gro'i yi ge dang / hor yig gsar la sogs pa yig rigs mang po gzigs pa tsam gyis dgongs te/ mdor na 'bri ba dang klog pa'i tshul thams cad la mkhyen rab phul du byung bas skye bo thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur pa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo drug bzhes pa na/ bdag chen rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dges pa rdo rje'i dbang / rdo rje phur ba'i dbang / drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang sogs dbang rjes gnang mang du gsan cing / sku gzhon nu'i skabs der nam mkha' la paṇ+ḍi ta sngo sang pod ral thogs pa seṅge la chibs pa zhig gzigs nas 'jam dbyangs ya gi na zhes gsungs pa yang byung bar grags te/ de ni bdag nyid chen po sa paṇ+ḍi ta nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa ste/ de la sogs pa mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di ni gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas yon tan gyi tshogs du ma la mnga' mdzad pa zhig ste/ ji skad du/ sku ni mdzes shing yid 'ong mthong na dga'/ /gsung ni 'jam zhing snyan la 'phrod par smra/ /thugs ni chos kyi bag chags bzang pos bgos/ /gzhon nur gyur kyang byis pa'i spyod las 'das/ /de'i tshe nges pa'i don du 'jam dbyangs nyid/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor sa skya paṇa chen zhes/ /snyan grags kun gyi gtsug na len pa de/ /rang snang ye shes tshul du gsal bar gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po 'dis rab tu byung nas bstan pa'i bya ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/ mgon khyod srid pa'i 'ching bas ma gos shing / /'khor ba'i phun tshogs snying po med gzigs kyang / /mchog gi spyod pas 'gro rnams rjes bzung phyir/ /khyim gyi 'ching ba dug can zas bzhin spangs/ /slar yang e waṃ chos kyi 'jug ngogs cher/

/blo gsal chu bya mang pos mdun bsus te/ /mkhan slob ngang pa'i ded dpon bka' drin las/ /bslab gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtshor rim kyis zhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes pa shing mo yos bu'i lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs la mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba'i drung du bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pas thugs rgyud gtams shing / rab tu byung ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas par mdzad/ gzhan yang mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa de las/ thub pa dgongs gsal gyi bshad bka' sogs chos tshul du ma gsan te/ de nas lo de nyid kyi rgyal gyi zla ba la ngor e waṃ chos ldan du phebs te/ zla ba de kha'i yar tshes bcu gnyis kyi tshe/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phel pa'i drung du mkhan po zhus/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pas slob dpon mdzad nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa nos shing / mtshan yang don dang mthun par 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bar gsol te bslab bya'i gnas phra zhing phra ba la yang kha na ma tho ba'i dri mas ma gos pa'i btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur to/ /de nas me pho 'brug lo rje nyid dgung lo bcu gnyis la nye ba tsam na/ mkhan chen chos kyi rje dang dpon slob lhan cig tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa du ma'i 'khor dang bcas te gdan sa chen po'i phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba mdzad nas rim gyis phebs te lo gsar gyi dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam sprul chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i chos kyi khri ga la ba der rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam po che thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po yongs su rdzogs pa nyi ma gsum gyi bar du legs par bshad pas/

skye bo'i tshogs thams cad ngo mtshar zhing / sku na gzhon nu 'di lta bu la sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rmad du byung ba 'di 'dra ba 'byung ba ni/ nges par chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nyid slar yang gdul bya'i don du sku'i skye ba bzhes pa yin yang dag go /zhes mkhas pa'i skye bo rnams kyis mchog tu bsngags pa'i gnas su gyur pa zhig go zhes grags te/ ji skad du/ 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku/ /rim par byon pa'i dpal ldan sa skya zhes/ /grags pa'i rnga chen srid na gsal ba der/ /bcu gnyis bzhes tshe bshad pa'i dga' ston bsgrubs/ /sku ni 'khor tshogs dbus na zla ltar brjid/ /gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar dal dod snyoms/ /thugs ni shes bya'i gnas la gsal bar 'jug /yon tan skye bo kun gyi kha na rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /des nas dgung lo bcu gnyis pa sa pho rta'i lo bzhi thog gi gdan sa mdzad nas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol zhing / slar yang rtse gdong du phebs pas ra dbon yon tan 'byung gnas la 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba/ 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel/ sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rigs pa'i gter/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba sogs sde snod gtso bor gyur pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig lung rigs kyi mtha' dpyod bcas te legs par gsan cing / 'bel ba'i gtam gyi sgos legs par gtan la phab ste smra ba'i khyu mchog tu gyur la/ de dus snga dro ja sbyor re tsam gyi bar la shog bu mda' tshad bdun tsam re zin pa byas zhes gsungs pa dang / ji snyed thugs su chud pa rnams kyang bsnyel ba med pa'i spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba ste/ bdag nyid chen po rang gi gsung las/ gsang ston slob dpon yon tan 'byung gnas la/ /'dul ba mdo rtsa ka ri ka la sogs/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel rigs gter sdom gsum dang /

/pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs 'ga' zhig nos/ /sngags kyi sdeb sogs lag len phran tshegs bslabs/ /de ltar thos pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad la/ /bsam pas sgro 'dogs chod cing bsgoms na yang / /the tshom mi za yid ches cung zad yod/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de nas lug gi lo rje nyid dgung lo bco lnga pa'i dus yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i gsung gis rang gzhan gyi don gnyis bsgrub pa'i phyir gsung bsnyen mdzad dgos pa'i bka' stsal ba la brten/ dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ rdo rje phur ba'i bsnyen pa/ nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i bsnyen pa rnams mthar phyin pa mdzad pas/ de dag gi skabs su kyai rdo rje dang rdo rje gzhon nu/ gur mgon rnams zhal gzigs pa la sogs pa grub pa'i mtshan ma mang du byung bar grags la/ de nas yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni dge slong nyid yin par dgongs nas/ dgung lo nyi shur phebs pa shing pho byi ba'i lo mkhan po sngar gyi dge tshul mdzad pa po nyid dang / las kyi slob dpon 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po dang / gsang ston ra dbon yon tan 'byung gnas kyis mdzad de/ dge 'dun bcu phrag phyed kyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas/ 'phags pa rta thul ltar spyod lam shin tu dul ba dang / ka ta ya na'i bu ltar bslab bya rnams la shin tu gus shing / 'od srung bzhin du sbyangs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa zhig ste/ ji skad du/ zhi dang nyer zhi'i myos bum mtho ldan zhing / /kun nas dul ba'i gser gyi dra ba can/ /thub bstan skyed tshal mdzes pa'i gnyis 'thung khyod/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs par bzod/ /spyod lam kun nas dul ba rta thul te/ /bslab byar gus pa ka ta ya na'i bu/

/sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan pa 'od srung bzhin/ /dri zhim blta na sdug la 'od chags 'bar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar nges legs kyi lam la gcig tu gzhol zhing / lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyis thugs rgyud phyug par mdzad nas/ slar yang rang gzhan rnam grol thob pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo dam pa'i chos thos nas nyams su len pa dang / de yang rtsa ba dri ma med pa'i gsung rab la thos pa bya ba nyid yin par dgongs nas/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/ khyod ni mkhyen pa'i lang tsho cher rgyas kyang / /blo gsal yongs kyi spyad bya 'di yin zhes/ /mang du gsan pa'i snyim pa rab brkyangs te/ /mkhas mang zhal gyi bdud rtsi dges par gsol/ /zhes pa ltar/ chos kyi rje yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i drung du dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed/ de gnyis kyi yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa/ dges pa rdo rje yab yum gyi dbang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang sogs dbang gi rnam grangs du ma dang / gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi khrid dang / 'di dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs mtha' dag dang / rgyab rten gyi yig cha'i lung / gzhan yang ḍom+bhi ba'i lhan cig skyes grub sogs lam skor phyi ma brgyad du grags pa man ngag yig cha phran tshegs dang bcas pa/ shan+ti pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba sogs sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa rnams dang / gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu po sogs dges pa rdo rje'i chos skor mtha' yas pa zhig dang / yang 'khor lo bde mchog skor la dpal mngon par rtogs pa sogs lū hi pa'i smad lnga/ bde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub thabs sogs nag po gzhung drug bde mchog lus dkyil sgrub thabs sogs dril bu skor gsum gyi lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor phal mo che dang / gzhan yang sgrub thabs mdo byas/
