mdo bsres/ rnam gzhag rim pa sogs pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor mang po zhig dang / thun mong sgrub pas mchog zhar la 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum gyi byin rlabs man ngag las tshogs dang / de dag gi yig cha'i lung / rje btsun gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rnams kyi bka' 'bum/ gzhan yang chos skyong skor gyi rjes gnang gi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / khyad par brgyud pa dri ma med pa las 'ongs ba'i sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nos pas/ bla ma rnams kyi nang nas 'di nyid la rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu 'dzin pa yin te/ nyid kyi gsung las kyang / khyad par rdo rje 'chang chen rat+na'i mtshan/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog dam pa las/ /sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nyer nos pas/ /bka' drin che ba'i bla ma'i mchog tu bzung / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub las dam pa'i chos gsan tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen po rang gi gsung las/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs la ches zab pa'i/ /kyai rdor rgyud gsum gsang mtha' gur mgon sogs/ /thun mong ma yin yid chos gnad rnams zhus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bya ba spyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i rigs gsum spyi dbang / rnam 'joms ma ṇi badz+ra lugs kyi dbang sogs smin byed dbang gi rnam gzhag bcu phrag gsum du lnga phrag gcig gis lhag pa rnams dang / dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi rigs lnga phrag gsum tsam dang / gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ don zhags lha lnga/ gur mgon lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / zur bka' bzhi bcu lhag pa tsam sogs 'di dag kyang rgyab rten gyi yig cha so so'i lung dang / gzhan yang dges pa rdo rje rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka'/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i lung bshad sogs dang /

chos rje mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa rang nyid kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung sogs mchog tu zab pa'i chos kyi bka' drin mang du gsan te thugs su chud par mdzad nas/ yang rje 'dis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang zhal mi gnyis pa'i rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rin chen gyi drung du snga phyir gsan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ rdo rje phreng ba kri ya sa muñtsa dang bcas pa'i dbang / bde mchog nag po pa'i chos skor yongs rdzogs/ sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang / blo sbyong gi skor/ rje mus chen rang nyid kyi gsung 'bum kyi lung sogs gsan cing / mdor na sngar gsan pa'i gdams ngag mang po yang bskyar nas gsan par mdzad de/ nyid kyi gsung las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug bud+dha rat+na las/ /sngar gyi gdams ngag phal cher bskyar nas nyan/ /gzhan yang gsang 'dus rigs gsum blo sbyong spyod/ /kri ya sa muñtsa la sogs mang du thos/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /gzhan yang thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po la dus 'khor ba sa lugs kyi dbang / sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid/ tha snyad rig pa la/ sgra ka tsan gnyis 'grel pa yan lag dang bcas pa sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas/ tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long / mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos sna tshogs gsal ba'i nyer mkho bsdus pa sogs mang du gsan cing / gsan pa de dag kyang ming tsam ma yin pa tshig dang don du bcas pa legs par dgongs shing thugs su chud pas phyi nang gi rig gnas gang la yang thogs pa med pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur pa yin te/ nyid kyi gsung las/ 'gos lo dharma pa la'i zhal snga nas/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur sa lugs dang / /jo zha lugs kyi sbyor drug la sogs zhus/ /ka la tsan+t+ra rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /sna tshogs gsal ba snyan ngag me long dang / /dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs tha snyad kyi/

/gtsug lag phal cher zhus shing nan tan bgyis/ /rang gzhan rkyen dang rnam 'gyur la sogs pa/ /dus dang don la 'jug tshul cung zad shes/ /saṃskṛ ta dang bod kyi klog tshul la/ /snga rabs 'chad tshul rab tu mang na yang / /skyon med 'bri dang brjod pa'i tshul shes pa/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan 'di nyid sku drin las/ /gzhan la 'chad dam rang nyid nyams su len/ /ji ltar byed kyang lag nom mi dgos tsam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gzhan yang chag lo tsā ba rin chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang / lus dkyil lha nyer lnga ma'i dbang / mgon po lha bcu gnyis ma dang brgyad ma'i dbang la sogs pa zab cing dkon pa'i chos mang du gsan la/ de ltar mkhas shing grub pa'i sa brnyes pa'i bla ma'i tshogs du ma zhig las phyi nang gi chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad pas/ gzhan la 'chad pa dang rang nyid nyams su len pa sogs gang la yang thogs pa med pa'i blo gros mnga' ba zhig ste/ ji skad du/ sgra tshad bzo dang gso ba nang don rig /sdeb sbyor mngon brjod zlos gar tshig gi rgyan/ /rtsis sogs mkhas pa rnams la yongs grags pa'i/ /rig gnas phar cher gzigs pa tsam gyis dgongs/ /khyad par nyi zla lta bu'i ka tsan gnyis/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum dpal ldan dus 'khor lo/ /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i/ /gtsug lag kun la mi 'jigs spobs pa thob/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'dis yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams las phyi nang gi rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi rnams phyogs der ris med pa'i gdul bya blo gsal dad 'dun can rnams la 'chad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'da' bar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/sngon byon mkhas grub mang pos nyer bsten pa'i/ /bgrang yas chos kyi khri la mnga' mdzad nas/

/blo gsal mang po'i re ba skong mkhas pa'i/ /mgon khyod gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po nyid/ /blo gros lus dkar gangs ri'i rjes 'gro zhing / /gzhung mang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gom stabs can/ /stong phrag mkhas btsun bzang po'i khyu mchog de/ /gus pas btegs khyod lnga rig paṇ+ḍi ta/ /chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gis mdzes pa'i/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /bsnyengs bral thos bsam sgom pa'i khrir 'khod nas/ /ston pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin khyod 'od srung che/ /phyi rig gling chen bzhi la mnga' bsgyur zhing / /nang rig lhun po'i rtse mor bgrod mkhas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dbang po rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /zab mo sgrog khyod grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpe'i ri mo rnam bkra ba'i/ /thub chen rgyal ba'i zhal gyi pad+mo ni/ /skyon bral thugs kyi me long ngos yangs por/ /nges par gzigs khyod sa thob sems dpa' che/ /zhes pa ltar te/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul zhib par sus kyang brjod par dka' mod/ 'on kyang mdor bsdus pa tsam ni 'di lta ste/ rje 'dis gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya/ rtse gdong / ngor e waṃ chos ldan/ na len+t+ra/gling kha bde ba can/ chos 'khor lha sa/ byang ra sgreng sogs gnas mang por chos kyi 'khor lo ji snyed cig bskor ba'i dus rnams su shes bya'i gnas la ma nor bar spyod pa'i mkhyen rab kyi 'jug pa rnon pos/ bshad bya'i chos de/ tshig rna bar snyan zhing / chod che la dka' ba'i gnas rnams dpyis phyin zhing / byed pa gsal ba'i sgos so so'i blo dang 'tshams par bshad pas/ gdul bya rnams kyi blo gros kyi pad+mo rgyas par mdzad pa na/ nyin rang por chos kyi grwar gnas kyang skyo sun sogs gtan nas mi skye ba zhig yin par yongs su grags shing / ji snyed gsungs pa'i rnam grangs kyang / rgyud sde rin po che dri ma med pa rnams nas bshad pa'i spyi'i dbang bskur rdo rje 'phreng ba dkyil 'khor zhe gnyis/

de'i steng du kri ya sa muñtsa'i dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum ste bzhi cu zhe lnga'i dbang dang / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang rnams dang / bye brag gi dbang la kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi'i dbang la sogs pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig ste yongs bsdoms smin byed dbang gi rnam grangs brgya rtsa brgyad dang / gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa la sogs pa grol byed khrid kyi rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa bdun tsam dang rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs la sogs pa snyan brgyud zab mo'i byin rlabs kyi rim pa nyer gsum tsam dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho ste rjes su gnang ba'i bka' srol chen po gnyis dang / mi g.yo ba dkar sngon gyi rjes gnang sogs rjes gnang zur bkar grags pa bcu phrag bzhi lhag pa dang / dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi bshad bka' dang / kye rdor rgyud gsum bshad bka' sogs rgyud dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel zab mo'i bshad bka'i rnam grangs bcu gsum tsam dang / gzhan yang sor sdom/ byang sems kyi sdom pa'i bslab bya ston pa'i gsung rab du ma dang / sgra dang sdeb sbyor snyan ngag dkar rtsis la sogs pa tha snyad kyi rig pa dang / gzhan yang gong du bshad pa'i dbang khrid byin rlabs rnams kyi rgyab rten gyi bka' dang bstan bcos sogs lung gi tshogs rab tu mang po sogs chos kyi rnam grangs re re nas kyang lan grangs mang po zhig rtsom par mdzad cing / yang bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa dang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i gdul bya rnams la phan pa'i slad du legs bshad gsar du mdzad pa yang / rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la mchod yar gyi tshigs bcad/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhi la bstod pa sogs gsol 'debs dang bstod pa'i skor du ma dang / rje sangs rin dang glo bo mkhan chen pa gnyis kyi rnam thar/

gzhan yang sgrub thabs/ dkyil 'khor cho ga khrid yig lha so so'i rjes gnang gi yi ge chos skyong gi bskangs pa/ bstod pa/ nyid kyi gsan yig pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba sogs mdor na sngon med pa'i legs bshad kyi tshogs glegs bam du longs pa mdzad de/ 'di dag kyang mir mngon brjod kyis spras pas bying che/ tshig snyan ngag gis brgyan pas rna bar snyan/ don brjod bya dang 'brel bas rtogs sla/ gcod mtshams sdeb sbyor dang mthun pas brjod bde ba la sogs pa bstan bcos rtsom pa'i yon tan thams cad tshang bas mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog par byed pa kho na ste/ ji skad du/ gzhung brgya 'chad pa'i lce bde blo gsal zhing / /lung rigs 'gal 'brel dpyod pa'i 'dren byed yangs/ /sdeb legs rtsom pa'i ro 'dzin bsgyur mkhas pa'i/ /gnas lnga rig pa dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /blo bzang khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i ded dpon gyis/ /mkhas grub zhal gyi chu gter las blangs pa'i/ /dbang lung man ngag yid bzhin rin chen gyis/ /zab yangs thugs kyi bang mdzod legs bkang nas/ /slar yang skye dgu'i dbul ba sel ba'i phyir/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dgongs don rin chen mchog /rdo rje phreng ba kri ya sa muñtsar/ /legs par bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga dang / /ngan song sbyong ba dkyil 'khor bcu dang gnyis/ /rnam gzhag zur bka' lnga bcu rtsa gcig ste/ /smin byed dbang gi rnam grangs brgya dang brgyad/ /grol byed khrid kyi rim pa nyi shu bdun/ /snyan brgyud zab mo'i byin rlabs nyer gnyis lhag /rjes su gnang ba'i bka' srol chen po gnyis/ /rjes gnang zur bkar grags pa bzhi bcu lhag /rgya bod mkhas pa'i dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i/ /zab rgyas rgyud sde'i bshad bka' bcu gsum dang / /so thar byang sems sdom pa bslab byar bcas/ /sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dkar rtsis dang / /bka' dang bstan bcos glegs bam rab 'byams kyis/

/dag gsal lung gi bka' drin dang bcas pa/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i bsam pa ji lta bar/ /stsol mdzad chos kyi sbyin bdag che ba po/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar 'gal 'brel gtam byed tshe/ /lung rigs rjes su gdams pa'i mche sder gyis/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom glang po'i lus/ /'joms mdzad smra ba'i seng ge mtshungs pa med/ /legs sbyar tshig gi srad bu la brgyus pa'i/ /rgyan dang mngon brjod sdeb sbyor nor bu'i phreng / /mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog dbyangs can mgul pa'i rgyan/ /spel mkhas tshig rje tshig bdag smra mkhas po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de bas na bdag nyid chen po 'dis mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i snyan grags phyogs kun tu khyab pa la brten/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams ma bsdus par yang rang gi ngang gis 'dus shing khyad par gsung gi bdud rtsi ngom par gsol ba dang / chos kyi 'brel pa ci rigs par thob pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi slob ma yang / bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dam par bzhugs pa'i rje rang nyid kyi sku'i gcung 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku mched rnams dang / snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku mched rnams dang / rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub dang / brag dkar sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / mkhan chen dpal ldan pa/ gser gling chos rje kun dga' bkra shis pa dang / bzhi sde chos rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa dang / thub bstan yangs pa can gyi chos rje rnam pa gnyis/ chos rje dngos grub dpal 'bar ba yab sras dang / rje lcags thang rab 'byams pa/ lo nas spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos grags/

chos rje sku skye ba ngag dbang grags pa/ lhun sdings lo tsā ba nam mkha' dpal bzang sku mched dang / byang pa dus 'khor ba rin chen bzang po/ sle lung mkhan po dkon mchog rin chen/ rnal 'byor dbang po kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma/ jo nang mkhan chen ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa/ srin po ri'i mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog gro pa mkhan chen nam mkha' dbang phyug stag lung mkhan po bkra shis dpal 'byor/ gser mdog pa gzhon nu nor bzang / spa spongs chos rje dge 'dun dpal bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ skyogs lo tsa ba ngag dbang rin chen bkra shis dpal bzang po la sogs pa mkhas grub kyi slob ma mtshan nas bgrang du btub pa brgya phrag du ma byon cing / gzhan yang gdan sa chen po'i brgya dpon dang / zur chos pa bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa du ma dang / dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi chos sde chen po'i mkhan po dang / dgon pa so so'i bla ma dang / grwa tshang tha dad kyi slob dpon dang / blo gsal du ma'i 'dren pa dang / mi chen mang po'i bla ma la sogs pa mdor na bdag nyid chen po dang yul dang gnas skabs kyis ma bskal zhing / chos lung gzhan gyi dbang du ma gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal mo che zhig gis rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi thob par byas nas dad pa chen pos rigs kyi cod pan dam par 'dzin cing / sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar gyi rjes su slob pa bgrang ba las 'das kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing de dag gi slob ma dang / yang slob dang / nying slob rnams kyis kyang sa chen po 'di yongs su khyab par gyur pa ste/ ji skad du/ ting 'dzin klu dbang du mas nyer bsten pa'i/ /gting mtha' mi mngon chos dbyings thugs mtsho las/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i chu chen rab phab nas/ /bstan 'dzin rtswa ljang myu gu mang du bskyed/ /e ma 'jam mgon gnyis pa'i zhal gyi lung /

/rna ba'i kun dgar mi 'dzin mkhas pa su/ /khyod kyi zhabs sen yid 'ongs nor bu'i phreng / /spyi bo'i rgyan du mi len chen po gang / /rang gi slob ma rang dang rjes mthun pa/ /mkhas btsan bzang pos mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum/ /mdzad nus du mas mdzad pa bsam yas kyis/ /blo gsal rnams kyi blo mtsho 'gengs la brtson/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di ni rang gis thos pa dang / gzhan la bstan pa de dag thams cad kyang zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la bcud len bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus drag pos/ nyin zhag phrugs re la ji ltar mdzad pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa yang / thog mar dges pa rdo rje'i phyi nang gi bskyed rim lam dus kyi dbang rgyas par blang ba dang bcas pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i lus dkyil/ nag po pa'i mngon rtogs/ phur pa'i mngon rtogs/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi srung ba gnyis/ na ro mkha' spyod kyi nyams len/ 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag dang bcas pa/ bde mchog dkar po'i nyams len/ rdo rje lha mo'i mngon rtogs/ dmar po skor gsum gyi nyams len/ sgrol dkar gyi mngon rtogs/ thub pa mi ru sbi ṣa ra/ rnam rgyal 'joms gnyis/ mgon po'i srung zlog rgyas pa sogs lha'i rnal 'byor re re nas kyang sngags kyi bzlas pa grangs mang po dang bcas thun gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi la sogs pa'i nges pas gtan mi chag pa'i dam bca' brtan po mdzad cing / gtso che rdzogs rim gyi nyams len lta ba skyong ba dang bcas pa du ma dang / sbyor drug gi nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor dang / rlung dang 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor du mas mtshan mo'i cha phal cher 'da' bar mdzad la/ snga dro thugs dam grol nas rten gsum rnams la phyag dang bcas pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang dkar gtor cha bzhi/ nyin bar gyi dus su tshogs chos gsung ba la sogs pa'i lung dang bshad pa la sogs pa'i phyag khrid rnams mdzad/

de lta bu mi gnang ba'i skabs su phyag dpe gzigs rtog kho na mdzad cing / thun mtshams gang rigs la gtor ma brgya rtsa rgyas pa chu sbyin dang bcas pa/ dzam ser nag dbyug gu ma spun gsum/ dus 'khor gyi srung ma drug cu/ thugs rje chen po'i grul gtor/ cha gsum gtor ma rnams mdzad nas mthar shes rab snying po saṃskṛ ta'i skad du tshar gsum bdud bzlog bsngo ba smon lam dang bcas pa mdzad/ bar skabs su sku chag pa'i zhabs skor dang bcas te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa bzhi dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bstod pa du ma dang / brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha yar/ dpa' bos mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstod tshogs 'ga' yar/ dpal ldan chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi bstod pa rgyun chags/ tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs phyogs bcu ma/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i bstod pa me tog phreng 'dzin sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa mang du mdzad/ dgong mo'i cha la dbang dang byin rlabs dang rjes gnang zab mo rnams so so'i blo dang 'tshams par mdzad/ de nas yang srod thun pher rdzogs pa'i mjug tu/ bde dge phur gsum mgon po lha brgyad sogs yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo rnams rgyas par mdzad/ de nas srod thun gyi 'phro rnams rdzogs par mdzad pa la sogs mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi mnyam gzhag thugs dam rnams lta zhog chos spyod dang gtor ma'i sgrig chags tsam yang / deng sang gi dge ba la rtse gcig tu zhugs par rlom pa rnams kyis nyin zhag du mar 'bad kyang grub par dka' ba mthong zhing / de ltar rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo la g.yel ba med par bzhugs pa'i 'bras bus gnas skabs su bla ma yi dam sogs kyis zhal bstan cing rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba yin te/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis dgung lo nyi shu rtsa grangs bzhes pa'i skabs shig

rtses gdong gi sgos gzhis mdo chos gzim khang du sku mtshams mdzad nas rdo rje phur pa gtso bor gyur pa'i thugs dam gnang dus/ sa bir zhal sprod/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal gzigs pa dang / bdag nyid chen po 'di dgung lo sum cu so gnyis su phebs pa me pho byi ba'i lo na len+t+rar gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pas thog drangs/ khrid lung man ngag byin rlabs rjes gnang sogs zab rgyas kyi dam pa'i chos mang po rtsol pa na/ de'i skabs su rje sangs rgyas rin chen yang phebs te/ de nas yab sras lhan gcig tu gtsang phyogs la btegs te/ yar lam srin po ri mjal bar phebs pas/ bde mchog gi sku de bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gzigs nas sku lus la 'phar g.yo la sogs pa byung ste/ gar stabs sna tshogs mdzad cing / de nas de las bsangs pa na/ khye'u dkar po gcig gis bsu ba byas nas skor lam la phebs pas/ de'i dus su rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyis 'khor rnams la/ khong pa la gzigs snang dang nyams rtogs mang po 'khrungs gda'/ mi tsho bde mchog sngon po yin zer te/ 'di ni dkar por 'dug gsungs ba la sogs pa dang / yang lan cig mus kyi bsam gtan phug tu lo gcig hril por sku mtshams la bzhugs te/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi gsung bsnyen mthar phyin pa mdzad pa'i dus su 'khor lo bde mchog bde chen lha lnga dang / rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen rnams nam mkhar zhal gzigs shing / khyad par 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i rnam par gzigs te/ de'i skabs su sku 'khor rnams la gzigs snang rnams byung tshul dang / nyams rtogs kyang blo kha rdzogs pa tsam byung / rje sangs rgyas rin chen 'di dus kyi min pa/ sems dpa' chen po las 'jigs pa 'dug

ces rje nyid kyis gsungs zhes kyang grags shing / yang chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis zhal bstan te 'phrin las bsgrubs pa'i tshul ni/ skabs shig shab dge sdings kyi mgon khang du rgyun ring bzhugs te thugs dam dang / chos skyong gi gtor 'bul dang / bskangs pa bstod pa rgya chen po mdzad pas/ de'i dus su kyai rdor dang / rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang / khyad par las mkhan pu tra chen po lus kyi stod nyang byas pa zhig mngon sum du gzigs shing / gzhan yang chos skyong mnyes pa'i rtags/ bud med rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa dang / dzu ge mang po dges pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang byed pa gzigs te/ de nas chos skyong 'khor bcas la bstod pa dgra bgegs srog gcod kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba dang / dpal ldan lha mo'i bskang gso dngos grub rol mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis brtsams par mdzad pa yin zhes thos la/ yang de'i rjes thog zhig sgo rum du bse mgon yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du sku mtshams yun ring gnang ba'i skabs su rje btsun bir+wa pa'i sku'i bkod pa drug dang / sa chen gyi sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gzigs nas/ bir+wa pa dang sa skya pa chen po gnyis ngo bo gcig par yang dgongs shing / thugs la nyams rtogs kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par ba du ma 'khrungs zhes grags pa dang / gzhan yang skabs shig byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du tshogs bdag gi sgrub pa mdzad skabs/ gnod sbyin bse'i gdong can gyi 'tshub kyi rnam pas gzim khang gi g.yam gdung gas grum cher byung pa na/ gzim khang la zhig gsos mdzad cing bar chad las grol te/ slar sku mtshams de kha'i mu mthud nas yun ring gnang ba dang / rje btsun rin po che dang / rdo rje lha mo sogs bla ma yi dam du ma'i zhal gzigs shing / de skabs dgong phyogs sku 'chag pa la zhal 'don dang bstun rje btsun rin po che'i zan 'bum la zhabs skor rgyun du gnang gin yod pa la/

mgo zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi rje sa paṇa gyi dus chen gyi nyin/ phyag g.yog pa rab 'byams pa kun tshe bya ba dang dpon slob gnyis kyis zhabs skor la phebs pas/ rje 'dis nam mkha' la gzigs te zhabs 'bring ba de la/ khyod kyis e mthong gsungs pa dang / des kyang nam mkha' la bltas pas/ nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la 'ja' 'od zlum po shin tu legs pa gcig 'dug nas/ 'di bzhin 'dug gzhan ni ma mthong zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas ya gi na rje sa skya paṇa chen phebs 'dug 'ja' 'od de tsam mthong ba yang sgrib pa chung ba yin gsungs te/ dpon slob gnyis kas dad pa chen po mdzad pas thugs nyams 'phar ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang mdzad ces grags shing / yang lan cig gi tshe la stod lho'i sa skyong chen pos spyan 'dren gyi gsol ba btab ste zhal gyis bzhes nas/ der phebs pa'i gong rol zhig tu mkha' spyod gzim chung phug tu bzhugs pa'i skabs shig mtshan lam du/ rje sa skya pa chen po dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin nam snyam pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha lugs byas pa zhig chos rje sa paṇa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa ba rnams chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pa'i drung na bdag nyid chen po 'di phebs te the tshom mang du bcad/ khyad par nag po spyod pa ba la 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor ma lus pa gsan cing / nag po gzhung drug rdzogs mtshams mnal sad ces grags shing / de nas la stod lhor phebs te/ der snga dro thugs dam grol mtshams shig rje'i gsung gis/ da nangs tho rangs bram ze'i gzugs ral pa'i khrod na seng ldeng gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa yod pa zhig byung ste/ khyod rang gi mi 'phrod yod do zer nas/ ban+de 'phyar zhags gyon pa gnyis gtad pa'i snang ba byung / phyi na mar ltos shig dang gsungs/ sde pas sgo phye 'phral bltar btang pas/ 'bul bsdu pas btang pa yin zer ba'i sle'u gyon pa gnyis sgo drung na slebs 'dug ces gleng ba byung /

de nas yang gdan sa chen por chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te phebs lam shrī rgod tshang du bzhugs nas/ rgod tshang phug par tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdzad pas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil na bzhugs pa mngon sum du gzigs/ de nas gdan sar phebs te chos 'chad nyan rgya chen po mdzad pa'i skabs/ bzhi thog gi gzim chung mkha' spyod phug tu thugs dam mdzad dus/ 'khor rnams la khyed rnams phyir song / brda ma byung bar la su yang ma gtong gsungs nas thugs dam la sngar bas kyang rgyun ring ba bzhugs pa na/ gzim dpon gyis da nangs sku khams nyog pa min lags sam zhus pas/ nyog pa min da nangs bde ba can yin zer ba'i zhing khams yid du 'ong ba zhig tu slebs/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med la sangs rgyas byang sems mang pos bskor ba dang / rje sa skya pa yab sras/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen rnams kyang bzhugs 'dug de rnams kyi drung na rin po che'i khri shin tu mdzes pa gnyis 'dug pa'i cung mtho ba la mtha' skor du mchod pa'i lha mang pos mchod rdzas thogs nas 'khod pa/ steng na gdugs phub pa zhig 'dug pa der khyod sdod zer nangs ngas bsdad/ cung dma' ba der gzhan zhig phebs rgyu yin pa'i mtshan don byung ba brjed 'dug gsungs/ nga yod dus khri de stong par yod/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi drung du chos mang du thob/ zhing khams de las yid du 'ong ba mi 'dug gsungs/ nan gyis tshul snang zhus pas gnyid sad pa'i snang ba byung gsungs shing / de nas ha cang rgyun mi ring ba zhig na glo bo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa na/ de dus bdag nyid chen po'i gsung las/ kha sang bde ba can gyi zhing khams na yod pa'i khri stong pa de mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'byon pa'i ltas su 'dug ces gsungs par grags la/ de ltar bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis zhal gzigs lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad cing /

de la brten nas nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma yang mngon du mdzad/ phyi rol tu grub pa'i mtshan ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' mdzad pa zhig ste/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis lha sar jo bo shākya mu ne mjal bar phebs pa'i lam du skye chu bya ba'i chu bo de la grur zhugs nas phebs pas gru bying nas shin tu nyen che ba byung pa na/ rje 'dis rje sangs rgyas rin chen la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bya rog gcig gru'i rta mgo'i steng du byung nas 'jigs pa las grol ba dang / gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis byang ra sgreng bskor bar phebs te slar yang phebs pa'i lam du bla ma dge dga' ba bya ba dang / mal gro sgrub chen pa'i slob ma bla ma sbal pa blo gros bya ba sbyor drug gi thugs dam shin tu smin pa gnyis kyi rmi ltas su rje 'di 'jam dbyangs dngos yin pa'i mtshan ma sogs rtags khyad par ba mang du byung bar grags pa dang / khyad par 'bab rong gi gnas mchog tu phebs pa'i tshe/ phebs lam kyi brag srub cig tu skye bo mang po la 'dre srin gyi gnod pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir rdo la zhabs kyi rjes shin tu gsal ba 'jog pa mdzad pa na/ de nyid kyi snyan grags la brten sku tshe'i bar chad du song dogs/ mtho'i 'og tu gnon gsungs pa'i bka' phebs pa bzhin 'khor rnams kyis bka' bzhin bsgrubs zhes nyid kyi sku 'khor ba rnams gleng bar grags shing / gzhan yang de skabs dgun shin tu grang ba'i dus yin kyang brag gseb nas 'jam dbyangs me tog mang po 'khrungs pa sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas/ 'phags pa bsdus pa tshigs su bcad pa sogs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs rnams las byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags su gang bshad pa thams cad bdag nyid chen po 'di la mnga' ba yin la/ de bas na rje btsun sa skya pa zhes snyan pa'i grags pas rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs su khyab pa'i gdung gi rigs su 'khrungs pa la bdag nyid chen po sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gyi dge legs tsam gyis kyang skal ldan blo gsal rnams kyi snying gi chu skyes bzhad par nus pa de nyid khu dbon dang /

bod yul mun pa'i gling 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me chen po legs par sbar te/ byang grol thar pa'i lam gyi rgyu'i gtso bo lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che'i srol chen kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir gsar du gtod par mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam par sprul pa'i sku dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum na g.yo ba ste skyes chen mchog de byon pa'i phyi nas/ bdag nyid chen po 'di bas mkhas pa'i yon tan phul du byung ba gzhan ma byon par sa chen po la gnas pa'i skye bo mkhas blun yongs la grags shing grub la/ btsun pa dang bzang po'i yon tan gnyis ni/ rgyas par phye na bsam gyis mi khyab mod/ mdor bsdus pa ni/ ji skad du/ khyod thugs dag pa'i nam mkhar tshigs gsum gyi/ /tshul khrims yar ngo'i cha shas yongs 'phel zhing / /nges par 'byung ba'i chu shel las grub pa'i/ /gzhan la mi gnod btsun pa'i 'od dkar can/ /byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor cher rgyas pa'i/ /sems nyid nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mun pa dpyis 'byin pa'i/ /phan bde'i lam bzang gsal mdzad skye dgu'i sgron/ /zab don ljon shing dam tshig rtsa ba brtan/ /rim gnyis yal 'dab lag len me tog rgyas/ /zung 'jug 'bras bu'i khur ldan 'phrin las kyi/ /grib bsil g.yo ldan rig 'dzin dpag bsam shing / /zhes btsun pa'i yon tan dang / bgrang yas yon tan kun gyi rtser 'dzegs kyang / /mngon par khengs pa'i mdung gi ba dan bsnyal/ /skye dgu kun gyi gtsug gis rab btud kyang / /kun gyi 'bangs ltar gzhan gyi don la dges/ /spyod lam kun tu zhi zhing dul ba'i thugs/ /grogs ngan sdug bsngal zab mo thos mi skrag /skad cig nyon mongs go skabs g.yo min pas/ /mchog tu zhi bas gzhan gyi khro ba'ang 'joms/

/rnyed dang ma rnyed la sogs mgo snyoms shing / /'phongs dang mgon med rgud pa kun las 'dzin/ /zab bcas 'phrin las ngang gis myur mdzad cing / /rtag tu 'dren pa kun gyi bran du bzhugs/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong rdo rje lta bu'i sku/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu chos char 'bebs pa'i gsung / /snying rje gzhan dbang gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /khyod kyi mdzad pa byis blo'i yul las 'das/ /e ma bdag ni tshul 'di mthong bas kyang / /skyon med rnam par thar pa bsam yas kyis/ /mgon khyod gzhan las bzang por sgrub min te/ /phyogs 'di kho nas spu ldang mchi ma g.yo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyis dgung lo bcu gcig nas brtsams te/ bzhi cu rtsa brgyad pa chu pho 'brug gi lo ma rdzogs kyi bar du bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum spel mar mdzad pas thugs shin tu rangs par gyur cing / snyigs ma'i skye bo ngan pa rnams kyi spyod tshul rnams gzigs pas thugs cung zad gdung bar gyur pa na/ zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa la mngon du phyogs par gyur te/ de'i snga ltas su sa g.yo ba dang / nam mkha' la mi shis pa'i skar ma mjug phod can gcig kyang shar zhing / rtsis pa rnams kyis kyang / da lo rje 'di la sku dog shin tu che zer ba byung pa na/ kun sems yed yed bor gyur te/ de'i skabs su thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis rje 'di la deng sang mtshan ltas la sogs pa ji ltar byung / phyi lo 'di dgung steng yin pas sku dog bzhin ni med lags sam/ zhes zhu bar mdzad pa na/ bdag nyid chen po'i gsung gis/ deng sang rmis ltas la sogs pa gang yang ma byung / kha sang snga gong za zi bzhin kha cig byung ba glo bo mkhan chen chos kyi rje zhing gzhan du gshegs pa la lta ba yin nam snyam pa zhig byung ste/

de ka rkyang pa min pa 'dra/ phyi lo 'di la dog cha phran bu yod nyen ka che zhes gsungs/ de la rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ 'o na de la dmigs nas sku rim dang / sku mtshams sogs mdzad nas yun ring du zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'brel gnang dgongs zhus pas/ rje'i gsung gis/ rim 'gro sogs sngar yang gang grub byas/ da rung rim pas byed rtsis yin/ 'tshams dam pa zhig byed snyam na'ang / kha sang nas chos 'chad pa dang / deng sang gdan sa 'di pa rnams la mdun chags shig yong re nas 'gyangs pa yin/ 'di tsho'i brel ba chod 'phral la mtshams byed ces gsungs pa la sogs pa zhing khams gzhan du 'byon pa'i bka' du ma snga rol nas stsal pa dang / gzhan yang sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i ltas du ma snga gong nas byung bar grags shing / de nas sbrul lo zla ba dang po'i tshes nyi shu skor la rin chen sgang gzim khang du phebs nas sku mtshams bug sgo 'dag sbyar mdzad de thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig tu bzhugs shing thun mtshams rnams la gsung rtsom 'phro can rnams kyang grub par mdzad/ zla ba lnga pa'i nyer bzhi lnga tsam nas gzhan ngor zhabs cung zad bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan nas/ de skabs kyang thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig tu bzhugs shing / skabs 'gar khyed rnams ma 'dug par mchod pa gsar pa shoms zhes pa yang yang gsungs/ de dag gi skabs su nam mkha' bai ḍu ra ya'i mdog ltar shin tu dwangs shing snum pa la nyi ma'i 'od zer sngar bas kyang gsal ba dang / lha'i me tog gi char bsam gyis mi khyab pa babs pa na/ sku 'khor rnams yid ma bde nas/ 'di ltar 'dug lags pa ci 'dra lags sam zhus pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa la la bltams pa dang / la la mya ngan las 'da' ba la sogs pa'i tshul ston pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ de kun gyi ltas yin mod gsungs shing / gzhan gyi sems bsrung ba'i phyir du yal yol mdzad/

tshes bcu'i snga dro'i dus da lta sku khams gso ba'i mnal cung zad cig mdzad na nyin mo sku khams dwangs pa yong lags sam zhus pas/ de tsam 'dug long med ces gsungs shing / zhing khams 'di'i mdzad pa re zhig rdzogs pa dang / zhing khams gzhan du gdul bya rgya che ba la dgongs nas rtag 'dzin can rnams nges 'byung bskyed pa dang / le lo can rnams brtson 'grus la bskul ba'i ched du chos kyi rje 'di nyid dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa dgur phebs pa chu mo sbrul gyi lo chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyi ma dro bar tsam la gdan sa chen po'i bla brang rin chen sgang nyid du gzugs kyi sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad cing / de nas phyi dro'i cha la babs pa na thams cad kyis gsan pa'i thag sgra shin tu che ba dang bcas te dbu'i gtsug gi thod pa sor gang tsam gcig gtsug tor gyi tshul gyis 'phags pa la byang sems kyi zil pa khrom me ba dang bcas par gyur cing / de ma thag nas sngar su zhig gi sna'i yul du tshor ma myong ba'i lha rdzas kyi spos kyi dri bsung khyad par can gyis gzim khang gi steng 'og thams cad khyab pa dang / kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'ja' tshon gyi ri mos mdzes pa'i nam mkha' las me tog gi char chen po babs pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ rgyud sde nas 'byung ba'i 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor gyis bde ba can gyi zhing khams su dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bsu ba dang bcas gshegs par gyur to/ /de ltar sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid kyi gsung las skyes pa'i bstan 'dzin kyi slob bu rnams kyi khrod nas/ lugs 'di'i chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs rdzogs nos pa gcung bdag chen nam mkha' tshe brtan gyi zhal snga nas ni rtag tu zab mo'i nyams len la brtson par bzhugs pas nyams rtogs kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur cing / stong gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin rab tu brtan la/

sa skya pa'i chos skyong rnams bran bzhin du 'khol ba zhig yin no zhes thos la/ yang sa lo nyid las dus 'khor rdzogs par gsan pa'i chos rje lcags thang rab 'byams pa ni/ 'chad nyan gyi ngang nas thugs dam la brtson pas nyams rtogs bzang po thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / lhag par bo dong / bya rgod gshongs su mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan la rtsal du bton te/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa la zhabs 'degs ngo mtshar can mdzad pa de yin zhing / chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje ni/ sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi steng nas/ sa los dus 'khor gyi chos gsungs pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan te/ kha'u brag rdzong zhing skyong dbang po'i me 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang gi bya 'dabs bskyed lhas sgrub sder gcig tu nyams bzhes la dril nas bzhugs pas/ srog rtsol rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin te/ rgyu ba gsal ba dang / rnam pa nges pa sogs kyi nyams rtags rnams mthar phyin cing / mnyam rjes kun tu stong gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin brtan pas nyams la gang shar gyi spyod pa skyong ba las 'phral gyi mdzad pa mi su dang yang mi bstun pa zhig yod ces bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyis gsung las thos shing / mdor na grub pa'i sa la bzhugs pas skyed lhas dang / byas 'gyur gyi bar la yar 'phur mar 'phur mdzad pa las dag pa 'gas mthong zhing / grub thob dpal rdor ba zhes yongs su grags pa de yin la sa lo chen po'i thugs sras bstan 'dzin kun rgyan du 'gyur pa ni/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po sku mched sogs dang / rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub rnams te/ de yang gcen bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub ni/ 'khrungs ma thag nas rang grol gyi grub thob chen por gyur te/ ri dwags sogs sems can bsad nas gso bar nus pa dang / 'bri mo la byin rlabs mdzad de/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa la g.yag rwa lnga 'byung ba'i bka' bsgo mdzad pas/

ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin byung ba'i g.yag gi mgo bo da lta yang rtse gdong na yod pa dang / bsam yas chos skyong chen pos kyang / sngags 'chang chen po'i drung du byon pa zhig gi tshe/ khyed kyi gcen po rtse gdong dge bshes kyis nyi ma re re bzhin grub rtags mi 'dra ba mang po ston gyin 'dug kyang / de grub rtags su shes pa nged gzugs med rnams min pa mi 'dug gsungs pa sogs bsngags brjod du ma mdzad pa dang / mdor na 'phral gyi mdzad pa rnams kyang grub pa'i spyod pa ya ma zung so so skye bo'i blo'i yul du shong bar dka' ba kho na mdzad pa'i grol ba mchog gi sa la bzhugs pa'i rtsod pa dang bral ba'i skyes bu chen po zhig yin la/ de nyid kyi gcung rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba gnyis pa ltar gyur pa ni/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i me ro gso ba la bsam na du sku skye ba bzhes pa de nyid kyi sku tshe 'di'i sngon rol tu thabs la mkhas pa'i sprul pa'i sku du mar bstan te/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ sngags 'chang bla ma bstan pa'i nyi ma grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'di nyid ni/ dus gsum rgyun mi chad par zhing khams ji snyed par gdul bya so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i sku dang mtshan gyi rnam pa tha dad du bstan nas/ gdul bya'i 'gro ba 'khor du ma 'dus pa rnams bsdus pa/ bsdus pa rnams smin/ smin pa rnams grol/ grol ba rnams mthar phyin pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa yin no/ /de yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de nyid thog mar sngags kyi lam du zhugs pa'i skal ldan rnams kyi ngor/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag sdud pa po mchog tu gyur pa gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje zhes bya bar grags shing /

theg pa chen po'i rigs can rnams kyi ngor/ theg pa chen po'i bka' dag sdud pa po kun tu bzang po zhes bya bar grags la/ gdul bya nyan thos pa rnams kyi ngor/ mdo sde'i sde snod sdud pa po dgra bcom pa kun dga' bo zhes bya bar grags shing / yang bod gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mdo rgyud kyi chu gter chen po spel ba la mtshungs pa dang bral ba'i lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na zhes grags shing / slar yang blang dor gyi rnam gzhag tshul bzhin du ston pa'i rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bar grags pas rgya bod hor gsum gyi gdul bya skal ldan rnams dam pa'i chos la 'god par mdzad nas/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i mchog gi sprul skur gyur te/ zhing de'i gdul bya rnams phan bde la 'god par mdzad pa yin la/ de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i snang ba ji snyed cig bstan pa de dag gi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa bzang po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas gos dkar lcang los mdzes pa'i skur sprul te/ snyigs dus kyi skye bo gdug pa can rnams zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad pa ni dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa 'di nyid yin la/ de lta bu'i sprul pa'i sku'i snang ba de dag sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig gi ngo bor grub pa'i tshul sogs rgyal ba'i lung tshad ma dang sbyar na/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal ba'i sras po kun tu bzang po/ nyan thos chen po kun dga' bo ste mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i sdud pa po rnams ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang dbyer med yin pa'i tshul ni/ gsang ba grub pa'i rgyud las/ 'di yi sdud par byed pa po/

/gzhan dag yod pa ma yin zhes/ /bdag nyid 'ba' zhig smra bar byed/ /bsdus mdzad pa ni thugs rdo rje/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las kyang / 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga / /zhes gsungs pa 'dis grub/ khyad par kun tu bzang po dang kun dga' bo gnyis ngo bo dbyer med yin pa ni/ gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud las/ de nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'khor phun sum tshogs par bshad par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ 'jam dpal ni rgyal po chen po zas gtsang mar gyur to/ /'jig rten dbang phyug ni lha mo chen mo sgyu 'phrul du gyur to/ /dpal lha mo ni grags 'dzin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ni sgra gcan 'dzin no/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel ba ni shā ri'i bu'o/ /kun tu bzang po ni kun dga' bor gyur to/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin ni gnas brtan lha sbyin no/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub par gyur to/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis grub/ don de dag la dgongs nas mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rabs kyi don bsdus tshul gsum gsal rgyan las/ khyad par 'khor gyi gtso bo sdud pa po/ /ston pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las/ /gzhan ngor sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /'og min gnas dang gsung rab/ me tog rgyan gyis brgyan/ /mi mjed zhing dang khyad par mi yi ngor/ /rim bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bzang / /gsang ba'i bdag po kun dga' bo zhes grags/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /bai ro tsa na dang kun dga' bo thugs rgyud gcig pa ni/ pad+ma thang yig las/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa nas/ /shākya thub pa'i nye gnas kun dga' bo/ /tshe 'phos longs sku'i zhing khams mang nyul nas/ /mi lus chos ldan skye ba bdun gyi mtha'/ /gtsang gi snye mo bye mkhar zhes bya yi/

/gnas gzhi gcig gi brang khang mig dgu na/ /pha ming dpa' gor he 'dod ces bya dang / /ma ming bran ka gza' sgron skyid kyi bu/ /gan byag thang tha zhes bya lo brgyad pa/ /de la bslabs pas lo tsā rtsod med 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa 'dis grub/ sa skya paṇa chen dang bai ro tha dad med pa ni/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma kong po spu ri phug mo che nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lung bstan bka' rgya'i las can nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lung bstan las/ lo tsā dpa' gor bai ro tsa na khyod/ /tshe rabs skal bzang da dus tshigs la phan/ /de bzhin ma 'ongs dus kyi mthar thug pa/ /rim bzhin 'gro rnams 'dren dang bstan pa skyong / /khyad par dmu rgod 'dul mgo 'chol ba'i tshe/ /sa zhes bya ba shākya'i zhing khams su/ /sgra bsgyur lo tsā paṇ+ḍi blo stobs can/ /sa skyong rgyal po'i mchod gnas byed pa ste/ /dmu rgod kha gnon 'gro la phan pa pa 'byung / /brgyud mang rim bzhin de bzhin bsam mi khyab/ /ces lung bstan pa 'dis grub/ de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal rje sa paṇa dang ngo bo gcig pa ni/ sngon rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus zin pa'i dus re zhig gi tshe na/ rje sa paṇa la rje btsun rin po che dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang / grub chen nag po pa gsum gyis sku'i snang ba dngos su bstan cing rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas/ khyod skye ba 'di'i 'og rol tu mkha' la gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin par gyur nas/ sa lam gyi rtogs pa phal cher bgrod/ de nas rgya gar shar phyogs mu mu na'i zhing khams su rgyal po nyi ma'i stobs 'phel gyi bur gyur te 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad can gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams yongs su sbyong bar byed cing / de nas skye ba bzhi pa la mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro/

/zhes lung bstan pa 'dis 'grub/ de ltar na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku'i snang ba ji snyed pa de dag bai ro tsa na dang thugs rgyud gcig yin zhing / de dang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po nyid tha dad med pa ni/ gsang ba'i lung bstan gab rgya can las/ da lta'i lo tsā bai ro tsa na khyod/ /nges don rnam snang gangs can mtsho zhes grags/ /longs sprul byang sems du mas 'gro ba 'dren/ /gsung gi sprul pa drang don bcu gsum gyi/ /tha ma 'khon gyi rigs la grags pa'i mtshan/ /bdud kyi nye mtshams gsang sngags bstan pa skyong / /byang sems drag gtum ma nges snang tshul can/ /de dang 'brel tshad skye ba gsum nas grol/ /dri snying rta sogs lag gis gang reg pa/ /ngan song skye sgo chod de nges tshig yin/ /legs ldan de la bdud mo'i bar chad dam/ /rgya nag khams nas lha bu'i bdud la gzob/ /de dus thugs sprul zag med dam pa dang / /'phrad na 'gro la phan pa dpag med 'byung / /tshe mthar phyin zhing bar chad tshogs las rgyal/ /khyad par stod hor bdud sprul zil gyis gnon/ /sprul pas sems can don la sgrib g.yogs med/ /mtha' yas longs sku chen po'i zhing khams su/ /nges par snying la chongs shig sa ma ya/ /zhes dang / snang rtse gter ston pas chos 'khor lha sa'i sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi sku rgyab kyi gter nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'khor ba las sgrol gyi chos kyi lo rgyus/ lung byang gsal ba'i sgron me las/ bai ro'i skye ba 'khon rigs glang lo pa/ /grags pa'i ming can chos bdag skyes bu 'byung / /de la gtad pas sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel/ /zhes dang / yang sprul sku snang rtse bas khyung tshang brag gi pad+ma bcu phud nas gdan drangs pa'i dam 'dzin lha sras skye rgyud las/ de lta'i lo tsā bai ro tsa na khyod/ /'khon gyi rigs la grags pa'i ming 'chang ste/ /zab chos 'di dang 'phrad na tshe mthar phyin/

/bstan pa dbus khams yongs la spel bar byed/ /ces lung bstan pa 'dis grub pa yin no/ /'di dag ni gang zag 'ga' zhig la skyes bu dam pa 'di zhes bya ba'i rnam par sprul ba'o/ /zhes zog rdzus can dag gi long ba 'khar 'dzugs kyis rang gzhan gnyis phung las la sbyor ba'i tshul dang mi 'dra ba'i/ dri ma med pa'i lung tshad mas grub pa 'di ni kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /gzhan ngor sprul sku du ma'i zlos gar gyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don mang mdzad pa 'di/ /sngags 'chang bla ma'i sngon gyi skyes rabs yin/ /gnyis pa da ltar gyi sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam spel ba la don gnyis te/ tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang / de'i don rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ phyi ma ni sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid kyi rnam thar rgyas pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho zhes bya ba kho bos logs su byas pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /'dir tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas mdor bstan tsam zhig brjod na/ 'di lta ste/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen zhing brtse ba las/ /nus mthu gcig bsdus dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /dri med rigs su bsam bzhin skur bstan pa/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen zhes grags pa'i/ /skyes mchog de nyid me mo glang lor bltams/ /bcu bdun bar du sa skya lo tsā che/ /'bral med bsten te dam chos mang du nos/ /de nas yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub dang / /dpal ldan bkra shis ngag dbang chos grags zhabs/ /sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen legs blo sogs/ /gus pas bsten nas dbang khrid man ngag lung / /rjes gnang byin rlabs bka' gtad la sogs pa/ /grangs med gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod bzung nas/ /byas 'gyur rdo rje brag rdzong la sogs pa'i/ /gnas mchog du mar dges rdor bde mchog dang /

/rdo rje phur ba chos skyong gur zhal sogs/ /lha mchog zhi khro rab 'byams du ma yi/ /grangs dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho bran ltar 'khol/ /de tshe bstan la gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs rnam shes dbyings su bsgral/ /de dag ma 'ong srid pa'i rgyun yang bcad/ /gzhan yang rang gi snang ngor dag snang las/ /ma 'das mod kyang gdul bya gzhan gyi ngor/ /dka' spyad drag pos bstan dang 'gro ba'i phyir/ /sku srog nyid kyang gtong la mi zhum pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po ches/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen kun bsal nas/ /snang srid lha mi thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /de nas sngon byon gong ma'i gnas kyi mchog /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /gtsug lag khang chen nyams pa rnams gsos te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang mchod chas bkang / /gzhan yang 'gro ba'i bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir/ /ngo mtshar mchod pa'i rten dang mchod pa'i rdzas/ /yid 'phrog khang bzang du ma'ang gsar du spel/ /khyad par rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal mdzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen brgya phrag mang po 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen dang / /gsang sngags 'dzin pa du ma 'du ba'i gnas/ /bde ba chen po'i gling sogs legs btab ste/ /bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / /mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis/ /bde gshegs bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar spel/ /gzhan yang rdo rje 'chang dngos sa skya pa'i/ /gong ma dgongs pa chos dbyings mnyam bzhag pa/ /de dag thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir dges rdor dang / /bde mchog gsang 'dus yang phur la sogs pa/ /dri med rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /bsgrub cing mchod dang bdag 'jug len pa dang / /slob ma dbang bskur la sogs lo re bzhin/ /ma nyams dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel bar mdzad/ /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi/

/sna tshogs thabs mkhas du mas gdul bya rnams/ /gang la gang 'dul tshul du legs bskyangs te/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di rdzogs ldan bde la bkod/ /sngon tshe chos rgyal mes dbon de dag gis/ /bstan pa rin chen bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul/ /bsam las 'das mod sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /rnam par sprul ba de dag 'das pa'i rjes/ /gangs can khrod 'dir kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs chen mdzad pa la/ /sngags 'chang nyid las ngo mtshar che ba gzhan/ /med ces deng dus dpyod ldan yongs la grags/ /de lta'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po de/ /re brgyad bzhes pa shing pho spre'u'i lo/ /gro bzhin zla ba'i yar ngo'i bcu gnyis la/ /sa skya'i lha chen lhun grub pho brang du/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim tshul bstan/ /de lta'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog de nyid las/ /brgyud 'dzin slob bu mang du 'phel ba yi/ /kun gyi mchog ni chos dang rigs kyi sras/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug puṇ+ya in+t+ra dang / /sems dpa' chen po grags pa blo gros mtshan/ /gzhan yang bstan pa gsal mdzad bshes gnyen tshogs/ /nyi zla bzhin du grags pas yongs khyab cing / /skar phran bzhin du bgrang ba'i yul 'das pas/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di yongs su khyab gyur te/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin po che/ /dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel ba'i dge mtshan 'di/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /kun dga' rin chen gang gi rnam thar yin/ /zhes so/ /mdor na sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes pa'i sprul pa'i sku gdon mi za ba yin pa'i phyir gzhan las ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa 'di ltar snang ste/ de yang dam pa 'di'i mdo sngags kyi zab rgyas kyi chos tshul gsan pa rnams la bsams na sku tshe hril por yongs 'dzin dam pa du ma las dam pa'i chos gsan pa kho na mdzad pa lta bu/ yang dben gnas ri khrod rnams su thugs dam zab mo la gcig tu gzhol bas nyams rtogs bzang po 'khrungs tshul rnams dang /

yi dam zhi khro du ma dang / rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyi gsang sngags zab mo mang po'i bye bsnyen mdzad tshul rnams la bsams na sku tshe ril por zab bzhes la chig sgril kho na mdzad pa lta bu/ yang sa skya ba'i yab chos dri ma med pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang khrid lung man ngag rjes gnang bka' gtad sogs zab mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul rnams la bsams na sku tshe hril por chos kyi 'khor lo kho na bskor ba lta bu/ yang bstan pa'i dgra bo lha gnas gnyis kyis thog grangs pa'i bdud kyis gnas mal snying la bcas pa'i stobs ldan gyi gdug pa can mang po/ sa skya pa'i bka' srung khyad par can rnams bran du bkol te drag po mngon spyod kyi las sbyor gyi sgo nas gtan brlag tu mdzad de rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba'i tshul rnams bsams na sku tshe hril por las sbyor kho na mdzad pa lta bu/ yang bsam yas dang sa skya sogs kyi gtsug lag khang mang po'i zhig gsos mdzad tshul dang gsar bzhengs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa/ mdo sngags kyi dge 'dun gyi sde gsar 'dzugs gnang ba rnams la bsams na sku tshe hril po gtsug lag khang dang / dge 'dun sde'i zhabs tog dang gsar 'dzugs kho na mdzad pa lta bu/ yang lho bod dbus gtsang gi khyon 'di rgyun chad med par zhabs kyis bcags shing dgon che chung / grwa bu slob/ bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i sbyin bdag sa skyong chen po rnams lugs gnyis 'phrin las kyi sgo nas bskyangs tshul rnams la bsams na sku tshe ril por de kho na mdzad pa lta bu/yang bde kye gsang gsum/ yang phur/ chos skyong che chung / gzhan yang yi dam zhi khro du ma dang bcas pa'i sgrub dkyil/ dbang rjes gnang sogs kyi yig cha dang gsol 'debs/ nyams mgur/ zhal gdams kyi tshogs du ma/ rab gnas sogs dang / gzhan yang gdan sa chen po'i dus ja/ dkar me/ sgrub mchod rnams dang /

dbyar chos dgun chos dus rim che chung sogs kyi 'phral gyi dge rgyun gtong dgos kyi deb chen/ zhal ngo che 'don sogs dang bstan pa'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa'i deb chen/ 'bul sdud kyi deb/ gdan sa mdzod chen gyi deb sogs dang / gtsug lag khang mang po'i deb chen/ chos sde che chung mang po'i bca' yig sogs dang bstan pa'i rgyun la phan nges pa'i gsung rab mdzad pa rnams la bsams na sku tshe hril por bstan bcos rtsom pa kho na mdzad pa lta bu sogs mdor bsdus na skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar gyi mdzad pa'i cha shas gang la bsams kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa kho na las ma 'das pa 'di ni grub mtha' ngan pa dang / yul dus kyis ma bskal ba'i skyes bu blo gzu bor gnas shing rnam dpyod dang ldan pa kun la rlung ltar grags pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i sprul ba'i skyes chen sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyis/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i drung du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin grol gyis bsdus pa'i chos tshul rnams rgyas par gsan te/ rgyun pa'i thugs dam gyi tshe yang dus 'khor bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang / dus 'khor maṇ+ḍal sogs chag med du mdzad pa'i rgyun da lta'i bar du yod pa 'di yin la/ de ltar dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod nas/ da ni kho bo cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gnyis kyi rnam par thar ba cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de'ang rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gnyis kyi/ gcen 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'jig rten mthun 'jug sogs gang yang mi mdzad par grags shing / lhag pa'i lha zhi khro du ma rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams dang bcas pa'i gsang sngags zab mo rnams kyi gsung bzlas kyi grangs blos dpag par dka' ba zhig mdzad la/

de la brten nas yi dam zhi khro du ma dang / chos skyong du mas zhal gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs pas/ 'phral gyi mdzad pa yang grub pa'i spyod pa ya ma zung la sus kyang ma thul ba'i 'jig rten na dregs pa kun kyang 'dar bar mdzad nus pa dang / gzhan yang skam sar chu 'don pa dang / brag la zhabs rjes 'jog pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa stod mnga' ris/ bar dbus gtsang gi cha dang / de'i nang nas kyang za phu'i gnas chen rnams su yang yang ston par mdzad pa dang / lhag par slob dpon pad+ma'i gter sku tshe chu ma la gsol 'debs mdzad pas tshe chu dngos su byung ba dang / byas 'gyur du gzigs snang la zangs mdog dpal ri pad+ma 'od dang / slob dpon rin po che gtso 'khor rnams yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams rdo rje'i chos skyong du ma dang bcas pas bskor ba zhal bstan cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can byung ba sogs gang nas bsams kyang pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul lam/ rjes su bzung ba'i mthu stobs can zhig yin par gdon mi za ste/ de bzhin yin pa'i zhal bzhes bdag nyid chen po rang nyid kyis kyang mdzad de/ dam pa 'di nyid dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim par nye ba'i sprel lo hor zla drug pa bdun pa'i skabs su nged rang dang sa skyar mjal dus/ shin tu dges pa'i ngang nas nged rang dpon slob thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i legs lam la brten nas sngar su la yang ma gnang ba'i tshe sgrub chig brgyud ma gnyis dang / lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab khyad can sogs gnang ba'i tshe/ spyir thugs dkyil nas bzhar ba'i 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya du ma dang / lhag par bstan pa'i rtsa ba gdan sa chen po'i lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong spel gsum rnams 'chug mi 'chug khyed rang la rag las pas/ gang spyi'i spang blang 'di bzhin gyis sogs bka' stsal pa'i mdo la/ nga ni slob dpon pad+ma rang mkhyen bsam pa 'di kho na min pa gzhan nyams len gang yang byed rgyu med ces gsungs byung ba dang /

yang rje 'di'i gsung rtsom rang rig dbang bskur gyi sgom tshul gcig shes kun grol zhes bya ba'i mjug na/ pad+mas rjes bzung ban rgan mgo dkar ba/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang gsung rtsom du ma'i mjug tu de 'dra ba mang du 'byung bas pad+mas rjes su bzung ba zhal gyis bzhes par go zhing / mdor na kun gyis zhal dkyil mthong ba tsam gyis dbang du 'du ba'i skyes bu chen po zhig go /'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid kyi gcung bdag gi bla ma rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid ni nges pa kho nar rgya gar gyi mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho dang / bod 'dir yang 'gran zla dang bral ba'i 'gro ba'i 'dren pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nyid gdon mi za ba yin ི tshul slob dpon rin po che'i ma 'ongs lung bstan las gsal bar gsungs pa sogs yid ches pa'i gtan tshigs ngo mtshar du ma dang ldan pa'i phyir de'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar brjod kyis ga la lang / 'on kyang rang re so so skye bo'i snang ngo tsam du bstan tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ yon tan gyi tshogs gang yang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul gyis chos dang srid kyi bya ba gang la yang thugs skyel dang / thugs ngang ring po'i sgo nas gang yang 'jam dar gyi tshul gyis skyong ba la shin tu mkhas pas/ dmu rgod su gang gis 'dul bar ma nus pa rnams kyang rang gi ngang gis 'dul bar mdzad cing / kun gyis sems dpa' chen po zhes sgrog cing 'dzin pa yin la/ mdor na sngags 'chang bla ma sprul ba'i sku ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis dpal sa skya ba'i sde gdung brgyud sogs bstan pa'i me ro gso bar mdzad pa'i rgyun de nyid ma nyams shing yar ldan du mdzad de skyong ba la/ bdag gi bla ma sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can 'di nyid las lhag pa gzhan su yang ma byung bas/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i sgron me ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab gcig pu lta bur gyur pa yin pas dregs ldan cher rloms kun gyis 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skyes chen zhig ste/

zhing brje ba'i tshe yang sngon gyi skyes bu chen po slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa dang mthun par sku'i bkod pa gnyis su ston par mdzad pa yin te/ de yang me sbrul sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi tho rangs gzugs sku bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa'i/ de dang nye ba'i tshes bcu drug tsam gyi nyin mo'i cha zhig la/ gdan sa na yod pa'i phun tshogs zer ba'i bu mo chung ngu smra shes tsam zhig bla brang bzhi thog gi ltag sgo na rtse zhing yod pa'i mngon sum gyi mthong snang la/ ltag sgo'i rdo skas kyi mgor bud med rgyan gos zab cing dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa mang po zhig gis ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra drag tu bcams byung bas/ de nas dar tsam zhig nas sngags 'chang bla ma grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid sku gzi 'od 'bar bzhin pa dang bcas bzhi thog bla brang gi ltag sgo brgyud nas phebs byung ste/ bu mo de rang la byin rlabs gnang byung ba'i mod la/ sngar gyi bud med de rnams kyis bsus te ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra chen po dang bcas rim bzhin sa dkar logs kyi ngos la byon te bar snang la yal song ba mthong bas de ma thag bu mo chung ngu de nyid de rang gi ma'i rtsar brgyugs byung ste/ 'di bzhin byung ba'i lo rgyus rnams sgrib med du smras byung bas/ ma yang ha las te smras pa/ da lo gong bzhugs sku shin tu ma bde ba'i tshul gleng ba la/ khyod kyi mthong snang de bzhin byung tshul smras na chad pa yang yong bas su la yang ma zer cig /ces kyang gdams mo zhes thos so/ /'di lta bu ni slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo mkha' spyod du gshegs pa sa skya'i rgan mo zhig gis mngon sum du mthong ba dang tshul mthun pa yin no/ /gzhan yang thun mong du snang ba'i sku gdung la zhugs 'bul ba'i tshe yang de dang dus mnyam lha'i rol mo dang me tog gi char babs shing /

spur khang la 'ja' dkar po zhig gdung btsugs su zug pa kun gyis mthong ba dang / gzhan yang sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid kyi rnam thar mdo tsam ni kho bos byas pa'i gsol 'debs legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma 'grel pa dang bcas pa las kyang rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gnyis kyis kyang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du/ dpal sga los sa chen la gnang ba'i ma rgyud kyai rdo rje'i sbyor drug gi man ngag gi yi ges mtshon pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor ci rigs pa dag gsan cing / thugs nyams su yang bzhes par mdzad pa yin la/ don du na sngags 'chang yab sras 'di gsum ni/ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa' phyag na pad+mo/ gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs pa'i rnam thar sprul pa byang sham+bha la'i rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po rnams dang rnam dbyer med par bzhugs pas na/ nges don gyi bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa ni/ dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams la yid gnyis dang bral ba de'o/ /yang rje btsun sa lo chen po las bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos tshul yongs su rdzogs par gsan nas mnga' bdag chen por gyur pa'i chos kyi rje e waṃ pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa cung zad rgyas par spro bas/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ 'dir bdag cag gi bla ma kun mkhyen shākya'i rgyal po'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa'i rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po/ srid zhi'i rgud pa ma lus pa sel ba'i yid bzhin nor bu/ rig gnas ma lus pa la mi shes pa'i mun pa mtha' dag drungs nas 'byin pa'i nyi ma chen po/ 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang dam pa bde blag tu stsol ba'i sman pa'i rgyal po/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub zhes grags pa 'di nyid bskal pa bgrang ba las 'das pa'i sngon rol tu 'og min chen por rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po zung du 'jug pa'i yan lag bdun ldan gyi sku mngon du mdzad de/

thugs rje chen po dang smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho thams cad du sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / drang srong dang / 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / khyim bdag dang / sman gyi dbang po dang / nor bu la sogs pa gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul du sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa yin par gdon mi za ste/ ye shes grub pa las/ sangs rgyas thams cad brtan g.yo kun/ /kun gyi dngos por de 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa sgrub par byed/ /sangs rgyas nyams kyis mdzad pa bstan/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs/ /sna tshogs gzugs byad rig pa yis/ /'gro ba mtha' dag mgu bar byed/ /ces pa la sogs gsungs pas so/ /gang gi dngos kun rang bzhin spros bral dbyings/ /bde chen ye shes zung 'jug sku brnyes nas/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i blo yi chu gtsang du/ /ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i snang brnyan ci yang bstan/ /de las kha ba'i sa 'dzin gyi phreng bas nye bar brgyan pa'i ljongs 'dir gdul bya rnams thar ba mchog gi skal ba dang ldan par mdzad pa'i slad du dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam par 'phrul ba'i tshul bstan pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa 'di la/ theg pa chen po'i rigs can yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam gyi shugs dang ldan pa rnams rna ba blags te nyon cig de la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa las rang gzhan gyi don thams cad bde blag tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na rang gzhan gyi don chen de ci zhig de la dad pas de ji ltar thob ce na/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas srid pa nas srid par brgyud mar mnog par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pas gzir ba'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rang gzhan brgal te thar pa mchog thob pa ni don chen po yin la/ de lta bu yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas bde blag tu thob pa yin te/

ye shes grub pa las/ gang la bla ma'i drin yod pa/ /de yis de nyid mchog brnyes 'gyur/ /gzhan du byis pas yun ring du/ /rnam par rmongs pas yun ring 'gyur/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos gyur cing / /dge 'dun yang ni de bzhin te/ /de yi drin gyis shes 'gyur bas/ /de bas dkon mchog gsum yin no/ /mi shes rab rib kyis ldongs la/ /'di ni lam rab ston byed yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa po dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo rje btsun bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi rnam par thar ba brjod pa la don bdun te/ gzhan don du skye ba ji ltar bzhes pa'i tshul/ sdom pa gsum gyis rgyud dag par mdzad pa'i tshul/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten te thos bsam sgom pa mdzad pa'i tshul/ de la mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan brnyes tshul/ bsdu ba rnam bzhis gzhan don ji ltar mdzad tshul/ gzugs sku'i bkod pa ji ltar bsdus tshul/ bstan 'dzin gyi slob ma ji ltar byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ skyes bu dam pa 'di nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i gnas thub pa chen po mngon par byang chub pa'i yul rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i sa/ jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti shas rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa 'byon par lung bstan pa'i gnas/ sa'i mtshan ma las 'gran zla med pa mkhas grub bar ma chad par 'byung ba'i rtags dang ldan pa/ rdo rje gdan gnyis pa dpal ldan sa skya zhes grags pa'i 'dabs su/ skye bo kun gyis ya rabs kyi ngang tshul can du bkur ba'i yab yum las/ dmar ser can zhes pa me mo sbrul gyi lo la rmad du byung ba'i rtags du ma dang bcas bltams so/ /gzhon nu de ni rang bzhin gyis sku brjid chags shing / zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong na yid du 'thad la dpral ba'i dbyes che zhing / shangs gzengs mtho ba dang / dbu gdugs lta bu la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa zhig go

/de yab yum gnyis kyis gces par bskyangs shing skyed bsrings pas cher 'khrungs pa na/ des shing mdzangs pas rgan pa rnams la ni gus/ dul ba dang / ngag 'jam pas 'khor rnams la ni byams/ yid gzhung zhing dbang po rno bas klog dang / yi ge dang / tha snyad thams cad la gsal zhing byang bar gyur to/ /'jig rten byis pa'i spyod las rab 'das kyang / /'jig rten gzung phyir gzhon nu'i tshul sogs kyis/ /'jig rten ji srid gnas kyi bar du ni/ /'jig rten rdul snyed mnyam pa'i mdzad pa ston/ /gnyis pa sdom pa gsum gyis rgyud dag par mdzad tshul ni/ de nas gzhon nu de nyid 'di lta bu'i bsam pa dang ldan par gyur te/ khyim na gnas pa ni bya ba ngan pas brel zhing mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam dang mi nye bar shes nas/ gdan sa chen po de nyid nas ha cang mi ring ba'i shar kyi phyogs su mngon par 'phags pa na/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa la dbang 'byor ba'i sdom brtson dam pa rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po zhes snyan pa'i grags pas nor 'dzin gyi gzhi mdzes pa de nyid la bcom ldan 'das ma rnam par rgyal mas lung bstan te gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i mtshan e waṃ chos ldan zhes grags pa'i dben gnas su sa mo sbrul gyi lo la phebs te/ gnyis med gsungs pa'i dbang po shākya'i rgyal po'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa dri ma med pa'i rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po 'gran zla dang bral ba rje btsun sa skya pa'i chos kyi gdung 'dzin pa'i mchog rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i seng ge'i khri la mnga' dbang mdzad pa/ 'dren mchog dam pa rat+na bha tra'i zhal snga nas dang dgung lo bcu gsum pa la mjal zhing / lo de nyid snron gyi zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes brgyad la babs pa na/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyis mkhan po dang / mkhan chen bud+dha min nam thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang /

sde snod 'dzin pa chos lung pa 'phrin las dbang phyug pas grib tshod pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa yon tan rgya mtsho la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun brgya phrag gcig gi dbus su/ 'khor ba mtha' dag me 'obs lta bur gzigs pa'i nges 'byung dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang la nad pa nad mtha' dag drungs nas 'byin pa'i sman mchog don du gnyer ba lta bu'i thugs 'dun drag pos dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa nos nas/ mtshan yang don dang ldan pa dkon mchog lhun grub ces 'dogs par mdzad do/ /slar yang skyes bu dam pa de srid pa gsum gyi 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal gyi phung po gting mtha' med pas gzir zhing nyam thag pa rnams dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis gso bar dgongs la/ gzhan don mdzad pa'i rten yang / mgon po byams pas/ rab tu byung ba'i phyogs 'di ni/ /yon tan tshad med rnams dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi rab tu byung ba bsngags pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rten la gsum gyi dge slong mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar de'i yang dge slong gtso bo yin par dgongs nas/ mkhan po mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje chen po tshad med pa mnga' bas 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gnyis su med la/ rdor dkar gdan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs la sogs pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan phul du byung ba mnga' bas 'od srung chen po lta bur gyur pa rje mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po dang / las kyi slob dpon 'jig rten gyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs te/ zab mo'i lam la rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad pa'i ri khrod pa chen po kun dga' mchog ldan pa/ gsang ste ston pa chos rje lha mchog seng ge ba/ grib tshod pa sde snod 'dzin pa chos lung pa 'phrin las dbang phyug dad pa'i dge 'dun 'dul ba 'dzin pa shes rab rin chen/ lung rigs smra ba dge legs bshes gnyen pa la sogs pa kha skong bar 'os pa'i dge slong du ma dang bcas pa'i dbus su/

dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi ba'i lo sa ga nya ba'i yar tshes bcu gsum la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs la yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa thob par mdzad de/ dus de nyid nas zhi bar ma gshegs kyi bar la nyes ltung phra zhing phra bas kyang ma gos pas gtsang zhing / dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi tshul khong du chud pas mkhas pa yang dag par blangs pa srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ba'i brtan pa'i tshul khrims dang / sngon srid pa nas srid par goms pas tshe 'dir ngang gis 'byung ba rang bzhin gyi tshul khrims dang kha na ma tho ba rmi lam du yang mi byed pa'i rdzogs pa'i tshul khrims dang / tshul khrims kyi yon tan mthong nas dga' bas dang du len pa rtogs pa'i tshul khrims dang / nyon mongs pa yul dang bcas pa las sgo gsum bsrung ba 'khrul pa med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pas/ ma ral/ ma zhig nag nog med pas 'phags pa dges pa'i tshul khrims la nye bar gnas pa yin no/ /srid 'dun 'ching bas nam yang ma bsdams shing / /myang 'das bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ngang tshul can/ /ring nas brtul zhugs mchog 'dir khyod gnas kyang / /'jig rten gzung phyir slar yang len pa snyam/ /kha na ma tho'i dri bral rab bzang po/ /shes bzhin tshon rtsi gsar pa'i mdangs gsal zhing / /bag yod srad bus sbrel ba'i tshul khrims gos/ /dpag med srid par khyod kyi dpal du thob/ /slar yang skyes bu dam pa de ni theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs nas bskal pa grangs med pa 'das zin pas rang bzhin gyis snying rje che ba dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos la lhag par mos pa dang / gzhan don gyi dka' spyad la bzod pa sogs rigs kyi rtags phul du byung ba dang ldan pas nye bar drangs te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams la byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / rgyud sde bzhi po so so'i cho ga rnam par dag pa la brten nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pas thugs rgyud la gtams par mdzad de/

de dag bslab par bya ba mtha' dag nyams 'og tu tshud pas rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i bsam pa ring du dor nas/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu la bslabs pa'i mthu la brten/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'bad med du 'byung zhing / de dag kyang tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pas mi brdzi bar lhag pa'i lha dang bde chen gyi ye shes su 'char ba las nam yang mi g.yo ba'i gsang chen bla na med pa'i spyod pa dang ldan pas rnam par dag pa'i sdom pa gsum la gnas pa yin no/ /bdag lta'i 'ching ba bcad pas srid bral yang / /nyam thag sdug bsngal gyis gzir 'gro rnams slad/ /dmigs med snying nas srid pa ji srid du/ /rlabs chen gzhan don spyod pa'i go bgos shing / /kun kyang rang snang lhag pa'i lha nyid dang / /bde chen ye shes spros bral ro bcud kyi/ /dngos kun mchog tu ro mnyam gyur pa yis/ /e waṃ gsang chen sdom pa'i dpal mnga' khyod/ /gsum pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas thos bsam sgom pa mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha'i zhal snga nas dang / tshad med thugs rjes 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs gnas su gyur pa mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen dang / rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / mtshungs med chos kyi rje ri khrod pa chen po kun dga' mchog ldan pa dang / chos kyi rje lha mchog seng ge ba dang / mtshungs med mkhas grub dam pa nam mkha' dpal bzang dang 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa lha dbang blo gros rnams gus pas bsten nas/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi la sogs pa theg pa thun mong ba'i skor rnams dang / theg chen thun mong min pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs la byams chos lnga dang /

bka' gdams gzhung drug tu grags pa dang / blo sbyong gi skor sogs mtha' yas pa dang / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i skor ro/ /rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs/ rigs gtad rjes gnang deng sang grags pa phal mo che gsan cing / khyad par sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i bcud kyi snying po gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag cha lag dang bcas pa'i ring brgyud nye brgyud dang bcas pa'i zab don mtha' dag thugs su tshud par mdzad la/ gzhan yang 'khor lo bde mchog man ngag thun mong ma yin pa rnal 'byor gsang mthar grags pa rnams dang / gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi dbang khrid man ngag ra skyo sa gsum gyi skor/ dus kyi 'khor lo ra 'bro sa gsum gyi lugs las byung ba'i dbang khrid rgyud kyi bshad pa sogs ding sang srol yod pa mtha' dag gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad de/ 'dir yi ge mang pas 'jigs nas ma spros la/ rgyas par rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsan yig thub bstan rgyas pa'i nyin byed du blta bar bya'o/ /de ltar gsan pa de dag kyang bsam byung gi rigs pas sgro 'dogs legs par bcad nas/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i spyi dang thun mong min pa'i rang rang gi rnam gzhag rnams kyi nang gses phra mo tshun chod la'ang rgyab rten gyi lung dang rigs pas brdar sha chod pas dpyis phyin par mdzad cing / de dag gi bar skabs su bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje/ 'khor lo bde mchog gsang ba 'dus pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag chos skyong che chung / 'jam dbyangs/ sgrol ma la sogs pa lhag pa'i lha rab tu mang po'i bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pas thugs rgyud legs par sbyangs nas/ rdzogs rim zab mo rnams kyi nyams bzhes la brtson pas thos bsam sgom gsum spel mar mdzad pa yin no/ /'phags yul 'chi med grong nas legs 'ongs pa'i/ /rig gnas yan lag brgyad ldan lam gsum 'gro/

/gshin rje dpal mgrin mnyes las babs pa'i tshogs/ /rnam dpyod lto bar sim mdzad dza hū nyid/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rin chen gyis 'phongs pa'i/ /phyogs rer 'bab pa'i chu phran ring dor nas/ /thos bsam sgom gsum rgya mtsho cher zhugs te/ /zab don nor bu'i gling pas dbang 'byor khyod/ /bzhi ba de las mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ mkhas pa dang / btsun pa dang / bzang po'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la spyir mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i ngos 'dzin yang / bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod/ /bye brag sbyangs pa'i don shes pa/ /de yang de la mkhas par 'dod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di la mda' ste/ de yang skyes stobs dang / sbyangs pa dang / lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas mkhyen rab phul du byung ba mnga' ba'i stobs kyis mkhas pa'i bgyi ba 'chad rtsod rtsom pa thams cad la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba'i spobs pa mnga' bas/ rgyud gzhung man ngag gang 'chad kyang / dang por don gyi cha mdor bstan nas/ de'i don rim pas phye ste rgyab rten gyi lung rnams ma 'chol zhing / rjod byed kyi tshig rna bar babs pas bde la kun la grags pa'i dpe la sogs pas gtan la phab pas rtogs sla zhing / slob ma'i blo dang 'tshams pa sogs 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'ba' zhig la sbyor ba'i sgo nas ston pas tshig yan lag brgyad dang ldan zhing / chos 'chad pa la dga' spro shin tu che ba yod ces gsungs shing / de dang mthun par thugs brel dang 'dod yon sogs gang gis kyang chos gsung ba la mi gnod cing / gzhan gyis dus 'dzin pa ma gtogs mtha' gtugs pa med la/ kun spyod kyang sku drang por bsrangs/ dran pa mngon du bzhag nas gsungs pas le lo med pa dang / tshig sub sub po dang / tab tab po med cing /

skabs don ngos bzung ste de'i don phye ste/ de la dogs pa bkod nas lan 'debs pa la sogs pas the tshom chod pa dang / yang yang 'doms pas gol ba la sogs pa med pas skyon brgyad dang bral ba yin la/ lhag par rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la gang gi sgo nas dri ba zhus na yang / rnam par phye nas spobs pa thogs pa med par dges bzhin du lan gsungs pas na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ chos bzang rigs pas rnam dpyad bsam pa can/ /rtag tu bdud kyis bar chad byed pa med/ /khyad par rnyed dang gzhan gyi phyogs sun 'byin/ /mi 'phrogs yongs su smin pa'i mtshan nyid 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa dang mthun par mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab mnga' la/ rje nyid kyis kyang / ston dang bstan pa gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i/ /chos 'di'i rigs skyes dkon mchog lhun grub lags/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang mthun pa'i phyir/ rje btsun gong ma'i rnam 'phrul lam 'phrin las yin par gdon mi za ba'i nges pa rnyed pa yin no/ /rtsod pa mdzad pa'i tshul yang / gong ma'i gsung rab la bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas dogs pa dpyod pa'i tshul gyis brgal brtags cung zad gsungs pa dang / dus phyis kyi grub pa'i mtha' sbyang gzhi la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag sngon gyi mkhas pa gang gi lugs dang mi mthun par smra ba la sogs pa rnams zhus pa na/ lung dang rigs pas sgro 'dogs skur 'debs mtha' dag thams cad sun phyung ste nges shes rnam par dag pa skyed par mdzad nus la/ yang rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rab la gzhan dag gis brtsad pa'i lan tshangs pa'i rigs sngags dang / mdo phyogs la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis gsung rab rin po che la dris pa'i lan nges don bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho mdzad nas chos dang mthun pa'i lan legs par btab pa dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis gsung ngag rin po che'i kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin phyin ci log tu smras nas/

de mkhas pa chen po bsod nams seng ge'i dgongs pa yin zhes smra ba na/ rje de nyid kyis 'jug pa dka' 'grel la brten nas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod pa dang / lag len phra mos khengs pa dag gis cung zad dpyad pa rnams la yang / mi dges pa gtan nas mi mnga' bar lugs so so'i rnam gzhag ma 'dres pa'i sgo nas the tshom chod par mdzad la/ karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje e waṃ chos ldan mjal ba la phebs dus mdo sngags kyi tshul la dri ba mdzad pa na/ thogs pa mi mnga' bar 'dod tshul gyi rnam grangs mtha' dpyad dang bcas lan mdzad pas/ kun yid rang zhing mkhas pa'i grags pa bsgrags pa yin no/ /legs bshad brtsams pa'i tshul ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar bstod pa/ zhu 'phrin phul ba dang / 'dod lha'i bstod pa rnams dang / brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs la sogs pa sgra don gyi rgyan gzhan las phul du byung zhing ngo mtshar bas/ sngon gyi slob dpon dpa' bo dang / tsan+t+ra go mi la sogs pa'i snyan ngag dang khyad par ma mchis shing / gsung rab kyi dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos rnams kyi tshig gi cha sdeb dang / tha snyad dang / tshig 'phrad la sogs pa rnams dag cing sdeb legs pa dang / don gyi cha rtogs sla zhing grags che ba rnam bshad ches pa'i skyon dang bral zhing / dka' ba'i gnas rnams bya byed las gsum dang sbyar ba dang brgal zhing brtags nas lan 'debs pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bshad pas nges pa lhag par bskyed nus shing / lag len gyi tshul ston pa rnams kyang thun mong ba rnams spyi dang mi 'gal zhing rang rang gi sgo nas chos rnams ma 'dres par ston par mdzad pas rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa gzu bor gnas pa rnams gus pas len zhing bsngags pa brjod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa btsun pa'i yon tan ni/ sdom pa gsum la nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pa yin la/ de la so so thar pa'i mi mthun phyogs gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor gtan mi mnga' zhing /

dge sbyong gi chos bzhi bsgrub pa'i dam bca' mdzad nas/ de las nam yang mi 'da' la/ mdor na phyi dro'i kha zas dang sha chang la sogs pa spangs pas nyes byas phra mos kyang ma gos par dgag bsgrub gnang gsum gyi bslab pa rnams ma 'tshol bar thugs nyams su brtas par mdzad pas 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la smon 'jug gi bslab bya ltung ba dang pham 'dra dang nyes byas la sogs pa gang dang yang 'gal ba mi mnga' zhing / nag po'i chos bzhi'i char gtogs pa gzhan gyis byed pa gzigs na nyam nga ba'i rnam pa chen po mdzad cing / 'o skol chos pas rdzun la sogs pa ga la rung sems can bslu ba yin mod ces gsungs la/ mdor na byams pa snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud brlan pa'i bdag gzhan brje ba'i lhag bsam dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa la/ dam tshig nyi shu la tshul bzhin bslabs te dus thams cad du mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob kyi nyams len la g.yel ba mi mnga' bas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pas ma gos pa'i phyir rig pa 'dzin pa chen po yin te rgyas par 'og nas shes par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa bzang po'i yon tan ni/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis de'i yon tan sems nang du gnas pa dang / rang bzhin gyis zhi zhing des pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pas 'jigs pa dang bral ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan la/ khyad par du/ thos pa mang dang chos 'dzin dang / /shes rab ldan zhing thar pa 'dod/ /yon tan rnams la dga' ba'i mi/ /de dag dga' ldan nye bar 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas nas dri ma med pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos rnams la thos bsam tshul bzhin du byas pa la sogs pas phyi ma dga' ldan du skye nges shes pa re byed dgos zhes yang yang gsungs la/ rje nyid ni de ltar mdzad pa yin nges te/ zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshe 'ga' zhig gi rmi lam du/
