rje nyid seng ge la chibs nas nam mkha' la gshegs te/ ngas mi tshe rang po 'chad nyan byas pa yin kyang / da 'gro na 'di bzhin byed ces gsungs pa'i snang ba byung zhes rmi lam rmi ba po des/ nye gnas pa la yi ge bskur ba'ang bu slob 'ga' zhig gis mthong bar grags la/ gzhan sdug bsngal ba la mthong na shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje mnga' bas sdug bsngal de lta bu dang bral na dgongs pa'i lhag bsam gyis bdag gzhan brje ba'i dmigs pa yang yang mdzad la/ gzhan la yang bdag gces 'dzin sun 'byin/ lus srog la mi lta bar gzhan don la 'jug pa'i snying stobs bskyed pa'i thabs mkhas 'di lta bu nyams su len dgos zhes yang yang 'dom par mdzad cing / de lta bu ston pa'i gsung rab spyod 'jug dang / rgyal sras bka' 'bum thogs med kyi bka' 'bum dang / blo sbyong gi skor rnams la bsngags pa mdzad cing / gsang sngags bla med kyi bskyed rim bsgom pa dang gnad gcig ces gsungs so/ /mdor na sems can su la yang gnod par 'gyur ba spangs nas phan pa 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa lhur len pa dang / dus rgyun du bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i lam dus kyi dbang rgyas par len pa rtsa sngags kyi bzlas pa dang bcas pa dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ru pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba/ na ro ta pa'i lugs kyi mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len/ khyad par gyi lam gyi gtso bo bla ma'i rnal 'byor la nyams bzhes kyi mthil mdzad pas de'i byin rlabs thugs rgyud la zhugs pa'i tshul rje nyid kyis zhal nas/ rje 'dren mchog zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshe/ nye gnas pa la sogs pa ni gzhan du longs spyod la g.yengs/ zla ba mang po zhig gi bar la sku gdung drung du nyin mo rdo rje 'dzin pa gzhan dag dang mnyam du bsgrub par mdzad/ mtshan mo nga kho na las med pas bla ma 'di gshegs pas kho bo gcig pu mgon dang bral bar 'dug dgongs nas bshums shing sku gdung la dbu gtugs shing gsol ba 'debs pa kho na byas pas blo las su rung ba dang /

rje btsun gong ma la dad pa lhag par skyes shing / de dag gi gsung rab la go ba rnyed pa byung gsungs pa dang / yang nga rang la phyi nang gi bar chad dam mtshan ma ngan pa byung ba'am/ dgon pa 'dir 'thab rtsod nad yams sogs ci byung yang / bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas/ rje ngor mus sa gsum gang rung dang mjal 'ong / des rang zhi la 'gro yi yod gsungs shing / gzhan yang kyai rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen mdzad pa'i tshe snang ba rnyed pa'i mtshan ma yod ces gsungs mod kyis thugs zab pas gsal bar ni mi gsungs so/ /'jam dbyangs dkar po'i bsnyen pa mdzad nas zla ba gza' 'dzin byung ba zhig la/ de'i mā ṣa la brten pa'i las sbyor mdzad pas myu gu zhal gyi sgor 'thon pa byung zhes gsungs/ gsol ba btab na bar chad dngos su sel nus te/ thugs dam pa zhig nyag ra'i spyi khang na bsdad dus rlung stod du hags pa'i gegs byung nas rje nyid la gsol ba btab pas/ btsun pa zhig gis btung ba'i rnam pa mdog bzang po byas pa snod du khyer byung nas rje nyid kyis gnang ba yin 'thungs zer nas 'thungs pa'i nyams snang byung bas de ma thag phan pa dang / phyis gling gi stod na yod pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi gegs de lta bu byung bas/ sngar ni gsol ba btab pas rje nyid kyis gnang ba yin zer ba'i yi ge'i rnam pa zhig 'dug pa bklags pa'i nyams snang byung bas de ma thag phan 'dug ces de nyid kyis bsgrags pa dang / yang de la rmi lam du 'du khang na rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo chos gsung gin yod pas 'gro ba yin zer ba'i mi mang po dang mnyam du phyin pas bzhugs khri ngo mtshar che ba zhig gi steng na rje 'di nyid gzhan las ches phul du byung ba'i mnga' mdangs dang bcas bzhugs 'dug pa rmis pa dang / gzhan yang rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ e waṃ bla brang gi steng 'di 'dra ba zhig tu kun mkhyen bu ston dang mjal nas/ 'di skyes bu dam pa yin pas chos zhu dgos dgongs gsol ba btab pa rmis zhes gsungs so/

/bstan pa la dga' ba'i mi ma yin che ba dag gis kyang bkur bsti byed pa yin te/ gnod sbyin gangs bzang gi mdun du phebs dus shig blo bur du gangs mgul nas chu dwangs shing yid du 'ong ba sku mdun du babs byung bas/ rgyus yod rnams 'di lta bu skyes bu dam pa rnams 'byon dus yong ba yin pas ngo mtshar shin tu che zhes gleng ngo / /lhag par du yang lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rjes thob tu snang ba thams cad bden med sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur ngang gis shar te/ dngos 'dzin zhig pa'i tshul yang / sngar gzigs pa'i yul dang mi la sogs pa slar gzigs pa'i tshe/ sngar rmi lam du byung ba de ka yin pa la/ da dung de ka la 'dug snyam pa yong gis 'dug gsungs/ yang mnal lam bzung nas bla ma yi dam rnams dang mjal nas dogs pa sel ba'i zhu ba sogs mdzad nges pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan rtsom pa'i tshe/ mnyam rjes kyi dam tshig gso tshul la thugs dogs 'khrungs 'dug pa'i sang nyin/ 'di ltar yin pa 'dug ces nges pa bskyed pa'i gtan tshigs dang bcas gsungs pa'i rjes cung zad nas/ ngas nai gu 'di thob na bsam ste/ zhu sa yid ches pa rang gcig ma byung / bla ma dam pa rnams dang mjal nas the tshom zhu ba sogs byed 'dod nas/ man ngag gces bsdus kyi rmi lam 'dzin spel sbyang ba sogs kyi man ngag la nyams len byas pas/ 'dun pa drag drags pa'i skyon yin pa 'dra/ skabs 'ga' rer das chad nas gnyid yong ba dka' se ba gcig yong gi 'dug gsungs zhes thos/ gzhan yang thun mong pa'i yon tan rmad du byung ba mang du yod par snang mod kyis/ brgyud pa 'di pa gsang ba bcu las mi 'da' bas sbas pa'i rnal 'byor du mdzad pa yin no/ /rig gnas bsil zhim gyis brjid char gyi rdul/ /ljags dbang sprin gyis blo gsal 'dzin ma la/ /rim pas phab pas 'chi med 'bras bu'i sman/ /mtha' grur rgyas mdzad 'chad mkhas dbang po khyod/

/mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun gyi bcud 'thungs shing / /snyan brgyud man ngag zab mo'i mthu grub pas/ /lta ngan la 'tshol rgol ba ma lus pa/ /mthar byed rig sngags 'chang ba'i drang srong mchog /sdeb legs tshig gi kha dog mdangs gsal zhing / /zab don sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis yongs gang ba'i/ /legs bshad me tog gsar pa'i do shal gyis/ /thub bstan yongs 'du mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ /nam yang nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos shing / /lhag bsam 'od kyis 'chi med lam bstan nas/ /rim gnyis las byung ye shes mchog gi mthus/ /srid zhi'i phongs pa sel mdzad yid bzhin nor/ /lnga pa bsdu ba rnam bzhis gzhan don ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ dgung lo nyi shu tsam nas don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya 'ga' re la chos kyi rnam grangs ci rigs pa gsungs nas brtsams te/ drug cu re gcig bzhes pa'i bar du chos gsungs shing / de yang mdo sde rgyan las/ brtse dang snyan par smra ba dang / /brtan pa nyid dang lag brkyangs dang / /dgongs pa zab mo nges 'grel ba/ /'di dag blo ldan rnams kyi rtags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gdul bya rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde la sbyor ba'i thabs kho nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i lhag bsam dang ldan pas brtse ba dang / dbang po'i rim pa dang 'tshams par chos kyi bsngags pa brjod mkhas pas chos la 'dun zhing mos par mdzad pas snyan par smra ba dang / dbang po rtul po ji ltar bsten kyang khong du chud dka' ba dang / chos ston pa'i dus rnams la skyo ba mi mnga' zhing / log sgrub la sogs pas mi bskyod pa'i brtan pa dang / yo byad kyis phongs pa rnams 'tsho ba'i rkyen gyis tshims par mdzad nas thos bsam sgom pa la sbyor zhing / lhag par chos don gnyer cher byed pa rnams la shin tu mnyes pas phongs pas mi brel ba'i thabs sgo du ma nas mdzad pa'i lag brkyangs pa dang / gang zag la mi rton chos la rton pa dang /

tshig la mi rton don la rton pa dang / drang don la mi rton nges don la rton pa dang / rnam shes la mi rton ye shes la rton pa'i sgo nas chos gsungs pas dgongs pa zab mo nges par 'grel ba dang ldan pas gsung rab phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i gnas ni gtso bor e waṃ chos ldan du mthil bzhugs gnang la/ gzhan yang gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya/ gling dga' bde ba can/ 'bras yul skyed mos tshal/ yar 'brog gi chos sde rnams dang / shrī na len+d+ra/ snar thang chos sde la sogs par phebs nas/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul dang / dge slong gi sdom pa rnams dbang po dang 'tshams par stsal pas nges par legs pa'i snod du mdzad pa khri phrag tu longs pa yod cing / dbu sems su grags pa'i sems bskyed dang / gsung ngag rin po che'i dbang gi sngon 'gro brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi cho ga rnam par dag pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas par mdzad pa ni dpag tu med la/ skal ldan rnams la dbang gi cho ga rnam par dag pas smin pa'i rjes su bskyed rdzogs kyi lam cha lag dang bcas pa dang / rgyab rten du rtsa bshad kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa/ rje btsun gong ma 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i lung la sogs te/ mdor na deng sang yongs su grags shing yid ches pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' dag ston par mdzad pa yin no/ /lhag par dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa la dar rgyas byung na dgongs pas snga mo'i dus shig sa paṇa nas brgyud pa'i dus 'khor gsan pa'i ched du lam gyi dka' tshegs sogs khyad du bsad nas chos kyi rje glo bo mkhan chen drung du mnga' ris stod du phebs kyang / de dus dgongs bzhed bzhin cung zad ma 'grub pas/ phyis sa lo chen po la dus 'khor gyi chos rnams rdzogs par gsan cing mang du spel ba'i thugs 'dun cher mdzad de/ lugs 'di'i gtan tshigs kyi yig cha ngo mtshar can yang mdzad pa ni gong du bstan pa ltar yin la/

de ltar chos gang gsung ba de dag kyang brgyud pa so so'i lugs gang yin pa/ de gzhung ngam rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di dang bshad pa'i rgyud 'di la brten/ smin grol gyi babs 'di ltar yin zhes zin thun mdzad nas/ don gnyer dang / 'dun pa dang / shes rab yod pa rnams la zhabs drung du gsol ba dang ja la sogs pa gnang zhing / dri ba legs par mdzad de gzengs bstod pa dang / dogs pa zhus na shin tu dges pas the tshom sel lan yang yang 'doms par mdzad pas/ e waṃ chos ldan du rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras gnyis kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge ma gtogs rje 'di las bstan pa'i 'phel rgyas lhag pa su yang byung ba med ces gleng ngo / /de yang slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi yis so/ sbyin pa'i g.yab mos legs bos nas/ /snyan par smra ba'i gtam byas te/ /don spyod pa yi bag phebs nas/ /don mthun gros chen gdab par bgyi/ /zhes pas de dang mthun par so so'i yid dang mthun pa'i sbyin pas bsdus nas chos kyi bsngags pa brjod pas dad par byas te/ rang nyid chos bzhin du spyod pas gdul bya mgu bar byas shing / dbang po'i rim pa dang 'tshams par chos ston par mdzad pas rgyal ba dges pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa yin no/ /chos kyi snod du ma gyur pa'i skye bo tha mal pa rnams kyang phul du byung ba'i thugs rjes sdug bsngal las 'don par mdzad pa yang / shar kha ba dang gzhi dga' rin spungs pa so sor dpung bshams nas g.yul 'khrug rgyun ring por zhi ma thub par/ mi phyug rnams nyam thag pa gsan pas thugs kyis ma bzod nas/ snga mor nye gnas pa so sor bsam pa len pa la gnang ba na/ rje 'di nyid phebs na bka' lung bzhin bgyid ces phyogs gnyis kas khas len par 'dug pa bzhin/ slar sku ngos phebs nas gdan sa chen po nas gnang ba'i mi sna dang / g.yas ru byang pa'i mi sna dang bcas pas so sor bka' lung gnang ba na de ma thag dmag gyes thub la/

de dus dgun grang sgang du song zhing 'tsho bas 'phongs pas shi chad mang pos shin tu sdug bsngal ba las gso bar mdzad pas yi rang nas/ skye bo thams cad rje 'di nyid kyi bsngags pa yang yang sgrog pa dang / gzhan yang yul so sor phebs pas nad gdon zhi ba dang / 'bras bu'i 'byung khungs bzang du song ba dang / chu dkon pa'i sa phyogs su chu gsar du byung ba sogs dge legs byung ba'i tshul yang / rdzong lhun grub stag rtse'i gzhol pa rnams la gegs lhog gi nad shin tu thu bas rgyun ring por phan par dka' ba la/ rje btsun 'di nyid der phebs pa la zhi bar mdzad pa'i gsol ba btab pas/ tho gsum brtsigs pa la rigs gsum mgon po'i bskyed chog mdzad de shis pa brjod pa tsam zhig gnang bas/ gnod pa de dag ming yang mi grags par song ba dang / lcags rir chu gsar du byung ba'ang thos mod kyis rgyas par ma spros so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ phongs pa'i gdung sel dri zhim ngad ldan zhing / /snyan smra li shi'i me tog 'thor mkhas ma/ /don spyod lang tsho'i dpal ldan ri dwags mig /don mthun dga' bde sbyin pa'i yid kyi grogs/ /zhes so/ /drug pa gzugs sku'i bkod pa ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul ni/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig bzhes pa me mo sbrul gyi lo shar ba'i dpyid gsung ngag rin po che gnang ba'i tshe sku de nyid kyis 'dul bar 'os pa'i gdul bya rnams 'dus pas/ rgyu dus dang lam dus kyi dbang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang dgos shin tu mang bas sku lus dub cing / sku gshed dang gsol dang zhan pa ma gtogs bsnyel ba'i rnam pa cung zad kyang med mod kyis/ mi bzhugs pa dgongs pas lam zab lha khang nas phyag dpe blangs pa rnams gzigs rtog grub ma khad/ 'di skyol 'o cag nam 'chi mi shes pas/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag dpe 'khyar na mi yong zhes 'phral 'phral la gsungs/ sgrub mchod kyi bris byed pa'i nyin de skyed mos tshal nas kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer gyi nang rten bzhengs pa'i bar chad sel ba dang /

bzhengs grub pa'i tshe rab gnas la phebs dgos zhu ba'i bang chen 'dug pas/ rtsol ba bskyed nas bzhengs dgos bar chad mi yong / de bar ma shi tsam yong las che bas dam pa de'i sku drin bsab pa'i slad du yong thub pa byed gsungs pa'i phyag dam gnang gi 'dug ces thos la/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes gcig gi nyin de drung du 'khor ba zhig gis 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel lo chen chos skyong bzang pos bsgyur pa de'i dpe phul bas/ cung zad gzigs nas blta long yong ba'i dus yin na phan thogs pa 'dug ste/ da blta long mi yong ngam gsungs/ sku khams ci 'dra yong mnal ltas la sogs pa ci 'dra yod zhus pas/ sngar yin na na ba la sogs pa'i tshe bla ma'i rnal 'byor gtso bor nyams len byas pas bla ma dam pa gsum po gang rung re dang mjal ba'i rmi lam yong zhing / des zhi 'gro ba zhig yod de/ da lam sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa yin snyam pa zhig rmi lam du byung ste/ sku gsal po mi mngon 'dug pas/ da yun ring mi sdod dam gsungs zhes thos/ lo de'i hor zla dgu pa'i zla ba tshes la khad skyed mos tshal nas e waṃ du phebs te/ ser 'phreng gi mchod pa'i gral dbu la byon pa'i phyi dro'i dus/ gling gi mtha' la gzigs rtog gnang / da sang nas mtshams byed pas blta ba ma yong gsungs te mi bzhugs pa'i brdar 'dug de nub nas sku mtshams gnang / bco lnga'i nam lang du nye ba na sku khams cung zhig dub tu song bas/ sku rim gyi mang ja nyi ma 'ga' zhig sbrel nas gnang / de dus gsung las/ nga dang po 'dir slebs dus dag ljon skor gsum gyi dpe las lag len phran tshegs kyi dpe rtsis che ba yod/ ngas rtsol ba byas pas deng sang gong ma'i gsung rab la thos bsam byed pa mang du yod/ da dung lo shas ma shi na sa skya pa'i bstan pa la phan thogs pa 'dug ste/ da lan 'chi bar 'dug sa skya zhabs drung bdag chen rin po che sku mched 'di gnyis thugs mthun pa zhig byung na bsam pa yod/

gzhan sems kyi lhag ma gcig kyang med gsungs/ de'i tshe du ba mjug ring glo bur du shar zhing mtshan ma ngan pa gzhan yang mang du byung ngo / /rgyun du gsol ba snum bag can ye mi bzhes pas ser ma che ba dang / sku bsil bas na za 'chag la phu thung gi rnam pa cung zad yod pa gcig phul ba na/ skabs shig gi tshe rje btsun rin po che dang / rgyal sras rin po che phebs 'dug na bza' de phul zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang bde ba can gyi zhing khams sogs dag snang mang po gzigs pa dang / 'dom gyi lba ba sbubs su nub pa sku 'khor 'ga' zhig gis dngos su mthong ba sogs dang / nam mkha' la 'ja' ris khyad par can sna tshogs bkra ba dang / me tog gi char chen po rgyun du 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung bar snang ngo / /de nas dbyug pa zla ba'i nyer gcig gi mtshan phyed yol ba'i tho rangs kyi cha la slebs pa na/ nyid kyi gsung las/ nga rang la bdag tu bzung ba'i dngos po gang yang med pas/ bla brang nang nas dus mchod 'dzin pa dang / phyi rten nang rten sogs gang yang ma byed/ grwa pa rnams zhwa 'jog pa sogs mya ngan ma byed par/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la thos bsam mdzod/ des nga'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa yin no zhes skyes bu dam pa rnams dang mthun pa'i dus mtha' ma'i bka' lung gnang nas/ mda' kha ma'i nyams len zab mo dang bcas zhing mchog bde ba can du gshegs so/ /mkhyen pa'i snang bas lam bzang stsol mkhas shing / /kun la snyoms pa'i dmigs med thugs rje can/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa sel ba'i mthu mnga' ba/ /skye dgu'i yid bzhin nor bu deng 'dir stor/ /mi shes rab rib kyis ldongs 'gro ba rnams/ /las dang nyon mongs rlung gis rab ded nas/ /nyam nga'i g.yang du lhung ba 'di bor te/ /mgon khyod zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs lags sam/ /dam pa'i rnam thar nyin byed la sdang zhing / /log shes mtshan ma'i bu mo la brtse ba/

/bshes gnyen 'byung po'i bya rnams yid dga' ba'i/ /rgyal mtshan du ba'i tog dang lhan cig shar/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i gzi mdangs rab gsal ba'i/ /mkhas mchog nyin mor byed pa'i dpal de nyid/ /bstan srung lha yi thun mtshams chu 'dzin dang / /lhan cig bde ba'i gling du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /rig gnas pad tshal 'dzum pa'i bzhin bsdus shing / /blo gsal bung ba'i tshogs rnams sa mthar 'khyar/ /zab don sbrang rtsis phongs dang lhan cig tu/ /sgro btags 'jag ma'i me tog 'phel bar gyur/ /kye hud skye ba'i zhags pas rab drangs nas/ /las kyi mtshon cha rnon pos phug pa na/ /mya ngan smre sngags 'don las gzhan pa yi/ /mgon med nyam nga'i gnas su lhung ba bdag /lus med bcud kyi stobs ldan kuk+ku ṭā/ /gsang mtho'i skad kyis dus su snyon dor sgrog /nyon mongs gong bu'i sems 'khrugs de dag gis/ /gzhi med spyo ba'i gnas skabs 'di 'dra'i tshe/ /dri bral mkhyen pa'i rgya mtsho las byung ba/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i 'od zer kun nas gsal/ /srid zhi'i dgos 'dod kun stsol dbang gi rgyal/ /khyod las skyabs gzhan med do thugs rjes gzigs/ /de nas nyer lnga'i snga ba'i cha la sku gdung chas 'jug gi tshul bgyis te/ drung du kyai rdo rje'i sgrub mchod phul/ nyer bdun gyi nyi dro'i dus me tog gi char dpag tu med pa babs pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung zhing / gnyug mar gnas pa dang / glo bur lhags pa'i dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams la kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bsnyen bkur gya nom pa dang / nang rten gtsang khang du rnam rgyal mchod rten/ lam 'bras lha khang du sku 'dra che ba/ lam zab tu sku 'dra mtho gang gi tshad tsam rnams gser zangs las grub pa bzhengs shing / 'di rang byung lta bur byon la/ gser sku lha khang dang / gzim chung du tsan+dan dmar po'i lde gu las grub pa'i sku 'bag rnams bzhengs te dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyis so/

/bdun pa bstan 'dzin gyi slob ma ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan rig 'dzin gyi dbang po dpal sa skya pa chen po bdag chen rin po che sku mched/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer/ dul ba'i lus la sde snod mtha' dag gi rgyan gyis mdzes pa mkhas pa legs pa'i blo gros/ blo gros kyi bang mdzod mdo sngags kyi nor gyis phyug pa chos kyi rje blo gros 'byung gnas/ thugs dam zab mo las ma g.yos bzhin du 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa spel ba chos rje lha btsun pa/ sa skyong mtha' dag gi gtsug rgyan grub pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde/ mkhyen rab kyi snang bas gzhung lugs mtha' dag tshul bzhin du gsal ba'i smra ba'i dbang po lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin pa rin po che sangs rgyas seng ge dbang lung man ngag mtha' dag gis gdul bya tshim par mdzad pa chos rje shes rab rgyal mtshan pa/ gzhung lugs mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i mkhas pa lhun grub rgya mtsho ba la sogs pa dang / mdo khams phyogs su yang spa spungs chos rje kun dga' lhun grub/ lnga rig mkhas pa chen po gnas byi chos rje shes rab grags pa/ gser mdog pa chos rje khu dbon/ kun mkhyen dbon po sku mched khu dbon rim par byon pa sogs kyis bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad la/ mnga' ris su yang lnga rig mkhas pa rdo rje sgrol ma ba/ shi ri chos rje la sogs pa mang du byon mod kyis yi ge mang pas 'jigs pa'i phyir ma spros la/ mdor na rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che la bya ba mdzad pa'i mkhas pa dus mnyam pa phal che ba mtha' dag gis gus pa chen pos zhabs pad bsten pa yin no/ /de ltar mkhas pa'i dbang po rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rnam par thar ba cung zad rgyas bar spel ba bstan zin nas/

da ni sa lo chen po'i dngos kyi slob ma dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyi rgyan dam par gyur pa lo chen rat+na bha dra nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rtogs pa cung zad spel bar bya ba las/ de yang slob ma rnams kyis gsol ba btab nas rje rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rat+na bha dra'i rnam thar bri/ /dad pa chen pos kun nyon cig /rang lo bcu nas nyer lnga'i bar/ /mdo sngags gsung rab slob gnyer byas/ /nyi shu drug nas so gnyis bar/ /sna tshogs chos nyan gtso bor bgyis/ /de nas rang lo zhe brgyad bar/ /bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa mang du byas/ /de nas rang lo nga brgyad bar/ /rang gzhan klog dang skor las bgyis/ /drug cu pa nas don bzhi'i mthar/ /bstan dang 'gro la ci phan byas/ /bla ma rnams kyis bu bzhin bskyangs/ /tshogs kyi dbus nas yer gyis thon/ /rgyas kyang de ka bsdus kyang de/ /'di yi khongs na mang po yod/ /yid ches skyed la dad pa mdzod/ /sbyangs pa'i slob dpon 'di rnams yin/ /mkhan chen bde legs bkra shis dang / /'dul 'dzin dam pa nam mkha' grags/ /zung chos slob dpon legs rin pa/ /gsum la tshad ma yun ring sbyangs/ /mkhan chen pa dang zur chos la/ /rnam 'grel ṭik+ka mang du nyan/ /ka bzhi'i gzhung dang dbu spyod dang / /sdom gsum rab dbye bshes springs rnams/ /dam pa zur chos pa nyid kyi/ /drin las byang bar bzung pa lags/ /rig gter ṭika chen nam mkha' grags/ /de la 'bad pa chen pos nyan/ /'dul ba mngon pa byams pa'i chos/ /pha rol phyin gzhung zab rgyas dang / /dbu spyod sdom gsum rab dbye sogs/ /dpal ldan blo gros rgya mtsho la/ /po ti bcu dgu lo lnga'i bar/ /gus pas nan tan bgyis pa lags/ /rgyal ba'i yum dang dkon brtsegs dang / /'dul ba lung la sogs pa yi/ /lung dang phreng ba zhe gnyis ma'i/ /dbang skur mkhas pa'i dbang po la/

/zab rgyas rgyud 'bum dam pa'i chos/ /dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog la'o/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bka' 'bum sogs/ /shākya ye shes bla ma la/ /sprul pa'i lo chen dam pa las/ /dus gsang spyod phyogs sgra snyan sogs/ /mang du nyan pas snang ba bye/ /grub chen byas 'gyur chos rje la/ /sa skya'i rgyud lung man ngag dang / /blo sbyong dmigs pa thun gnyis zhus/ /snying rje'i sa bon 'di yis btab/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po la/ /brtag gnyis dges rdor dus 'khor dbang / /lam 'bras la sogs khrid nyer gnyis/ /do ha snying gi bdud rtsi zhus/ /'di gsum man ngag bla ma'o/ /de steng blo gros rgya mtsho dang / /sa lo mkhas pa'i dbang po dang / /shākya ye shes bzhi bsnan pas/ /bla ma rin chen sna bdun yin/ /sbyong dkyil la sogs dbang mang dang / /ra pod la sogs man ngag dang / /me 'bar la sogs chos skyong dang / /pod bzhi la sogs lung 'ga' ni/ /sa skya'i rje btsun lo tsā la/ /sangs rgyas rin chen cog pu pa/ /chos grub seng ge dgon gsar ba/ /bzhi la'ang snga ma bzhi po las/ /nyung zhing nyung ba mang rab zhus/ /dril bas dam pa bzhi bcu yod/ /byin la chos kyi 'brel pa tsam/ /brtse ldan kun dga' legs pa la/ /brten nas dad dang snying rje 'phel/ /snang ba bsgyur nus bla mar 'dug /gling dga'i chos rgyal yab sras la/ /mos gus snying gi chu rgyun 'phel/ /sbyor drug lo bzhi zla brgyad bar/ /bsgoms dang yi ge drug pa yi/ /bzlas pa yun ring byas pa'i gnas/ /sman sdings sa yi lte ba'o/ /khri mkhar chos sdings dgon gsar dang / /dpal ri gzim chung dga' ldan sbug /blo ldan nam mdzod me lung dang / /rin chen sgang dang nyang po dang / /mdzo sna sa bzang dkar po brag /sa skya rnams ni dge sbyor gnas/ /rgyal khams kun la blta shes kyis/ /ltad mo sna tshogs legs par bltas/ /rten 'brel gnad rnams lha sar bsgrigs/ /thog tha bar la bla ma rje/

/khong rang bka' drin che ba lags/ /gzhon nu'i dus su khegs dregs kyis/ /slob gnyer mang ste las su song / /don med las de 'o re brgyal/ /dar ma'i dus na dge legs kyi/ /blo stobs nam mkha' 'dra ba yod/ /dam pa'i mdzad spyod mthong thos drin/ /rgan dus phyi ba phug zhugs bzhin/ /blo thag chod pa'i mdun ma bgyis/ /dpal ldan dges pa rdo rje la/ /aṣ+ḍa'i bsnyen pa lan brgyad btang / /'khor lo sdom pa lū hi pa/ /dril bu pa ste rnam gnyis la/ /yi ge bdun pa bye ba bzlas/ /gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi/ /bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum tsam la bsdus/ /gshed dmar 'jigs byed ra lugs la/ /hriḥṣ+ṭ-i'i gsang sngags rang rang bzhin/ /'bum phrag nyer lnga nyer lnga bzlas/ /ya ma rā dza bzhi 'bum dang / /ya mān+ta ka 'bum phrag bdun/ /kun rig durga bzhi 'bum rnams/ /sgo gsum bzhur te yid ches bgyis/ /gzungs ring bzhi 'bum yi ge drug /dung lnga rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /oṃ gsum ma la 'bru bsnyen btang / /sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs khro phu ba'i/ /'jam dkar gnyis dang mi g.yo dkar/ /dbyangs can phag dkar sher phyin ma/ /dkar mo rnams te lha bdun gyi/ /bsnyen pa mtshan ma legs mthong bar/ /byas pas skyabs gnas ma nor gda'/ /bcu gcig zhal gnyis lha lnga dang / /gtso 'khor gsum pa de bzhi la'ang / /bdag bskyed dam chos yi ge drug /bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa tshar re btang / /rje btsun sgrol ma rnam pa gsum/ /thub dbang mi g.yo sngon po dang / /ri khrod ma dang rta mgrin gnyis/ /gu ru drag po rnams la'ang byas/ /phyag rdor gtum po'i bsnyen pa gnyis/ /grub rgyal ma la lan mang bgyis/ /nag po che la bla ma yi/ /man ngag bzhin du yun ring bsnyen/ /zhal bzhi pa la'ang zla lhag bgyis/ /de tshe smra ba don ldan lags/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /phyag rgya che la mnyam par bzhag /bla ma lha la dad pa byas/ /dad pa de rnams ma nor gda'/

/sangs rgyas zer ba'i grags pa can/ /mnyam med shākya thub pa yi/ /gdung rus rtsol med lag tu byung / /bka' 'gyur bskor ba btab pa'i drin/ /mang po rong rong 'phel nas byung / /skye bo kun la mang du byin/ /sa gzhi mchod rten dkar pos bkang / /dpal gyi grub gnas ri bo che/ /smon lam btab pa'i 'bras bur nges/ /dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa la/ /dub ste dub ste dub bzhin bskor/ /dub pa'i ngang nas gsum de'i dus su jo bo'i zhal nas lung bstan ngo mtshar can byung ba ni/ dge slong rin chen bzang po khyod/ 'khor dge slong lnga brgya dang bcas te phyi ma nub phyogs bde ba can du pad+mo las brdzus te skye ba len par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsal dag snyan pa'i gsung gis lung bstan par grags so/ /thebs/ /'bum skor nyis brgya brgyad lhag la/ /gzhan bkod mthun rkyen dum tsam sbyar/ /zhal gser dkar mo smon lam pa/ /rags rgyab stobs can lan drug brdzangs/ /sangs rgyas drin lan khyer ro snyam/ /dpal gyi bla ma dbu rgyan rdzong / /byin rlabs gter chen chos rje yi/ /sku la 'bum skor gya gnyis btab/ /brgyad stong pa sogs bskor rten gzhan/ /skor ba kun la yod pa lags/ /sku gzugs gsum khri nye bar bzhengs/ /lus la snying po blangs so snyam/ /yi dam thugs rje chen po'i sku/ /khri kha thal ba bar du btab/ /sa skyar rten la 'bum bskor btab/ /sdug bsngal don dang ldan par go /byas lo dbu gsum sa lo dang / /blo gros rgya mtsho gling dga' ba/ /shākya ye shes dus mchod bdun/ /kun mkhyen rje la yang dus mchod/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mang po yi/ /dus mchod gnad kyi don gcig ste/ /dgu dgu dge 'dun sde long la/ /zla re bzhin du 'chag med yod/ /bcu dgu'i dus mchod chung ngu la/ /mngon rtogs rgyan gzhung 'don du bcug /dbul yang bsod nams rgya mtsho snyam/ /mdor na ra sar 'od dpag med/

/'bum phrag par du btab pa dang / /bskor ba shog par btab pa dang / /sāts+tsha btab pas don yod bgyis/ /rang gis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur bklags/ /gzhan gyis bka' 'gyur tshar bcu gsum/ /brgyad stong pa nyid stong phrag bzhi/ /rgyal yum brgya tshar dgu rnams te/ /dril bas brgyad stong pa nyid la/ /tshad byas po ti khri gcig dang / /bzhi stong bdun brgya lhag tsam bklags/ /mthun rkyen dum sbyar gzhan dag la/ /rgyal yum rgyas pa khri tshar gnyis/ /stong dang brgya tshar gsum klog bcug /bka' 'gyur yum brgya brgyad stong pa/ /stong tshar sgrog la mang po bkod/ /mi pham bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs phyir/ /byams chos khri tshar 'don du bcug /byams mgon drung du 'bum skor gyis/ /skor tshab bzhag cing byams smon yang / /legs par 'debs pa'i mi gnyis bzhag /rin chen gos dar sman rnams las/ /grub pa'i byams sku nyer bzhi dang / /gzhan yang byams sku stong ra bzhengs/ /khro phur dkar me smon lam gsum/ /gzungs gzhug la sogs zhabs tog dang / /byams chen gnyis la zhal gser zung / /sgrol ma thugs rje chen po sogs/ /'jim pa'i par du btab pa'i dus/ /yid ches mtshan ma bzang po byung / /dpal gyi grub gnas jo nang du/ /mchod pa'i rten la na bza' phul/ /sgrub sde de la sgrub rgyags btab/ /rje btsun byams pa'i chos lnga po/ /ya ga chos sdings dge 'dun pa/ /bzhi bcu tsam gyis zla re bzhin/ /'don pa'i rkyen sbyar chos sgang pa'i/ /dge 'dun nyi shu tsam nyid kyis/ /byams chos lo gcig zla re bzhin/ /'don pa'i rkyen sbyar de man la/ /grwa pa rang gis rkyen sbyar nas/ /'don pa'i srol ka da lta yod/ /'di nyid nyams par ma gyur cig /bzang ldan chos sder cho 'phrul la/ /byams chos chag med 'don pa yi/ /dge rgyun 'bad pa chen pos btsugs/ /ngag las don ldan de btsugs lags/ /mar yul rgyal po'i sa phyogs su/ /nyin rer 'dab chags brgya tsam gyi/

/srog gcod spong ba'i g.yar dam ni/ /lo gsum bar du brtse bas blangs/ /de bar khra khyi'ang spong bar byas/ /chos sde chen po'i snyan bcag dang / /rtsam mar mang ja'i rten ma rnams/ /mar dang nas ras dar du bsgyur/ /ngam ring gnyer khang gshin rje'i dong / /lo rer phyed ma'i tshe thar byas/ /ra sa'i ston 'jal dmyal ba'i rmangs/ /de rnams thams cad nas su bsgyur/ /rdzong phu'i sgrub mchod khrag gi mtsho/ /'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen por bsgyur/ /bde yangs smon lam ma dag zas/ /brtse ba chen pos legs par bkag /chung ka'i dgon par nya 'don bsab/ /'gro mang mu ges gzir ba'i dus/ /nas khal lnga brgya brtse bas byin/ /'di rang bsam pa tshim par byung / /de rnams pha ma'i drin lan yin/ /drin lan 'jal lugs ma nor gda'/ /'jam dpal mtshan brjod rgyud zab mo/ /bcu drug dge 'dun sde la btsugs/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs gsung 'byon drung / /mtshan brjod brgya rtsa 'don mi bzhi/ /bstan pa gnas kyi bar du bzhag /cho 'phrul dus bzang bde mchog rgyud/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor brtag gnyis rnams/ /bstan pa spel phyir 'don du bcug /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bzang spyod smon lam bdun bcu pa/ /nyi shu pa dang bde chen gyi/ /smon lam rnam bzhi legs par btsugs/ /bshags pa'i rgyal po ltung bshags tshugs/ /'di yis yid la dga' ba skyes/ /ngan song sbyong dang bde kye dang / /gshed mar 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor lnga'i/ /sgrub mchod dge 'dun sde la btsugs/ /zhing bzang dge 'dun sde mang la/ /dam chos yi ge drug pa btsugs/ /snyung gnas go brgyad dung phyur bdun/ /de rnams tshogs bsog sgrib sbyong lags/ /mar yul rgyal po'i sa phyogs nas/ /dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa dang / /sdig yul phag ri'i tshong 'dus nas/ /mtha' 'khob dang ra'i bar dag tu/ /dad dang snying rje chen po yis/ /yig drug bskul ma mang po bzhag

/bod yul bde la bkod do snyam/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs so snyam/ /yig drug dung phyur brgya phrag 'ga'i/ /mthun rkyen 'bad pa chen pos byas/ /bla ma chos rje'i bka' drin yin/ /khyad rang rnams kyang bla ma bsten/ /nga drug pa la gtsang phyogs kyi/ /'od gsal sgrub sde thog mar btab/ /rang lo nga brgyad pa yi lo/ /gting skyes ra sa'i sgrub sde gnyis/ /nga dgu pa la mdo smad kyi/ /sgrub sde rnam pa gnyis po btab/ /drug cu pa la nyin sbug dang / /smad sdings lha khang bdag rkyen byas/ /chu pho byi lo brag lhas btab/ /mtha' gong spangs sgang gnyis su khrid/ /re bdun pa la dngul chu yi/ /sgrub sde rnam pa gnyis po btab/ /rkyang phu tsha thog la sogs kyang / /'brug sbrul gnyis la dger bu dang / /zur gtso'i sgrub grwa rnam pa gnyis/ /bdun bcu pa la ri bo cher/ /sgrub sde gnyis btab zhig gso dag /brag sna'i btsun ma sgrub sde btsugs/ /lug lo dpal ldan 'dzim du phyin/ /don gsum pa la shang phyogs kyi/ /sgrub sde gsum sogs dge tshogs che/ /mang mkhar mu gu lung gi gnas/ /nyams pa 'bad de legs par bsab/ /bla ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs la/ /khyi lo gsung ngag rdzogs par bshad/ /ngam ring chos sder dpyid chos kyi/ /'jam thal gnyis phul legs tshogs spel/ /chos sgang la sogs grwa dgon bcur/ /bzang spyod smon lam 'bum gter btsugs/ /dgon bcur tshogs khang gyang ris dag /snga phyir bla mchod 'bum gter lnga/ /byin rlabs mtshan ma mang po byung / /mdor na thams cad legs bsdoms pas/ /grwa dgon sgrub sde sum brgya la/ /yo byad mang nyung ci rigs phul/ /legs tshogs che chung 'bad pas bsgrubs/ /snga phyir ngam ring chos sde la/ /mang ja sum brgya bcu gsum zhus/ /smon lam chen mo yang yang btab/ /gzhan yang gdan sa la sogs brgyar/ /mang ja 'ga' re drangs te mchis/ /'di rnams kho bo'i dge legs tshul/

/'phyor po'i rgyan bzhin ngom pa lags/ /rkun po'i nor bzhin nyes pa rnams/ /'bad pa chen pos sbas pa lags/ /da dung kho bo ma shi na/ /bod yul sa yi thig le 'gar/ /sgrub rgyud bstan pa dar ba dang / /lho phyogs dpal kyi 'bras mo gshong / /phyogs der kho bo la brten nas/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar bar smon/ /rang lo don bzhi rdzogs nye la/ /rigs bzang dad ldan snying rje can/ /lha btsun bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ /bskul te rgan po rat+nas smras/ /da dung tshe rabs legs tshogs la/ /rten 'brel sgrigs shig bla ma rje/ /dngos grub stsol cig yi dam lha/ /bar chad sel zhig bstan srung tsho/ /tshogs gnyis spel cig rat+na ba/ /zhes pa rgyal mtshan bzang po khams la 'gro khar nan gyis bskul te cung zad kha bskangs pa'o/ /'di chu pho khyi lo sa ga'i tshes bcu bzhi la mdzad cing / phag lo dpyid 'bring gi tshes pa brgyad la dga' ldan du phebs pa yin no zhes thos so/ /yang rje lo chen de nyid kyis rang gi rnam thar nyams dbyangs gsol 'debs kyi tshul du gsungs pa ni 'di ltar/ me tog gi char pa babs pa'i sa/ /gnas sman sdings ri bo'i mgul pa ru/ /ma ṇi ba rat+na bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems snying rje 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /thos bsam gyi 'bras bu smin pa'i sa/ /gnas sman sdings ri bo'i mgul pa ru/ /sgom pa rat+na bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' bral lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /byin rlabs kyi chu bo 'bab pa'i sa/ /gnas sman sdings ri bo'i mgul pa ru/ /dad ldan rat+na bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma dbang du 'du bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mdo rgyud kyi thos pa grub pa'i sa/ /gnas sman sdings ri bo'i mgul pa ru/ /mang thos rat+na bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /dag snang phyogs med du 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' 'gro ma khri phrag 'du ba'i sa/

/gnas sman sdings ri bo'i mgul pa ru/ /sngags 'chang rat+na bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra grags stong du 'char bar byin gyis brlobs/ /yi dam gyis dngos grub stsol ba'i sa/ /gnas sman sdings ri bo'i mgul pa ru/ /skal ldan rat+na bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro kun smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa yang rgyal khams kyi sprang po rat+na bha dra rang gis sbyar ba e waṃ/ zhes 'byung / de lta bu'i lo chen snying rje'i gter chen de nyid la bstan 'dzin gyi slob ma mang du byung ba las kun gyi 'gran zla dang bral ba ni 'jam mgon kun dga' grol mchog nyid yin te/ sprul ba'i sku 'di'i sku skye ba snga ma rnams su rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang / bod 'dir yang paṇa grub zam ma chad par byon pa'i skyes rabs rnams dang / sku tshe 'di'i rnam thar rgyas pa ni rje de nyid rang gis mdzad pa'i yig cha che ba rnams su blta zhing / 'dir de dag gi snying po bsdus pa lta bu'i rnam thar dpe rdzi mar grags pa rje grol mchog rang nyid kyis mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa ni 'di ltar/ na mo gu ru/ rje sangs rgyas las kyang sngon sangs rgyas/ /yab sbas pa'i sangs rgyas bla ma'i gtso/ /mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i bka' drin can/ /pha rdo rje 'chang dngos de la 'dud/ /'dir rang gi sems la sgrib med par/ /dpe me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /don ma 'dres gsal ba'i ri mo 'di/ /tshig ma sbas yi ge'i lam du 'god/ /ces mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/ bdag cag pha ma'i gam du gnas pa'i tshe/ ra ston chos rjes gnang ba'i sgrol ma 'bum ste tā ra lak+ṣa zhes 'bod cing / khyim pa'i rtags spangs nas rab tu byung ba'i skabs mkhan po'i mtshan las dras nas kun dga' grol mchog dgon gnas kyi 'dzin pa btang nas rgyal khams 'grim dus ni yan pa blo bde/ de nas rnal 'byor pa'i rang sa 'dzin dus ni sems kyi mdud grol/

slar dpal rin po che lcang lung pa'i zhabs drung du gdams pa dang rjes gdams kyi bka' drin nos dus rtsa ni dpal ldan kun bsnyen par rdzogs shing rig gnas cung zad sbyangs pa bgyis pa'i dus/ dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde/ lha dang mkha' 'gros byin pa'i ming 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo zhes bya la/ dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs dus kyi gsang mtshan ni/ brjod pa'i gnas ma yin no/ /de ltar don med ming mang ldan pa'i dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa bdag thog mar paṇ+ḍi ta 'bar ba'i gtso bor skye ba bzung ste/ bla ma ni dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub snying po/ yi dam sgrol ma/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa'i mthu thob pa zhig byas/ de nas grub chen nag po spyod pa'i skye ba bzung ste/ bla ma grub thob dza lan+dha ra pa yin/ yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog gis rjes su bzung ba snyam byed/ de nas rat+na bha hu lar skyes/ bla ma shrī ko k+ṣa nā tha yin zhing / da lta dzo ki'i skad la bag chags che ba'i gnad kyang de yin/ de nas bod zal mo gangs kyi ra ba 'dir rong zom chos bzang du skye ba blangs nas/ jo bo rje lha cig gis rong chen gyi chu tshan khar/ rgya gar gyi ā tsar+ya nag po'i zhabs tshe 'phos pa 'di yin zhes ngos bzung zhing / de dus rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog blo la bzhag bod kyi lha srin ma lus pa'i srog snying long pas/ ding sang gar phyin yang bar chad med pa de'i rten 'brel yin par snang / de nas 'bab rom pa dar ma dbang phyug tu skye ba blangs/ de dus 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po sogs slob mar 'dug pas/ deng sang stag lung chos rje sogs bka' brgyud kyi bu slob mang la gus pa 'di de'i rten 'brel dang las 'phror 'dug de nas a wa dhu ti 'od zer dpal du skye ba bzung / de dus rje btsun grags pa'i thugs shes kyis dgongs nas mdze thod blangs/

rje btsun rang gi sku 'dra'i nang bzhugs mdzad pas/ da lta sa skya pa'i chos la sbyangs pa che zhing / nyams len gyi rgyun dang gzhan phan kun khyab 'di de'i nus pa lags/ de nas zhang 'khrul zhig tu skyes/ khong gi bsnams phod gting skyes na 'dug pa ngo shes byung / de nas gnyos lha snang bar skyes rjes/ tshe snga ma'i las snang gis dran pa 'di rang gsal ba 'dug gye rer phyin dus dngos po re re nas dran pa'i gsal cha dang / lhag par bal po rgyal pos phul ba'i lhung bzed de yang ngo shes nas blangs pas sbyin/ da lta chos lung byang rtse na bzhugs pa 'di yin/ de nas kun mkhyen saṅga bha drar skye ba 'phos/ de dus traka shad 'di dam la thogs pas/ deng sang bu bzhin bsrung bar mdzad kyi snang / kun mkhyen dol bu ba dang gnyis kyi ston pa'i drung du chos lhan cig mang du zhus pa'i rdo rje spun yin pa'i dam tshig gis/ tshe 'dir jo nang pa yang phan pa cha tsam byung ngo / /de nas 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan par skyes pa yin/ dus der gzhung chen brgya rtsa'i tshig don la sbyangs pas da lta kho bo blo gsal ba yin/ brjod pa gtsang ba yin/ dge 'dun stong phrag mang po'i dbus su spobs pa che la gzengs mtho ba 'di lags pas dngos su gzigs/ de nas paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi nyin byed du skye ba bzung zhing / 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan pa la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis/ skye ba phyi ma rgya nag tu 'gro bar lung bstan pa bzhin/ siṅga la'i gling phyogs nas rgya nag tu byon par snang / de nas da lta'i mi lus 'di thob pa yin no/ /bdag gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /'bar ba'i gtso bor skyes pa'i tshe/ /bla ma klu sgrub snying po yin/ /yi dam 'phags ma sgrol ma lags/ /nag po spyod par skyes pa'i tshe/ /bla ma dza lan+dha ra ba/ /slob ma dha ma dhu ma yin/ /yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog yin/ /rāt+na chen po bha hu lar/

/skye ba bzung dus bla ma ni/ /shrī gor+ṣa nā tha yin/ /bka' srung lha mo tsan+t+ri ka /rong zom chos bzang skyes pa'i tshe/ /lung bstan jo bo lha gcig yin/ /bsnyen bsgrub ma shing phur pa yin/ /lha 'dre yongs kyis srog snying phul/ /'bab rom chen por skyes pa'i tshe/ /lha bla dwags po lha rje yin/ /yi dam phag mo dmar chung yin/ /bka' srung mgon po gri gug can/ /a wa dhu tir skyes pa'i tshe/ /bla ma la stod dkon mchog mkhar/ /yi dam bde mchog lhan skyes yin/ /bka' srung lha mo re ma ti/ /zhang ston 'khrul zhig skyes pa'i tshe/ /bla ma zhang lo mya ngan med/ /yi dam gshin rje dgra nag yin/ /bka' srung dmag zor rgyal mo yin/ /gnyos su skye ba blangs pa'i dus/ /bla ma 'jig rten gsum mgon yin/ /yi dam 'jam pa'i rdo rje yin/ /bka' srung trak+shad nag po yin/ /sang gha bha drar skyes pa'i tshe/ /bla ma rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /yi dam 'khor lo chen po yin/ /bka' srung dpal mgon traka shad yin/ /'jam dbyangs chos rjes skyes pa'i skabs/ /bla ma rje btsun tsong kha pa/ /yi dam dus kyi 'khor lo yin/ /bka' srung myur mdzad mgon po yin/ /chos kyi nyin byed skyes pa'i dus/ /bla ma mi yi nyi ma yin/ /yi dam sgrol ma ral gcig ma/ /bka' srung ha ri sing ha yin/ /gzhan yang rdzogs chen tshul blo dang / /dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal la/ /'gos lo chen po gzhon nu dpal/ /brag dkar sems dpa' la sogs pa/ /skyes bu 'di rnams thugs rgyud gcig /zhib tu smra bar mi spob ste/ /cha tsam rdzun min yi ger bkod/ /dran pa gsal dus ma bris na/ /shi nas sus kyang rtogs par dka'/ /'di dag ni sngon gyi skyes pa'i rabs te/ tshe 'dir skyes nas da bar gyi gnas tshul ni shin tu zhib pa'i yi ge rim can du bkod pa 'di dag la/ dad pa dang ldan pa 'ga' yod na blta bar byos shig skye ba dang tshe rabs su 'bral ba med pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/

/de lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mnga' ba'i 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog 'di nyid kyis/ lo chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du spyir zab rgyas kyi chos tshul du ma zhig dang / lhag par dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor rnams smin cing rdzogs par gsan te/ rang nyid kyi rnam thar rgyas pa'i bla ma bsten tshul gyi skabs rnams su yang / byin rlabs zil chen rgyas pa'i lo chen zhes dad gus kyi bsngags brjod ci yang zhig 'byung ba yin no/ /smras pa/ skyes chen gang de rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin gong ma rnams dang / gtsug gi rgyan ngor rdzong go shag sogs mtha' dag du mdzad/ /de 'dra'i rnam thar rjes su mi skyong khar sku skye snga ma la yang khyad sod kho na mdzad pa'i/ ba'i/ /sprul dus phyis kyi jo nang sprul sku/ par grags pa de ni som nyi'i gnas/ rgyu mtshan spros pas chog go /zhes kyang shugs 'byung du smras so/ /de ltar rje grol mchog gi zhabs 'di nyid la rang re sa skya pa'i snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos kyang 'khor lo sdom chen dang / dgra nag gi dbang sogs gsan cing / rje dam pas kyang sngags 'chang nyid la tshe dpag med dze ta ri lugs kyi dbang gis mtshon pa'i zab chos du ma gsan te/ sku bstod tshigs su bcad pa zhig kyang 'bul bar mdzad cing / dpon slob phan tshun thugs nang shin tu dag par byung ba yin te/ rje dam pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa rang nyid kyis mdzad pa las/ dge sdings su dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen pa'i drung du tshe dbang lha dgu'i dka' 'grel zhus/ gser zho gang gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ gdung rgyud rin po che'i zhabs drung nas shin tu thugs 'dre ba'i bka' drin stsal cing / slar myur du 'khor shog gsungs ba dang / zhal mkhyen gyi rnam pas spos shel las grub pa'i thub pa'i sku gcig dang /

gur gum/ khyi la wa ri khung ma/ gzhan dza ti'i sman khyad par can/ ne tso dang bcas pa bsnams phebs dgos gsungs mnyes mnyes dpag med mdzad/ ces dang / yang rnam thar de nyid las/ dpal ldan sa skyar gdung brgyud rin po che'i thugs bzhed kyi spos shel gyi thub pa/ dzo ka'i rdzas sna tshang / gur gum/ ne tso sogs dgongs pa la 'byor pa'i dges pa bskyed/ spyir rten che long dang / khyad par rje btsun rin po che'i sku 'dra mdze thod ma la dgongs pa khyad par can gyi rten 'brel gyi dbang las snyan dar sna lnga/ spos chag li'i maṇ+ḍal/ sgo rum gyi mgon po'i drung du snyan dar kha yig 'byar ba bcu gsum/ gser gyi mchod phran/ dge 'dun bcu phrag lhag gi gtor sgrub dang bcas 'dod don zhus/ de skabs bzhi thog tu gdung rgyud rin po che'i thugs dam brgyud pa'i bris sku zab bris rnams bzhugs pa'i sgam de'i kha 'byed mdzad/ drung pa rang gi phyag gis gang zin gcig thog mar zhal 'byed par zhu/ rten 'brel zhig lta gsungs/ gcig blangs zhal phye bas nag po spyod pa'i sku byung / thugs mtshar mtshar gnang gi 'dug ces 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar sngon byon pa'i grub chen nag po spyod pa'i sprul pa'i sku rje dam pa de nyid zhing gzhan du gshegs par nye ba'i gzhan ngor sku snyel ba'i tshul bstan nas chos lung byang rtser bzhugs skabs/ dpal sa skya nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos lha sa rdzong pa sogs kyi skor gyi bka' gros gnang / che ba 'ga' zhig gi 'phen skor dang / lhag par brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'i sku tshab cher gtad gnang ba'i lan du/ rje dam pa rang gi zhu yig phyag bris ma 'di bzhin 'bul bar mdzad pa yin te/ dpal sa skya pa chen po gang gi zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa'i drung du/ gus pa'i phyag lan brgyar bgyis nas zhu ba/ bka'i rtags kha btags dang bcas phebs/ gzhis dga' rin spungs pa sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i srog tu gyur pa'i skur yul gnyan yang /

mdzad go log pas da ni ci 'dra 'char snyam pa'i sems tsab tsob rang mchis/ snga mor byang gi ngo len 'bad 'bad byed pa/ sbrul lo chos phyogs nas rje lo chen gyi dbu mdzad byang pa'i ser thogs/ 'jig rten nas bdag chen pas gtso mdzad/ dpon g.yog phyogs gtogs kyi rkang pa lcags las byas pas spyi bo bro 'khrab pa'i ngan lan du song dogs nas/ dgos med shing rgas po'i bar du mdzub mo brdzangs pa yin zhing / de phyin bya ba che 'bring chung gsum/ tha na zhu ngo gcig gi gcog gnyer med pa'i kun gsal 'dir mchis na'ang / lha sa rdzong pa'i thad blo yul du ma tshud grags kha nas dogs shor song / gzhan bdag 'dras gang yong lags pas/ 'chi ba bsgugs nas bsdad yod mchis/ bdag gi khams dbus dman/ dang kha 'gags/ spag kham gcig mid par mi 'gro bar/ tshod ma dang / bshos ldag thur ma'i rtses len dgos pa'i lus zungs zad/ lang brtan mi thub par nyin mtshan 'gyel ba'i ngang la mal las gom gang mi g.yo ba 'dir mchis pas/ da shi na de ring dang nang par yang / de ring shi ba dga' ba'i gnas na mchis/ byang pa gang dran gyi ma 'ongs pa'i mtha' mi dgongs pa la yang / logs nas sems ma bde yang / zhu rgyu zad mchis/ 'phen ne nad g.yog rang la bcar yod/ rlung 'phral 'phral yong ba zhig 'dug pas/ glo bur ba byung dogs rdzong mi nus pa dgongs dbyings mi 'gal ba dang / bdag gi tsho ma zin na tshul phul ba phral rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod zhag sbrel zhig thugs la 'dogs dgos/ gzhan zhu rgyu med cing / mi sna bzhin gtan mi gnang ba mkhyen/ zhu rten du brtan bzhugs slar log mtshon pa'i zhabs gdan 'di nyid la rtags 'byar/ yi ge 'bri ba yang ngal ba'i ngang nas zhu'o/ /zhes pa'i zhu yig dang bcas brtan bzhugs slar log gi tshul du gdan sa chen por sngags 'chang nyid la 'bul bar mdzad pas/ de'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po sku dngos dang /

phyis byon pa'i nged rang sa skya pa'i zhal ngo thams cad sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i sgo rmad du byung ba rang 'grig tu gyur pa yin no/ /de ltar 'phags pa'i yul gyi nag po spyod pa nyid gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir dge slong mchog gi zol du byon pa'i skyes chen dam pa gang des/ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rgyun rnams phyogs dang ris med pa'i gdul bya rnams la spel ba las/ rgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo rnams kyi ya gyal paṇa chen shākya shrī/ chos rgyud 'dzin pa'i jo gdan tshogs pa'i bla ma mkhan chen shes rab rin chen gyi drung du/ kho bo cag gi rdo rje slob dpon chen po lo nas spyan snga rin po che sprul pa'i sku byams pa kun dga' don grub kyis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin grol gyis bsdus pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan nas bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la dges bzhin du gnang ba lags so/ /de lta bu'i spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa rgyas par ni logs su 'chad par spro zhing / 'dir ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa rnams nyung ngu'i ngag gis tshigs bcad du bsdebs te gsol 'debs dang sbyar nas bstan par bya ste/ de yang / sngon tshe chos kyi rgyal po tshul khrims 'bar/ /phyis rabs ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa zhes/ /dus 'dir spyan snga byams pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskal brgyar zhabs brtan mdzod/ /gang sku ngo mtshar tshul khrims dri bsung g.yo/ /gang gsung zab rgyas chos kyi sgo brgya 'byed/ /gang thugs bde gsal mi rtog ngang gnas pa'i/ /gang yang yon tan dpag med gter la 'dud/ /gzhon nu nyid nas dam pa'i rigs sad de/ /yi ge la sogs shes bya'i gnas phal cher/ /ma bslabs par yang phul phyin khongs su tshud/ /kun gyi yid rab 'phrog par mdzad la 'dud/

/mgon khyod sku gsum mngon du mdzad zin kyang / /'jig rten drang phyir brgyud ldan bla ma las/ /skyon med bstan pa'i rtsa ba legs nos te/ /dkar phyogs lha yi dga' ston spel la 'dud/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes chen bgrang yas las/ /mdo sngags zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /ngom pa med par gsol ba'i dge mtshan gyis/ /deng dus bstan pa'i nyi mar gyur la 'dud/ /so so thar pa'i rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /byang chub sems gnyis lo 'dab bye bas mdzes/ /gsang chen me tog 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ /sdom gsum dpag bsam ljon pa khyed la 'dud/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i mngon rtogs yon tan brnyes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas skal bzang gdul bya skyong / /'dzin skyong spel bas thub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad don gnyis grub la 'dud/ /yi dam lha dang bstan srung dbang po'i tshogs/ /gzhan yang lha mchog zhi khro rab 'byams kyi/ /mtshan dus grangs kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i rgyan du gyur la 'dud/ /gangs can ma rung 'dul mdzad sprul pa'i sku/ /pad+mas byin brlabs gter khrol gnas su khyod gshegs tshe/ /skal bzang 'ga' la u rgyan dngos su bstan/ /lha yi me tog sil mas mchod la 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i sras po dpal ldan a ti sha'i/ /thugs kyi snying po bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la/ /gsol ba btab pas jo bos zhal bstan nas/ /rdo rje gcod pa'i zab don nos la 'dud/ /bod yul rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa cher/ /dam can chos skyong las la bskul ba'i tshe/ /khyod ni sngon tshe rgyal sras thogs med ces/ /'phrin las mgon po'i lung bstan brnyes la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo nag po che'i/ /phyi yi las mkhan rjes gnang stsal ba'i tshe/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun dngos su phab la 'dud/ /mdor na khyed kyi mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs/

/brtse bas 'jig rten dbang phyug zil gyis gnon/ /nus pas nyon mongs ye shes bsgyur mdzad pa'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan yongs 'dzin dam par 'dud/ /mgon khyod yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khur chen po/ /phyogs dus kun tu 'khyer la mi ngal bas/ /rjes su slob pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu yis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di khyab par mdzad la 'dud/ /khyod kyi yon tan srad bu mtha' med cing / /rnam thar nor bu brjod pa'i bu ga bral/ /des na bdag 'dra'i phreng ba mkhan po yis/ /cha shas 'ga' yang brgyu bar nus min yang / /rang bzhin dag pas ston gyi nam mkha' la/ /ma bkod phreng du bsgrigs pa'i rgyu skar bzhin/ /bdag blo dwangs pa'i yid kyi chu gtsang las/ /ma btab bstod tshig me tog phreng 'di 'bul/ /de ltar dam pa'i rnam thar brjod pa las/ /las dkar bsags pa gang des skye bo kun/ /kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras kyi rjes 'gro zhing / /zhing 'di'i phan bde'i dpal 'byor rgyas par shog /bdag kyang gang gi drin las nyer thob pa'i/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul rgya mtsho yis/ /skal bzang 'gro la chos kyi char phab ste/ /brgyud 'dzin slob mas ljongs 'di khyab gyur cig /ces rang nyid la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab rgyas chos kyi bka' drin stsol ba'i dpal ldan bla ma gang gi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rgya mtsho lta bu rnams yi ge'i tshegs bskyung ba'i phyir nyung ngu'i ngag gis gsol ba 'debs pa dang sbyar te tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas brjod de/ da ni brgyud pa'i lugs srol gzhan yang bshad par bya ba ni/ gong du bstan pa'i kun mkhyen nam mkha' chos skyong gi rgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma'i gtso bo paṇa chen dus zhabs pa nam mkha' dpal bzang po ba ni gtsang bzang yul zhes bya ba ru yab yum rigs ldan gyi sras su shing pho spre'u'i lo la sku bltams/ gdung rus gnyag yin/ rje 'di sku skye ba snga ma nas mdo rgyud mtha' dag la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa mdzad pas/

gnas lnga rig pa mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur kyang / 'dir 'jig rten pa'i skye bo phal pa rnams ma dad pa spang ba'i phyir/ bshes gnyen dam pa bsten pa'i tshul du mdzad de/ mkhas grub dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi gsung rab phal mo che gsan par mdzad cing / chos rje shes rab 'od zer ba/ kun mkhyen nam mkha' chos skyong / sems dpa' chen po kun dga' dpal ldan pa rnams la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan cing / zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor thugs nyams su bzhes pas mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med du mnga' ba dang / rlung bcu dbu mar chud pas bde nyams 'ur langs shing rtags bcu yon tan brgyad sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma brtan po brnyes/ dgon gsar dpal ldan 'bras spungs su grags pa btab nas sgrub pa pho mo rnams la zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dus rgyun du gnang bar mdzad cing / chos kyi rgyal po rnam rgyal grags bzang pa'i gdan sa yang lo bco brgyad kyi bar du mdzad/ mi dbang ta si chen po nam mkha' legs pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba yab sras mes dbon blon por bcas pa'i mi chen po rnams kyis kyang zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs te/ zab lam kyi bdud rtsi'i ros tshim par mdzad/ sle ga 'bras spungs/ lhun grub sdeng rnams su phyogs nas byon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams dang / gzhir bzhugs pa'i sgom chen pho mo skya ser skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag mang po la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang man ngag rgyud bshad dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bde kye gsang gsum/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ma hā ma ya/ gshed dmar/ nai gu /ma cig blo sbyong / tshe khrid/ kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum sogs gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun ldan du bskor bar mdzad pas nges don gyi bstan pa'i snying po gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/

/rje 'di nyid kyi 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal las grol kyang / bdag sogs rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir dgung lo drug cu rtsa drug pa sa mo glang gi lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la lha'i dri bzang po dang / 'ja' 'od dang / me tog gi char chen po dang bcas te chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i pho brang du gshegs so/ /sku gdung bzhu mchod phul bas ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur to/ /rjes de la bu slob du ma byon pa las/ sras kyi thu bo mkhas mchog shes rab bkra shis pa/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ gling dpon chen ting 'dzin 'od zer ba/ btsan ma dpon chen pa/ chos rje bkra shis seng ge ba/ chos rje 'brug sgra rgya mtsho ba rnams so/ /sras kyi thu bo mkhas mchog shes rab bkra shis ni/ gtsang ma'i rigs su 'khrungs shing mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma las zab rgyas kyi chos tshul mtha' yas pa gsan cing / lhag par mkhas grub nam mkha' dpal bzang gi drung du/ rgyud sde'i nges gsang mchog gi nying khu ngom par gsol te/ lung rtogs kyi yon tan du ma'i mnga' bdag tu gyur nas/ 'dul bar 'os pa'i gdul bya grangs med pa zhig bskyangs pa las chos kyi rje byams pa shākya 'od zer sogs rgyud 'dzin gyi slob bu nam mkha' dwangs pa la skar ma bkra ba lta bu'i grangs dang tshad med pa zhig bskrun par mdzad de/ slar gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshe yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /rje de nyid kyi bu slob rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pa chos rje byams pa shākya 'od kyi rnam par thar pa mdo tsam tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas brjod pa ni 'di ltar/ byams pa'i thugs kyis 'gro la rab brtse bas/ /shākya'i bstan la de nyid gnyis pa ltar/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'od zer spro mkhas pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin nam mkha'i nor bu de la 'dud/

/mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes chen du ma las/ /gsan pa rgya mtsho'i zab rgyas pha mthar son/ /khyad par rje btsun shes rab mtshan can gyi/ /sras kyi thu bor gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum la/ /thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab mchog mnga' bas/ /bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dus 'khor gyi/ /chos kyi sgron me gsal bar mdzad der 'dud/ /khyed kyi gsung las skyes pa'i sras kyi mchog /dus zhabs par grags chos dar grags 'phel sogs/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu du ma bskrun mdzad pa'i/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi mar gyur der 'dud/ /zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i don rnams rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /'gro kun yid 'phrog ngo mtshar ltas dang bcas/ /bde ba'i lam nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes chos rje byams pa shākya 'od zer gyi rnam par thar pa cung zad tshigs bcad du spel nas/ da ni de'i thugs sras dus zhabs pa chen po chos dar grags 'phel gyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa'i cha shas rnams cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang dam pa'i rigs su 'khrungs shing / chos kyi bag chags bzang po sad pas gzhon nu nyid nas mkhas btsun gyi yon tan ngang gis rdzogs/ skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros rab tu gsal bas mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams kyis ma gcig pa'i bu bzhin bskyangs te zab rgyas chos tshul rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tu gyur/ lhag par mkhas grub byams pa shāka 'od dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i legs lam la brten dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur/ bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la brtag 'grus su mdzad pas/ snyigs dus skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba 'gyur med bde chen sogs chos las skyes pa'i thugs kyi sras mchog du mas rgya mtsho'i gos can mdzes par byas/

mthar gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshe yang sgra dang 'od dang me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyis phyogs kun tu khyab par bkang nas dag pa'i zhing du thogs pa med par gshegs par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyi brgyud 'dzin bu slob kun gyi gtso bor gyur pa ni/ rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po 'gyur med bde chen te/ 'di'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar gyi snying po rnams dad ldan gyi slob mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rje de nyid rang gis tshigs bcad du bsdebs par mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba de nyid 'dir bshad par bya ste/ de yang ji skad du/ na mo mdzu na thā ya/ dal 'byor rmad byung dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /grub rigs yongs 'du'i tshal du lcags byi yi/ /smin drug zla ba'i 'phel ba dang 'grogs te/ /skye ba yongs su bzung la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus der tshe rabs mang por dge ba'i bshes/ /chos kyi spyan ldan lo chen rat+na'i zhabs/ /spyi bor bzhag nas 'gyur med bde chen zhes/ /ming btags byin gyis brlabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bcu phrag lon tshe rdo rje'i slob dpon che/ /dpal ldan lhun grub zhabs pad nye bar bsten/ /gsang bdag dkyil 'khor du bcug dbang bskur nas/ /bsnyen sogs dag par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bcu gsum pa la rje btsun rtse mo'i zhabs/ /gus bsten lam 'bras nai gu'i khrid tshul la/ /thos bsam sgom pas rgyud sbyangs dge tshul bsgrubs/ /ngur smrig 'dzin par gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas rang lo bcu dgu'i bar dag tu/ /mgon de'i zhabs bsten sa skya'i ring lugs la/ /rgya cher sbyangs shing dges rdor gzhi bsnyen sogs/ /bzlas brjod klog pas brel la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas nyi shu lon tshe spyan ras gzigs/ /lo chen rat+nas mkhan po rtse mo'i zhabs/ /las slob gsang ston sangs rgyas dpal ldan sogs/

/tshogs su bsnyen par rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par mchog gzigs rje btsun rat+na yis/ /rnal 'byor drug pa nyams khrid du stsal te/ /lus gnad lta stangs byed pa 'ching ba'i gnad/ /nan tan chen pos bsten la gsol ba 'debs/ /lo bzhi zla brgyad bsam gtan khang bu ru/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan g.yo ba med par bzung / /dad dang nges 'byung 'od gsal 'char sgo sogs/ /byin rlabs stobs las shar der gsol ba 'debs/ /skabs der snyan rgyud gdams pa'i chu bo cher/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa chos kyi blo gros kyis/ /bka' rgyud gnyis kyi chos kyi sgo phye nas/ /dbang lung gdams pa stsal der gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos lo chen zhabs drung du/ /sgrub pa'i kun bzang mchod sprin phul nas slar/ /lam 'bras la sogs chos tshul rgyal mtsho'i dpal/ /brtse ba chen pos gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /skabs der lo chen dges pa'i 'dzum zhal las/ /dus gsum dge ba'i bslab ston ci yang stsal/ /lhag par gzhung lugs kun la 'jug pa'i sgo/ /sgra rig slobs shes bskul la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam mgon grol mchog zhal gyi pad+mo las/ /dbang khrid rjes gnang sbrang rtsi ci yang 'thungs/ /khyad par ye shes mkha' 'gro nai gu ma'i/ /zab lam dges bzhin stsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'khor zhabs pa chos dar grags 'phel las/ /yongs rdzogs dpal ldan sdom pa chen po dang / /rgyud dang sems 'grel bdag po chen po'i dbang / /yongs su rdzogs par nos la gsol ba 'debs/ /stag lo nyi 'og dbus kyi rgyal khams cher/ /zas gtsang sras dang srong btsan sgam po yi/ /rab gnas byin rlabs rten rnams mjal ba dang / /mkhas grub 'tshol phyir gshegs la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyan snga dam pa chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs/ /gus bsten dbang khrid rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /skad gnyis smra ba rab tshe zla ba las/ /rig gnas ku mud bzhad der gsol ba 'debs/

/lo chen bshes gnyen rnam par rgyal ba las/ /sgra snyan legs bshad bdud rtsi ci yang blangs/ /'phags yul glegs bam yid 'phrog me na kā /blta ba'i blo mig thob der gsol ba 'debs/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa/ /'jang bu'i drang srong che der chos don gnyer/ /nyams dga'i skyed tshal sgo drung nas bsus te/ /thogs med mngon shes gsungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpe med 'tsho dang grub mchog sha wa ra'i/ /gdams pa nags kyi rin chen las 'ongs pa/ /zab las ches zab bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /snying gi bum pa gang la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung rab dka' ba'i gnas la dpyad pa yi/ /'dri dang lan ldon mkhas pa'i rna rgyan du/ /mdzes pa'i rin chen rgyan phreng spel mkhas pa/ /smra ba'i dbang po mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /khams drug ldan pa mchog gi dngos grub kyi/ /snod du 'os pa skal bzang gdul bya la/ /shin tu myur ba zab mo'i lam bstan te/ /smin cing grol bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar bsngags 'os dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /rab tu dwangs pas rtse gcig gsol btab pas/ /gdod nas gnas pa'i lhan skyes ye shes che/ /mngon gyur phan bde'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /ces bstod tshig gi phreng ba rnam par spel ba 'di/ rang nyid la lung rtogs kyi yon tan ci yang med kyang / dad sogs 'phags nor gyis mdzes pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i bkas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ skad gnyis smra ba'i btsun pa 'gyur med bde chen gyis grub ri'i bsam gtan khang bur bkod nas phul ba'o/ /de lta bu'i rnam thar gsol 'debs de nyid las/ dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa/ /mdzangs bu'i drang srong che der chos don gnyer/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi don ni/ rje 'gyur med bde chen nyid kyis lha sa'i jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs dbus phyogs kyi gnas mjal la phebs pa'i tshe/

zha lu lo chen gyi dngos slob 'jang bu'i chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis cher gtad mjal bar phebs pa na/ chos rje kun rgyal bas kyang thugs mkhyen gyis dgongs te/ gzim khang la phyag dar sogs mdzad cing / spyir chos rje de rgyun du sku mtshams kho na la bzhugs pas thugs mkhyen thogs med mnga' ba sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar can du ma mnga' zhing / sne gdong gong ma drag zhan sus spyan drangs kyang mi 'byon pa sogs thugs thag chod cing rgal tshig shin tu bzang ba zhig yin kyang / rje 'gyur med nyid la thugs lhag par mos pas gzim khang gi sgo drung du bsu ba la byon nas phyag sngon la 'tshal ba sogs mdzad cing / sgrub khang gi nang du yang rje 'gyur med la bzhugs khri shin tu mtho ba dang / chos rje kun rgyal ba rang bzhugs gdan srab mo zhig la bzhugs nas/ sgrib med thol byung gi tshul du khong rang sngon rgya gar phyag na yin pa dang / rje 'gyur med bde chen nyid mnga' bdag mai tri pa yin pa'i tshul gyi sngon gyi skyes rabs rnams gsal bar gsungs shing / phan tshun thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba de nyid ston pa la dgongs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba chen po dpal 'gyur med bde ba chen po de nyid las rgyud 'dzin gyi slob bu ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni/ spyan ras gzigs mi'i zol 'dzin pa lo chen sprul pa'i sku 'phrin las dbang phyug 'gos pad+ma stong btsan gyi skye ba sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ thub bstan yangs pa can gyi mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs dbang phyug dpal bzang / grwa tshang chen mo'i mkhan po chos rje bla ma/ nags dgon chen mo sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ chos rje dkon mchog legs 'dzin/ lcags zam gdung dbon bsam grub lha khang pa/ 'bras spungs gdan sa byams pa bkra shis/

chos rje chos 'phel bkra shis/ mnga' ris bla ma bkra shis 'od zer/ rje dbon mkhas btsun/ 'bum dmar gdan sa nam mkha' bde legs/ phug chen sprul sku/ rgod tshang gdan sa pa/ sgam nag bla ma u rgyan thugs 'dzin/ brang chung bla ma 'phags pa ba/ ka thog pa/ bkras sgang chos rje/ pho brang dbu mdzad pa/ gling dga' mkhan chen/ rje rin chen chos 'phel/ rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ ngam ring mkhan chen tshul khrims rgyal po/ gshong chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ dge bcu gdan sa pa rje byams pa phun tshogs/ grub chen dbon po kun dga' blo gsal/ rtsa gong gdan sa pa sku mched/ shel dkar chos dpon 'phags pa lha/ thub bstan mkhan po ngag dbang chos grags/ me lung mkhan po shes rab nor bu/ rnam rgyal lha rtse'i mkhan po blo gros phun tshogs/ bsam gling mkhan po rgya mtsho pad dkar/ thugs sras sprul pa'i sku gser pa sprul pa'i sku/ sgam po sprul pa'i sku rin chen dpal bzang / chos rje kun dga' dpal ldan/ 'bum chen dpal 'byor shes rab/ las chen lha'i dbang po/ las chen chos grags/ khra mo slob dpon rngo pa rang 'grel ba/ chos sde chen po'i dbu mdzad rin po che 'ga' rong pa/ chu bzang bla ma bzod pa rin chen/ so tshe'i bla ma bsod nams/ skyar skya byang ri'i chos rje/ byang rtse dbon chen mang thos mtshan can/ shar phyogs dgon gsar bla ma dbon ral pa/ lha phu gdan sa pa/ bdag chen chos rgyal ba/ te se'i bla ma klu rgyal chos rje/ de'i gdan sa yon btsun ras chung / brang so'i slob dpon ye shes grags pa/ bla ma lho ma ba/ rags ljongs slob dpon dkon mchog blo gros/ bya btang kun tu bzang po/ bla ma ze ra ba/ mtsho 'gugs bla ma sgrol ma seng ge /rin po che grags pa mchog sbyin/ bya gshongs gdan sa pa byams chos pa/ rin po che nam mkha' ba/ thub bstan mkhan po sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ me lung mkhan po shar rang ba/

bya btang brtson 'grus bkra shis/ bya btang tshul khrims bkra shis/ bya btang sangs rgyas mgon po/ sgrub chen gdong dga' ba/ sgrub chen 'be ri ba/ shel dkar chos dpon rje drung dkar po ba/ chos 'khor lhun po'i bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ byams pa chos gling gi bla ma rdo rje bkra shis/ rdor gling gdan sa pa mang thos/ rgyal khams spyi'i bla ma chos skyong bde legs sogs grangs dang tshad med cig byon nas rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di la ngal ba byin pa yin no/ /de ltar rgya gar grub pa'i dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri pa chen po'i sku'i rnam par sprul pa lo chen 'gyur med bde chen de nyid dgung lo bdun bcu don drug gi bar du bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad nas/ de nas srin po zhes pa shing mo yos kyi lo dus 'khor ba'i zla ba dang po'i tshes drug gi nyin sku cung zad dub pa'i tshul bstan pa la/ nyid kyi gcung gtso bor gyur pa'i zhabs 'bring pa rnams kyis brtan bzhugs dang sku rim rgya chen po bsgrubs pas/ tshes brgyad dang dgu gnyis la sku khams shin tu dwangs pa byung zhing / de nas le lo can rnams brtson 'grus la bskul ba dang / rtag 'dzin rnams nges 'byung skyed pa'i phyir du yar ngo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la babs pa na sku rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par mdzad nas dgongs pa 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan te/ de las zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs pa'i tshe/ shangs bug g.yon pa nas byang sems 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu ro sbrang rtsi ltar mngar ba dri phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa lhug par byon cing / nam mkha' la yang 'ja' dang / 'od dang / me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyis sa dang bar snang thams cad khyab par bkang ste dag pa'i zhing du thogs pa med par gshegs par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag dpal 'gyur med bde ba chen po de nyid kyi chos las skyes pa'i sras mchog bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa ni/

bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rje btsun mus pa chen po nyid yin te/ skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa cung zad brjod na/ de yang yongs su 'dzin pa chen po kho bo cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'di nyid ni/ nges pa kho nar bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu rnam pa thams cad mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po ro mnyam pa'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du mdzad zin kyang / gdul bya gzhan gyi ngor nam yang zab mo chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du de'i gzugs kyi sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa mchog dang / mchog ma yin pa'i sgo nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang / dpag bsam gyi shing las 'dod dgu mtha' dag 'byung ba'am/ nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa tshon sna tshogs pa dang 'phrad na de dang de'i kha dog mdzes pa 'dzin pa ji lta ba bzhin gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang / bsam pa dang / dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i gang zag tu nges pa las/ 'dir ni so so skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul bzung bar snang ste/ de ltar yang rje sa paṇa gyis/ khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas/ /gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin la/ des na kho bo cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'di nyid gzhan don du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul dang / mchog gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul gyi rnam par thar pa tsam zhig brjod na/ de yang dang po ni phyogs gang du/ dus nam gyi tshe 'khrungs pa'i tshul bstan snyam na/ bod 'dir sa'i cha gsum du gnas pa las/

bar gyi cha/ de la yang ru bzhir grags pa las g.yas ru'i khongs su gtogs pa/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong ba'i mnga' 'og dol smad ces bya ba'i 'brog gseb tu/ mi'u rigs bzhi las ldong gi rus 'dzin pa/ yab shangs pa chos skyong bkra shis bya ba bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad cing sems can la snying rje che ba/ lugs gnyis la mkhyen pa rgyas pa zhig dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i mtshan rtags dang ldan pa'i ston mtsho ma tog gzungs skyabs ma zhes bya ba dad pa dang snying rje che zhing dkon mchog gi zhabs tog la brtson pa zhig gi sras su/ dus ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa lung gi dus/ mdo sde spyod pa nas brgya phrag gcig dang bcu phrag brgyad dang nyag ma bzhi 'das pa'i lnga pa'i steng su slebs pa/ dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i gza' tshes bzang po'i nyin/ bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'di nyid bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas mngal gyi dri mas ma gos bzhin du phru ma sgom thag gi tshul du byas nas yum la gnod pa med par bde bar bltams shing / lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe na'ang yum la rmi ltas bzang po du ma dang / nyin bar gyi tshe yang shes pa gsal zhing bde bas brgyan pa dang / lus ldang ba yang zhing zo mdog bde ba la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rtags khyad par can du ma byung bar mngon/ de lta bu'i dam pa'i skyes bu gzhon nu de ni gzugs bzang mdzes la lta na sdug pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar zhing zlum pa/ shangs gzangs mtho ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes che zhing / spyan ut+pal ltar bkra ba/ kun gyi yid du 'ong ba zhig go /zhes thos la/ de nas yab yum rnams kyis dga' mgu yi rang ba dang bcas mtshan khro bo rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar btags so/ /gnyis pa mchog gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad pa la don tshan bcu gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i don rnams zhib tu shes par 'dod na/

logs su bstan pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa rnams las rtogs par bya zhing / 'dir de dag gi snying po bsdus pa'i cha shas mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ bdag cag yongs su 'dzin pa chen po mtshungs pa med pa'i rdo rje slob dpon 'di nyid ni/ nges pa'i don du khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog gi tshul bzung ba yin pa'i phyir de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa rdzogs par ni rje nyid rang dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas nang phan tshun dag gis rtogs pa dang brjod par nus pa yin gyis/ gzhan sar gnas kyi byang sems dag gis kyang de ltar ma yin na/ bdag lta bu'i so so skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan dag gis brjod par nus pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ 'on kyang rang nyid mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen pos kun nas bslangs te mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig ste/ de yang mkhas pa'i tshul ni/ spyir shes bya'i yul thams cad dang / lhag par sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde'i tshogs mu mtha' med pa rnams dang / de'i nang nas kyang rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kye gsang gsum/ yo ga bya spyod dang bcas pa'i rgyud/ rgya gzhung / 'grel pa/ 'grel bshad/ dbang khrid man ngag zhar byung phyag len phra mo tshun la'ang mkhas pa'i mchog dam par dus mtshungs pa'i mkhas shing mkhas par grags pa'i sa skyong chen po rnams dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / rnam dpyod rab tu gsal ba'i skye bo kun gyis mgrin gcig tu 'dzin pa'i yul du gyur pa yin la/ btsun pa'i tshul ni so thar gyi bslab tshigs gsum gyis rim pa bzhin thugs rgyud gtams pa nas bzung / nyes ltung rags pa rnams kyis lta ci smos/ skye bcad kyi nyes pa tsam gyis kyang ma gos pa'i lo rgyus yod la/

tha na bla gos bzhes lugs ma legs pa tsam yang zhabs drung du yun ring du bsdad pa'i skye bo sus kyang mthong ma myong pa yin zhing / dbu lo dang na bza' sogs la'ang tshul khrims kyi dri zhim khyad par can 'byung ba ni kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa 'di yin no/ /byang sems kyi sdom pa bzhes phyin phar gnod pa lta ga la zhig ste/ tshur gnod pa chen po byas pa la yang khong khro ba tsam yang mi mnga' zhing / gnod lan du phan pa kho na bsgrub par mdzad la/ dus ngan gyi skye bo drin lan log par 'jal ba'i bdud sprul 'ga' zhig gis rje rang gi sku la brdegs pa dang / tshig ngan gyi mtshon cha'i char chen po phab pa la'ang thugs bzod pa chen pos de ma thag bshags pa bzhes pa dang / slar sdang shugs dag gis byed pas nged la'ang khong khro skyes nas dge sbyor la gnod par byung bas rang gzhan kun las ngan la sbyar bas shin tu ma legs zhes thugs la khro ba cung zad 'khrungs pa la yang 'gyod pa bzod blag med pa lta bu mdzad cing / zhal nas kyang / sngon gyi thang sku rnams kyi rgyab yig la/ rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes bris pa 'di chos pa rnams kyis blo la 'jog dgos zhes yang yang gsungs so/ /rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa dbang dus su tshul bzhin du thob pa lam dus su gus pa dang brtag pa'i sbyor bas nan tan du bsrung sdom mdzad pa la brten nas de'i sdom pa'i snying po rim pa gnyis kyi lam la mngon par byang chub ste/ tha mal gyi rtog pa gang gis kyang brdze bar mi nus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la dbang 'byor ba yin te/ de'i tshul ni rje rang gi gsung las kyang / sngon mar pa lho brag pas paṇa chen na ro pa'i drung du dbang thob phyin chad nas bzung tha mal rnam rtog gis brdzi ma myong gsungs pa ltar/ sa skya pa'i bla chen gong ma lnga dang /

de'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa rim par byon pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bla ma gong ma 'ga' re la de 'dra ba'i rtogs pa 'khrungs 'dug pa bzhin nged kyis kyang rje btsun dam pa mkhan chen chos dbang phyug pa sogs la dbang thob nas zhag 'ga' tha mal rnam rtogs gi brdzi ma myong zhes gsungs shing / nyams len thams cad sems dang 'dre dgos pa yin pas/ chos gang nyams su len yang sems dang bsres nas byed dgos zhes yang yang gsungs/ dus phyis bdag sogs dad ldan gyi slob grangs mi nyung tsam zhabs drung du yod pa'i skabs 'ga' re yang spyan 'bras shangs kyi rtser zim bur gzigs shing ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la mnyam par 'jog pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ de'i ngang la rgyun po'i bar 'byams 'gro zhing / slar gzim sgo phye ba sogs rkyen gyis ting nge 'dzin de las sad yong ba yang yang mthong zhing / snga gong nas kyang 'di 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du 'byams pa'i lo rgyus mang po yod la/ bu slob 'ga' zhig la nged la nyams rtogs chen po med kyang ye shes 'jug ldog du ma yong kyi 'dug ces kyang gsungs 'dug go /de ltar mkhas pa dang btsun pa'i yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag nyid kyi bzang po'i yon tan mtha' dag lta ci smos/ kho bo rang gi blo ngor shar ba tsam zhig brjod kyang mtha' yas mod/ 'dir mtshon pa tsam zhig brjod na spyir rje bla ma 'di nyid ni chos mdzad gzhan gyi lugs ltar bcad rgya la sogs pa'i skabs 'di dang 'dir thugs dam la brtson la/ de las gzhan pa'i 'di dang 'dir mi brtson no zhes pa'i skabs med par dus khor yug tu mtshan gung gi cha la sku khams gso ba'i mnal gyi rnal 'byor cung zad re dang / snga dro dang phyi dro'i thun mtshams gang rigs la gsung rab zab mo'i gzigs rtog gam/ yang chos zhu ba yod tshe rang gi chos thun rnams gsungs pa sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i skabs rnams ma gtogs pa nyin mtshan khor yug tu thugs dam 'ba' zhig la bzhugs pa yin la/

de la brten nas ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan khyad par can 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/ zab mo'i yang rtse mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor la brten nas sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / 'chi 'pho skye ba len pa'i tshul sgrib med du gzigs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa gzigs pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa'ang thugs la 'khrungs shing lung bstan khyad par can thob pa dang / 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor 'byongs pa'i rtags mtshan mig yod kun gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa yin te/ de yang rje'i zhal nas/ nged kyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi rin chen bzhi'i bsnyen pa byas nas bzung lus kyi shig rnams med/ da dung khog pa'i nang na srin 'bu cung zad yod tshod du 'dug ces sgrib g.yog dang bcas gsungs pa dang / bde mchog gi rdzogs rim zab mo'i dpyid thig gi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu bzhugs skabs sbyin bdag ma zhig 'das nas de'i yar 'dren la spyan drangs nas/ de dus kyi sbyin bdag ma de gang du skye ba sogs shes pa tsam byung gsungs shing / rdzogs rim zab mo'i dpyid thig la brten nas nyams rtogs khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor la rang dbang thob pa'i rtags ni rje nyid kyi dbu gtsug na dbu thod gzhan las mtho ba'i ting phor sgong zhabs kyi tshad tsam pa'i dbu thod 'bur mo zhig yod pa la rje'i gsung las/ nged kyi thod pa 'bur ba 'di rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma de sbyangs pas 'byongs pa'i rtags dod yin zhing / gzhan gyis sbyangs na'ang 'di ltar 'ong zhes rje'i dbon po 'ga' zhig la gsungs 'dug pa brgyud nas thos so/ /yang dpal kyai rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chu bo ma nub par thugs nyams su bzhes pas ngo bo nyid gsum gyi lta ba mthar phyin cing bskyed rim la brtan pa thob ste/

snang srid tha mal pa 'di lha dang gzhal yas khang du gzigs pa yin te/ rje'i zhal nas/ kho bos dgon pa rdzong du kye rdo rje'i lam dus kyi nyams len tshul bzhin byung bar 'dug ste/ gnas der lam dus nyams su blang skabs/ skabs 'gar dag pa dran pa tsam du slebs pa dang / bzhugs khang tshom gyis snang ba de khrigs 'gags nas 'gro ba 'dra yang byung gsungs/ yang zab mo nai gu chos drug la brten nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa yin te/ rje'i zhal nas/ nged kyis rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho ba la nai gu chos drug zhu bzhin pa'i ngang nas bsam gtan phug tu nai gu'i zab lam chos drug so so rnams la chig bsgril du mdzad pa'i skabs shig na/ nam phyed tsam nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngo mtshar can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs nas/ sang sgrub khang la nyi ma lhag gi shar gyi bar la ting nge 'dzin de'i ngang la 'byams te nyi ma shar 'phral 'jam bkod ran par 'dug dgongs gzim phug gi phyir byon pas/ bsam gtan phug gi ri ra ba khang khyim thams cad za za'i ban bun lang long du gyur nas snang ba thams cad bden med du rtogs pa snyam byed pa byung / de mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes rtags rung tsam du gda'/ gang zag phyi mar na 'phos par go gsungs shing / yang skabs der rmi lam kyi khrid kyi skabs su rje nyid kyis bsam gtan phur mnal lam bzung nas dgon pa ma'i bla brang na rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho bzhugs pa la mjal bar phebs pas/ bla brang gi sgo de mnan 'dug pas logs kyi dkar khung las 'dzegs pa'i tshul gyis zhugs byon pas/ bla brang gi 'og gzhi me ma mur gyis khengs 'dug pa de rnams dkor rdzas su 'dug gsungs pa dang / de nas rje'i gzim chung dkar me khra thag ge 'dug pa'i nang du byon nas rje la byin rlabs zhus pas/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i phyag nas bdud rtsi ka pā la gang gnang byung gsol ba'i snang ba byung gsungs shing /
