/de nas n+ye gro dha'i phug gi g.yon na rdo'i dbang phyug rang byung zhig yod pa'i steng du bzhugs pas/ nga yul 'di nas ma 'bud ces pa'i sgra zhig grags pa dang / rgyal po ra ma pā la dbang che ste ngas yul nas phud do gsungs pas/ cung zhig na nam mkha' la 'ur sgra chen po dang / mu stegs kyi lha dang / mi'i dmag dpag tu med pas bskor byung pa la/ he ru ka spyan gsum par bstan pas bros so/ /yang phug de'i g.yon na spyan ras gzigs kyi sku rang byon gcig yod pa'i drung du bsgoms pas/ spyan ras gzigs dang / 'od zer can byon nas gdams ngag gnang / chos skyong gi rdo sku rang byon gyi drung du bzhugs pa na/ las mgon bya rog gdong can nam mkha' la byon pa la bstod pa mdzad/ sa la ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa byon pa la srog snying sgrub thabs la sogs pa zhus/ phyis tsa mis sgrub thabs dang zhus dag byas pas rtsa sngags dang srog snying la khyad ma byung / de ltar bsil ba'i tshal du zla ba dgu bzhugs pas ma ga dha/ shar bhaṃ ga la/ lho ko sa la/ nub kha che dang / u rgyan/ byang wa ra ṇa si sogs rgya gar/ bod rgya nag 'dzam bu gling thams cad du snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ rgyal po ra ma pā las grub pa'i mtshan ma ston par zhus nas dur khrod kyi mtsho gnyan po zhig yod pa'i 'gram du rgyal po dpung tshogs dang bcas pa dang / phyi nang gi paṇ+ḍi ta mang po dang / ltad mo ba mang po tshogs pa na/ mtsho'i steng du skyil krung bcas nas bzhugs pas/ mu stegs pa rnams chu la mi bying pa rlung bsgoms pas 'ong / 'di la ngo mtshar ci che zer ba la/ rang 'dra'i sku bdun sprul te mu stegs pa sun phyung bas thams cad 'dud par gyur cing / rgyal pos gdan drangs sku bkrus pa'i chus khrus 'thung byas pho brang la gtor/ glang po che 'char byed la blud ma thag des durka'i dmag pham par byas pas rgyal po mchog tu dad/ rdo rje gdan du shākya thub pa'i zhal gzigs/

bya rgod phung po'i ri bor zla ba gsum bzhugs dus/ u rgyan nas paṇ+ḍi ta mang po sga lo'i rdzu 'phrul blta ba la byon pa na/ bya chen po zhig 'phur byung pa la lta stangs mdzad pa la sa la lhung ste shi ba na/ de rnams ma rang pa dang / se gol zhig gtogs pas 'phur nas song / der yang thub pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa gzigs/ de nas na lan+d+rar byon pa'i lam du mi thams cad kyis me tog gtor ba'i gseb tu ma thar te 'phyag dgos pa byung ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams sngon chad 'di 'dra ba'i mi thams cad dad cing 'dun pa 'ong ma myong zer/ grub thob 'gas kyang zhabs la btud do/ /kos la kra mang bzhugs dus rgya gar shar phyogs nas grub thob gsum sogs rnal 'byor pa lnga brgya mjal du byung zhing / siṅga la dang / gser gling dang / zangs gling la sogs pa'i gling phran drug gi tshong pa mang pos kyang nor bu phul te/ de rnams su yang grags pas khyab/ de nas bod du byon te la stod dge phug tu lo gsum bzhugs dus/ ma jo lham gcig ma zhes pa srog chags gsod pa'i chos log spyod pa zhig 'dul ba'i ched du dge phug gi brag logs kyi gna' zhig la sdigs mdzub mdzad pas thang la lhung ste shi slar se gol gtogs pas gsos pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyis de yang dag pa'i lam la btsud/ der khams pa a seng la sbyor drug gnang / mal yer pa la bde mchog gnang / sa skyar rje sa chen la ma rgyud kye rdo rje'i sbyor drug gnang / gang du byon sar khrom ches pas mi shong pa tsam byung / de nas dbus su byon dus gtsang po la mnyan mkhan pas gru ma btang pas chu'i steng du skyil krung mdzad nas byon/ byang se mo do la lo lnga bzhugs/ der smen 'dor ba khu bsgom dang / byang chub sems dpa' stag ston rnams sbyor drug gi gdams pas grol bar mdzad/ don grub kyi zhal gzigs/ klu'i yul du byon klu rnams la'ang bstan/

gnam rtse ldang du gser brdzangs pa'i drin gzor lo gnyis bzhugs/ sga ston dang / dpal phag mo grub pa la gdams pa gnang / 'phan yul rgyal du dus gsum mkhyen pa la gdams pa gnang / byang gi 'bab rong du lo gcig mdo khams skam po gangs rar lo bdun bzhugs/ mdo smad du byon nas yab yum ni mi bzhugs/ mkhan por gdams ngag phog ste nyams rtogs la bkod/ sbyor drug gi gdams pas 'bri lung du slob ma grub pa thob pa bdun byung / rgya nag rgyal pos gdan 'dren byung pas/ de la bros nas yar byon/ mdo khams sgang du mi nag pos chos bsnubs pa rnams btul te thams cad chos la bkod/ stong tshar lha khang dang rab sgang sba mda'i gtsug lag khang sogs lha khang bshigs pa thams cad gsos/ khams kyi nag tshul skyil krung gis phar chod tshul chod mdzad pas 'phrang de la phyin chad 'grul pa la dgra med par mdzad/ nag shod du zhang la sbyor drug gnang / de nas yang 'bab rong dang mgor mdzod brag sogs su bzhugs te sku'i bkod pa gsum ston pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' ltar che ba/ sku'i bgres gzhon sna tshogs su ston pa la sogs pa cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa bstan nas 'gro ba mang po rdo rje theg pa la bkod pas/ slob ma'i tshogs grub pa thob pa mang du byung / gya dgu pa la rtse shod rang rdzong 'gor rdo rje'i skyil krung las mi g.yo bar shing bal ltar yang ba'i sku gdung bzhag ste mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to/ /gdung zhugs la phul ba'i du ba la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung ngo / /yang lo tsā ba chen po 'gyur med bde chen las dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos tshul gyi bka' drin nos pa'i zhal slob kyi gtso bo zhig ni bdag cag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa nyid yin te/ 'di'i rnam par thar pa rgyas pa ni logs su 'chad la/ 'dir mtshon pa tsam zhig rnam thar bstod pa'i tshul gyi tshigs bcad du sngar sbyar zin pa de nyid 'dir dgod par bya ste/

de yang 'di ltar/ rgya gar skad du/ dharmā swa mi shrī wan sargu ru sarba dzñā wa ka gin+d+ra dharmā kirti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ye satwo traṃ shrad+dhā bhak+ti kri pa war+ṣo3 be sha na maḥ bod skad du/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa dad gus thugs rje'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ut+pal sngo ldan te 'jam dbyangs kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ rigs kyi mtshan 'chang ba/ /gang sku 'dren byed dbang pos te gdam ngag gi mngon brjod/ mthong tsam gyis/ /yid ldan te mi'i mngon brjod/ snying po'i ste sems kyi mngon brjod/ nag nog ste sdig pa'i mngon brjod/ sel mdzad pa'i/ /ljongs 'dir dbyig 'dzin ste sa gzhi'i mngon brjod/ mdzes pa'i rgyan der 'dud/ /gang gi rnam par bu ram shing pa ste sangs rgyas kyi mtshan kyi mngon brjod/ ltar/ /ngo mtshar yon tan sa la 'gro ste rgya mtsho'i mngon brjod/ lta bu/ /mthong ba'i mod la skal bzang ma nu'i bu ste mi'i mngon brjod/ /bdag yid gcig min te the tshom gyi mngon brjod/ dang bral dad pas 'dud/ /khyod kyi yid tshol te mkhyen rab kyi mngon brjod/ zur phud lnga pa ste/ /dmigs med snying rje rdo rje nyi ma ste spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ ra mtshungs/ /nus pa zla ba'i thod te 'khor lo bde mchog gi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ can la 'gran pa'i/ /kun gyi zhum byed de la dad pa'i mngon brjod/ 'joms pa'i dbang por 'dud/ /lha lam ste nam mkha'i mngon brjod/ 'od ldan mi ltung ste skar ma'i mngon brjod/ bgrang yas kyang / /pad+mo'i bdag ste nyi ma'i mngon brjod/ dang grib ma'i lus lta bu/ /gzhan med de bzhin ri dwags 'phrog byed de seng ge'i mngon brjod/

ltar/ /'gran bral snyigs ma'i mun pa 'joms sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ der 'dud/ /deng sang yongs 'dzin gzhan med can lha spyi'i ming gi mngon brjod/ gyi tshogs/ /mtha' yas dbus na stobs 'jigs te lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi ming gi mngon brjod/ ji bzhin du/ /grags khyod nyi brtan te phyogs kyi mngon brjod/ kun las rnam rgyal bar/ /nyal slong ste shes rab kyi mngon brjod/ che ldan bdag gis shes nas 'dud/ /bdag blo skyes stobs sprin gyi so can ri bo'i mngon brjod/ las/ /legs 'ongs sbyangs pa'i blo gros sa'i gdub bu/ ste ut+pal gyi sngon brjod/ khyed gsung sgrogs ldan te 'bab chu'i mngon brjod/ gyis bskyed legs bshad kyi/ /dri bsung rkang drug ste bung ba'i mngon brjod/ tshim par stsol der 'dud/ /rnam dpyod rgya mtsho'i ske rags te sa gzhi'i mngon brjod/ la 'gran pa'i/ /skal bzang slob bu'i 'dab chags zhes pa bya'i ming ste 'dir ngang pa dang sbyar ro/ grangs med rnams/ /ring na gnas kyang rab byed de dad pa'i mngon brjod/ kyis bsdus pa'i/ /chos kyi rin chen 'byung gnas te rgya mtsho'i mngon brjod/ gang der 'dud/ /ye shes lnga ldan kha dog shukla dkar po/ dang / /kriṣ+ṇa nag po/ dang ni gau ser po/ ra yi mdog ha ri ljang khu/ ro hi ta dmar po/ yi mdang 'dzin pa'i/ /bhi shwa bo dhaḥ thams cad rtogs te sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ rigs lnga'i gtso der 'dud/ /gnas skabs dbyig ldan te brgya byin kyi mngon brjod/ bde la'ang ma chags shing / /gcig tu dpal stug ste sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ sgrub la gzhol ba can/ /gdul bya drang phyir mngon shis drug ldan te sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/

nyid/ /shed bu'i ste mi'i ming gi mngon brjod/ zol gyis bstan pa spel der 'dud/ /sngon sbyangs blo yis gtsug phud can te me lce'i mngon brjod/ gsal ba/ /las 'ongs rnam dpyod me yi rgyal mtshan te du ba'i mngon brjod/ can/ /kun gyis skyed byed de ma'i ming gi mngon brjod/ dang ni mngal 'dzin ma/ /lta bur gyur pa'i nyi ma'i gnyen te shākya thub pa'i mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ der 'dud/ /de ltar gu ru badz+ra dha ra bla ma rdo rje 'chang / yi/ /yon tan su bi muk+ta shin tu rnam dag bkod pa'i gtam/ /ngo mtshar a bhī mngon brjod phreng ba/ dhā na a ba li/ /'di sbyar dge bas sid+dhār+thaḥ don grub ste shākya thub pa'i mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ 'grub shog /ces chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa dad gus thugs rje'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di yang yongs su 'dzin pa chen po de nyid las chos tshul rgya mtsho'i bka' drin mnos pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos me mo yos kyi lo sa ga zla ba'i mod rdza phul+la si ta dharmā ko ṇa ta ma hā gu ṇa rat+na ka raḥshrī wan bhu mi'i dkar phyogs dga' ba'i me tog bzhad pa'i chos kyi grwa chen po yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan sa skya'i/ gnas mchog bzhi thog bla brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa maṅga la bkra shis/ 'i ming can gyis bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub nas chos srid kyi karma bistā ra bha wa tu/ 'phrin las rgyas par gyur cig shu bhaṃ ka l+yā ṇā war+dhan+tu dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig

su khash+tsa hi tā stu/ phan bder gyur cig 'dir smras pa/ mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal ba dang / /tshig gter mu tig phreng ba sogs/ /ngo mtshar mngon brjod glegs bam la/ /bag chags sad pa gang des sbyar/ /sgra rig rgya mtsho ma 'thungs kyang / /sgra yi sbyor tshul phra mo rnams/ /mthong bas shes de'i yang srid mngon/ /sgra bsgyur lo tsā ma yin nam/ /zhes nyams ldan gyi tshig smras pa la sa de wa dza saṅgu ru dharmā swa mi lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje/ khyed kyis bzod par mdzad nas/ sngon chad kyang thugs rje chen pos a dhiṣ+ṭha na/ byin gyis brlabs kyis/ da dung byang chub bar du a dhiṣ+ṭha te swahā/ byin gyis rlobs/ smras pa/ dpyod ldan mkhas pas sbyar ba'i bstan bcos gang / /ming rnams mngon brjod kyis brgyan bying che zhing / /tshig dag snyan ngag gis brgyan rna bar snyan/ /don rnams brjod bya dang 'brel rtogs sla zhing / /gcod mtshams sdeb sbyor dang mthun brjod bde ba/ /de 'dra 'byung zhes sngon gyi mkhas rnams la/ /yongs su grags mod ding sang phyogs 'dir ni/ /blo mig gsal ba ljongs 'dir re re tsam/ /sarba maṅga laṃ thams cad bkra shis/ /zhes rang nyid kyi dngos kyi bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi rtogs pa brjod pa mtshon pa tsam zhig bstan zin nas/ de dag ni ring brgyud kyi tshul rnams brjod pa yin la/ nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang ngam spyan ras gzigs la grub chen sha wa ri dbang phyug gis gsan te/ 'di ni grong khyer te te'i gar mkhan lo ki dang gu na gnyis kyi bu tsha rigs ngan glu gar gyis 'tsho ba'i ming sring gsum yod pa la/ slob dpon klu sgrub bhaṃ ga la'i ri bo na bzhugs pa la slong du phyin pas/ rigs ngan la rnam rtog ma mdzad par nang du bos kha zas mang po byin pa dang dad pa thob ste/ byang sems blo gros rin chen gyi sku'i ras bris mthong ste/

'di ci lags zhus pas/ byang sems lha'i bu tha mal pas mi mthong ba zhig yin gsungs/ bdag cag la bstan par zhu zhus pas/ spyi gtsug na yod kyi ltos gsungs/ de mthong ba'i mig gcig zhu zhus pas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur rgyud bshad gdams pa gnang / de dag gis kyang nyams su blangs pas rgyud dag nas byang sems kyi zhal mthong ste/ bram ze chen po'i do ha glur blangs nas gar byas mchod pa phul bas/ khyod kyis de'i don shes sam gsungs/ mi shes pas zhu zhus pas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs te do ha'i snying po don gyi dgongs pa bstan pas de nyid du de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa thob bo/ /der byang chub sems dpas rigs kyi bu khyod lho phyogs ldong ngar gyi ston pa sha wa ri dbang phyug bya ba yin pas 'dir ma sdod par rngon pa'i chas su zhugs la lho phyogs dpal gyi ri/ sems ngal bso ba'i ri/ yid pham par byed pa'i ri la song la dbang po yang rab rnams kyi don gyis shig ces lung bstan pa bzhin/ de rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du byas pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te ding sang gi bar du yang bzhugs so/ /'dis/ ma rig mun pa'i nags tshal du/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi ri dwags rgyu/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi gzhu brdungs nas/ /snying po don gyi mda' gcig 'phangs/ /'chi ni rnam par rtog pa 'chi/ /sha ni gnyis su med par zos/ /ro ni bde ba chen por myong / /'bras bu phyag rgya chen po thob/ /ces glu blangs so/ /'di la bla ma rdo rje gdan pas kyang / gar mkhan dpal gyi ri la bzhugs/ /lcam sring gnyis kyis dngos grub brnyes/ /sha wa ra zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod do/ /de la paṇa chen bhi bhu ta tsaṇ+ḍas gsan te/ de ni rgya gar shar phyogs pa ren+t+ra pa sgos dza gar+dha la pa yin/ rigs rgyal rigs mang pos bkur ba'i sde pa las rab tu byung /

rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen/ theg pa che chung gi chos ma lus pa la sbyangs/ khyad par du gsang sngags la mkhas/ bid khyā de wa dang / shākya shrī dang / chos 'bangs las dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa gsan cing mkhas par mkhyen nas rgyud 'grel gyi mchan mdzad/ thog mar 'jam dbyangs dang / phyis bde mchog dang dus 'khor la sogs pa yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal mjal/ shākya shrī'i phyag phyir bod du byon/ srin po rir bde mchog gi sku bzhengs/ rgya gar du thegs nas slar yang bod du phebs/ sdom gsum 'od phreng mdzad/ bod skad la shin tu byang bas 'bring mtshams rgya btags gnas su nyi ma dpal ye shes kyi brjed byang la sogs pa rang 'gyur mang po mdzad/ 'gro phan che bar mdzad nas bal por byon te/ yam bu'i s+d+yaṃ bi ha ra ka ba'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa rna ba la kṛṣ+ṇa sa ri'i rwa dung bcug pa/ de'i pags pa'i smad dkris can ras kyi 'ga' 'phyar bsnams pa/ lang tsho dar la babs pa zhig byon nas/ 'dir zhag 'ga' bsdod pa yin gsungs/ der sgra slob pa'i brang khang zhig tu bzhugs su bcug pas/ sgra slob pa ba de rnams na re/ rnal 'byor pa 'di ngo mtshar ba zhig gda'o zer nas bla mas spyan drangs te/ chos kyi gsung gling byas pas/ gang dris pa thams cad thogs pa med par byung bas/ sha wa ra yin par dgongs te yin nam zhus pas yin gsungs pa dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pa'i snying po zhig zhu zhes gsol bas/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi man ngag 'di gnang nas nga 'gro gsungs/ gar gshegs zhus pas/ nub phyogs kha cher 'gro/ las can gyi gdul bya yod/ de nas dpal gyi ri la 'gro gsungs nas gshegs te/ lar s+d+yaṃ bi ta ra gar zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhugs skad do/ /paṇa chen gyis kyang bsgoms pas dngos grub brnyes nas gzhung chung yi ger btab/

ngas dus 'khor bshad bka' dang khyad par man ngag gi bka' 'di dar ba zhig bya/ lhag par bod du phan thogs che bar 'ong bar dgongs nas/ bod kyi bya bral ba rnams la/ bod na dge ba'i bshes gnyen su che dris pas/ ko brag pa grags pa che bar gsan nas/ ko brag pa la ngas bod na dge ba'i bshes gnyen snyan pa dang grags pa su che nyan cing dris pas/ ko brag pa khyed grub thob kyi grags pa che bar 'dug nged la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bshad/ khyad par man ngag gi bka' mchog tu gyur pa yod pas sbyin gyis/ khyed bal por thag ring ba la ma rtsegs par shog 'gro phan cher 'byung gsungs pa'i gsung shog dang / de'i rten du thub pa'i rdo sku mdzad pa brgyad kyis bskor ba gcig bal po lugs kyi za 'og yug gcig ka ra'i glang po che gcig rnams paṇa chung gcig la bskur te/ ko brag pa glang gor na bzhugs pa'i sar skyel du btang byung pas/ ko brag pas/ bla ma paṇa chen gyi gsung shog gnang sbyin dang bcas pa thugs la btags/ nged gcig pu bal yul du 'ongs pas sems can la phan thogs che rgyu mi mchis/ bla ma paṇa chen nyid bod du byon na dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan phan can mang po la phan thogs che bar mchis pas/ cis kyang bod du 'byon pa zhig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhes pa'i zhu yig dang / yi ge'i rten du paṇa chen la ber thul bzang ba gcig paṇa chung rnams la bod kyi na bza' bzang ba re re/ tshur la 'byon pa'i chas ka dang bcas pa mi bdun la bskur te paṇa chen gdan 'dren du s+d+yaṃ bi ha rar btang ngo / /de nas paṇa chen 'byon gyi yod ces pa'i gtam slebs byung pa dang / ko brag pas skyi rong thub bsu ba la byon/ phyogs thams cad du'ang paṇa chen 'byon gyin yod ces pa'i grags pa sgrog tu btang / paṇa chen glang gor du phebs pa dang / bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po yang 'dus/ de rnams la dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyud bshad khrid bcas pa gnang /

khyad par du ko brag pa/ dpyal a mo gha/ nyag po chos ldan/ lho pa tshul gzhon/ mar ston g.yang 'bar/ g.yung phug pa rgyal mtshan dge ba/ gnyal mi mnyam bzang po ste slob ma dam pa bdun la sbyor drug gi gdams pa rdzogs par gnang / mi mnyam bzang pos dpe med mtsho'i sbyor drug bsgyur/ glang gor du dus 'khor gyi bka' rdzogs pa gsum mdzad pa'i rjes su/ paṇa chen la snyung ba drag po zhig byung ba la ko brag pas gegs sel mdzad pas/ paṇa chen mnyes te ko brag pa la yang paṇa chen gyis chos gsan/ lar paṇa chen gyis bod du lan gsum byon pa'i tha ma yin/ da res kyang srin po ri yan chad du byon te/ gtsang rong du rje btsun sga lo dang / gtsang stod du kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la sbyor drug gnang / rgyus pa gzhon seng dang / khang bsgom rin seng la ye shes spyan bsgrub sogs gdams pa mang po gnang / khrid kyi sgo nas gzhan phan che bar mdzad de slob ma grub thob mang du byon/ paṇa chen slar rgya gar la phebs te gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku grub bo/ /dpyal a mo gha ni/ dpyal chos bzang gi gcen po slob dpon ba stag dang / yum bkra shis dge la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba yin/ mtshan kun dga' snying por btags/ dgung lo dgu pa la grub thob niṣ+ka laṅka la kyai rdo rje'i dbang zhus/ dus de nyid rdo rje 'chang dngos su gzigs/ de dang khu bo dpyal chos bzang gnyis la bde dges gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan/ bcu bdun pa la rab tu byung / mtshan a mo gha shrī bha dra don yod dpal bzang por btags/ paṇa chen shākya shrī dang / chu mig lung pa dmar rtse dang / ko brag pa sogs las sngags mtshan nyid gzhung gdams ngag mang du gsan/ khyad par paṇa chen bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra rgya btags nas thar par spyan drangs/ skad gnyis yi ge dang bcas pa legs par bslabs/ chos mang du gsan/ phyis paṇa chen ko brag pas gdan drangs pa'i tshe sbyor drug lugs gnyis rdzogs par gsan cing bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes/

thar pa'i gdan sar gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod nas/ re brgyad pa la rje btsun seng ge sgras lung bstan pa ltar 'jig rten gyi khams pad+mo can du gshegs pas pad+mo can pa zhes grags/ paṇa chen bi bhu ta tsan+d+ra dang dpyal a mo gha gnyis la kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis gsan/ de la kun spangs chen pos gsan te/ bi bhu ta tsan+d+ra'i slob ma mar ston g.yar 'bar ni/ bi bhu ta la sbyor drug zhus nas bsgoms pas rlung dbu mar chu sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang po gzigs/ bla ma yang shin tu mnyes/ phyis gtsang thang gi se per bzhugs/ stong gzugs kho na las 'das ma 'ongs mtha' dag gzigs pa'i mngon shes dang ldan no/ /de la rnal 'byor seng ge 'bum gyis gsan te/ de ni spyir rgyud sde dang gdams ngag mang du gsan/ khyad par mar ston g.yar 'bar la sbyor drug gsan te rtse gcig bsgoms pas rtogs pa'i yon tan phul du phyin/ stong gzugs kyi ka bum la sogs pa gang rung dang bsres pas stong gzugs dang sku lus gcig tu gyur te sna tshogs su sprul nus/ bde ba can la sogs pa'i gang 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de mi shigs pa'i thig le'i nang du gzigs ma thag mngon du gyur/ spyir gnas nges pa med pa ri khrod gang dben du bzhugs shing / 'khyog dur gyi dgon par yang cung zad bzhugs pa mdzad do/ /de la kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis gsan no/ /de man chad gong du bstan pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa de rnams ni bla ma gzhan las phul du byung bas mchog gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhes bya ste/ bsdus rgyud las/ dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dkrugs pa las bu rnams kyi ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba ri bong 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par 'dir bla ma ni gnyis te/ bla ma dam pa dang bla ma dam pa ma yin pa'o/ /de dag gi sems dkrugs pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/

rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir ro/ /de la gzhan gyi don gyi phyir sems 'khrugs pa ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /gang rang gi don gyi phyir sems 'khrugs pa ni bla ma dam pa ma yin pa'o/ /de'i phyir dpal ldan bla ma'i sems dkrugs pa ni/ slob ma rnams mi dge ba bcu la 'jug pa'o/ /sems 'khrugs pa ni de'i phyir rtsa ba'i ltung bar 'gyur gyi rang gi don la 'jug pa'i bla ma mi dge ba bcu la 'jug pa ni ma yin par nges pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la zhib mor rnam par brtag par bya ste/ 'dir dpal ldan bla ma zhes bye brag tu nges par bzung na dpal ldan bla ma yin pa'i bla ma yang yod dam/ dpal ni gang / ldan pa'i tshul ni ji ltar zhe na/ dpal gyi skad dod shrī zhes bya ba dpal dang / g.yang dang / shis pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa rnams la 'jug pa de yang skabs thob kyi don du ma la 'jug kyang / 'dir ni dbang bzhi pa'i zab don la dpal zhes brjod de/ srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad sel ba'i dpal yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ldan tshul yang rnam pa gnyis te/ tshig kha la ldan pa dang / don snying la ldan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i nges don phyin ci ma log par 'chad shes pa ste mkhas pa'i yon tan no/ /gnyis pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i rtogs pa mi 'gyur pa'i bde chen thugs la 'khrungs pa ste rtogs pa'i yon tan no/ /de yang bsdus rgyud las/ sangs rgyas zhal 'di gang gi snying dang kha la gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /dbang bzhi pa'i zab don la sangs rgyas kyi zhal zhes brda mdzad pa 'di la mchog tu zab pa'i legs bshad kyi gter du ma rnam par dpyod pa rab tu dkar ba'i 'dzin mar gnas pa rnams ni snyigs ma'i 'gro ba byas pa mi bzo ba rnams la phang par bzung ba'i gter bdag gis 'khyud pa nyid kyi phyir re zhig rnam par ma spros so/ /de lta bas na bla ma ni spyi dang /

dpal ldan bla ma ni bye brag tu shes dgos la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ni de las kyang khyad par du gyur pa zhig la 'chad pa ni chos 'di pa'i legs bshad rmad du byung pa'o/ /gal te de ltar na bla ma la dpal ldan dang / de ma yin pa gnyis yod pa bzhin du/ dpal ldan bla ma la yang dam pa dang dam pa ma yin pa gnyis su 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'gyur ba yin te/ slob ma mi dge ba la 'jug na mi mnyes pa ni dam pa yin la/ rang gi rnyed bkur nyams pa sogs kyis mi dgyes pa ni dam pa ma yin pa'o/ /de ltar brgyud pa gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i bla ma dam pa de dag las 'ongs pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i lung bshad sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dus 'khor gyi chos skor rang nyid kyis ji ltar thob pa rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams rtogs sla ba'i phyir mtshan gyi bye brag so so ba dag nor bu'i phreng ba bstar la brgyus pa ltar phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te brjod na/ thog mar dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ dbang gong ma dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa sa lugs ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje snying po dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rtsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta/ /dus zhabs che chung mkhas pa dpe med mtsho/ /sā dhu su tra dharmā ka ra dang / /dharmā mi tra bi khyā ta de wa/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa rgyus pa gzhon seng dang / /dol po ye mgon kun spangs kun tu bzang / /kun mkhyen 'phags 'od bu ston rin chen grub/ /'gro mgon bsod rgyal dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ /ru pa ka bzhi slob dpon bsod grags pa/ /zha lu lo chen sa lo thams cad mkhyen/ /rat+na bha dra 'jam mgon grol mchog zhabs/ /mkhan chen shes rin spyan snga kun dga'i mtshan/

/skyes mchog de las sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag gis thob/ /ra lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang zla bzang lha dbang gzi brjid can/ /zlas sbyin lha yi dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ /lha yi dbang ldan grags pa pad dkar dang / /'jam dbyangs sprul pa tsi lu ar+ya ba/ /po to ba dang dus zhabs rnam pa gnyis/ /mañdzu kirti sa man+t+ra shrī dang / /chos rab ye shes seṅge 'bum seng dang / /sga lo shes seng dpal ldan seṅge dang / /kun mkhyen bu ston dang ni chos kyi dpal/ /dge 'dun bzang po dpal ldan legs pa dang / /nam mkha' tshul khrims dang ni bsod nams grags/ /lo chen chos skyong bzang dang sa lo che/ /rat+na bha dra 'jam mgon grol mchog zhabs/ /mkhan chen shes rin spyan snga kun dga'i mtshan/ /de las thob pa ngag dbang kun bsod do/ /yang na dpal legs don grub kun dga' dang / /thar pa bzang po lo chen yan chad 'dra/ /yang na rong pa sga lo tshul khrims dar/ dbus pa dus 'khor ba/ /ye shes rin chen shar ba dus 'khor ba/ kun spangs chen po dang / /byang sems rgyal ye jo nang yon rgyal pa/ /kun mkhyen dol po dang ni de yi sras/ /ma ti paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / /byang chub seṅge gsum kas rjes bzung ba/ /theg chen chos rje dpal legs pa man 'dra/ /yang na shes seng skyi ston grags rgyal dang / /kun mkhyen dol po man chad gong bzhin no/ /yang na jo nang phyogs rgyal dbon rgyal bzang / /rigs rnam rgyal grags pa bzang / ldan chen po shang ston kun dga' dpal/ /nam mkha' dpal bzang shes rab bkra shis dang / /byams pa shāka 'od chos dar grags 'phel ba/ /lo chen 'gyur med mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen/ /ngag dbang chos grags zhabs las sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag gis so/ /'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo zla bzang lha dbang dang / /gzi brjid can dang zlas byin lha'i dbang phyug

/sna tshogs gzugs dang lha yi dbang ldan dang / /rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags dang pad+ma dkar/ /bzang po dang ni rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang / /phyag dmar khyab 'jug sbas pa nyi ma grags/ /shin tu bzang po rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang / /rgyal dka' nyi ma sna tshogs gzugs zla 'od/ /mtha' yas sa skyong dpal skyong dus zhabs gnyis/ /zla mgon 'gro ston lo tsā dkon mchog bsrung / /rnam rtsegs yu mo dharmā shwa ra dang / /mkhas pa nam 'od grub thob se mo ga ga na bh+wa dra/ che/ /'jam gsar chos sku 'od zer kun spangs rje/ /byang sems rgyal po jo nang yon rgyam pa/ /kun mkhyen dol po man chad gong dang 'dra/ /yang na byang sems rgyal ye 'phags pa 'od/ / 'dis chos sku 'od dang kun spangs pa gnyis la'ang gsan/ kun mkhyen bu ston man chad gong bzhin no/ /yang na 'jam gsar rong pa sga lo dang / /shes seng 'phags 'od bu ston man chad 'dra/ /'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ se mo che pa bo dong rin rtse ba/ /stag sde seng rgyal gshong ston sku mched dang / /lo mchog dpal seng bu ston man chad 'dra/ /yang na lo mchog skyi ston grags rgyal dang / /kun mkhyen dol po man chad gong dang 'dra/ /yang na rin rtse 'dzin pa rin shes dang / /ye shes rin chen kun spangs pa sogs 'dra/ /yang na rin shes 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ /byang sems rgyal po man chad gong bzhin no/ /de ltar brgyud pa thams cad kyi phyag len phyogs gcig tu dril ba'i dbang rgyas par thob nas/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags bzang gis mdzad pa dang / dbang chog lo chen 'gyur med bde chen gyis mdzad pa'i lung yang thos so/ /mdo rgyud thams cad kyi nges don gyi snying po zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid nges don gyi dbang dang bcas pa thob pa'i rgyud pa ra lugs ni/

'og min gnas su chos sku rdo rje 'chang / /chos dbyings chen por longs sku dus 'khor lo/ /dha n+ye ka ṭar sprul sku shākya thub/ /sham+bha la ru chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams/ /orba sa ru tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bhaṃ ga la ru si to ā tsa r+ya/ /ba ren+t+ra ru dus zhabs chen po dang / /mañdzu de shar dus 'khor zhabs gnyis pa/ /rgya gar shar du mañdzu kriti'i zhabs/ /ye rang grong du sa man shrī che/ /ne'u me tog ldan du 'jo grags kyi sras/ ra lo shes rab dang / /khu lung se khyir ye shes seṅge ra/ /khu lung chos shing dgon par de'i sras/ 'bum seng ra/ /dben par dgon par rje btsun sga lo dang / /sham 'bar gnas su de'i sras dngos/ shes rab seng ge'i zhabs/ /dben gnas jo mtshor de'i sras/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od/ /ri phug dgon par mkhan chen bu ston rje/ /gnas mchog der bzhugs lce btsun sku zhang / nam mkha'i mtshan/ /chos grwa zha lur mkhas mchog tsan+t+ra shrī/ /bsam sdings dgon par 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan rje/ ri phug /shar chen gnas su mkhyen rab chos kyi rje/ /grwa thang chos sder lo chen chos skyong bzang / /dpal ldan sa skyar sa lo 'jam dbyangs che/ /sman sdings gnas su lo chen rat+na'i mtshan/ /chos lung byang rtser 'jam mgon grol mchog zhabs/ /jo gdan tshogs su mkhan chen rin she ba/ /lo yi dgon par spyan snga kun dga'i mtshan/ /de las thos pa sngags 'chang a nan+da'o/ /yang na chos rab lha rje dpal rgyam dang / /glo bo lo tsā dol po ye shes mgon/ /kun spangs chen po 'phags 'od man chad 'dra/ /yang na kun spangs byang sems rgyal ye dang / /mkhas btsun yon rgyam kun mkhyen dol po'i zhabs/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ /grub chen kun blo 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang / /zha lu lo chen man chad sngar dang 'dra/ /yang na sga lo man lung gu ru pur+d+ya shrī/

dang / /shes seng 'phags 'od bu ston man chad 'dra/ /yang na man lung gu ru lo grags yar lung lo tsā ba kirti bh+wa dra/ pa/ /grub pa dpal bzang mkhas btsun yon rgyam pa/ /kun mkhyen dol po man chad gong dang 'dra/ /'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rgyal rigs ldan man chad ra lugs dang 'dra/ de nas/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du dus 'khor zhabs/ /tsau rī sa ru dus 'khor zhabs gnyis pa/ /kha che'i grong du paṇa chen zla ba mgon/ /'phan yul krabs su sgom pa dkon mchog bsrung / /gnam la sgang du sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ /'o yug rgyal khab gnas su mi bskyod rdo rje mtshan dngos dad pa rgyal mtshan pa/ yu mo rje/ /g.yas ru grong chung dgon par de'i sras/ chos dbang zhabs/ /khang gsar dpal gyi dgon par nam mkha' 'od/ /pho lung sa phug gnas su se mo chos dbang gi sras gaṅga bh+wa dza/ che/ /rkyang 'dur chos grwar 'jam gsar shes rab 'od/ /ma dag dge sdings dgon par chos sku 'od/ /skyed phug bde ldan gnas su kun spangs che/ ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra mtshan dngos thugs rje brtson 'grus/ /bde chen dgon par byang sems rgyal ye'i zhabs/ /jo mo nang du mkhas btsun yon rgyam pa/ mtshan dngos thugs rje rgyal mtshan/ /sku 'bum chen mor kun mkhyen shes rab mtshan/ /mkhar chung dgon par phyogs las rnam rgyal che/ mtshan dngos chos kyi rgyal po/ /rtse chen chos grwar nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ /sho ma'i ri bor grub chen kun blo'i zhabs/ /shar chen rtse chen/ gnas su 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang / /grwa thang chos grwar lo chen chos skyong bzang / /dpal ldan sa skyar 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan/ /rat+na bha dra man chad gong dang 'dra/ /yang na kun spangs rje nas 'phags 'od dang / /bu ston lce btsun pa sogs gong dang 'dra/ /yang na 'jam gsar sga lo shes seng dang / /'phags 'od bu ston lce btsun pa sogs 'dra/

/yang na se mo che pa rin rtse ba/ /'jim pa rin she shar pa dus 'khor ba/ /jo nang kun spangs pa sogs sngar dang 'dra/ /yang na rin she 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ /byang sems rgyal ye man chad sngar bzhin no/ /nye brgyud dpe med mtsho nas brgyud pa ni/ /rdo rje 'chang chen grub chen dpe med mtsho/ /grub thob dpal 'dzin zhabs sa tu pu tra dang 'od byed lha/ /chos 'byung zhi ba grub thob nyi ma dpal/ /rin chen 'tsho dang paṇa chen bi bhu ti/ /yang na chos 'byung zhi ba grags pa'i lha/ /paṇa chen chos kyi 'bangs dang bi bhu ti/ /de yis rjes bzung ko brag bsod rgyal dang / /g.yung phug rgyal dge lho pa chos ldan zhabs/ /gsum kas rjes bzung gong lung gzhon nu dpal/ /thang pa lo tsā kun mkhyen bu ston dang / /lce btsun nam mkha'i mtshan sogs gong dang 'dra/ /yang na bi bhu ti nas a mo gha/ dpyal pad+mo can pa'ang zer/ /kun mkhyen chos 'od kun spangs chen po dang / /byang sems rgyal ye man chad ring brgyud bzhin/ /yang bi bhu ti nas g.yang 'bar dang / /rnal 'byor seng 'bum kun spangs pa sogs 'dra/ /sa skya pa chen pos sga lo la gsan pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rigs ldan dus zhabs gnyis/ /tsa mi sga lo sa skya'i bla chen rje/ /rje btsun sku mched sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ /rgyus pa gzhon seng dol po ye shes mgon/ /kun spangs chen po man chad sngar dang 'dra/ /yang na rigs ldan sprul pa'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa dang / /phyogs kyi bram ze dha ri ka pa dang / /dus zhabs che ba bo dhi bha dra'i zhabs/ /tsa mi sga lo sa chen man chad 'dra/ /nye brgyud paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rigs gsum mgon po dus zhabs gnyis/ /nā ro pa dang dpal ldan 'jigs med grags/ /paṇa chen shāka shrī dpyal ston chos bzang dang / /dpyal ston a mo gha dang kun spangs pa/

/byang sems rgyal ye kun spangs 'phags pa 'od/ /mkhan chen bu ston la sogs sngar dang 'dra/ /yang na byang sems rgyal ye yon rgyam pa/ /kun mkhyen dol po la sogs sngar bzhin no/ /sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas kha che paṇa chen la gsan pa'i srog rtsol rdo rje'i snyan brgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rigs gsum mgon po dus zhabs gnyis/ /dpe med mtsho dang 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas/ /rnam grags lha dang dad byed lha dbang dang / /kha che paṇa chen sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ /rgyus pa gzhon seng dol po ye shes mgon/ /kun spangs chen po kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od/ /mkhan chen bu ston man chad gzhan dang 'dra/ /yang na kun spangs pa nas byang sems pa/ /mkhas btsun yon rgyam kun mkhyen pa sogs 'dra/ /shin tu nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen sha wa ri dbang phyug dang / /paṇa chen bi bhu ti dang ko brag pa/ /go lung gzhon dpal thar lo nyi ma'i zhabs/ /kun mkhyen bu ston man chad sngar dang 'dra/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang chen sha wa ri/ /paṇa chen bi bhu ta dang chos sku 'od/ /kun spangs zhang dang byang sems khams pa dang / /yon rgyam kun mkhyen pa sogs sngar bzhin no/ /de ltar dngos su smos pa'i brgyud pa de thams cad dang / gzhan yang gyi jo/ tsa mi/ sga lo/ sa skya pa/ zhang tshal pa/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa la sogs pa'i sbyor drug gi man ngag thams cad gcig tu dril nas ma tshang ba med par bkod pa kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston chos rje dang / chos kyi rgyal po phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa'i thog mtha' bar dge'i khrid yig so so dang / jo nang phyogs las pas mdzad pa'i ngo sprod gsang ston rab gsal/ zha lu mkhyen rab chos rjes mdzad pa'i sbyor drug nyams su len tshul gyi yi ge lo chen 'gyur med bde chen gyis mdzad pa'i sbyor drug gi khrid yig chen mo dang po'i sangs rgyas 'char ba/ chag lo chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dus 'khor chos 'byung chen mo dpag bsam snye ma/

dus 'khor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gsar rnying mang po'i lung sogs thos shing gong du smos pa'i brgyud pa de rnams kyang thog mar dge ba bi bhu ta nas brgyud pa dang / bar du dge ba paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa/ tha mar dge ba chos rgyal rigs ldan sogs nas rim gyis brgyud pa gtso che ba yin zhes gsungs so/ /mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel chen po gshong 'gyur la/ lo tsā ba blo gros rnam gnyis kyis bcos pa'i steng nas bshad bka' thob pa'i brgyud pa dang gong ra 'bro gnyis kyi dbang gi rtsa ba'i brgyud pa dang 'dra ba las/ kho bos thos pa 'di ni rigs ldan chen po nas/ shang ston kun dga' dpal ldan/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' dpal bzang / paṇa chen shes rab bkra shis/ rje btsun byams pa shāka 'od/ thugs sras chos dar grags 'phel/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen nas brgyud pa de gtso che'o/ /yang gong gi yig cha de dag gi lung gi brgyud pa lugs gzhan ni/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen yan phal cher sngar dang 'dra ba las/ lo chen 'gyur med kyi rjes su mkhas mchog rje btsun a wa dhu ti pa/ mkhyen rab gyi dbang phyug mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ de las bdag sa skya ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis thos so/ /bu ston dang mkhyen rab chos rje'i yig cha de dag gi brgyud pa'i lugs gcig ni/ mkhyen rab rje/ rgyal mtshan rin chen/ don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling rje/ rin chen dbang phyug rin chen rgya mtsho/ bhik+ṣu ku sa li pa/ des bdag sa skya pa la'o/ /de ltar de dag gis ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa ngo mtshar dad pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to// //'dir smras pa/ zab dang rgya che'i dus 'khor chos tshul rnams/ /sham+bha la dang 'phags yul rgyas mdzad pa'i/

/chos rgyal rigs ldan dus zhabs zla mgon sogs/ /rim byon bka' drin dran pas slar yang 'dud/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ra lugs/ 'bro lugs/ sa lugs/ gsum zhes/ /sngon dus dus 'khor bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ste/ /phyis rabs jo zhal brgyud par bcas pa rnams/ /lugs 'dir bka' drin che zhes mkhas rnams sgrog /sa lugs la yang brtse chen sa skya pas/ /dpal chen sga lor gsan pa'i sbyor drug dang / /kha che'i paṇa chen drung du sa paṇa gyis/ /gsan pa'i bka' babs gsar rnying gnyis su byung / /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar rnam dbye ma rtogs pa'i/ /deng dus sa skya'i rjes 'brangs thos chung rnams/ /dus 'khor chos zhes gzhan gyi lugs srol du/ /brtags dpyad med par 'dzin 'di gad mo'i gnas/ /des na kho bo'i rjes 'brang blo gsal rnams/ /tshur byon dus 'khor dam chos byung ba'i tshul/ /legs bshad ngo mtshar dad pa'i shing rta 'di/ /slobs dang lugs 'di'i chos tshul kun rig 'gyur/ /de rjes snyoms las spangs te brgyud ldan gyi/ /bla ma sten la dbang rgyud man ngag sogs/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos tshul rgya mtsho la/ /thos bsam sgom pas rang gzhan don gnyis sgrubs/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun byang nas/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa dpag med shog /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /bdag cag 'khor bcas 'bral med lhan cig tu/ /bde ba can du pad+ma'i snying po las/ /brdzus te skyes nas sa lam mthar phyin shog /slar yang bsam bzhin skye ba len pa sogs/ /gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs thabs mkhas kyis/ /srid mtha'i bar du bstan pa spel ba dang / /'gro kun dag pa'i zhing der 'dren gyur cig /ces dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa ngo mtshar dad pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di yang /

khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rigs ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang phyug dang thugs rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po dang dbyer med pa'i bka' drin mnyam med sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas khyab bdag dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gzhan ngor dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zol gyis mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi rnam par 'phrul pa lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te ding sang dus ngan snyigs ma bstan pa'i mjug tu slebs pa'i dbang gis mchog dman gyi skye bo thams cad mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu rnams la slob 'dod lta ci smos/ gzhung lugs phyogs re ba dag la yang mthar phyin gyi thos bsam mi nus par/ lto chos lag len phra mo dag gi ngag 'don sogs rjes 'gro tsam la brten nas mi tshe dkor nag za ba'i ngang nas stong zad du skyel ba mthong zhing / lhag par bstan pa'i snying po dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos tshul rnams ding sang phyogs gang na yang dar po mi 'dug pa nas/ bdag gis brtsams pa'i chos 'byung 'di la brten nas dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan par thos bsam bsgom gsum bgyid 'dod kyi skal ldan las 'phro can re re tsam 'byung du re ba dang /

de la brten nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos tshul rnams dar rgyas kyi rgyur e 'gyur snyam pa'i gcig tu rnam par dkar ba'i blos bskul ba dang / rang nyid kyang lugs 'di la bag chags bzang po 'jog 'dod kyi bsam pas nye bar len pa'i rkyen byas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab dang / rnam thar so so nas legs bshad kyi cha blangs shing / rang gi blo gros kyis zhib tu dpyad nas bsdebs pa 'di ni/ thub dbang mya ngan las 'das nas mi lo nyis stong lnga dang bcu gcig 'das shing / rigs ldan grags pas bsdus pa'i rgyud bsdus nas stong dang brgyad brgya bcu gcig lon la/ ma kha'i yul du kla klo'i chos zhugs nas stong phrag gcig dang bcu gcig 'das shing / rigs ldan rgyal dkas nyung ngu'i rtsis mdzad nas lo brgyad brgya dang nyer dgu lon la/ de yang sham+bha lar sa snying gi sprul pa rigs ldan stobs po che byon pa'i dus yin pa las/ de yang shing mo glang gi lo la rgyal sar byon nas seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nas bzung lo bcu gcig 'das pa shing mo phag gi lo la chos 'byung 'di nyid rtsom pa'i dbu btsugs nas/ de'i lo phyi ma rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag bzhi lon pa 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi ba'i lo sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms dmar gyi dpal ldan 'phags pa'i zhabs kyi bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi drung du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas shing rnam dpyod kyi blo gros rab tu gsal bas yi ge'i 'du byed la mchog tu mkhas pa'i shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis dad gus kyi sgos mgyogs par bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di dang phyi ma'i don rnams yid la re ba bzhin 'bad med du legs par grub ste/

spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa rin po che nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu gsal bar byed cing / khams gsum gyi 'gro ba pha mar gyur pa thams cad dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can du 'dren nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig sar+b+ba saṅgu ra waḥm ma pa ti sa pa ri wa ra s+ya ā yu puṇ+ya dhan sh+tsa wat+tā ni bistā ra bha wan+tu/ bla ma dam pa thams cad kyis bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe bsod nams nar longs spyod 'phel zhing rnam par rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ bā h+ya mad+dha yeḥsar+b+ba a pak+ṣa u pa shān+tiṃ kurban+tu/ phyi dang nang gi mi mthun phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sarba sid+dhem+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ dngos grub thams cad bdag la rab tu stsal tu gsol/ sarba maṅga laṃ thams cad bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 364 a myes zhabs/ dus 'khor chos byung ngo mtshar dad pa'i shing rta/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
